title: ..kill ´em all
short_description: A dark psychological FPS that pulls the protagonist through a hostile industrial maze of close-quarters combat and stalking patrols, guided by an AI whose influence blurs the lines between help, manipulation, and truth.

title: 1.44MB RESCUE
short_description: Write Python-style code to program repair patchers and rescue a corrupting 1.44MB floppy sector by sector. Start with four commands; every file you restore unlocks loops, variables, functions and lists, until your programs bring all 1,474,560 bytes back to life. The whole game fits on one floppy.

title: 10 Million Bounces
short_description: Start with one ball and grow a mining swarm. Break ore, gain experience, and evolve six ball types with blinking, splitting, fire, and lightning. Rainbow balls learn nearby abilities. Choose where to launch and watch each bounce open new paths.

title: 10 More Minutes
short_description: Summer, 2001. Explore a Ukrainian village, help your grandfather, get to know the people who live there, and earn enough money to visit the local gaming club. A warm story about childhood, discovering video games, and a familiar world that changes as we grow older.

title: 100 Hidden Relics
short_description: Find 100 hidden relics as a renegade knight. Explore a small town and its surrounding lands in this short dark fantasy hidden-object game.

title: 100 Years Atop Mount Ellumbee
short_description: Six factions climb one mountain over a century, vying for land and the Tide of Battle. Build your economy, dominate your opponents through Battle Card duels, where Battle Cards are simultaneously revealed, and claim the Summit of Mount Ellumbee.

title: 1000 Days with My Kid's Concert Band
short_description: Your child joined the school concert band. Somehow, you ended up its director. Scold the ones who skip rehearsal and the band gets better. That evening, your child doesn't say much. Three years. Nine endings.

title: 100K ZOMBIES
short_description: 100K Zombies is a route-planning incremental tower defense. No fixed paths—place walls and firepower freely, designing the zombies' route to their doom. Build winding mazes or layered defenses. Every map is yours to create. Ready? Obliterate the 100K zombie horde!

title: 11 PM: A Minimalist Factory Game
short_description: A minimalist factory game that doesn't quite work the way you expect. Choose modules carefully, place them on your machines, and watch them drastically change how each machine produces. Build your own factory with its own rules. Optimizing it can become an obsession!

title: 1453: Fall of Constantinople
short_description: Venice, 1500. Anna Notaras takes down four testimonies of the fall of Constantinople: a janissary, a baker's daughter, an engineer and a noble, each living the same 53 days of the siege. What one witness does changes what the others can do. An illustrated, choice-driven historical novel.

title: 15 Days Zombie Survivor
short_description: 《Zombie Survivors on Day 15》 is a semi-open-ended survival game. Facing waves of zombie attacks continuously, the countdown of life begins. You must remain vigilant at all times. Fighting and evolving are the only choices for you to survive.

title: 1930: Ink & Bullets
short_description: A first-person game of 21 where losing can cost you a bullet. Use items to bend the rules, risk drawing blessed or cursed cards, and face bizarre opponents in a world inspired by 1930s cartoons. Lose all your lives and start over.

title: 1daYs
short_description: What should have been an ordinary morning takes an unexpected turn when a letter Minsu wanted to deliver changes the course of his day. 1daYs is a 2D pixel-art narrative adventure about small incidents and mysteries hidden within everyday life.

title: 20 Floors Down
short_description: Forced to descend a dark dungeon of endless horrors, you must get to the bottom to escape your torment. 20 Floors Down is a brutal top-down horror roguelite where you must manage items, manage upgrades, and survive relentless monsters in the dark. And remember... DO NOT let your light run out.

title: 2027 毕业生工作
short_description: Where should the Class of 2027 go? (This game is only in Simplified Chinese)

title: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
short_description: A hardcore first-person survival simulator. Explore a wrecked freight train, loot containers, hunt, gather resources, craft weapons and gear, and manage hunger, thirst, fatigue, and warmth to make it through 28 days of cold and predators.

title: 2D Hates 3D
short_description: A short incremental game where you play as Commander, leading a squad of flat 2D shapes against an invasion of 3D ones. Clear timed waves, collect scrap. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from squad damage to time-bending perks. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

title: 3:33 AM
short_description: Jump scares beware! At 3:33 AM your phone rings, and the dead are calling. Answer out loud with your own voice. Talk, laugh or scream, and the caller hears your room. Tell the truth and your dark bedroom changes around you. Twelve calls. One night. Try not to scream.

title: 3A 大作
short_description: The AIs from your phone suddenly appear right beside you—and it seems a conflict has broken out between them. In the game, DeepSeek—once a cooperative AI partner—suddenly turns rogue due to an unknown anomaly, becoming a force that disrupts the balance of the world.

title: 3D Bumper Billiards
short_description: Zero-gravity pool, seen through a porthole in the cue ball, because that's where you are. Fifteen numbered balls float in a sealed room with a pocket in every corner. Every shot throws you backward: it's how you get around, and how you sink yourself. Solo, vs a bot, or with a friend on one screen.

title: 47都道府県にプロ野球チームが存在する世界線で日本一の球団をめざそう！
short_description: Choose one of 48 fictional Japanese baseball clubs and run it as GM: draft, develop, set lineups and watch games. Play the opening month (27 games) free, with no time limit. Continue with the separate Full Game DLC; Data Editor DLC is optional. Japanese only.

title: 4:12 AM
short_description: December 1999, the eve of Y2K. Twelve nights as the 911 operator of a dying Pennsylvania coal town. Speak with your own voice; a fully offline local AI plays every caller. Every night at 4:12 AM the phone rings: a girl missing for fifteen years. Who lives and who is lost depends on how you answer.

title: 8 floor, only me ?
short_description: A horror game where you must identify anomalies in the environment. You’re trying to leave the building, but the 1st floor never comes.

title: 9 Layers of Hell
short_description: Carve through thousands of demons on your way down the nine layers of Hell. Combine your own spells, chase legendaries that rewrite your build and craft the perfect gear between waves. A horde survivor with the loot of an action RPG. How deep can you go?

Build a space program from one launch pad to colonies on distant moons and planets, in 2D, with real orbital physics. Design rockets, fly every mission by hand, dock stations, mine asteroids, and launch with friends in online co-op. Deorbit a moon if you want.

title: A BILLION GOLD DEBT
short_description: Grow your settlement, automate production, explore the surrounding lands, and trade with your neighbors to repay a debt of 1 BILLION gold!

title: A Baker's Dungeon
short_description: The ingredients are fighting back! Build your bakery adventuring party, battle through charming bite-sized dungeons, and turn your spoils into new characters, abilities, and upgrades. A short cozy incremental auto-battling RPG where your little heroes do the fighting while you make them stronger.

title: A Bun Above
short_description: Layers score off their neighbors: cheese melts onto the patty, tomato lifts the bacon, a full BLT multiplies the lot. Every layer adds to the score — but one greedy layer can bring the whole tower down. A physics-stacking burger roguelike deckbuilder.

title: A Cat's Little Pond
short_description: A cozy incremental game about a hungry cat and its little pond. Grow your pond, collect fish and curious creatures, unlock new skills, discover rare relics, and watch your tiny ecosystem come to life.

title: A Cube's Choice
short_description: A Cube’s Choice is a 3D platformer where you bob, weave, and use movement abilities to reach the end before the music stops. Explore abstract, song-shaped worlds and face the Wall through soft, symbolic storytelling.

title: A Game About Cutting Grass
short_description: Grab your tools and start mowing! A Game About Cutting Grass is a cozy, relaxing mowing sim where you cut lawn after lawn, upgrade your tools, unlock new zones, and play at your own pace. Relax, or chase your best times and become the fastest grass cutter!

title: A Healer's Almanac
short_description: A cozy pixel-art life sim inspired by traditional Chinese medicine. Grow medicinal herbs, examine symptoms, read the pulse, diagnose patterns, craft remedies, and care for a village through four seasons and the twenty-four solar terms.

title: A Heart-Stirring Date by Victoria Harbour: New Year's Eve at the Turn of the Millennium
short_description: 这是一款互动恋爱 + 港片商战悬疑影游。在千禧前的香港，你将扮演李洋，在失恋、追杀与资本争夺中寻找真相，你得先活下来，改变处境，也需要找到愿意与你站在一起的人。最后结局会是怎样的，我想把这个决定留给你。

title: A Knight's Fury - The Vaults of Venom
short_description: A Knight's Fury is a first-person, turn-based dungeon crawler built for one lone knight. Choose attacks to exploit each monster's weaknesses, gather loot, upgrade your gear, and venture deeper into dangerous fantasy realms—without party management or endless grinding.

title: A Little Faraway
short_description: Some days, you just need a quiet place to be. Come to a little island far away, where you can wander at your own pace, watch the sky change, and discover little wonders. No rush, no expectations, nothing you need to do. Just a beautiful place to stay awhile.

title: A Place for Every Potion
short_description: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

title: A Possum's Favorite Game
short_description: Plagued with wrath, Matthew is forced to confront the traumas of his childhood while battling with a Sinister Force.

title: A Quiet Place Between Us
short_description: A choice-driven anime romance visual novel inspired by real-life choices and their consequences. Shape Kenta and Hina’s relationship through branching dialogue and discover three different endings.

title: A Roguelike Tower Defense
short_description: Build a unique defense every run in this roguelike tower defense. Choose a hero, discover new towers, collect upgrade cards, and create powerful synergies to overcome increasingly difficult enemies and bosses.

title: A Sector Darkly
short_description: Command a ship and crew stranded far from home in this open-world space sandbox RPG. Explore, trade, fight, and craft to survive among the strange alien factions. One by one entire sectors are going dark and no one knows why. Solve the mystery of the dark sectors and get your crew home.

title: A cointoss roguelike
short_description: Let's try our luck with a coin toss. The Odds Should Be 50/50.

title: AETHERIA
short_description: A high-speed aerial roguelite where you fight massive swarms in full 360° 3D space. Fly freely, combine auto-attacks, skills, and randomized upgrades into powerful builds, and survive enemies and giant bosses attacking from every direction.

title: AFKTower
short_description: A pixel-art idle RPG docked to the edge of your screen. Your hero climbs a 10,000-floor tower while you work: 12-rarity loot, 4 classes, key-gated bosses, a deep forge and a Paragon Constellation. And it keeps earning while it's closed.

title: AFTER THE SILENCE
short_description: Alone at a remote observatory, you must manage equipment, investigate mysterious transmissions, and survive the unsettling events that follow every signal. Maintain satellites, process incoming data, explore the station, and uncover secrets hidden beyond the univers.

title: AFTERMATH: Bunker Trader
short_description: A simulation game where your bunker becomes the safe space survivors need. Trade and craft items - organize them in storage. Scavenge the surface yourself and hire personnel to send on expeditions. Become the ultimate trading hub in this post-apocalyptic world.

title: AI Apocalypse
short_description: A cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Fight the AI apocalypse with melee, magic, or rifle — 3 weapon classes, 9 build paths, 140+ cards. Every run is a new tactical puzzle of stance, distance, and deck synergy.

title: AI Clicker
short_description: Click Your Way to World Domination (Or Doom)! Welcome to AI Clicker, the only game where mindless clicking actually makes you smarter… or creates a future where AI replaces you!

title: AI Lab Tycoon
short_description: AI Lab Tycoon drops you into the infancy of the AI revolution in 2016. Starting with nothing but a check from a skeptical investor, you'll build an empire of superintelligence over the course of two decades. Can you lead the greatest technological revolution in human history?

title: AI Startup Simulator
short_description: AI Startup Simulator is a first-person business management simulation. Start in a cramped storefront, assemble your own servers, and turn client work into a growing AI business.

title: AIR EMPIRE: Airline Tycoon
short_description: 1950 — you run the world's smallest airline, dead last of 19. Hire planners to read unsurveyed markets, send negotiators to fight for slots, price every seat. Each month's ledger shows exactly why you won or lost; each December, the board judges you. An Aerobiz-inspired tycoon.

title: ALASH
short_description: ALASH is a brutal 2D action-survival game in the Kazakh steppes. Defend your yurt, craft defenses, eat besbarmak to heal, and swing between structures with web-slinging mechanics to fight off endless hordes of enemies under the hype commentary of a legendary voiceover!

title: ALL EYES ON ME
short_description: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. In this bullet heaven roguelite, their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play co-op locally or online, or join online conquests.

title: ALL GAS
short_description: ALL GAS is an endless traffic-weaving roguelike experience on a highway that crumbles behind you as you drive.  Upgrade your vehicle and modify your environment in real-time as you weave through traffic.  Find your line, stay in the flow, and earn your spot on the global leaderboards.

title: ALL OUT WAR
short_description: ALL OUT WAR is an autobattler RTS, where you create the army, and the units fight autonomously! There are many different robots at your disposal, each with their own designs and quirks. The secret is choosing the right units at the right time, to obliterate the enemy.

title: ALL-HU: Mahjong Puzzle
short_description: Every hand must win. ALL-HU is a single-player mahjong puzzle with every tile face-up: read the wall, plan each draw and discard, and guide two — or four — hands to victory at once. 1,100+ solver-verified puzzles, including Steam-exclusive Gambit mode. No luck, no in-app purchases: pure tile logic.

title: AMEN: MAYHEM
short_description: A game where players just kill each other. Up to 12 fighters, top-down pixel art, lots of blood. Whatever the dead leave behind is yours to take. Inspired by the deathmatches in Nox.

title: AMERICAN LIFE SIMULATOR
short_description: A happy North American neighborhood awaits you! Play solo or with up to 9 friends. Build your crew, take on jobs around the neighborhood, earn money and buy houses. Create your own cash flow and happily build your real estate empire!

title: ANIMITE -Echoes of the Chasm-
short_description: Dive the Chasm: think, fight, scavenge, and get back out alive. A survival tactical RPG that switches between real-time exploration and turn-based combat. Your wolf, and the elemental reactions under your feet, are what get you out of a bad spot.

title: APARTMENT 001
short_description: You awaken inside an unknown facility and must explore its mysterious spaces in order to recover your lost memories. Gather clues, follow the records and procedures left behind by the Bureau, and overcome the threatening anomalies that stand in your way.

title: AQUA FALL
short_description: Slide, fly, and crash in! Aqua Fall is a chaotic party race where up to 8 players tear down a water slide. Shortcuts off the course are the key to victory. Dive into the pool at the finish and compete for first place! Public matches and bot battles are easy to jump into.

title: ARCHIVE ZERO
short_description: In Cold War Britain, you will work through lost reports, photographs, letters, and artifacts as they arrive at the archive. Most seem routine. Some don’t. Follow the details, connect the cases, and decide what is worth digging into.

title: ARCHIVIST: Tidy Up & Sort
short_description: A first-person archive work simulator. Sort through boxes of documents, arrange files on the shelves, and bring order to the archive by following its filing rules. Handle stacks of records, keep each section organized, and enjoy the satisfying process of restoring order step by step.

title: ARCHSCROLL
short_description: An indie action RPG set in a fantasy world. Experience a deep storyline and immersive action featuring beautiful characters and environments!

title: ASANA Visual Novel
short_description: A sci-fi dark comedy visual novel with English voices. Build your stats, choose branching routes, and try live AI conversations and persuasion challenges as Captain Asana. N.E.K.O., your judgmental cat-shaped ship AI, has opinions. He is still not impressed.

title: ASTERIS
short_description: A 1–4 player action roguelite with MMO-style co-op raids. Reshape each of 33 active skills in 24 ways, take a god's form and unleash its ultimate, then push into endless Rifts. Your gear and growth stay after every run.

title: ASTERSTEAD
short_description: Mine. Process. Circulate. Stabilize. Build an unmanned planetary base capable of surviving every test before humanity takes its first step onto the surface.

title: AT THE READY
short_description: A Wild West quick-draw duel: wait for the signal, then draw, aim and fire. Play 1v1 or three-way standoffs, let a friend call the shots as Signal Caller, or race your own Shadow and challenge records from friends and players worldwide.

title: ATC: Tower & Ground
short_description: Real Spanish air traffic control. Vector arrivals through storms and windshear, run the taxiways, and keep your nerve when an engine fails on the takeoff roll. Real procedures, real data, pilots that answer back. All of Spain, one airport at a time.

title: ATTAQ Arcade Collection
short_description: A collection of complete, punchy games packed inside a tactile desktop launcher. You start at an old computer, with floppy disks scattered across the table. Pick one up, drag it into the drive, and boot the game. A tiny ritual before jumping into another world.

title: Abductables
short_description: An incremental roguelite in a vintage sci-fi comic. Pilot a flying saucer, beam up whole crowds of farmers, cows, cops and soldiers, stack them for huge combo payouts, and bank permanent upgrades before the army fills the sky. Every run sends a stronger saucer back to Earth.

title: Abjure
short_description: Win by emptying your hand. Abjure is a roguelike deckbuilder where the 2 of Spades reigns supreme — draft cards, stack relics, and outplay every opponent in a strategic twist on the Big 2 card game.

title: Abyss Card Legend
short_description: Clear stages for god-tier gear, sacrifice to summon the Boss! In Abyss Card Legends, resurrect the ultimate Demon King with your own hands and claim the most game-breaking loot!

title: AbyssMachine
short_description: AbyssMachine is a chaotic action Roguelite where a single button press can completely turn the tide of battle. Combine wildly imaginative skills to tackle increasingly difficult levels, transforming simple inputs into chain reactions of devastating destruction.

title: Abyssal Hollow
short_description: Plant strange seeds, grow adorable little horrors, and choose their fate: raise them as battle companions or harvest them for potions. Delve into the Abyss, battle cursed creatures, discover rare seeds, and strengthen your haunted garden through growth, crafting, and dungeon runs.

title: Abyssal Moonlight-Chapter1
short_description: No light. No names. Only numbers. In the lowest city of the deep, a boy raises forbidden jellyfish to buy his friend's dream — and every choice can end the story.

title: Abyssfall: The Black Citadel
short_description: Abyssfall: The Black Citadel is a dark fantasy tower defense game where you build defenses, control a battle mage in real time, and gamble on a tabletop-inspired d20 Fate Dice system against waves of abyssal monsters.

title: Across Crime
short_description: A deduction game where every case challenges you to uncover who committed the murder, with what, and where. Step into the shoes of Leah Sharp, a detective working for an agency that uses neural synchronization to send its investigators into reconstructed crime scenes across time and space.

title: AdorableCat
short_description: A cozy and relaxing desktop companion game filled with adorable cats. Welcome a variety of cats into your family, care for them, and enjoy everyday life together.

title: Advancing Legion
short_description: This is a relaxing idle auto-battler game.Starting as a lone hero, gradually recruit powerful subordinates to form a mighty legion, upgrade powerful abilities, and then conquer the entire world.

title: Aer Isles
short_description: Rise, knight. Reclaim the skies you were once promised. alone or with up to four friends. Cross ever-changing floating isles, survive chaotic encounters, gather Power, and strengthen your Bonk. Conquer the Aer Isles, or knock each other back trying.

title: Aera in the Ink Realm
short_description: Enter cursed books, fight broken stories, and rescue five lost friends in a dark fantasy action RPG.

title: Aetherantis Realm of Fates
short_description: Aetherlantis is a turn-based strategy board game blending resource gathering, territory expansion and fate cards. Explore the floating continent via dice rolls, construct settlements and cities, and turn matches around with fate cards. Enjoy couch tabletop gameplay with up to four local players.

title: Aethyr Idle
short_description: An idle RPG with the build depth of an MMO. Pick one of four classes, climb a talent tree into one of twelve specializations, and write the spell rotation your hero fights with. Then dig into crafting, elements, Mythic+ dungeons and an endless Abyss. It runs while you're away.

title: After All Is Abraded: A Study on Disappearing Completely
short_description: Explore surreal, fractured spaces, recover traces of someone who disappeared, and piece together a story of disappearance in a first-person psychological horror game. Episode 1 of a planned trilogy, made by a solo developer.

title: After Hue
short_description: After Hue is a charming puzzle platformer starring an adorable chameleon on a grand adventure! Shift colors, phase through obstacles, and unravel the mysteries hidden within every hue!

title: Aftergrowth
short_description: A top-down survival game for one to five. Wake with nothing, research your way from a stone axe to steel, build and upgrade a camp worth defending, and follow the road east to one of two endings. The other survivors keep a ledger of what you do to them.

title: Against the Horde
short_description: A PvE roguelike deckbuilder where you can customise your deck with thousands of unique cards. Upgrade, draft, and buy new cards to field a respectable army on unique battlefields that favour tactical movement and card play. Master the five factions and stand Against the Horde.

title: Age of Failon - Birth of the Hero
short_description: Age of Failon is a turn-based dark fantasy strategy RPG where exploration and battle drive your progression. Build your army through adventure instead of weekly creature spawns, develop your stronghold, unlock spells and lead your hero through a massive 30-chapter campaign with 6 playable realms.

title: Ages TD
short_description: Spear towers become balistas, balistas become railguns. Defend one world through three ages as it grows around your towers - and find out why the horde keeps returning. A story-driven tower defense about a world worth 800 years of war, and the Reaper who farms it.

title: Agile Team
short_description: Agile Team is a humorous narrative business management game where you step into the role of a Product Owner. Focus on the human side of software delivery: conflicting priorities, executive misunderstandings, office politics, sprint compromises, and the absurdity of modern software development.

title: Airspace Master
short_description: Control both skies and ground in a complete ATC experience. Manage arrivals, departures, and taxi operations while maintaining Operational Integrity. Dynamic weather, a day/night cycle, multiple airports, and unique challenges.

title: Aiya Desire
short_description: Exploration × Rhythm Game × Horror Adventure?! After her mother dies and her father disappears, Aiya heads to Sentinel Radio Tower. Explore, solve puzzles, talk, flee a relentless pursuer, and survive 2-button rhythm boss fights. Did HC, the Harmony Chip, end the Infection Panic—or hide a secret?

title: Ake no Yosuga - Twilight Loop
short_description: At 5:00 PM, she always dies. No matter how many times time rewinds, her death repeats. Relive the same day, uncover the truth, and defy her fate in this time-loop psychological horror adventure.

title: Akuro and Bahaku VS Pollution Monsters
short_description: Brick-building auto-battle Roguelite. Pick a character, explore random labyrinths, collect Combat Bricks to boost stats and Legendary Bricks with special effects. Dozens of enemies, a corruption system, multiple endings, and exclusive Defeat CGs for every character-monster combo.

title: Alchemist's Books: Sorting the Old Alchemist's Storage
short_description: Discover 2,532 unique potions, learn their recipes, and organize the old alchemist's shelves. Restore order to the forgotten storage, one potion at a time.

title: Alchemy Duel
short_description: Alchemy Duel is a card game that combines elements of alchemy and roguelike gameplay. Alchemize monsters suited to the situation and unleash powerful combos by making use of synergies between your cards!

title: Aldmark Calls for Aid
short_description: A medieval siege-defence strategy game where a rival crown comes for your city. Command your troops on the walls and in the field, and between rounds light beacons to choose which allies will march to your aid. Win or lose, every battle earns renown to make Aldmark stronger.

title: Alembix TCG
short_description: Brew the periodic table into a card game. A free-to-play alchemical TCG where every creature is an element and every fusion is a real reaction.

title: Alien's Fridge
short_description: Fight for control in Alien's Fridge: A physics-based horror roguelike where aliens don't just attack – they physically dominate you. One slip sparks fear, one misstep makes it clear.

title: All Night Ascension
short_description: A cultivation backpack auto-battler. Arrange methods, artifacts and materials on three Bagua rings, then watch your flying swords and cannons fight. Five sects are planned for the Early Access launch. Try Tianhe and Qianji in the free demo.

title: All Peaceful at the Adventurer`s Guild Today.
short_description: All Peaceful at the Adventurer's Guild Today is the ultimate tiny idle RPG, designed to fit neatly at the bottom of your desktop. Just leave it running on the side of your screen, and watch your very own guild grow. Become the Guild Master and build a guild that's truly yours!

title: Alpha 7: The Last Hope
short_description: One-click evasive & defensive bullet hell. Interact with the environment and prove your reflexes to survive the greatest space mission in the year 2075 to save humanity from the reptilian invasion.

title: AmaTisMo
short_description: A visual novel about mental health, depression, and self-love. Play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in isolation, as she begins a journey she never asked for. Every choice shapes the story. Fully accessible for blind and visually impaired players.

title: Amateur Football Together
short_description: 5v5 cage football with your mates. Everyone controls one player, AI keepers guard the goals and bots fill empty spots. Pass, cross, dribble and shoot under the sunset lights. Quick matches, quick chat, no offsides.

title: Amazing Slot Survivor (A.S.S.)
short_description: Spin the slot machine and see how powerful you'll become! Luck shapes your arsenal, but only skill keeps you alive in this high-stakes bullet heaven roguelite. Master unique weapons and destroy the Spawners summoning endless hordes, and push your luck to the limit.

title: Amberfall: Village Defense
short_description: A medieval fantasy village builder and auto battler. Gather resources, expand your settlement, and build a force of warriors, archers, and mages to face monster waves. When your village falls, spend earned Skulls on lasting upgrades and return stronger.

title: American Gold Rush
short_description: Dahlonega, Georgia. 1829. You've got a shovel, a day's food, and a hole in the ground that gets richer the deeper you're willing to go. Every step and every swing costs energy and daylight, so the real game is deciding when to push one more swing of the axe, and when to climb out.

title: Among Paws
short_description: Who stole the fish? Among Paws is a cozy 4-8 player social deduction party game where sneaky cats steal fish at night, accuse each other by morning, and race to be the first 5 kg champion. No eliminations, no waiting.

title: An Unreasonable Number of Zombies
short_description: Push your luck in a city overrun by zombies. Every district is a different fight, with its own rules and its own way to lose. The longer a run goes, the more you can earn.... and the worse things get.

title: An-pêng: Still Here
short_description: After China's air raids, everyone in Anping was evacuated. You stayed. A ten-floor apartment with no power, someone who couldn't be bothered to leave, and a fridge of food gone bad. Cards decide where the time goes: search, move, eat, sleep. No base to hold, no breaking out. Just one more day.

title: Ancient Duel
short_description: Ancient Duel is a free-to-play historical turn-based strategy card game. Build 40-card decks, combine ancient factions, position units and commanders, and outplay opponents in tactical 1v1 battles where timing, energy and formation matter.

title: Andrea
short_description: Andrea is a crafting-driven roguelike RPG, featuring a unique equipment crafting system and a highly variable talent tree. Your goal is simple: grow as strong as you can and defeat the final boss. Survive if you can — death resets everything, but every run stays with you.

title: Andromeda Wars
short_description: Andromeda Wars is a retro styled space RTS. In Andromeda Wars you must gather power, build a fleet, build defences to defend your mothership, and try to survive the onslaught from the opposing factions. Each ship you add to your fleet gives you powers but also reduces your dwindling resources.

title: Angel Guardian
short_description: Angel Guardian is a sci-fi side-scrolling action shooter set in a space station under attack. Play as Kita, a warrior guardian on a mission to rescue the young prince while fighting hostile enemies. Use shooting, stealth and hacking to face powerful bosses and prove yourself as a true guardian.

title: Animal Clicking
short_description: Animal Clicking is a cute, cozy island builder that blends farming, automation, and resource management with the addictive gameplay loop of clicker games into a completely new sandbox experience.

title: Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
short_description: Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats is a hidden object game where you race against time to find 100 cats hidden across the world's most iconic locations. Spot the cats, click carefully, use hints wisely, and climb to the top of the global leaderboard.

title: Anomagram
short_description: Anomagram is a horror set on a night shift moderating a short-video feed. More slices of someone else's ordinary life arrive each night, and you approve or report each one. Some videos are not normal. The anomaly doesn't stay inside the video. It reaches the terminal, and you. Eight nights.

title: Anomaly Express
short_description: Anomaly Express is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror aboard a winter train. Spot anomalies, survive deadly encounters, and uncover the supernatural force behind this endless journey.

title: Anomaly Grid
short_description: Anomaly Grid is a turn-based strategy puzzle game about numbers, colors, and control. Capture tiles, merge units, spend score on upgrades and abilities, and outplay an escalating AI before the grid collapses.

title: AnomalyVault
short_description: Anomaly Vault is an industrial sci-fi horror simulation in which you become an employee of APC, the last corporation remaining in a dystopian world. Analyze unidentified anomalies, construct automated processing facilities, and survive incidents that spiral beyond control.

title: Another Black Hole Incremental
short_description: Begin as a fragile singularity, devour matter, reform after collapse, and spend permanent Radiation on a branching constellation of upgrades. Master short, high-pressure runs, break cosmic defenses, and grow powerful enough to consume the Galactic Core.

title: Another Map Simulator
short_description: Be the architect and the audience of a living, breathing fantasy world. Generate vast procedural maps, paint your empires, and watch as autonomous AI nations wage war, forge alliances, and build deep economies. Intervene as an active god, or sit back and watch centuries of history unfold.

title: Ant Mill Inc
short_description: Feed the nest. Grow the swarm. Devour the world. A dark incremental ant colony game where one ant becomes thousands. Gather food, upgrade the nest, uncover strange offerings, and fight for survival. Face the HUNGER - or become it...

title: Antarctic Showdown
short_description: Kill your friend! Antarctic Showdown is a 1v1 roguelike shooter. Grow stronger with every defeat and claim victory!

title: Antique Dealer
short_description: A turn-based strategy card game of real and fake antiques. Test your knowledge by spotting fakes, if you wish. Adapt to changing demand and prices, take calculated risks, and finish with the most silver. Between games, unwind with idle collecting: 600+ antique cards spanning ten Chinese dynasties.

title: Ants TD
short_description: Thousands of ants race for your nest. Dig the paths they follow, block shortcuts with barricades and lure the swarm with fruit, then shoot, burn and blow it all up in a chaotic tower defense.

title: Ants in Space!
short_description: A roguelike strategy game where you evolve and mutate your space ants to repel an invasion of asteroid termites! Combine fast-paced exploration of tiny planets with spaceship travel across the galaxy. Find the ultimate ant DNA combination to withstand the unstoppable force.

title: Anvilia
short_description: Cozy crafting meets chaotic fantasy adventure. Forge every tool by hand with friends, open your shop and serve customers while your dog chases thieves. Then step through the portal into living caves and forests full of rare loot and monsters. Mine it, forge it, sell it, explore deeper. Repeat.

title: Anxiety Mori
short_description: A short first-person psychological horror game about trauma and anxiety. Explore a fractured world where memory and reality blur, experience puzzle narrative, and uncover what happened to a man who lost everything. Around 1 hour of playtime.

title: Anything Goes Derby
short_description: A party game where horse racing meets a classic naming game! Name your racehorse to fit the theme, and the name alone decides its stats. Bet on a 3D race with commentary that calls out your horse's name. Play solo, against strangers in Random Match, or with up to 64 people including spectators.

title: Anywhere RPG
short_description: An AI-directed RPG that unfolds in real time.

title: Apocalipsis Survivor
short_description: In the first worlds the infected just walk at you. In the fourth they start shooting back. An action survivor across 10 worlds: pick your hero, upgrade your weapons on the fly and hold off ever denser hordes all the way to the alien source of the plague.

title: ApocalypseHQ
short_description: Lead a survivor headquarters after the zombie outbreak in this turn-based management strategy game, where each turn represents one day. Allocate scarce people and supplies, restore territories and infrastructure, and expand through research and high-risk external operations.

title: Apotheosis Engine
short_description: Lost in the void, a space probe awakens to a mind it was never designed to possess. Apotheosis Engine is a lore-rich incremental game about exploring an alien operating system and growing from a simple probe into a digital deity.

title: Apparatus Inspector
short_description: Apparatus Inspector is a retro OS horror simulation where you are locked underground evaluating synthetic AI robots for anomalies. Chat with infected bots, execute commands, deliver judgement, and hide from physical threats to survive your 5-day shift.

title: Aqua Factory Simulator
short_description: Harvest and farm aquatic commodities, build and automate your factory, and turn the commodities into valuable products. Run the store automatically, expand your operation, optimize your production, and team up with friends in co-op to build and manage your growing aquatic business.

title: Aquarium Days
short_description: Aquarium Days is a cozy fish-collecting game with 60 adorable species, 117 appearances, and 18 aquarium scenes. Keep your aquarium in a small window on your desktop, or set it as an animated wallpaper.

title: Arcade & Motel Simulator Together
short_description: Run a neon-lit roadside motel with an arcade next door. Haggle with guests, play 13 fully playable arcade games, open a bowling alley, cook burgers, hire staff and run it all from your retro tablet, solo or in online co-op with voice chat for up to 4 players.

title: Arcade Park Islands: Rides & Minigames
short_description: Explore a colorful arcade park with a relaxed island vibe, among palm trees, rides and minigames. Anytime, jump into one of 15 action-packed games with online highscores, from fairground fun to dinos and pirates. Online, roam the islands with up to 3 friends and play selected games together.

title: Arcade Warlord
short_description: A business strategy tycoon set in the 80s arcade boom, where your company exists on the map. Develop hit games, command a workforce of specialist Agents, move cabinets and cash across the city, and compete for strategic locations while managing the logistics of expansion.

title: Arcana Rift: Tactics
short_description: Arcana Rift: Tactics is a turn-based tactical strategy game where Swords, Wands, Cups and Pentacles become battlefield units. Recruit your forces, craft equipment, summon powerful Arcana and destroy the enemy Tower in strategic offline or online battles.

title: Arcane Abyss
short_description: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.

title: Arcane Circuit
short_description: ARCANE CIRCUIT is a dark fantasy deck-building roguelite. Socket Core Cards into Emitters, chain Modules together, and create fully automated arcane circuits. Explore the wastelands, collect powerful Relics, and build your very own spell-slinging machine gun!

title: Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure
short_description: Ilenor the Brave's cat Shadowtongue has been catnapped! Run, jump and blast through 36 levels in this retro inspired DOS-style pixel platformer to get Shadowtongue back, plus his stolen wand, cauldron and diamond. Try the free demo!

title: Arcane Survivors
short_description: Write your own spells by joining a verb to a noun. ArcaneSurvivors is a horde-survival roguelite set in a library that is falling apart. Build from 1,008 combinations, gamble your sanity for stronger runes, and survive 20 minutes.

title: ArcaneBound
short_description: ArcaneBound is a pixel-art bullet heaven action RPG. Collect familiars, defeat hordes of monsters, gather rare cards, level up, and create increasingly devastating builds.

title: ArcheAge Chronicles
short_description: Explore Auroria, a vast and vibrant world brimming with rich lore and thrilling action. ArcheAge Chronicles delivers an immersive experience that will capture players' hearts, whether they are newcomers to the setting or seasoned adventurers.

title: Archronica
short_description: Stack Blessings and unleash Resonance in a deliberate card battler fought on a 2×3 grid. Build two-element decks, awaken your Legends, and follow the Awakened from the Prologue through Chapter 2. Battle the characters you meet or your friends online. Every card is earned by playing — no paid packs.

title: Arctic Roll
short_description: Embark on a relaxing turn-based tactical roguelite adventure. Lead your team of explorers, face dangerous encounters, uncover mysterious artifacts, and unravel the secret behind a strange signal.

title: Arena Blast
short_description: Arena Blast is a fast-paced third-person shooter that throws Steam, Android, and iOS players into the same arena. Pick your weapon, customize your look, gather your friends, and cause trouble across different game modes. Making a plan is optional. Sticking to it is rare.

title: Arena of Realms
short_description: Arena of Realms blends auto-battling, team building, and tournament management. Recruit fighters, train your roster, and combine equipment and relics to win a 16-team double-elimination tournament. Scout rivals, place wagers, and compete solo or in multiplayer.

title: Arena of the Forge
short_description: Fight. Loot. Forge. Repeat. Arena of the Forge is a pixel art endless arena battler. Fight through waves of enemies and bosses to collect and forge stronger gear in the Arena or enter the Onslaught for a boss rush experience.

title: Arisen Force: Vonimir
short_description: Gather allies, fight the shadows, and uncover the secrets of Vonimir. In a land of pixel beauty and epic battles, your legend begins.

title: Arkney: The Bone Road
short_description: A handcrafted pixel action RPG. Fight living-world hordes, hunt roaming golden beasts, gather and forge your gear, and walk the Bone Road across three chapters, solo or in 2-player online co-op with a friend. Every hit counts, and death always costs you.

title: Army Troop Remastered
short_description: Brings the classic Army Troop to life with immersive 4K graphics and enhanced realism. This complete overhaul redesigns every sound, music, effect, UI, animation, and 3D model with stunning 4K textures. Supports up to 24 players, online PvP, and offline PvE with AI bots and preserved progression.

title: Arrownomics
short_description: Arrownomics is a short incremental game about shooting arrows. Hire archers, build and upgrade targets, unlock new abilities, and boost your income.

title: Ashen Throne
short_description: A free-to-play, top-down action MMORPG. Play as a Warrior, Wizard or Taoist, explore dungeons and hunt bosses with friends. Find and craft equipment, develop your skills, and join your guild in battles for territory and Ashen Castle.

title: Ashigaru Tactics
short_description: Ashigaru Tactics is a turn-based hex tactical combat sandbox game, set in Sengoku-era Japan. Assemble a squad of mercenaries and fight, survive, and kill in a land ravaged by clan wars, bandit incursions, and whispers of Yokai emerging.

title: Ashrose Manor - A Portrait of Forbidden Love
short_description: Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love is a first-person gothic mystery about memory, loss, and a love the Ashrose family tried to erase. Explore a forgotten manor, uncover hidden clues, restore a damaged portrait, and reveal the truth behind Julian Vale’s disappearance from history.

title: AsterMaster
short_description: A beat-driven roguelite shooter on a hex grid. Bosses and elites are clouds of thousands of glowing shards: every hit carves a real crater, strip the plating and parts tear off. Everything moves on the beat. Stack weapon mods, break bosses, haul your ore back out alive. Steam Deck friendly.

title: Astral Boost
short_description: A little nostalgia. A lot of "just one more run." Inspired by the golden age of Flash games and classics, Astral Boost brings back the simple joy of chasing high scores and seeing how far you can push your limits. Build momentum, ride the clouds, and launch yourself into space. How far can you go?

title: Astralight: Pilgrim's Duel
short_description: A fantasy card game where a deck-building roguelike meets a TCG. Draft a deck, explore branching dungeon maps, collect relics and defeat hero bosses, or build your collection and duel with a 30-card deck.

title: AstroPoly
short_description: A pixel-art space mining game. Dig into procedurally generated planets, chart your own route across the star map, collect rare ores, level up your gear, and grow your fortune by investing in the market.

title: Astromino
short_description: A roguelite battle against cosmic evils - drop customized polyominoes, collect relics, and execute powerful combos to defeat your enemies!

title: At Once, My Lord!
short_description: The battle of Kor’Vhar is over. The heroes are gone, at least the ones who made it. Now someone has to clean up the mess... Guess who. Collect over 10,000 remains, toss them into the dimensional recycling container, earn Lord Shellborn’s respect, and maybe he’ll reveal himself.

title: Atom By Atom
short_description: Build a factory around a black hole. Extract elements, route atoms through Matter Tubes, bond them using valence-driven chemistry, and scale precise molecular production lines atom by atom.

title: Aubelys
short_description: Play as the leader of a light fantasy town. Your character gather resources, raise a five-tier settlement, recruit and specialize fellow villagers, and defend against nightly raids in solo, online co-op, PvP, or local split-screen as you push back against the dark spreading in the land of Aubelys.

title: Audiospeed
short_description: AudioSpeed is an audio game centred on high-speed races between spaceships. Totally accessible for blind players. In the far future, pilots race not cars, but starships on a number of orbital tracks.

title: Augment Mahjong
short_description: A single & multiplayer game blending Riichi Mahjong with a rule-breaking Augment system. Acquire cards each round to override the board's rules. Combine System Overrides and your Augments to create powerful synergies! Enjoy this thrilling variant with friends or sophisticated AI.

title: Aurora: Firebreak
short_description: Break through self-replicating warforms in fast neon expeditions, evolve a new ship build every flight, recover lost technology, and rebuild humanity's last uncorrupted fleet across a branching campaign for survival.

title: Auto Empire Tycoon
short_description: Start in the 1950s with a small factory and a single dealership. Research new technologies, design cars, manage production, keep your dealerships stocked, and outpace your rivals to build your own automotive empire in this isometric tycoon simulation.

title: Auto Squad RPG
short_description: An auto-battler RPG where you cultivate and evolve heroes and monsters. Evolve your units to unlock new potential, and combine diverse heroes and equipment to build the ultimate formation. Explore dungeons, farm powerful gear, and assemble your very own elite squad!

title: Autobus - The Card Game
short_description: Race to empty your main pile in this fast-paced multiplayer card game for 2–4 players. Stack cards on shared build piles, outmaneuver your opponents, and be the first to go out. Play solo or online via Steam.

title: Avalon Jewels 3 Collector's Edition
short_description: Restore the magic of Avalon in a fantasy Match-3 adventure! Battle the Shadow King's minions across 250 handcrafted levels, explore enchanted realms, master magical powers, and choose between Relaxed or Puzzle Mode as you save the kingdom from darkness.

title: Aveos
short_description: Rediscover the classic feel of linear ARPGs in Aveos! Explore four unique levels with multiple stages, hundreds of unique items, and ongoing quest updates! Explore the world, find your own play style, and take on challenges alone or with friends in a new, unusual world.

title: Avian Deity
short_description: This world’s mahjong is actually a medium for summoning ultra-powerful familiars?! A mahjong spirit who crossed over from another world, together with a beckoning lucky cat, will set you on your path to becoming the Avian Deity!

title: Aviator: Airline Empire
short_description: Build a global airline empire from the dawn of the Jet Age into the future. Connect 120+ cities on an interactive world map, command iconic aircraft, and outsmart rivals in this turn-based strategy sim. Features solo campaigns, an Open Skies sandbox, and 2–4 player local hot-seat multiplayer.

title: Awoken
short_description: Awoken is a story-rich fantasy RPG with real-time pausable combat, developed solo by a veteran developer as a long-running passion project. Investigate a magical disaster that created a dangerous Zone, explore five regions, recruit up to three companions, and shape the world through your choices.

title: Axomorph Idle
short_description: Axomorph Idle, an idle biogentics game about evolving an axolotl from a cell to an ultimate axolotl form. Journey through an idle adventure through growth, expansion, mutation, and transcendence stages. If you love numbers, or axolotls, this game might be it for you. Try it out today for free!

title: Azzog's Idle Asteroid
short_description: A cozy idle game that lives on your desktop. Every 25 minutes, Azzog interrupts your focus with a fun choice or important decision. Watch him fish, mine, fight, explore, and relax while you work, study, or unwind.

title: BACKBITE
short_description: Snake, but as a duel. Two snakes, one board and five powers to sabotage each other. And dying first doesn't mean losing: the one who ate more wins, not the one who survived.

title: BACKROOMS: REALITY FAILURE
short_description: BACKROOMS: REALITY FAILURE is a first-person psychological horror game where your first day at work becomes a nightmare. Explore a distorted office complex, uncover mysterious letters, and find a way out as reality begins to fall apart around you.

title: BAD STUDENT LOVE
short_description: Labeled a “troublemaker,” you transfer to the worst high school. There, you become entangled in dangerous relationships driven by desire, jealousy, and manipulation. Will you get closer, be used, or get hurt— your choices will determine how your story with them ends.

title: BALLRENA
short_description: BALLRENA is a physics-driven build-crafting auto-battler roguelite. Choose a Core, buy, rotate, and merge oddly shaped parts, then fit them into a tight 5×5 grid. Send your custom ball into the arena and watch every collision, weapon trigger, and chain reaction put your decisions to the test.

title: BATTLE: PARTS & POWER
short_description: Build robots, equip factories and defend your headquarters in a strategy auto-battler. Collect parts, refine your army and take on Campaign, Endless Solo, co-op Duo or a Duel with a friend.

title: BE QUICK! The Rise of Fraya
short_description: A cinematic QTE boss rush built around reflexes and precision. Track moving targets, maintain your combo, develop eleven attributes and guide Queen Fraya through 17 champions to challenge the god Mayinalli.

title: BECOME LIFE
short_description: A single-player narrative survival experience set in the abandoned landscapes of Gargano, Italy. Explore, endure, and uncover what happened after the disappearance where every choice leaves a mark.

title: BLOK 200: Prologue
short_description: A visual novel in the Samosbor setting. You are a student of the technical college who wakes up in a stranger's hab-cell after your own death. You must come to terms with your new grim nature and face the cruel world far from the walls of your native incubator block.

title: BOB LOGISTICS
short_description: Welcome to Bob Company! Fill orders, haul goods, and make work easier with automation. Rise from Intern to Director in a relaxing first-person warehouse sim. Each promotion opens new areas of the company and reveals more of the stories behind it.

title: BOMBACON!
short_description: A blind pig, a mute pig, and a deaf pig. A BOMB about to explode! BOMBACON! is a chaotic 3-player co-op bomb defusal game that tests your friendships in the most absurd way. Grab your radios, set up your communication chain, and open the briefcase before time runs out. Or you're all bacon!

title: BONEYARD BOUNCE!
short_description: Fire spell-balls from all four paddles and clear the graveyard of monsters! Block breaking, evolved into a monster shooter. Hit a weakness and the blast chains through walls, taking the whole horde with it. Fun even with bad aim. Escaped monsters strengthen the next graveyard — you pick the order.

title: BORE
short_description: A survival horror game for 1–4 players. Operate a giant drilling machine. Explore caves, collect valuables, and escape the creatures below. Return to the surface to sell what you found and buy upgrades and equipment. Play solo or in online co-op.

title: BRAINFREEZE
short_description: A first-person ice cream roguelike. Serve the line, hit the quota, and hand every cent to a boss who is very clear about what happens if you come up short. Draft cards between shifts to build a run that survives one more day. The truck is locked. The phone is ringing. Get scooping.

title: BRAVERUN
short_description: Thrilling action and epic boss battles! Dash through a 90s-style pixel world in the retro action RPG BRAVERUN — cut through hordes of enemies and face mighty foes!

title: BREACHED: Follow Me
short_description: A first-person psychological horror game with a VHS atmosphere and an Eastern European setting. Explore dark locations, uncover hidden secrets, and discover a story where reality may not be what it seems.

title: BROMS: Battle Royale Management Simulator
short_description: A management simulation game where you run a battle royale. Host matches to increase revenue from gacha requests, expand the map, and place objects to improve the environment. You can also play on the maps you create yourself.

title: BROODHOUSE
short_description: Your deck is alive and it breeds. A creature card hits for its whole strain's population, so your power sits in the cards you never draw. Push past carrying capacity and the overflow turns feral in your hands. A roguelike deckbuilder about a colony that grows faster than you can hold it.

title: BULLETJUMP
short_description: Jump with one hand, shoot with the other. BULLETJUMP is a fast arcade score-chaser: weave through bullet storms, skim close calls to push your multiplier to x5, and chase the player one rank above you. Watch any run back, take on a new Daily Challenge every day, and climb the global leaderboards.

title: Babel Destiny
short_description: A hardcore isometric soulslike in the Tower of Babel. Every enemy announces its blow in a dead language. Red, you roll. Learn its letters and the same blow comes in white: now you parry it. Speak the Tower's words, climb its strata, and ring the Knell.

title: Babo & Luda adventure
short_description: Babo And Luda Adventure is a chaotic 3D action platformer! Take control of this wild duo and embark on a crazy journey to defeat evil enemies. Master insane combat combos, explore wild environments, and gear up for action packed run and gun stages!

title: Baby Peak
short_description: Baby Peak is a chaotic, physics-based multiplayer platform game where four babies race at the same time, and where reflexes and strategy collide. Your goal is simple: jump, climb, sabotage your rivals, and be the first to reach the golden pacifier. Explore the party modes and different levels.

title: Backrooms: Splatter
short_description: You're the night-shift paint crew in an office that never ends. Spray paint to reveal invisible floors, fake doors and hidden signs. But spraying is loud, and four things in the dark are listening. PSX horror for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. PIGMENT CO. is not liable.

title: Bad AI
short_description: Rapid advances in AI have sparked a wave of unemployment—and you are one of those left without a job. Your story begins at a black market, where you meet an outdated AI destined for destruction. Left behind by a changing world, humans and AIs find warmth in one another and slowly become a family.

title: Bad Pig House
short_description: A CRAZY HORROR GAME INSPIRED BY “THE THREE LITTLE PIGS”! GATHER RESOURCES, BUILD BEFORE SUNSET, AND SURVIVE THE NIGHT WITH THE WOLF!

title: Baitcore
short_description: BAITCORE is a survival fishing horror game. Trapped inside a container after a shipwreck, you are lost somewhere in the open ocean. By day, scavenge for supplies among the wreckage and fish to survive. When night falls, stay hidden—because something is lurking beneath the waves.

title: Ballistic Brews
short_description: Drive tanks and robots in a third-person bullet-heaven roguelike. Drift, shoot, and smash through 15 waves while brewing the ultimate build to take down brutal bosses and elite enemies.

title: Ballzy: PvP Block Puzzle
short_description: Build the longest route, solve handcrafted and community puzzles, then outthink rivals in hidden-block PvP. Ballzy is a premium pixel-art strategy puzzler with Classic, Story, Puzzle, and asynchronous Battle modes.

title: Bancet
short_description: Survive alone or with friends in a chaotic frog survival adventure. Fish, loot, steal, throw, poop, and somehow earn enough coins before another ridiculous day begins.

title: Bar Baron: Restaurant & Nightlife Tycoon
short_description: Turn a half-empty room into the hottest place in town. Build your rooms, open up your menu, hire your crew, plan your supply and handle the crises every night throws at you. Bar Baron is an isometric management game that simulates running a bar and restaurant in depth.

title: Bar Owner Simulator
short_description: Take over a small neighborhood bar and turn it into a thriving nightlife venue. Mix cocktails, serve customers, manage stock, add pool and karaoke, upgrade your bar, and handle the chaos of every busy night.

title: Barely Running
short_description: Take your weathered old car and roam the boundless wilderness.Stumble upon abandoned shacks and unique structures along the way, scavenge supplies and resources to survive in this desolate land.

title: Baskets and Blooms
short_description: Grow what you sell and sell what you grow in this cozy, pressure-free third-person farmer's market simulator. Choose your agricultural identity, nurture your farm at your own pace, play road-trip minigames, and serve customers face-to-face as your small business blooms!

title: Bastionveil
short_description: Command your legion in a dark-fantasy lane auto-battler. Raise free-producing barracks, summon 10 unique heroes, gear them up, and smash the enemy base across two lanes. Pure strategy — no unit micro. Outwit the AI. Free to play.

title: Bastyrion: Endless Tide
short_description: Design and pilot custom-built vehicles to survive tides of 6,000+ simultaneous enemies. Harness real-time physics to engineer anything from armored rafts to agile flyers in this high-octane voxel roguelike. Your craft is your only sanctuary—arm it to the teeth.

title: Bat Flapper
short_description: Fly as a bat through pitch-black caves where Echo-Location reveals danger. Eat glowing bugs to keep your passive sonar alive, dodge deadly obstacles, and chase high scores in a tense 3D arcade runner.

title: Battle Runes of Metalaria
short_description: Battle Runes of Metalaria is an action packed, chaos infused board game for up to four players. Stack your runes on the board to make vertical and horizontal combos or smash your opponents pieces to smithereens

title: Be a Pirate!
short_description: Defend your pirate fleet from the Crownsmen - and the monsters that lurk beneath. Command Cannons, Voodoo Cauldrons and more across the land and sea, rescue and upgrade a crew of missing pirate captains to assist you while you face down the Crown and their dark plan. Think, don't just click!

title: BeBalance
short_description: Balance brooms, reeds, feather dusters, and one deeply uncooperative crowbar on a single fingertip. Chase the center of mass, survive crosswinds and parrots, earn coins, unlock skills, and consider an important question: is staying upright really more impressive than being caught?

title: Beach Manager Simulator
short_description: Clean, rent, build, and play! Run your own beach in this first-person management sim. Earn money from gear rentals, expand your facilities, hire staff, and tow banana boats full of guests. Go fishing, dig up treasure, and make the beach your own.

title: Beast Tide: Slay to Ascend
short_description: A cultivation-themed roguelite survival game. Forge your build with Innate Traits, Cultivation Arts, Artifacts, and Divine Arts. Slay demonic hordes, break through realms, and claim your own Dao Name on the path to immortality.

title: Beatlash: Survival
short_description: A horde survivor that plays your music. Thousands of enemies, all moving to the beat, and when the drop hits, so do you. Put on your favourite song and watch the whole screen come apart in time with it.

title: Beellionaire Incremental: Bee Simulator
short_description: Fill a giant 5,000,000-liter jar in the valley! Harvest your first honeycomb by hand, lay hose networks, and scale up to 10,000 liters/sec with drones and full automation. Unlock 200+ upgrades, play guitar on your farm, and uncover the jar's secret in this cozy 8-10 hour journey!

title: Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler
short_description: You've been bitten. Five days before you turn. Swab your own wound, identify the virus under the microscope, synthesize a vaccine and inject yourself. But every cure teaches the virus something new. A survival lab sim where your antivirals fight it out as an auto battler.

title: Behind Room 102
short_description: In a dark nation of crime and corruption, you're more than just a hotel worker. Inspect the people in front of you, catch their lies, and make decisions. Your boss expects the best. To survive in this ruthless world, doing what you're told is a MUST! But will you follow every order?

title: Belatoris
short_description: Lead your legion in an open-world RPG with tactical combat, settlement management, and meaningful choices.

title: Berserk Heroes Online
short_description: Welcome to Laar, the world of epic battles and true heroes. Take part in thrilling fights, devise cunning strategies, and make your own invincible deck out of 350+ cards available. Become a great warlord in the digital version of the iconic card-collecting tabletop game Berserk Heroes.

title: Better World
short_description: Seven evenings in one house. A tired father, five kids, a wife who counts his pills. Take one every evening and everything is lovely — until the walls start writing back. A short PS1-style psychological horror story. Two endings. What did you do, Arthur?

title: Beyond the Cradle
short_description: Build factories on tiny planets where every part rides a belt you lay yourself. Launch rockets with cargo to eight more worlds and assemble, module by module, a stellar engine to take your star away before the wave arrives. No enemies: pure logistics.

title: Beyond the First Star
short_description: Beyond the First Star is a fast-paced 2D side-scrolling shoot 'em up. Choose your pilot, shoot down supply carriers for weapon cards, stack up to four support weapons that fire all at once, and take on handcrafted stages and bosses with unique attack patterns.

title: Bid Wars
short_description: Enter round-based auctions and engage in psychological warfare! Outbid to secure rare loot or deceive your opponents with lowballs, bluffs, and everything in between. Arm your warriors and send them out on raids to get even more loot! Grow your fame and become the ultimate KING.

title: Billionth Soul
short_description: Grow humanity’s last colony from one thawed sleeper to one billion souls aboard a failing generation ship. Draft cards, build powerful grid combinations, and trade population against dwindling life support in this idle roguelite deckbuilder. The billionth soul is the hardest one to save.

title: Binary Proof
short_description: Test Specialist Aaron Blonde finds himself in the midst of uncanny and strange events during a routine workday. In this facility where the boundaries of logic are pushed, he must use every detail of his environment to his advantage and overcome the obstacles to escape as soon as possible.

title: Bio Party
short_description: Bio Party is a chaotic 2–4 player party game packed with fast-paced minigames, ridiculous physics, and plenty of ways to sabotage your friends. Compete, cooperate, betray, and survive a series of unpredictable biological challenges.

title: Biocybernetic Trap
short_description: Biocybernetic Trap — an interactive cyberpunk detective. You are given the quantum diary of a long-dead detective, where reality fractures into parallel versions of the investigation.

title: Birch
short_description: Little birds live on your desktop and settle on your icons. Come close and they'll react. Ignore them and they won't mind. Stick around long enough, though, and they start to know who you are.

title: BirdBots
short_description: Master a unique skill-based flight system in a post-apocalyptic world. Play the story, survive procedurally generated tunnels, or compete with up to 6 players in multiplayer races and Last BirdBot Standing battles.

title: Bit Footballer: The Career
short_description: You're the player — not the manager. Start on the bench at a fourth-division village ground and play your way up to the title. Every career runs in its own generated world: 74 clubs, four divisions, and a scout who sees everything.

title: Black Hole Idle
short_description: Start as a tiny black hole and grow by consuming asteroids, planets, and star systems. Automate your power, unlock upgrades, and devour the universe in this relaxing space idle incremental game.

title: Black Hollow
short_description: Become the doctor the plague fears. Battle infected hordes solo or in up to four-player online co-op in this first-person dark fantasy roguelite. Harvest ichor, unleash volatile alchemy, and forge monstrous builds across four haunted hunting grounds.

title: BlackHole Collapse
short_description: You are a stationary black hole, growing more powerful with every run. Devour crystals, fend off relentless swarms and volatile anomalies, and unleash devastating gravitational blasts to survive the void in this fast-paced action roguelite.

title: Blackbeam
short_description: BLACKBEAM is a light top-down sci-fi action adventure. Drive a rover, smash crystals, battle alien wildlife, expand your base, and venture ever farther. Explore more freely by day. At night, darkness, energy demands, and hostile creatures raise the stakes.

title: Blackbox Creations
short_description: The world's first AI-mechanic bullet-hell roguelite where you generate one-of-a-kind skills, pets, and buildings in real time. Now, smash the machines with the Blackbox!

title: Blackbriar Crypt
short_description: Lead three doomed mercenaries through a plague-haunted roguelite. Loot drops as items you physically fit into 4x4 packs. What touches what unlocks combos, curses, fire, poison, and the tactics you need to survive.

title: Blackout Route
short_description: The world has been taken over by the Synchronization Network. A co-op action horror game with crafting, raids, and extraction. Defend your base, rescue survivors, gather resources, fight Network Agents, disable Signals, and make it back to camp alive.

title: Blastlane Racers
short_description: Explosive top-down arcade combat racing. Boost past your rivals, unleash powerful weapons and master 24 hand-crafted tracks packed with hazards. Race solo or battle friends in chaotic 4-player splitscreen, earn progress and unlock new skins for 10 different cars.

title: Bleeding Nightmare | 血に染まる悪夢
short_description: Descend into the fever dreams of a traumatized young man in a first-person psychological horror game about grief, trauma, and fractured memories. Confront the horrors of your past and find a way back home from Hell. KNOCK, AND THEY WILL ANSWER.

title: Blend Hunter: Smoothie Bullet Heaven
short_description: 112 smoothie weapons. Six slots. Discover powerful combos, mow down hordes, and take on towering Bounty Bosses in this colorful 3D bullet heaven. Turn fruit into firepower and build your own recipe for destruction.

title: Blightsilver
short_description: Join a paranormal investigation where card battles are the key that uncovers the conspiracy beneath the city. Duel on a secret 5×5 grid. Reveal your opponent’s hidden information—while they hunt for yours.

title: Blind Route
short_description: Blind cannot see the route; their teammates must describe it by voice. Communicate as Blind and Guide, survive dangerous 3D obstacle courses, and reach the finish before the rival team in solo, co-op, and competitive online modes.

title: Block By Block Tycoon
short_description: Build a cozy city block by block in a spatial puzzle city-builder where smart placement earns points. Create powerful synergies, unlock new tools, expand, and grow a living city.

title: Blokkit
short_description: Drop pieces, flip tiles, light up the whole board. A cozy, tactile logic puzzle where every placement flips the cells it covers. Settle in for 81 handcrafted puzzles across 9 gentle-to-tricky worlds, share one daily board with the whole world, or unwind with endless puzzles in zen or arcade mode.

title: Blood & Canvas: Bareknuckle Boxing
short_description: Rise from illegal underground bouts to bareknuckle champion in a single-player boxing career where damage carries from fight to fight and can bring your career to an early end. Fight, upgrade your gym, climb the rankings, and see how far you can make it.

title: Bloody Fighters
short_description: Command a brutal comic-book faction in fast territory wars. Capture relays, mutate your fighters, earn permanent Superweapons, conquer an industrial campaign, battle ruthless AI, or face up to seven players online.

title: Blooming Parasite
short_description: A first-person sci-fi survival horror game set in a research facility hiding a classified underground complex overrun by an evolving parasitic organism. Explore abandoned laboratories, uncover buried secrets, and fight to survive a nightmare that's spreading from the inside out.

title: BloxFun
short_description: In Lightus, you are a traveler with no "past," embarking on an adventure across a vast world. Collect various magical creatures, challenge powerful enemies, and collaborate with other players to craft, cook, farm, rebuild the world, and create your own home to enjoy your dream life.

title: Blue Blood Love Song
short_description: A multi-ending visual novel blending romance, sci-fi, and mystery. A perfect reunion gradually gives way to unsettling inconsistencies. As your relationship with him deepens, you must choose between trust and doubt—and every decision may change your bond and the ending that awaits you.

title: Blue Dimension: Save the Game
short_description: Machines are stealing the world's last PCs. Fight through a neon labyrinth, find the key and SAVE THE GAME before it's gone. Die, and you don't restart: you become your drone and fly back to a revive PC. Pierce enemy lines with a laser sniper and rocket-jump through the Blue Dimension.

title: Blue Remembered Hills: A Miscellany of Wayfarers from Yeyu
short_description: Blue Remembered Hills: A Miscellany of Wayfarers from Yeyu is a narrative management game set in southwestern China during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. You keep a mountain inn—running the business, receiving travelers, and witnessing and shaping their stories.

title: BoQiong: Warlords Vie for the Realm
short_description: BoQiong: Warlords Vie for the Realm is a light online strategy game for 2–4 players set in the Three Kingdoms. Recruit officers and items, negotiate, trade, ally or betray, and roll ancient BoQiong dice to turn the tide and unite the realm.

title: BoardboundHeroes
short_description: Recruit heroes, forge their gear, line them up—then watch them fight. A roguelike autobattler of deep dungeon dives: build parties around classes and trait synergies, draft reward cards to shape each run. Your army and gear persist as lasting assets. Play hands-on or let auto-farming grind for you.

title: Bone to Pick: Forensic Case Files
short_description: From a single bone to a name — and the truth. A visual novel mystery set in a forensic anthropology lab. Read the bones, search the scenes, run the experiments and crime scene analysis, and close in on the killer. Seven names waiting, 21 forensic tasks, and side stories with your quirky lab team.

title: Bonehaven
short_description: You only have one life. Don't die! Build your own strategy against incoming enemy groups, upgrade your stats between waves, and craft unstoppable builds with cards. As each wave gets tougher, how long can you survive the chaos?

title: Bongo VPet - Taskbar Buddy
short_description: A tiny VPet device lives on your taskbar and its pixel pet hops with every key you press. Earn Bongo Points, catch a box or a key every 30 minutes of play, open boxes on a spinning reel and collect 140 devices from 7 series, pets, straps and charms you can trade on Steam.

title: Booker Blitz - Wrestling Booker Simulator
short_description: Run a wrestling promotion and book every title picture. Build divisions with standings and number-one contenders, cut promos beat by beat, then sit in Gorilla Position and change the finish live. A keyboard-centric management sim, 100% playable on Steam Deck.

title: Books Hate You
short_description: Escape a library where every book wants you dead. Dodge charging tomes, books that drop from above, and ledges that crumble the second you land on them across 29 levels of precision 3D platforming. Die once and you restart the level. Again. And again.

title: Boom Cube
short_description: Break away from traditional 2D Tetris. Control axis-based blocks in a 10×10×10 cubic space, clear lines by filling full rows or columns, and experience the all-new thrill of 3D block elimination.

title: Border Control Together
short_description: Border Control Together is a first-person border checkpoint simulator for 1-4 players. Check documents, inspect vehicles, uncover contraband, manage your earnings, upgrade the checkpoint, and decide whether to follow the law or profit from corruption.

title: Bore Bore
short_description: Descend to the center of the Earth and survive beneath toxic skies. Watch out for the creatures. Manage your air, water, and food. Build vehicles to dig deeper. Grow potatoes, gather resources, and design robots to defend and automate your world — the control is in your hands.

title: Borrowed Flesh
short_description: A deck-building roguelike of body horror where your whole party shares one deck: when a hero falls, every card they own dies with them. Pick 3 of 5 broken souls, survive permanent mutilation and unraveling minds, and descend as far as your flesh can bear.

title: Boss After Boss
short_description: Boss After Boss is a short incremental game about breaking chests, collecting powerful skills, and taking down increasingly dangerous bosses. Upgrade your stats, unlock higher-tier chests, build stronger skill combinations, and exploit each boss's weaknesses.

title: Boss Toss
short_description: Deflect the ball launched by the boss, pass it to a friend, then smash it right back into the boss! The more you pass the ball, the faster it gets—and the fight descends into chaos. Hit the boss. Not your friends.

title: Boss in Diapers
short_description: Boss in Diapers is a party game set in a chaotic daycare! Defeat your rivals to sit on the Boss Chair. Create your little troublemaker and battle with 2–4 players to rule the daycare.

title: BotForge
short_description: BotForge is an intense roguelite auto-battler where strategic loadouts, custom circuits, and precise heat management dictate the fate of every run. Build your ultimate mecha, optimize core systems, and adapt your tactics to survive relentless, escalating waves of deadly alien invaders.

title: Bottlecappers
short_description: Build a bottle-cap factory, automate the line, and survive quarterly reviews from investors who judge you on a single number. A satirical factory-management roguelite: hit their KPI, buy back every share, and show them the door.

title: Bounce Rush 跟你爆了
short_description: A pinball-action × roguelike strategy game. Launch balls to smash enemies, equip turrets and skills, and craft your own build from hundreds of combinations. Three modes: turn-based tactics, real-time combat, and stage-based challenges.

title: Bouncer
short_description: Bouncer is a compact two-player strategy game about predicting your opponent, controlling space, and surviving the collision. Choose your moves at the same time, resolve them together, and use the game's bounce rules to outmaneuver your rival and hold their base.

title: Bow & Banner
short_description: Live the campaign of a medieval longbowman. Hunt, scout, survive and fight in brutal battles as Kaden of Bracken, mastering archery and battlefield judgment across 14 chapters, while choices, wounds and failure shape a war story with 13 endings.

title: Bowls Above
short_description: Bowls Above is an always-on-top corporate satire idle sim powered by working programs. Work makes tokens rain; tokens hit workers; workers lose bowls. Grow your workforce and build a wild pin-machine.

title: Brain Bomb
short_description: Concepts are bombs. Association is death. An cult-like anti-utopian psychological horror puzzle game. The subject has a concept bomb implanted in brain. If a subject thinks of the [Fuse Word], their head detonates. You, as the "cognitive bomb defuser", dismantling the deadly "brain bomb".

title: Brainrot Fire
short_description: Build your own battlefield. Climb into the sky, outplay your enemies, and battle as iconic Brainrot meme characters in a fast-paced multiplayer shooter.

title: Brassfang
