short_description: Explore a castle filled with monsters and strange experiments in this steampunk action RPG metroidvania. Combine vampiric and mechanical powers, face challenging bosses, and create unique builds through randomized upgrade choices.

title: Braveforce: The Lost Dominion of the Void
short_description: A retro-inspired RPG that blends classic simplicity with modern convenience.

title: Bravemech: The Century War
short_description: An action strategy RPG with mechs. Fly your own mech in side-view real-time battles, solo or with up to 4 players on one screen, and command one warship and its voiced crew through a hundred-year war.

title: Bravest!2
short_description: The sequel to “Bravest!,” the classic front-view RPG that was a hit during the feature phone era!

title: Breakfast Shop Legend
short_description: Run a Taiwanese breakfast shop in this fast-paced time-management sim! Fry egg crepes, deep-fry nuggets, and mix drinks by hand. Every round ends in a frantic Rush Hour. Serve 31 customer types, catch dine-and-dashers, survive health inspections, and grow a roadside stall into a legend.

title: Breakremental
short_description: Breakremental is a brick breaker incremental game. Break bricks, get coins, buy upgrades, add more balls and watch everything slowly get out of control. There are bosses too, because apparently breaking normal bricks wasn't enough.

title: BreathBound
short_description: BreathBound is a 1–4 player co-op horror game built on breath and sound management. In the dark, every breath, step, and collision can draw the Corpse King, who hunts by smell and hearing. Team up to gather resources, distract threats, and rescue each other—know when to risk it and when to retreat.

title: Brewery Simulator
short_description: Run a medieval tavern, grow ingredients, brew unique alcohols with custom flavor traits, and serve demanding customers. Expand your business, unlock new brewing tiers, and manage the tavern solo or with up to 4 players in online co-op.

title: Brick Busters
short_description: An old-school arcade action game where you defend your base, survive waves of enemies, upgrade your tank, and fight bosses every 4th wave. Features roguelike progression, local 2-player co-op, varied maps, and 20+ abilities.

title: Broadband Architect
short_description: Britain's broadband is a mess, and you're the small company that says it can do better. Trench real UK streets, wire real homes to fibre, and size your network against the 8pm evening peak — when the whole town logs on at once. Dig up Britain. Sell broadband. Survive the evening peak.

title: Broken Orbits
short_description: Broken Orbits is a fast-paced 1–4 player co-op space-combat game. Tear through hostile fleets, loot wild weapons and prototype effects, create devastating loadout combinations, and fight through a complete three-chapter campaign against the Ancients.

title: Broken Rift: Dominion
short_description: Lead a fractured human frontier in a 4X strategy game powered by a fully offline, locally embedded LLM. Build colonies, design warships and tanks, command tactical battles, and face rival empires that plan, remember, negotiate, and wage war without relying on the cloud.

title: Broken Soccer
short_description: Pick one of 38 ridiculous teams, roll the die and unleash a dinosaur charge, a zombie infection, a bull market (with an actual bull) or Nietzsche off the bench. Tied at full time? Boots off, fists up. Solo, co-op or online versus up to 4v4.

title: Buckaroo
short_description: A creature-breeding sim where you catch wild critters in an open world and breed them into absurd creations, with over 60 million combinations. Then take your critter down to the rodeo or the racetrack and climb the ranked circuit.

title: Bug Bus
short_description: Safely transport young insects to their schools through a dangerous world. Customize your mobile home, the Bug Bus, care for your passengers, prepare its defenses, and explore for resources during school hours.

title: Bug Fix Billionaire
short_description: Build the most successful video game store in town! Develop your own games, stock your shelves with the latest hits, and grow your small shop into the ultimate gaming empire with employees, an esports team, loot boxes, and much more.

title: BugPot
short_description: BugPot is a casual roguelike where every spin shapes the fight. Match weapons and charms, upgrade your weapons, build powerful combinations and adapt your strategy as you face a bizarre variety of bugs.

title: Build & Bail
short_description: The party platformer where you build the track yourselves: every round a new trap, every race fresh chaos. In the end, all that counts is who reaches the finish first.

title: Bullet Barrage
short_description: Shoot. Dodge. Control the distance. Bullet Barrage is a commandless 1v1 bullet-hell action game featuring 8 unique fighters, CPU battles, local versus, and online multiplayer.

title: Buried Life
short_description: 1997. After a sudden mine collapse, you find yourself trapped inside an abandoned Soviet research complex where classified experiments were once conducted. Explore underground laboratories, uncover forgotten secrets, and discover why the facility was buried along with everything it contained.

title: Burn Out
short_description: Burn Out is a frenetic and chaotic 1-4 player online party game set in the ironical world of corporate life. Players battle deadlines and absurd tasks through increasingly stressful levels to climb corporate ladder and take the CEO's place - who stays calm, and who cracks?

title: Bury the Debt
short_description: Bury the Debt is a cozy first-person graveyard automation game. Dig graves, handle incoming coffins, collect Souls, Bones, and Gold, then hire a cheerful skeleton crew to keep the work moving until your debt to Death is finally paid.

title: Bush League Baseball
short_description: Arcade baseball with real rules and terrible players, in full 3D: bobblehead ballplayers, nine ballparks and Chuck Baseball, a booth announcer who loves every error. Found your own club, build its ballpark, race go-karts between innings and play for the World Series. One or two players.

title: Business Rivals
short_description: Compete against rival companies in a ruthless multiplayer business war. Build your corporation, hire employees, invest in legal and illegal operations, sabotage competitors, survive inspections, and become the richest entrepreneur in the city.

title: Business Wars
short_description: Build your business empire from company registration to IPO. Trade stocks with sector rotation, invest in residential and commercial real estate, navigate hundreds of life events, master acquisitions, VC financing, and banking. New Game+ with progress carryover. Every decision shapes your legacy.

title: Butterfly Project
short_description: Raise caterpillars, witness the metamorphosis, and complete your sanctuary in this relaxing butterfly-collecting game.

title: Buzzoria
short_description: A cozy excavation and colony-building game about bees, buried relics, and the mysterious Watcher. Dig through the remains of a vanished civilization, recover valuable finds, grow your colony, and uncover the truth one discovery at a time.

title: BuzztteVTuber: Go Viral in 2018?!
short_description: Time-leap back to 2018 and restart your VTuber career from zero. 48 weeks to go viral. Pull in your own avatar through the OBS / VTube Studio virtual camera and watch yourself stream inside the game. Miss a goal and time rewinds — your skills stay in your muscle memory, run after run.

title: CACTBOY
short_description: Put on your sheriff hat and load your revolver! CACTBOY is a hilarious and chaotic Western multiplayer party game for up to 4 players. From split-second quick-draw duels to absurd brawls, master a variety of minigames and prove who the true CACTBOY is!

title: CARKNIGHT
short_description: Destroy hordes of enemies behind the wheel of a heavily armed car in a fast-paced roguelike survival game. Build unique loadouts from weapons, chassis, and wheels — and create a machine that perfectly fits your playstyle.

title: CCR - Cosmic Card Realm
short_description: CCR is a free-to-play online collection game where every draw brings a new discovery. Complete card sets, forge them into unique Relics, and build a museum that grows with you. With no battles or competitive pressure, you can relax, draw a few cards each day, and enjoy collecting for years.

title: CHECKBORNE - A CHESS ADVENTURE
short_description: Challenge 20 chess masters from around the world to duels across the board. Defeat them one by one, prove your skills, and fight your way to the top to become the ultimate CHECKBORNE Champion.

title: CHOICEEEEE
short_description: A fast-paced action RPG. Fight through 100 levels of monsters and bosses. After each stage, pick one of three random skills to shape your build. Enemies drop gear with random affixes across five rarity tiers. Smooth combat, deep loot system. Every drop could change your strategy. Pure loot grind.

title: CHUM Fishing
short_description: CHUM Fishing is a cooperative multiplayer horror fishing game. As alien caretakers assigned to these terrifying waters, you and your friends must catch enough monstrous fish to feed the unknown beings lurking beneath the surface. But their appetites grow larger with each passing day.

title: CIVIREVIVAL
short_description: In this 4X + RPG strategy game, lead humanity’s last ark and rebuild a new home among the mysterious ruins of the stars. Starting from nothing, you will develop technology, build powerful fleets, resist external threats, and shape the rebirth of human civilization.

title: CLAY CLASH: Masterpiece
short_description: Sculpt colorful clay against the clock — and against your friends. Everyone gets the same challenge; see whose creation comes closest. Rush it in Speed Mode for gloriously lopsided results, or perfect it in Master Mode.

title: CLOWNROT -Kyoukan-
short_description: A psychological survival horror set in an underground parking garage. Trapped in an inescapable otherworld, survive until 5 AM while obeying absurd rules and fleeing a relentless clown. Each attack eats away at your mind, drawing you closer to becoming one. Can you survive the night as a human?

title: CLUTCHED!
short_description: *Clutched!* is a 2D side-scrolling steampunk adventure game! Experience the exhilarating fun of physics-based swinging, climbing, and impacts! It's a small, exquisitely crafted indie game, essentially made by one person.

title: COSPECO: Greedy Bullets
short_description: Dodge enemy fire, shoot back, and keep getting stronger in this easygoing action shooter! Switch between 9 different costumes to completely change your playstyle and turn the tide when the battle gets tough!

title: CRADLE PLANT: First Year Operations
short_description: Run a childcare plant where babies spend their first year in automated care. Build conveyor networks for feeding, sleep, hygiene, and play. As babies grow, their needs change. Keep your factory efficient while adapting to each child's unique reactions.

title: CRAGGFALL
short_description: You are a rock. Craggfall is a physics-driven momentum game where you roll, leap, and crash a living rock through dynamic terrain. Shatter what stands in your way as you explore mysterious worlds. Build up speed into huge air, and relive every glorious wipeout in instant replay.

title: CRUSHCHOP
short_description: From a hidden bastard son to the Lord of Sunlit City! Rebuild a burned realm through gambling in an arena of clashing warriors. You will gamble, rally soldiers, build castles, mine resources, raid giants, and do it all in CRUSHCHOP!

title: CURSOR SLASH
short_description: A pixel-art incremental game where your mouse cursor attacks automatically! Slaughter slimes to earn gold and collect ores such as copper, iron, and gold. Unlock a variety of skills, weapons, relics, and coins, then sweep away hordes of slimes!

title: CYBERLIFE
short_description: CYBERLIFE is a complex, terminal-based multiplayer hacking game set in a persistent, shared world. Explore a fictional network with its own commands, infiltrate companies, extract valuable data, and take control of the routes other players depend on.

title: Cable Arrange
short_description: One outlet. A whole room to power. Connect cables, power strips, and extension cords to bring every appliance to life in this cozy puzzle game.

title: Cage Legacy
short_description: Build a struggling MMA gym into a title-winning empire. Scout fighters, negotiate contracts, run training camps, survive the drama, balance every dollar, and work the corner live during fully simulated fight nights. A single-player pixel-art management sim.

title: Calcio 98
short_description: Calcio 98 is a single-player football management game set in the 1998/99 season and created by longtime fans of the classics like Premier Manager 98 or PC Fútbol 7. Lead your club across 18 leagues and 14 cups through tactics, transfers, squad development and finances.

title: Call of Donuts
short_description: Race solo against the clock or challenge your friends in a hero shooter where you and your teammates share the same ammo pool while dodging traps and defeating minions. Join forces or face off in up to 8 teams of 1–3 players on a procedurally generated map where every match is a brand-new adventure.

title: Calmaria: Wild Growth
short_description: Build and automate your settlement in this island survival game, play solo or with friends, but it’s better with friends! Start by tilling the soil and planting your first crops, delegate tasks to your settlers. Sail to new islands, loot dungeons, and prepare your defenses for the next wave.

title: Calorie Pinball
short_description: When can you lose weight with just a flick of a finger? Right now! Calorie Pinball turns your weight-loss plan into a pinball game. Will you bounce into a workout, a bizarre event, or that 2,000-calorie slice of cake? It all comes down to skill and luck!

title: Camera 5
short_description: Five cameras. Five nights. One caretaker who's starting to notice too much. A slow-burn surveillance horror where the building lies to you — and the system does too.

title: Campaign Forge
short_description: Infinity grows - Your story never ends. Create worlds, heroes, and play your legends chapter by chapter. Fight, explore, and shape a world that remembers you and your Party. Generate it free and fully offline, then change it how you want. Campaign Forge - The 2D Infinite Story RPG.

title: Campfire Battles
short_description: An auto-battler roguelike where every foe is another player's camp. Draft units, spells, and powers from the shop, arrange them for game-breaking synergies, and outposition your opponent to claim the win.

title: Camping Resort Simulator
short_description: Build and run your own campsite in this cozy management sim. Turn an empty stretch of coast into a camping resort with a character all its own: lay out paths, place pitches, glamping and bungalows, shape the landscape, and welcome guests who each live their own little holiday.

title: Can I see your...plants?
short_description: What if you had a plant wall at home that was entirely yours to shape? Grow and nurture a variety of plants, and earn money while the game runs on its own! The more you grow, the more you earn! Attract butterflies and insects, then create extraordinary mutant and hybrid plants never seen before.

title: CangLang Scrolls
short_description: Canglang Scrolls is a single-player wuxia sandbox RPG. Explore towns, wilderness, and unknown roads. Learn martial arts, trade, craft, build, and fight in tactical turn-based battles. Your choices shape the world, relationships, and future encounters. No fixed path — your story is yours to create.

title: Capital Criminal
short_description: Start in debt. Build an underworld empire in this retro economic strategy game. Buy low, trade across 12 cities and weigh police, gang and debt risks. Reinvest in longer campaigns and grow your fortune before the deadline: 30, 90 or 365 days.

title: Capsule Arcade
short_description: A cozy first-person tidying game in a neon capsule-toy arcade. Crack open capsules, sort 216 cute figures into their display cases and bring six dark floors of Hoshizora Capsule Hall back to life, one glowing machine at a time.

title: Captive 3000
short_description: Wake from cryosleep on a dying space station prison and guide a remote droid to your own rescue. A lightning-fast, real-time, grid-based dungeon crawler with traditional sprite design. Explore and fight through 50+ hours of handcrafted star bases, then infinite seeded missions. Free demo available.

title: Capy of Gods
short_description: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.

title: Capybara Clash
short_description: These Capybaras are armed to the teeth and eager to unleash destruction on both their enemies and the environment, with a huge arsenal of fun but deadly weapons. Blow it all up online, alone or in local multiplayer.

title: CarCrash.Tube: Car Crash Simulator
short_description: Create crazy crash scenarios, wreck cars, and capture the chaos! Share your best videos on your channel, gain new followers, and increase your earnings. Buy new vehicles and equipment, create bigger crashes, and take your CarCrash.Tube channel to the top!

title: Caracol - Wars of Religion in the 17th Century
short_description: Simultaneous turn-based strategy (WeGo) set in the age of the Wars of Religion and pike-and-shot warfare.

title: Caravan Survivors
short_description: Keep the wheels turning. Your caravan rolls down a deadly road while hired heroes and mounted turrets hold back the endless horde. Build your loadout, manage your caravan's inventory, and haul risky cargo for profit. Survive the route at all cost.

title: Card Duel: Black Rite 卡牌决斗：黑暗仪式
short_description: Card Duel: Black Rite is a card game where poker hands decide duels. Enter a dark, eerie card game, use a variety of magic cards to rewrite the cards in play, choose your fate, and win this dark duel.

title: Card Slay
short_description: The poker roguelike where the House fights back. Push your luck and turn poker hands into weapons: red suits strike, black suits shield. Forge your deck, unleash devastating rune combos, and outwit monsters that curse your cards and twist the rules. Think you can beat the House? Deal yourself in.

title: Card Warrior
short_description: Card Warrior is a wuxia roguelike card game combining martial arts and card mechanics. Play cards to strike, parry, counterattack, and strike relentlessly when you spot enemies’ flaws. Walk the path of a worrior. What kind of hero will you be?

title: Card&Dungeon
short_description: Build a three-hero party and brave procedurally generated, first-person dungeons in this roguelike deckbuilder. Each hero owns part of your deck, and fallen heroes change how their cards work. Fight turn-based card battles, claim relics, endure curses, and push deeper into the Soulwell.

title: Card: Heroes and Dispute
short_description: In this unique strategy RPG, you must collect resources and recruit an army by stacking cards in a fantasy world. Explore mysterious rooms, ingeniously use limited space to assemble powerful combat units, and face turn-based boss battles.

title: CardCraft Champions
short_description: A unique roguelike deckbuilding auto battler with many strategic choices. Customize your cards and discover powerful combinations.

title: Cards of Bellum
short_description: Master the Deck & overthrow the King in this roguelike tabletop deckbuilder featuring strategy, dice and a little luck. Dominate suit-based combat with strength-boosting dice, or recruit and use unique heroes, powerful wizards, and legendary knights.

title: Cardume
short_description: A real-time PvP card battler fought by swarms of thousands of living cells. Build a deck that shapes how your swarm behaves, then swing the fight with a few well-timed cards. Mesmerizing to watch, and deep to master.

title: Cargo Runner: Faction Fracture
short_description: One wrong delivery can start a war. Smuggle cargo in a Tetris-style hold. Dodge faction inspections. Betray whoever pays. A pixel-art space rogue-like where every run is one bad jump from total loss.

title: Carnival Stand Simulator
short_description: Grill it. Load it. Hand it over. Carnival Stand Simulator drops you behind the counter of a midway hot dog stand where the line never really ends. Serve fast, sell out, and build the busiest pitch at the fair.

title: Carpet Daddy
short_description: Turn filthy carpets into satisfying clean stripes in this first-person cleaning simulator. Vacuum, pre-spray, agitate and extract with professional tools, treat stubborn stains, and move furniture to reach every dirty corner.

title: Carry Bros: Find It Together
short_description: Hide objects, search industrial locations, and outsmart the opposing team in a fast-paced online party game. Play as Hiders or Seekers, use special abilities and power-ups, and complete your objective before time runs out!

title: Cartagol: Football Card Career
short_description: A football career sim where every match is a card battle. Build joker combos, chase form, survive the press, sign transfers and fill your trophy cabinet — all from your own room. Deckbuilding meets the beautiful game.

title: Carve The Cave Together
short_description: Dig a cave together with friends. Throw a ball at the rock and it bounces until the rock stops it. Mine ore, run it through the machine, crack open crates, and follow four buried stones to the one golden piece hidden in the dark.

title: Casa de Cuy: A Finca Full of Fluff
short_description: Find 850+ mischievous guinea pigs across a cozy hand-drawn hidden-object adventure set in a Peruvian-inspired finca. Collect snackos, unlock secret rooms, solve tiny puzzles, and follow the crumbs toward the legendary Golden Corn.

title: Casanova Simulator
short_description: This is a visual novel game where players step into the shoes of a charismatic young man, building emotional connections through thoughtful choices. Your decisions directly influence affection levels, shaping your romantic interactions and delivering an engaging romance experience.

title: Case Analyst
short_description: A retro-terminal detective game. Crack cases, analyze evidence, unmask a conspiracy. Step into the chair of an FDI forensic data analyst. Case Analyst is an investigative OS-sim where you crack cases from a retro CRT terminal -- issuing commands, analyzing evidence.

title: Casino Dealer Simulator
short_description: You're not the gambler — you're the dealer. Run the casino's blackjack and Texas Hold'em tables: deal by hand, count the payouts, read the hands, and catch cheats before the pit boss catches your mistakes. Real-time shifts, a career from Trainee to Pit Boss, and a VIP room if you earn it.

title: Castellan
short_description: A real-time roguelite castle defense made by a solo developer. Shoot from your castle, drag soldier cards onto the field and cast spells to hold the line. Lose, upgrade, return: 13 chapters, 33 different soldiers, 85 different enemies.

title: Castelune
short_description: An auto-battler about a castle and an army. At home you upgrade your wall and five castle buildings, while your army goes after a rival's castle. Merge and equip units and build race and class synergies. Online free-for-all for up to 8 players, or solo against AI.

title: Caster Crew
short_description: A 1–4 player co-op action roguelike where your voice becomes your spellbook. Speak incantations to cast magic, explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect powerful loot, visit shops, and face deadly multi-phase bosses together.

title: Castle Siege Commander
short_description: Command your army with your voice in this multiplayer medieval tactical game. Create custom voice commands, control siege warfare, and fight over strategic supply routes.

title: Castores vs Topos
short_description: A turn-based board game: beavers versus moles. Create or join an online lobby, play on the same PC, or face off against the AI. An easy-to-learn strategy game.

title: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor!
short_description: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor! is a relaxing sticker game about cozy rooms and cats. Pick up stickers with tweezers, place them into tiny dioramas, and slowly create warm little spaces you’ll want to return to after a noisy day.

title: Cat Survivor
short_description: Cat Survivor is a minefield auto-battler where mines become your greatest weapon. Read the numbers, place your flags, trigger explosive chain reactions, and wipe out entire hordes. Win with strategy, not brute force.

title: Catadel: Slot Defense
short_description: Command an army of cats in this slot-defense roguelite. Pull the lever, chain cascading matches and hold the castle, then push your luck on the multiplier wheel for up to ×10 damage. Damage becomes Gold, and the royal tax always comes due. No real money, just risk and reward.

title: Cats & Rhythmical Restaurant
short_description: A cozy cat restaurant that lives on your desktop and comes alive to whatever you're listening to. While sound plays, your cats head out for fish, cook, and serve hungry guests; when it's quiet, they get bored and doze off. Recruit cats, dress them up, and grow your seaside diner.

title: Cats Around Us: Yarn Ball
short_description: This is a very short game 🥳 We've hidden 200 cats inside a silent comic about a calico cat chasing a yarn ball all around the house. Can you find them all? 🔎🙀

title: Cats Love Cakes
short_description: Run a cozy bakery for cats! Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, serve your feline customers, and uncover six interconnected stories, each told from the perspective of a different cat.

title: Caveman vs Everything
short_description: You have a spear. They have a tank. Hold your totem through forty stages of escalating history, from hungry wolves to riot police, carving the arena apart as you go. Die, and you start again at the beginning, but the gear you took off a boss stays yours.

title: Celebria
short_description: From movie star to music icon, you run the show in Celebria. Guide your entertainer through landing roles, releasing music, touring the world, climbing global charts, chasing prestigious awards, and running a celebrity brand, all while navigating the pressures of fame.

title: Celestial Reverie
short_description: Celestial Reverie is the world’s first 3D anime AI life companion. Meet Rei, your always-on desktop parnter powered by Artificial Super Personalization tech, feel her completely independent mind and authentic soul! Say No to insincere flattery, say Yes to true emotion!

title: Celestial Sentinel
short_description: This is Xhono overwatch space station. Enemy forces are attacking. All kinds of turrets, space station supports and plugins at your disposal. Please use your resources wisely, build your defense, face against all kinds of enemies, and explore the unknown secrets of Xhono.

title: Cellular Sorcery
short_description: Explore a chaotic microscopic universe by traveling between strange cell planets and popping deadly infections with your friends or on your own. Combine upgrades in wild ways and evolve your build each run until you become the most infectious cell in the system.

title: Censor Me Totally
short_description: An absurd censor simulator in the Committee of Public Happiness. Censor images and texts, wheel and deal, chase the money, solve problems, try not to get caught, spread your wings, and keep your sanity.

title: Century of Conquest
short_description: Hex-grid auto battles × spell cards × hero progression. Recruit an army and deploy your formation, then watch units move and fight automatically while you cast spells to turn the tide. Level up your hero, collect relics, and conquer a three-layer campaign of sieges and bosses.

title: Chako
short_description: Survive enemy swarms in this isometric Action-Roguelite blending bullet-heaven combat with tabletop RPG mechanics. Auto-attack through procedural dungeons, roll d20s in event nodes, and gather loot to upgrade your spells and gear at the base. Dominate the leaderboards!

title: Champions Of Thaloria
short_description: An online fantasy RPG in a city built on the scar where two gods destroyed each other. Fight in real-time party combat as a Paladin, Wizard, or Fallen outcast, clear dungeons, upgrade your gear at the forge — and step into a PvP Arena where every cosmetic bonus is switched off.

title: Chaos Chess
short_description: Chaos Chess is a new chess variant that turns every capture into a battle. Think twice before attacking and prepare for the consequences. Build your army, fight through four custom campaigns, and challenge players worldwide in a tactical RPG twist on classic chess.

title: Chaos Cinema
short_description: Take over a run-down cinema and bring it back to life. Sell tickets, schedule movies, serve snacks and drinks, manage supplies, clean up the chaos and improve your cinema step by step.

title: Character Abyss
short_description: A turn-based card game featuring light roguelike elements, where exploration and combat revolve around the combination and transformation of Chinese characters.

title: Checkmade
short_description: Want an Engineer who can revive pieces back? Or a Rook that can move 1 square diagonally? Maybe a Pawn that can also go backwards? Well you got all of that in Checkmade. Custom puzzles with Workshop. Build an army with a budget in the Lab, take it into a match, and find out if the theory holds.

title: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
short_description: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

title: Chess Army
short_description: Build your army, merge your units, and dominate the battlefield in a chess-inspired turn-based strategy game.

title: Chess Town
short_description: A cozy chess career simulation where every move matters. Shape your strategy with decision cards, rise through local tournaments, and work city jobs to build the life that supports your path to becoming a champion.

title: Chess You
short_description: Play classic chess against girls who tease, provoke, and challenge you.

title: Chess of the Hidden Gates
short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a Chinese chess move: the horse leaps, the cannon fires over a screen, the pawn crosses the river and never turns back. Every enemy strike marks its target square first. Step aside and it misses. Breach the Eight Gates. Play, or be taken.

title: Chest & Blade
short_description: A dark fantasy idle RPG where the fighting happens on its own. The deciding doesn't: open chests, compare gear, salvage the rest, then spend it on skills, runes and three-card augments until the wall you were stuck on breaks. Offline progress keeps it moving.

title: Chest Looter: Cardimonsta Collection
short_description: A chest-looting incremental game. Loot chests, collect unique cards, and gain endless upgrades. Unlock stronger packs, discover more powerful cards, and keep expanding your collection without end.

title: Chichi's Desktop Journey
short_description: Welcome to chichi’s world! Chichi is a little mouse with big travel dreams and just one piece of luggage: a ball! Keep chichi company while you work or study, play together, try new outfits and skins, or go online with friends and bring your mice together on your desktops.

title: ChickenPlaguePolice
short_description: A deadly Chicken Plague has destroyed the world. As a guard of humanity’s last safe zone, you must inspect survivors seeking refuge and identify the infected. One mistake could doom the entire community, so examine everyone carefully before allowing them inside.

title: Chiki Poki: Rush🎉
short_description: The cutest cleanup operation in the world. A fast, hands-on incremental game. Take down the copycat "Chippies", collect Star Candy, and keep your Ultimate going forever! Grow stronger with every material you gather — until the "Chippy King" falls!

title: China Youth Academy
short_description: Live three formative years as a young footballer, or manage U13, U16 and U19 squads in a struggling academy. Train, compete, negotiate and face the consequences of your choices in a darkly comic take on youth football, where the hardest challenges often happen off the pitch.

title: Chinese Basketball Manager
short_description: Manage your team, train your players, build your dynasty, and watch young prospects with a passion for singing, dancing, rapping, and basketball live up to their talent!

title: Chinese Pancake Simulator
short_description: Run a tiny pancake stall beneath an overpass. Cook every order by hand, crack the eggs, add the toppings, give the right change, and work toward achieving your life dreams.

title: Chocoletters
short_description: Chocoletters is a cozy roguelike deckbuilding word game with a milky-smooth twist. Fill your Collection with tasty chocolate treats, spell the best words you can, and combine sweet bonuses to whip up deliciously absurd scores.

title: Chop Loop
short_description: A 3D incremental lumberjack game where every tree changes the way you play. Unlock unique tree mechanics, control which trees appear with runes and upgrade beavers to automate your harvest.

title: Chopex
short_description: Combine ingredient cards, use kitchen tools, and serve orders before time runs out! Chopex is a pixel art card game where you chop, grill, and plate your way through increasingly hectic kitchens.

title: Chreynard
short_description: Rewind time and control clones to solve intricate puzzles in this innovative 2D action-puzzler. Use your wits and skills to conquer all 30 stages of charming, nostalgic pixel art.

title: Christmas Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
short_description: Find 100 hidden cats across 10 festive Christmas scenes! Search carefully, use hints wisely, avoid wrong clicks, and race against time. Discover every cat, unlock achievements, and claim your place on the global leaderboard!

title: Chroma Keyboard
short_description: A calm four-key rhythm game with no fail state: every run plays to the last note. 40 original tracks span twelve traditions — kora, gamelan, maqam, milonga, techno — plus four Epics: ten-act suites, fifteen unbroken minutes each.

title: ChromaFlow
short_description: Build a factory powered by color. Extract red, green, and blue, route them through conveyor networks, and mix them into an expanding spectrum. Fulfil requests for the Chroma Core, unlock new technology, and optimize every production line.

title: Chromafall
short_description: Chromafall is a neon physics puzzle game where you drag and drop obstacles to redirect a bouncing ball of light toward glowing receptors. Place your pieces, launch the ball, and watch light cascade across the play field. Endless procedurally generated levels ensure the challenge never stops.

title: Chrome Circuit
short_description: A twin-stick roguelite in a 2086 cyber-dystopia. Chain kill-streaks for massive rewards, sign cursed loot contracts with brutal downsides, and stack upgrades into a new monster build every run.

title: Chronicles of Prozis
short_description: A classic fantasy JRPG filled with mysteries, friendships, and secrets. Explore the world of Prozis however you wish and uncover the truth behind a threat capable of changing the very fabric of the world.

title: Chronoseum
short_description: An action roguelite where you fight through arenas and unlock epic upgrades! Defeat the Bosses and challenge the Emperor. Die, upgrade, die and descend again.

title: Chunk DAW
short_description: Build music out of blocks! Place, pitch, and sequence sounds in a 3D world, solo or with friends in real time. Jam over built-in voice chat, shape terrain and scenery around your songs, then publish your creations for the world to browse, remix, and play.

title: Ciao Pizza: Cooking Chaos
short_description: Run a chaotic pizza shop alone or with up to three friends. Make every pizza by hand, deal with impatient customers, keep the kitchen running, and race deliveries across town before everything gets cold, burnt, or completely out of control.

title: Cinema Business Simulator
short_description: Cinema Business Simulator is a single player business sim where you run your own cinema. License movies, set ticket options, and sell snacks. Prepare fresh popcorn and serve it from your popcorn cart!

title: Cinematic Business
short_description: Run your own movie studio in a deep management simulation. Choose stories, negotiate with creative talent, and back the films you believe in. Balance ambition with your budget, face audiences and critics, and build your studio’s legacy in a competitive industry.

title: Cinnaboi Baked Brawl
short_description: A flavorful 2D brawler starring Cinnaboi and his crew of food warriors. Fight through interactive kitchens and diners, master unique movesets, and take on friends or foes in PvP, co‑op, or online play. Animated story scenes reveal Cinnaboi’s origins in this chaotic culinary adventure.

title: Circuit Keep
short_description: Your towers don't stop anything. Enemies walk straight over them. The only thing that turns them aside is a wall, so you build the maze yourself. Then the intrusions start fighting back. PHASE slides through your walls. HOPPER vaults over them. BREAKER eats them. You built the maze. Now defend it.

title: City Party
short_description: Chase the crown across the board and finish with the most coins to win! Watch out for traps and lurking enemies. Use cards to turn the tide and recruit allies to help you out of tough spots. Play through levels solo or team up with a friend for ranked matches. Join the fun in City Party!

title: City and War
short_description: City And War is a single-player strategy game combining city building, production management, and real-time warfare. Develop your population and industries, manufacture supplies and weapons, and command armies across battlefields and an expedition map.

title: City of Hunger
short_description: Survive a deadly parasite outbreak in immersive virtual reality. Fight for your life, uncover the truth behind Dr. Summers' experiments, and escape before it's too late.

title: Clairvoyage: The Lighthouse
short_description: A short, singleplayer time-loop puzzle game in which you restore a lighthouse to prevent a shipwreck that has already happened. Hunted by shadows across an island, you unfold the lighthouse keeper’s tragic story and piece together a way to end the nightmare.

title: Clash of Adventurers
short_description: Open-world indie MMORPG in development. The free Steam Playtest is LIVE NOW - open to everyone, instant access, no key needed. One class fills one role: Attacker, Defender or Supporter. Party up, fight monsters, gather, craft and quest across a seamless world with no instances.

title: Classroom in Sora
short_description: A laid-back sci-fi adventure about making friends at a school in space (Sora). You play a friend-seeking, space-born human at a new school full of alien students of every species. Talk to everyone—grow close or drift apart—and uncover the mystery hidden within the school.

title: Clean Memories
short_description: Clean, repair, and organize forgotten spaces. Uncover the memories hidden beneath the dirt in this relaxing first-person cleaning adventure.

title: Clean Tides
short_description: A cozy ocean-cleaning game where every haul builds a better boat. Sail a sunny bay, collect litter, clear oil spills, and power-wash coral reefs. Sell your haul to upgrade and customize your boat, hire cleanup boats, and feed wildlife. Bring a little sparkle back to the sea at your own pace.

title: Clearance Defence
short_description: Defend the clearance shelf. When the lights go out, the seasonal war begins. Lead your unsold Easter stock against waves of full-price enemies — before morning reveals the secret.

title: Click Flip
short_description: Click Flip is a short incremental game about clicking tiles, earning points, buying upgrades, and causing crazy tile combos.

title: Click to Mine
short_description: A cozy mining incremental. Click to shatter ores in a sunlit forest clearing, sweep up the pieces for gold, and spend it by the campfire at night. Unlock 14 ores, flying magic pickaxes and powerful abilities on your way down to the legendary Fire Opal.

title: Click to Obsolete
short_description: A satirical incremental clicker game. Play as a corporate tech CEO automating all human labor. Build server infrastructure, allocate compute to AI, manufacture robot armies, and lobby politicians to reduce global employment from 8 billion to zero.

title: Clicker Inc. - Generational Succession
short_description: Build a business empire across generations! Click to earn, hire employees for passive income, and use stocks, banks, and auctions to survive booms and crashes. Pass the company to the next CEO, unlock 100+ skills, complete achievements, and grow into a world-changing corporation!

title: Clicker Tactics: Memorian
short_description: A clicker × auto-battle tactics game where you place your companions on a 3×3 grid. Link chains with a wide variety of skills and relics, and mow down the hordes surging toward you. An exhilarating incremental RPG where every adventure makes you stronger.

title: Clinical Memory
short_description: Clinical Memory is a first-person psychological horror game set in the abandoned Ward 7B hospital. Experience distorted memory cycles, explore a changing environment, and make choices that may bring you closer to the truth or send you back to the beginning.

title: Clogwork
short_description: CLOGWORK is a factory automation game. Cut, glue and rotate pieces into the shapes you need. Build conveyor belts and logic circuits, prevent jams, and deliver finished shapes to the Hub. Build in 2D, or switch to 3D at any time.

title: Closed World: Memories of a Fleeting World
short_description: A long-form 3D JRPG of exploration and memory. Four hundred years out from Earth, six hundred sleepers share a single dream — and in its last chapter, Lityria sets out remembering nothing. Twelve labyrinths, 380 hand-built maps, one buried truth.

title: Cloud JourneyVR
short_description: Discover the world through a magical travel book. YunYou uses Gaussian Splatting to bring real landscapes into immersive VR. Flip pages to explore stunning scenery, walk freely, and listen to cultural stories. Peaceful, beautiful, and deeply engaging.

title: Cluckopia
short_description: Cluckopia is a cozy block-building game. You are a rooster: build a house — walls, door, roof — and set out to find your missing sister. Plant, cook, forge, decorate the village and make friends at your own pace; when danger comes, awaken the legendary powers. Play alone or with up to 3 friends.

title: Cluttermancer: Tidy Up the Nightmare Alley
short_description: A cozy first-person tidying sim set in a bustling alley: 5 magical shops and 6,666 items to sort. Every shop on this street is chaos, every shelf has a rule, and every misplaced wand is your problem now.

title: Co-op Chaos in Berlin
short_description: 4-player co-op bullet-heaven Survivor-like set in robot-overrun Berlin: auto-fire ridiculous weapons and choice-of-3 your way to broken builds. Solo works. Friends recommended.

title: Cocaine Smuggler
short_description: Smuggle illegal cargo across dangerous waters, evade the Coast Guard and DEA, upgrade your planes and boats, and make it home with the cash.

title: Code: Infinity
short_description: After being trapped in an infinite world, I find myself entangled with seven men?

title: CodePhantom
short_description: "CodePhantom" is a 3D action game where you pilot the humanoid combat mech PHANTOM and take on a variety of missions. Experience the thrill of controlling a powerful mech with smooth, responsive gameplay. Enjoy intense, no-nonsense mech action designed for fans of authentic robotic combat.

title: Codename: Operation Go
short_description: Codename: Operation Go is a turn-based strategy game that blends the rules of Go and the playstyle of strategy games. As in Go, players can deploy units directly to any available position on the battlefield, send them into action immediately, and capture enemy forces outright by surrounding them.

title: Coffin Hunter
short_description: You owe the Helix a very specific soul. Hunt for coffins, harvest rare souls, and build the ultimate killing machine in this fast-paced roguelite. Survive faction wars, hunt bounty hunters, and find a way to reach the Kingpin in the lawless Marupto Rift.

title: Coilbound
short_description: Coilbound is a dark fantasy roguelike where every enemy is a card of hidden traits. Descend a coiling dungeon, read each foe's abilities, and choose your path one card at a time — strike or slip past. But some traits refuse to end: it doesn't die when it dies.

title: Coin Pusher Millionaire
short_description: Spin the slots, fill your coin pusher with prizes, and push your way to a million! Buy upgrades, unlock higher tiers with bigger rewards, and complete collections in this satisfying coin pusher game.

title: Coins Must Be Made
short_description: Crush goblins with a magical stamp to mint coins in this active incremental roguelite. Spend your earnings on branching upgrades, but save enough to pay the king's tax before the deadline.

title: Cold Contours: Intake
short_description: You find yourself inside a frozen industrial megastructure. Its corridors are silent, its machinery locked in ice. Yet the pipes still breathe steam, and something at its very heart is waiting. The path to it is a puzzle of ice and metal, but all you have is a pair of magnets.

title: Collapse Vector
short_description: Pilot an experimental probe through collapsing celestial fields in a fast-paced rage arcade space game. Push deeper into the Transfer Gauntlet, build your probe, chase records, and see how far you can get before the Vector ends your run.

title: Collapsle
short_description: Collapsle is a fast-paced match-three score attack roguelite set in the Gold Rush West. Create powerful synergies and score big, with tons of items, characters, customization options, and challenges to discover!

title: Collectible Cars Shop Simulator
short_description: Build the ultimate die-cast car model shop! Find, buy, and sell rare miniatures, customize and expand your store, create racing tracks, and grow a small local shop into a world-famous destination for collectors.

title: Colony on the Run
short_description: Start as a single bacterium, multiply into a colony, and race through the human body! Escape white blood cells, evolve, adapt to each organ, and survive the massive antibiotic wave after three minutes in this roguelite action-strategy game.

title: Colosseum Infection
short_description: "Build your unique strategy stress-free, with zero time pressure! Combine synergies, augments, and items to form an unstoppable army. Step into immersive unit-view combat, taking direct control with manual movement and tactical potion throws to reverse the odds in this strategic auto-battler."

title: Columbine
short_description: "One ending leads to the next wish." A story-driven top-down 2D action game with four branching endings shaped by your choices.

title: Coma Dreams
short_description: Guide a wounded Marine through a nightmare born of his own coma, facing the horrors of war, scarce ammunition, puzzles, and dark labyrinths. Evade a colossal, relentless pursuer, overcome manifestations of his deepest psychological traumas at every stage, and help him wake up and return to reality.

title: Combo Break
short_description: Combo Break fuses the hypnotic pull of a peg-bouncer with roguelite deckbuilding. Load your board with special pegs, chain their effects into screen-filling combos, and watch the payouts explode. One more ball. One bigger combo. One perfect board.

title: Come to my party!
short_description: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.

title: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage
short_description: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage is a fast-paced, action-packed cooking game. Roast, fry, and sizzle a variety of dishes to complete orders and earn money before rent is due! Embark on this culinary quest of courage as Teal reheats her passion for cooking again!

title: Comic Shop Tycoon
short_description: Run the comic shop of your dreams! Discover collectible back issues, build your collection, prepare for New Comic Book Day, and stock comics, figures, dice, and RPG books. Set prices, serve customers, customize your store, and turn a small shop into a thriving business.

title: Company Captain: Westashes
short_description: You are the captain of a free company... one among many roaming this mercenary world, growing, falling, earning and betraying just as you do. The world will not bend for you, nor wait: the other companies are already writing their stories. Yours will be decided in steel, gold and a name.

title: Confined Space - Module Madness
short_description: A bullet-hell roguelite where your weapons wear out. Every module burns through its own durability, and when it breaks, it's gone for good. Loot, trade and rebuild your loadout between waves, adapt to whatever the next arena throws at you, and see how long you will last in the endless battle.

title: Conquest of Empires 3
short_description: Conquest of Empires 3 builds a strategy-first world of multi-civilization warfare, where cunning is the only passport, and every player can rely on their intellect to carve out their own empire in an epic sandbox.

title: Contrabandism Simulator
short_description: Contrabandism Simulator is a dark, atmospheric trading simulation set in a harbor that comes alive at night. Buy, sell, negotiate, take risks, and survive each night—alone...

title: Core Logistics
short_description: Core Logistics is a management sim about growing a transport company from a single van into a network across the whole map. Choose which contracts to take, match the right trucks and licenses to each load, and chain jobs together to cut empty driving. When you need to think, hit pause.

title: Core Splitter
short_description: Automate your factory to fuel a planet-splitting laser drill. Mass-produce mechanized combat units, deploy them in tactical auto-battles to conquer enemy outposts, and route their resources back to your expanding mega-factory. Grow your army and destroy the Runaway Artificial Superintelligence (RAS)

title: CoreRunner
short_description: Imprisoned within the Core, your only hope of escape are your light blades. Strap them on, grab your guns and your katanas, then experience a retrowave prison break. Skate, shoot, and slash your way to freedom under the neon glow of cyberspace, to the tune of a pulsing synthwave soundtrack.

title: Corefall: Idle Dungeon RPG
short_description: Assemble a party of heroes, descend into a living 3D dungeon, and watch them fight. A deep idle RPG with TONS of ENDLESS Content!

title: Corpo Dog
short_description: Deploy turrets, build defence lines, and shoot guns. Unlock powers through a rogue-like system and become unstoppable. Cyberrot has infested the city of New Meridian, and you are the cure. Fight your way through and become a true corpo dog. Remember, nothing is free in this place.

title: Corrupt Receptionist Elina
short_description: A receptionist simulation set in a medieval fantasy Adventurers’ Guild, where you review documents and process rewards. You should pay for your sick sister’s medicine. Will you work honestly—or turn to bribery and embezzlement? Your paperwork and choices will shape your fate.

title: Corrupted Worlds
short_description: Corrupted Worlds is a sci-fi puzzle adventure that tasks you with navigating a dying solar system full of perils. Survive, solve intricate puzzles, and scavenge for vital resources. Uncover ancient artifacts to reveal the past and saveguard life in the universe.

title: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator
short_description: Build and run your own bakery in space as orders start stacking up. Keep the machines moving, prepare sweet treats, manage your robot helpers, and turn your little shop into the galaxy’s busiest bakery — solo or with friends.

title: Cosmo Corgis
short_description: Scout is a terrible pilot, but he loves corgis. Rescue a crew with six corgi personalities across ten planets in this cozy desktop companion idler. Gather, upgrade, and rebuild the rocket while your new favorite coworkers keep you company.

title: Couch Pirates
short_description: Couch Pirates! is an easy to play local Wi-Fi party game that allows anyone to play using their phone or gamepad! Chose among four mini-games to battle it out on one desert island. The game is endless, and people may join and leave as they please throughout the evening.

title: Count on Chaos
short_description: Your computer is infected. Help Buddy, a tiny calculator, fight through the Wallpaper Kingdom. Give a plain answer to strike and brace, or build an equivalent equation to hit harder while viruses throw pop-ups, steal keys and play dirty.

title: Courage and Faith: Into the Dark Woods
short_description: A dark, atmospheric party-based RPG where you form an expedition, make difficult choices, manage tension, and fight tactical turn-based battles. AI-generated narration reacts to your decisions, making each journey into the forest feel distinct.

title: Court of Hearts: Masquerade Trials
short_description: Classic Hearts meets roguelite strategy. Build powerful runs with Artifacts, Tactics, enhanced cards, shops, Elite encounters, and Boss Rules. Face AI, compete online, or team up with a friend against AI in private lobbies.

title: Covenantum
short_description: Covenantum is a seasonal covenant-management RPG inspired by Ars Magica where you guide a growing magical covenant through decades of political intrigue, supernatural events, magical research, and strategic seasonal planning in Mythic Europe.

title: Cozy Airways
short_description: An airline tycoon with the stress taken out. Open routes across a storybook world, look after passengers who each have a story of their own, decorate a lounge worth waiting in, and grow one little plane into a global airline at whatever pace feels good.

title: Cozy Banker
short_description: The bank is drowning in cash. Sort eight currencies, organize over 30,000 banknotes, fill 34 safe-deposit boxes, and turn financial chaos into cozy order.

title: Cozy Burg
short_description: A cozy hex city builder with real people and real jobs. You have to earn every resident: they want nature nearby, a job they can get to, and a street worth living on. You build it from a small hand of cards. Make it beautiful, make it work.

title: Cozy Farm Life Simulator
short_description: Turn a quiet patch of land into a cozy farm. Grow and sell crops, raise animals, evolve helpful pets, upgrade your equipment, and expand at your own pace in a relaxing first-person farming experience.

title: Cozy Necromancy
short_description: A gentle mystery about a village that cannot let go of its dead. As a journeyman necromancer, you lay six spirits to rest by listening to them, investigating what holds them, and making your case with three objects in a ritual circle. No combat, no timers, no fail states.

title: Crack the Bills
short_description: Your breakfast diner is broke and the eggs won't stop coming. Aim a wooden spoon, crack eggs for coins, pay the bills before they pile up and dodge foreclosure in this crunchy, bite-sized active incremental game.

title: Crafty Marbles
short_description: Multiply, transform and blast your marbles through wacky worlds and crazy machines. Create runs, races, battles and wild chain reactions with your own rules. A physics sandbox where perfect plans turn into glorious chaos!

title: Cranked
short_description: Explore, race, and freeride in Cranked and experience the raw thrill of downhill mountain biking. It’s fast, responsive, and grounded -- we're chasing what it really feels like to ride. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down, and packed with virtually endless skill depth.

title: CrashFest
short_description: Build the track, then race it. Everyone adds a piece between rounds — the bots too — so the corner that just wrecked you is somebody's fault. Local arcade racing for up to six, with shotguns, landmines and homing missiles, plus three arena modes for when you want the track gone.

title: Crawling Desktop Pet
short_description: Raise a procedural pet on your Windows desktop. Hatch eggs, feed and evolve pets, collect Crystals, unlock toys and scenes, and shape each body part to create a companion of your own. Switch between windowed and transparent desktop modes, enable click-through, or invite friends online.

title: Crazy Bird Hunt
short_description: Crazy Bird Hunt is a fast-paced incremental arcade game inspired by the Moorhuhn games of the 2000s. Hunt birds, collect materials and medals, unlock weapons, and invest in permanent upgrades through a skill tree.

title: Crazy Life
short_description: A life simulation game for up to 6 online players.Become a resident of Shishizaka City and aim to become the richest by getting jobs, changing careers, buying properties, getting married, raising children, and using cards.Experience a turbulent life in a vast city!

title: Crimson Ark
short_description: Forge your own magic build in Crimson Ark, a single-player dark fantasy action RPG. Choose from three heroines, hunt for gear, and refine it through upgrades and reforging. Grow through auto-hunting, take direct control against bosses, and journey with Maria through a world of endless night.

title: Crimson Monarch
short_description: The old Monarch is dead. Long live the Monarch. Rule over five vampire factions, forge alliances, and decide who lives or dies. Protect the Veil of secrecy or let it burn. Every judgment creates friends or enemies in a high-stakes political visual novel

title: Critical Ward
short_description: Treat patients, build massive combos, create absurd builds, deploy automated medical infrastructure, and survive the escalating arcade chaos before hospital saturation reaches 100%.

title: Croissant Simulator
short_description: Manage your own croissant restaurant. Take orders, prepare fresh croissants, purchase ingredients, manage your inventory, and keep your customers happy. No distractions—just a focused, single-player croissant simulation.

title: Crooked Derby
short_description: Secretly bet on one of six horses, publicly claim who you support, then manipulate the race with face-up cards while your opponents decide whether to call your bluff. A turn-based board game for 2–6 players, playable solo or online.

title: CrossSpell
short_description: Weave words and cross them for massive combos! A competitive crossword puzzle where you freely place letters and "unleash" them to blow up your opponents. No falling blocks! Master deep tactics, play unique rules, or use custom dictionaries in "Deck Spell" mode in up to 4-player battles!

title: Crow Hunts Worms
short_description: An Action Incremental/Roguelite Puzzle where you Aim, Shoot, and utilize Gun Skills to annihilate worms! Upgrade your guns and get temporary upgrades while playing and clear infested areas OR play endlessly!

title: Crown Cribbage
short_description: The cribbage night you remember. Two, three and four-hand play: online at tables, passed around one screen at home, or against distinct opponents who never peek at your cards. Watch them play each other while you chat, or train in The Study — your first fifteen to muggins.

title: Crown Tactics
short_description: Race up an endless chessboard against a ticking clock. Capture pieces, earn upgrades, and deploy powerful units to extend your climb.

title: Crowned
short_description: Lead legendary medieval armies in a turn-based card strategy game set during the conflicts of the Middle Ages. Choose your King, build your deck, and outmaneuver your enemies on the battlefield. Every card is earned through battle. Every decision matters.

title: Crowns of Medieval Europe
short_description: Lead one of ten medieval kingdoms in this turn-based grand strategy game. Expand your territory, develop your economy, strengthen your army, and shape the future of Europe through diplomacy, war, and strategic decisions.

title: Crownsink
short_description: A fast top-down action roguelite. Every run: new floors, new loot, a new build. Chain hundreds of weapons and upgrades into something absurd, dodge through hazard rooms and arenas, and dethrone eight monster kings. Play solo or drop in with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

title: Crown’s Gambit：Federal Poker
short_description: CrownsGambit - A 3v3 Strategic Card Game of Betrayal and AllianceA 3v3 Poker-like Strategy Game of Medieval Intrigue）. Inspired by a classic Chinese strategy card game

title: Crumple Toss
short_description: A very difficult game of precise throws, dozens of misses, and world records.

title: Crunch Time VTuber: One Week ‘til Deadline
short_description: “Never do today what you can put off till tomorrow!” VTubers who live by that creed have their backs against the wall, and today they plunge into scheduling hell once again. Allocate your resources wisely and survive the one week until the deadline. A last-minute, task-crunching roguelite!

title: Cruzado
short_description: Fight by day. Choose by night. A brutal hand-painted bullet hell roguelite on the road to Jerusalem: dash through storms of arrows and fire, then forge gear, draw tarot, win hearts... or roll the d20 and pray no one finds your camp. How long will your faith hold?

title: CrystalCanvas
short_description: Enjoy ColorByNumber in 3D voxel art. Match the numbers, paint the blocks, and create beautiful 3D artwork in this relaxing experience. Complete a variety of models, from cute animals to massive buildings, and unleash your creativity in Sandbox Mode!

title: Crystalase
short_description: Unlock new images, explore different themes, and enjoy the rewarding process of turning scattered crystals into dazzling masterpieces.

title: Cthulhu Go Teaching
short_description: Go has never been so accessible! With Lord Cthulhu to guide you, playing Go becomes much more enjoyable. Whether you want to get started with Go, improve your skills, or tackle Life and death problems, Lord Cthulhu will keep you company forever!

title: Cube Duty
short_description: Cube Duty is a Cube-Powered City Builder where every throw shapes your kingdom. Every cube can become a building, resource or unit. Grow intricate production chains, recruit powerful armies, and defend your Castle against waves of enemies and epic bosses!

title: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper
short_description: Classic Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Orbit each board and read the numbers around corners and down through tunnels. Every board is guaranteed solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Dig for hidden gems and climb from your first click to Expert.

title: Cubersum
short_description: A cubic spaceship has crashed on a distant planet. Gather the blocks around you, build a new hull from them, and climb ever higher to return to space once again.

title: Cubic Color Confusion
short_description: A puzzle game where a unique color-cycle mechanic requires you to think ahead. Every move affects the state of the puzzle, opening new paths while closing others. Conquer increasingly mind-bending levels as you find order in apparent chaos. Can you sort out the confusion?

title: Cultivate, Then Romance Magical Girls
short_description: A visual novel × life-sim RPG in a city where convenience stores and demons share the same streets. Train, work, and win hearts by day; fight through black mist in turn-based combat by night. Ascend as an immortal — or charm your way through. The choice is yours.

title: Cultivation Legend
short_description: Build a five-hero squad, shape skills with Arcana, and combine heroes' strengths in automatic horde battles. Hunt loot and choose one of three realm traits after major breakthroughs. Roguelike-inspired builds meet long-term idle progression in a buy-once single-player RPG.

title: Culture Warz: Tactics
short_description: So, here's the deal: a global conspiracy weaponized social media and turned (almost) everyone into a mindless NPC. Yes, those kinds of NPCs. The ones who just repeat the same dialogue loop about awful trends and bad opinions. The vibes are... terrible.

title: Curio by Day, Mafia by Night
short_description: Manage a curiosity shop by day and excavate hidden underground relics for the mob by night in this atmospheric first-person simulation game.

title: Cursed Gas Station
short_description: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.

title: Cute Kitty WAR
short_description: The pests have come for the yard, and the cats have had ENOUGH. Choose from 48 cats and combine 97 weapons in an arena survival game for solo or 1–4 player couch co-op. Build your arsenal, survive 12 waves of adorable mayhem, and discover what waits beyond the fence.

title: Cutlery Warriors - The corroded kingdom
short_description: In a kingdom consumed by rust and decay, where every gleaming surface has lost its shine, three unlikely heroes—wielding nothing but kitchen utensils—embark on a perilous journey. United by fate, they must battle corruption, uncover forgotten truths, and restore light and beauty to Argenteria!

title: Cutset
short_description: Cut pipes and close valves until no route from source to sink survives. 80 industrial puzzles, each with one unique, provably optimal shutoff and exactly enough torch fuel to match it. No partial credit. One-time purchase. No in-app purchases, no ads, no internet required.

title: Cyan Moon - The Simulation Program
short_description: An experimental simulation sandbox where you shape procedural growth, adjust rules and parameters, and watch complex visual patterns emerge from simple systems.

title: Cyber Neon: Core Protocol
short_description: Enter a neon-soaked cyberpunk roguelike where a rogue AI is devouring the city network. Choose from four mercenaries, build your deck, install cyberware, and unleash Overclocking. Navigate shifting maps, read enemy intent, and battle through five deadly zones. Take the contract. Breach the core.

title: D.A.M.N!
short_description: Outplay your friends with cards instead of out-rolling them! In a cheerful race to the finish: help your partner, get in your rivals' way, combo, knock out, freeze, use ults... Collect awards, compare stats. Solo, in a team, with bots, hot-seat, cross-play online or offline — no limits!

title: DABANGGU
short_description: DABANGGU revives Korea’s classic 1970s–80s alleyway team tag. Race through iconic Korean neighborhoods, disguise yourself as street props, evade the taggers, and stage a dramatic jailbreak for your team—solo with BOTs or online with up to 15 players.

title: DATAWANDER
short_description: Embark on a surreal exploration of a digital island. Explore a silent virtual world and discover never-before-seen moments of transformation and hidden paths.

title: DATUM: Rescue One
short_description: A single-player helicopter search and rescue game. Fly through storms and darkness, locate survivors with FLIR, confirm with your searchlight, and bring them home. No weapons. Only the sea, the night, and time.

title: DEAD RECALL
short_description: A 2D side-scrolling roguelite where you command an armored vehicle fitted with an artificial brain through a battlefield overrun by Aberrants. Aim your machine gun, choose upgrades with biomass, and fight your way through the war zone.

title: DEEPest RESEARCH
short_description: She wants to kill the man who stole her love. To do so, she... His missing wife's phone reveals a hidden side: sweet whispers, sultry breaths, messages from strange men. Sick with anguish, the lawyer seeks the truth. But does he have secrets too? A smartphone mystery filled with forbidden desires!

title: DELVERS: Dragon's Hoard
short_description: A party autobattler incremental. Recruit heroes under their zodiac signs, gear them from a hoard of rolled loot, grow a skill tree that is the sky — then send four into the depths and watch them fight. Climb the cursed city of Greymarrow for gear no delve will ever drop. Every run reaches further.

title: DEMØNS GATE & Paintball Ops
short_description: Enjoy character development. Over 100 character slots. Auto-progression dispatch system. Over 50 stages. Auto-progression is also possible. `tactical role‑playing game (tactical RPG)` `strategy RPG (SRPG)` `grid‑based turn‑based tactics game` `Japanese turn‑based tactical RPG series`

title: DICEWAR OTHERWORLD
short_description: roguelike card game of claiming land on a board-game board. Build a squad with strategy and luck, defeat lords to win. Isekai heroes' power becomes cards: build decks, pair artifacts, make clever choices.

title: DIG
short_description: A cozy online co-op digging game for 1-8 friends. Dig a hole in your sunny backyard, find ore and lost blueprints, craft lovely things in your workshop and ship them to customers around the world, who write back with letters and photos. No timers. Just dig.

title: DIGITRE:SUM 10/20
short_description: Link adjacent numbers to total 10 or 20 on a rising board—a fast math action puzzle. Build CHAINs, collect TARGETs, chase SCORE, and cut CLEAR TIME. Soon, 10s and 20s jump out at you. Classic arcade play where every run shows your progress. Includes VS, PUZZLE, 50-clear BLITZ, and ENDLESS.

title: DIVEBOMB: Weaponized Racing
short_description: Realistic driving meets weaponized vehicular combat. Shoot straight, lay traps, and drive fast to win. Fight for victory in this high-octane, high-stakes combat racer.

title: DOG LIVES: Space Pirates War
short_description: The year is 2083. As the galactic space pirate crisis reaches its breaking point, you—a "dog of the military"—must pilot a humanoid Powered Metal Frame (MF), subdue rival captains, unite them under your banner, and emerge victorious in the ultimate Pirate War!

title: DORM
short_description: First-person horror. An old student dormitory in a provincial Eastern European town, strange residents, brutal encounters, blood, dark humor, and explicit scenes.

title: DOTS VS PIXELS
short_description: One screen, split in two: thousands of dots against thousands of pixels, and a front line between them. Paint to mass your army, bomb, freeze and erase theirs. Or set your machines like chess pieces, press PLAY and fight for the cup. Push the front until the whole screen is yours.

title: DPS: Desktop Pension Squad
short_description: A desktop idle RPG where monsters battle on their own while you work or study! Recruit a colorful cast of monsters, build your own squad, and reclaim the Dungeon Cores stolen by humans.

title: DRAWN TO RACE
short_description: DRAWN TO RACE is a roguelike arcade racer with hand-drawn pencil sketch aesthetics. Drive, overtake, drift and speed through corners to gain experience. Choose your upgrade cards on level up and build your roguelite deck. Defeat the boss racers in a 1v1 race and unlock new cars to use in the future!

title: DUAT
short_description: DUAT is a first-person survival horror game blending exploration, puzzles and psychological horror inside ancient Egyptian pyramids. Explore forgotten tombs, solve deadly mechanisms, uncover ancient secrets, evade relentless horrors, and survive the darkness.

title: DUE TONIGHT
short_description: An incremental stamping game about googly-eyed paperwork that is all due tonight. Stamp it, get paid, get promoted. Climb from the basement Mailroom to the Galactic Registry, hire a team, get fired, come back stronger, and approve the universe itself.

title: DUSTBLOOM
short_description: Team up with up to 3 friends and turn a dead red planet green. Mine, build and automate, haul ore with your truck, push the green frontier into high-pressure lands, and hold your base against the husks that come at night, while you uncover what happened to the lost 14th team.

title: Dacan Express: Logistic manager
short_description: Manage a high-stakes logistics depot where the hardest route to navigate is the human one. Negotiate ruthless contracts with e-shops, handle headstrong couriers on the brink of strikes, and build a delivery empire in a gritty management sim where every personality has a price.

title: Dadi Kingdom
short_description: Action RPG: You're the king. Everyone wants something from you, and you've got a sword. Every morning you judge your people: release, gold fine or dungeon? Then you walk out the gate yourself and fight bandits, skeletons and worse. Father an heir before your time runs out.

title: Daemon Doors
short_description: Defeat all Daemon Guardians through the Doors of the Daemon Server. Your only job is to choose the best Doors. Use inventory management and risk taking choices to enhance your buffs and prevent a Weak late game.

title: DaiDee 大弟
short_description: A solo Big Two roguelike. Split your 13-card hand into combos and choose the order you play them to beat score targets. Shop for Style cards and upgrades between rounds, then adapt when bosses change how you score.

title: Daily Life With The Herb Girl
short_description: A slice-of-life visual novel steeped in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Befriend Linglan, a girl manifested from medicinal herbs, learn herbal properties, and guide her through the modern world. Features Live2D.

title: Dairy Empire: Production Simulator
short_description: Build your own dairy business from the ground up. Milk different animals, process fresh milk into a wide range of products, construct your factory, manage your shop, and build a home in this hands-on crafting and production simulation.

title: Daisy's Dead
short_description: Tend a cemetery for the dearly departed in this cozy but macabre decorating game. Fulfill final requests, craft personalized graves, shape the grounds your way, and uncover the mystery of Daisy’s own death.

title: Dali's Adventure: Lost Worlds
short_description: A mysterious vortex pulls you out of reality. Play as Max, trapped between unknown worlds. Explore, observe, and solve puzzles to progress… but something may try to stop you. 🎮 Demo available — add it to your wishlist.

title: Dao Without End
short_description: Enjoy continuous, automated progression through idle cultivation in your Pocket Realm. Train Mind Arts, practice alchemy, forge gear, and enter fully automated turn-based battles driven by action gauges. Defeat monsters and bosses, collect powerful loot, refine your build, and reach higher realms.

title: Darcnia Monster
short_description: Place a card and its monster rises onto the board. A tactical card game, online and free, with no pay to win: every card is earned by playing, never from a gacha, and traded with other players in the Trade Hall and the Auction House.

title: Dark Eyes - Super Soldier 2
short_description: Continue the fight in the Dark Eyes universe as the Super Soldier battles the Delma and the elite Alpha commander. Experience fast-paced combat, massive battles, stealth, upgrades, and powerful abilities in this chaotic sci-fi action shooter.

title: Dark Ruins: Nine Dragons Pulling the Coffin
short_description: A dark fantasy auto battler with loot hunting and idle rewards. Combine gear, affixes and relics into hero builds. Field four heroes with reserves ready to take over. Earn offline rewards, forge mythic gear and push through new cycles, Boss Rush and the endgame boss.

title: Dark Runes: Forbidden Origin
short_description: Dark Runes: Forbidden Origin - A hardcore ARPG featuring versatile skill runes and classic Rune Words. The time has come to begin your looting legend! Every battle may drop loot that changes your fate, every rune combination can create new legends. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Dark Side Void
short_description: Dark Side Void is a 2D side-scrolling mecha action game set in space. Scarred by devastating interstellar wars, the Solar System is riddled with hidden dangers across its cosmic frontiers. Pilot your fully armed combat mech and embark on a cosmic journey packed with fierce mecha battles.

title: Dark Sorcery
short_description: Dark Sorcery is a dark fantasy roguelite where you battle endless hordes, unlock powerful upgrades, and create devastating builds. Master movement, teleportation, and strategy to survive increasingly dangerous enemy waves.

title: Dark Thoughts
short_description: We figured out how to stop those intrusive dark thoughts we all have to deal with. First, pick a damaged hero to fight for you. Then, guide them to victory. Heal them, help them evolve. Once proficient, you're ready to take on the heavy hitting causes of trauma and vanquish them forever!

title: Darkest Path
short_description: Darkest Path is a 2.5D roguelike FPS that merges a modern-retro aesthetic with cosmic horror. Navigate through shifting nightmare realms, master diverse character classes, and survive the brutal corruption of a decaying world.

title: Darkharvest
short_description: Dark Gothic survivor-style action with free loot drops and deep build crafting. Choose from Barbarian, Mage, and Assassin; evolve five skill paths and hunt legendary gear. Carve through undead hordes, grow from a lone survivor, and become the Dark Reaper.

title: Das Hexencafé am Zürichsee: Der letzte Eintrag
short_description: An atmospheric fantasy visual novel set on Lake Zurich. Make meaningful choices, uncover the mystery of the final entry, and guide Liva through a story with multiple endings.

title: DashBreaker
short_description: From breaking asteroids to piercing massive warships, grow your small craft into a force to be reckoned with. DashBreaker is an active incremental game: dash through enemies, gather resources, and buy permanent upgrades. Unlock new abilities and wipe out more enemies with every dash.

title: Data Breach Inc.
short_description: Pilot a breach rig into hostile corporate infrastructure. Mine the firewall, crack daemon cores, extract your haul, and buy permanent upgrades between sorties.

title: Daughter of Dawn
short_description: Only you can shape her destiny. Raise and guide the last princess of a fallen kingdom. Through friendship, love, growth, and loss, your choices determine her future. An emotional life simulation RPG with dozens of endings.

title: Dawnheart Keepers
short_description: Hold the line across a voice-acted 21-mission campaign, or begin a Long Dawn run: a generated board, no gold, and a card draft after every wave.
