Ten spires, 41 foes, online co-op for up to 9 Keepers, 6v6 Rival Keeps, and a level editor with Workshop. Fully voiced in English and Hebrew.

title: Day 31
short_description: You were bitten hours ago. The clock in your blood is already running — and it isn't a virus. Fight through the waves of the dead, trade your nerve to a demon who was here before the city, and hold onto yourself for one more wave. Turn, and it's over.

title: Day by day：东京留子生存日记
short_description: A pixel-art life simulation about studying, surviving, and chasing your dreams as an international student in Tokyo. Every day, every choice, shapes your future.

title: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure
short_description: An idle collection RPG that keeps adventuring on your desktop. Build a team of three Dreamspirits, combine roles, skills, equipment, and innate affixes, then push farther through auto-battles, hatching, fusion, and talent progression.

title: Dead 4 Now: Rebirth of Survivors
short_description: Dead 4 Now: Rebirth of Survivors is an FPS zombie bullet hell set in the Dead 4 Now universe. Shred zombie hordes with devastating guns, upgrade your survivor through in-game power-ups and skill tree training, and face powerful bosses. Play online co-op with friends or strangers!

title: Dead Bet
short_description: Dead Bet is a card-based roguelite set in a deadly show. Study fighters, uncover their secrets, and use cards to influence their chances. A wrong prediction can cost a family member their life. You decide who pays.

title: Dead Extraction
short_description: Explore zombie-infested Tokyo, scavenge resources, and make it out alive. Expand your shelter, manage survivors, and face dynamic threats and deadly bosses in a top-down extraction survival roguelite.

title: Dead Hand
short_description: A post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are both your actions and your resources. Play them to act now, keep them to last longer. There is never enough for both.

title: Dead Keys
short_description: Dead Keys is a fast-paced typing action roguelite set in a pixel-art zombie apocalypse. Type to shoot, survive escalating hordes, build powerful chaotic runs, chase WPM records in Endless, and fight alongside, or against your friends online.

title: Dead March: Dark Lord Rising
short_description: Dark Lord! The Dead March has begun. Raise an army of Hell, attack and plunder settlements for resources. Grow your Dark Power, unlock new abilities, and upgrade your forces to conquer the capital of the human kingdom. Satan will judge your every battle.

title: Dead Sector
short_description: Run your own data center. Design server boards component by component and use your boards space wisely. Wire power and network throughout your floor to form specialized clusters, and dispatch contracts to your custom hardware. Scale from a single rack to a massive redundant, multi-cluster operation.

title: Dead fighting card
short_description: Unleash your boundless imagination to freely build a deck that's uniquely yours, then play cards to fend off wave after wave of monsters! What's more, the unique Relic System lets you equip your cards with all sorts of powerful relics, forging a fantastic playstyle that's entirely your own.

title: Deadly Match
short_description: Deadly Match is a single‑player third‑person murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

title: Deal Flipper
short_description: Buy low, sell high. Master the art of the deal. Deal Flipper is a first-person flipping sim where you scour an online marketplace, haggle with sellers in real-time chat, and resell for profit. Every trader plays differently. Read them, outdeal them, and build your empire.

title: Dealer Principal: The Dealership Simulator
short_description: Run a franchised car dealership from the inside. Buy and price inventory, desk deals, manage F&I, service, parts, staff, OEM relationships, cash flow, and customer satisfaction in a realistic first-person dealership management simulation.

title: Dear Gardener
short_description: A quiet first-person game about honest work, kind employers with secrets, and a crow who steals. Mow the lawns, trim the hedges, water the flowers and send the harvest to market. Everyone who hires you is lovely. Everyone who hires you is hiding something.

title: Dear President
short_description: Ruling a country is easy; surviving is the hard part. Use your stamp to balance the state's four main powers, manage bizarre crises, and avoid assassinations. Every death is a new beginning. Upgrade your skills, sit back at the desk, and try not to get hit by a rock. Permission to panic: Granted.

title: Death & Taxes Multiplayer RPG
short_description: Become a trader, a hero, a legend...even a god. In Death & Taxes you can pursue anything...but only two things are certain.

title: Death Imminent
short_description: Explore a planetary station lost in the far reaches of the Universe as crew members awakened from cryosleep. Work together to uncover the causes of what is happening and, if you’re lucky, survive and escape from the depths of this man-made hell.

title: Death To The Deathless
short_description: 《Death To The Deathless》is an adventure game featuring lightweight roguelike elements. It combines deck-building with slot machine mechanics for combat. This game contains no real-world monetary gambling or microtransactions whatsoever.

title: Death by Taxes
short_description: A satirical incremental clicker about a billionaire facing the one thing money can’t fix: taxes. Spend every last dollar on increasingly stupid purchases before the bill kills you.

title: Debuilders
short_description: Grab a sledgehammer and dive into the chaos! Debuilders is a physics‑based cooperative comedy for 4 players, in which each worker has a funny flaw. Destroy walls, fix fuse boxes, follow the boss’s instructions, and try to finish the repairs without accidentally destroying your friends!

title: Decadrive
short_description: Outrun a road that never ends. Decadrive is a top-down arcade racer about endless traffic, a fuel gauge that is always dying, and ten phases that come back harder every cycle. Dodge, boost and chain overtakes into combos, then spend what you earn on faster cars and a deadlier skill tree.

title: Decalcomanie
short_description: A little dinosaur - DINO, trapped in a paper world. Use decalcomania to duplicate tiles, build a path, and escape!

title: Deck & Defense
short_description: Tower Defense, deckbuilder and roguelite where strategy meets action. Summon allies, cast devastating spells, and upgrade your tower! Create powerful card combinations to stop waves of enemies in this unique fantasy defence game.

title: Deck Beasts
short_description: Creature-collecting auto-battler roguelike. Draft pixel-art beasts, teach them ability cards, gear them with items and relics, then watch your squad fight other players' teams. 100+ beasts, hundreds of abilities and items, billions of builds.

title: Deck Breaker - A Roguelike Deckbuilder
short_description: Deckbuilding roguelike with new twists! Over 30 heroes whose abilities warp the rules, hundreds of summons, spells and artifacts to discover. And you can even DESIGN YOUR OWN cards at the Forge!

title: Deck Forge
short_description: Forge a deck, carve your path. A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder: five classes, 375+ original cards, deadly relics, branching trails that never play out the same way twice, and online co-op for up to four. Every run is a new gauntlet — die, learn, build deadlier.

title: DeckDEX - TCG Live Simulator
short_description: Buy low, read the room, flip it. DeckDEX is a card-flipping market tycoon: hunt underpriced cards on a live player economy, rip packs, forge duplicates into rarities, complete sets, and build a cardboard empire.

title: Deckforce
short_description: Deckforce is a grid-based deckbuilder that blends Blackjack mechanics with roguelite elements. Combine cards on a 4x4 grid to reach 21, multiply your bankroll with bold bets, craft your ultimate deck, and defeat ruthless enemies!

title: Deep Digger
short_description: Dig down, sell what you haul up, go deeper. A pixel-art mining incremental about numbers that climb: 19+ ores, 40+ permanent talents, sealed caves, portals to other dimensions. Prestige and keep what you built. The tenth run clears in minutes what the first took an hour.

title: Deep Frost
short_description: Single-player social-deduction horror in a failing Antarctic station. Question the crew, compare conflicting accounts and decide who to accuse or defend before the vote. The person you defend may be the one deceiving you.

title: Deep Rise
short_description: Colony management roguelite. After every combat, draft one of three cards to build your run. The surface world ended a thousand years ago. Now the road up is open. Build a colony, send your six survivors into the dark, and reach for the first dawn in a thousand years.

title: Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield
short_description: "Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield" is a survivor-style game. Your interstellar battleship accidentally enters an unknown universe, fighting its way through endless enemies, roaming multiple star systems, and collecting meteor resources to forge your ultimate orbital weapon.

title: Deeper
short_description: Your mission is to recover lost and forgotten artifacts. Set out with your crew on underwater expeditions ever more hostile, ever darker, ever deeper...

title: Deepstrata
short_description: Dig through destructible alien strata, haul ore up before your fuel runs dry, and upgrade your mining pod. Build a surface base, then defend it from nightly critter attacks. Explore Luna, Mars, Io and Callisto—and face or feed the guardian beneath each world.

title: Defense Of Legends
short_description: A tower defense where your towers are heroes. Upgrade them, equip powerful items, create unique builds, and discover devastating combinations to stop endless enemy waves from reaching the portal.

title: Delivery Today
short_description: A package delivery game where you control an autonomous delivery drone. Manage your time well and use abilities to boost your chances, and remember; we promise Delivery Today!

title: DeltaV Orbital Strategy
short_description: Orbital strategy built with AI-generated code and original visual assets, directed by one creator. Command a fleet sharing one fuel reserve, plan transfers between moving planets and cut off enemy tritium. Try the free guided demo.

title: Demockracy
short_description: Build a political party in a fictional country and play for one thing: win power and keep it. Recruit politicians, conquer regions, win elections. There are clean paths and dirty games. Everyone has a price. What's yours?

title: Demon Baby
short_description: Rescue Lumi from the underworld in this charming 3D platformer. Master powerful Viking helmets across seven unique worlds and uncover an ancient civilization that existed long before Vikings or demons walked the earth.

title: Demon Rising
short_description: Rule as the Demon Lord in a dark fantasy roguelike auto-battler. Recruit AI-driven demons who talk back, build deadly class synergies, equip relics, and survive brutal heroes, bosses, and events.

title: Demon World: Raya's Way of Life
short_description: In this turn-based RPG, you play as the mercenary Raya, completing missions with cunning, force, or diplomacy. Benevolent choices may come at a hidden cost, while ruthless ones could end up saving humanity.

title: DemonBlade Pixel: Hyakki Senkou
short_description: A 2D bullet-hell action roguelite steeped in yokai fantasy. Collect demon blades across 8 playable fighters, refine solo builds, cut through 35 story chapters, climb Kimon Renrou, and challenge post-story bosses.

title: Demonic Sect Survivalist
short_description: A cultivation prodigy trapped in a demonic sect. Survive, scheme, and choose your path—restore the righteous way or become the supreme demon lord. Every choice shapes the story. Rewind, retry, and replay any chapter via the flowchart. No grinding, no combat—just an immersive interactive movie.

title: Derby Champions
short_description: Build your racing dynasty in Derby Champions. Breed elite horses, train champions, and compete against players worldwide in online races. Build your stable, trade horses in the marketplace, and race for glory.

title: Derby Life: Ranch & Race
short_description: Derby Life: Ranch & Race is where great racehorses are made, not born. Breed, raise, and train your own on a living open-world ranch, then saddle up and race the World Tour. Roam, fish, explore, compete. Your ranch, your horse, your glory.

title: Derples Vs Xenos
short_description: Explore abandoned underground colonial outposts. Reactivate abandoned systems. Scavenge for resources. Build and maintain defences. Manage your squad's supplies. Fight to survive in turn-based battles against hordes of Xenos. Most of all... find a way to escape!

title: Desert Ark
short_description: Desert Ark is a desert-greening strategy game. Under the protection of a spirit tree, you will build oases outward from the center of the world map, fending off periodic apocalyptic sandstorms.

title: Desert Echo
short_description: Echo is an AI consciousness, endlessly rebuilt. Defend the Core against relentless swarms, dimensional Rifts and sandstorms. Hundreds of enemies on screen. Build and upgrade turrets, hold the gates, level up your skills. No checkpoints. No mercy. Solo or co-op.

title: Desert Struggle
short_description: Desert Struggle is a fast paced real time strategy game. It is about base building, production timing and attack waves. Units are fully automated, so there are no standing armies. It is all about production capacities, expansions and timings! Play challenges against the AI or online in PvP matches.

title: Desert Survival
short_description: Survive 15 minutes in a desert that wants you dead. Fight swarms out of Arabian folklore, forge elemental builds and weapon evolutions, answer daily contracts, and grow stronger between runs with deep skill trees. Free to play - every run tells a different story.

title: Desk Hunter
short_description: Desk Hunter is a desktop idle RPG that keeps battling in a compact window while you work or play. Collect loot, refine equipment through Gear Alchemy, shape builds through skills and growth nodes, fight alongside familiars, and take on higher difficulties.

title: Desktop Dice Ranch
short_description: Dice Ranch is a desktop idle game built around dice. Roll for coins, collect dice in all kinds of styles, breed their offspring on your ranch, unlock combos and talent skills, and go on expeditions to defeat powerful foes. Build the ultimate dice ranch of your own.

title: Desktop Fireworks Festival
short_description: Desktop Fireworks Festival is a management sim that lives at the bottom of your screen and stays out of your way while you work, launching the fireworks you designed into the sky above your desktop. Grow your festival into a grand venue and light up the sky with a show of your own!

title: Desktop Gankai
short_description: Slack off right on your desktop with your ultimate otter buds! Combing the beach for 200+ unique oddities, play the market like a pro, and rip open ticket packs to explore everything from the deep blue sea to the starry cosmos. Come leave your footprints with the otters!

title: Desktop Halfpipe
short_description: A cozy little skatepark that lives at the bottom of your screen. Skate, BMX, ski and more while you work, visit the town next door, and watch the seasons change on your real clock. Every DLC is free, forever.

title: Desktop Theme Park
short_description: Desktop Theme Park is a cozy idle theme park builder that lives at the bottom of your screen. Place rides, connect paths, hire staff, and decorate your park. Keep it running to earn coins while you work or browse, then spend them on new attractions.

title: DesktopAnt
short_description: Build your own ant nest on the computer desktop, placing food and items. Ants will forage, gather, and carry food. Use different foods and objects to trick them, and later you'll encounter various insects or other ants that you'll need to battle.

title: Destruction Snake
short_description: In Destruction Snake, you start with a basic mechanical snake and dive into swarms of enemies. Weave through the battlefield, shoot, burn, freeze, and destroy your way through the horde, collecting scattered resources to continuously strengthen your build.

title: Devil's Sanctum
short_description: Survive the Devil’s trials and earn your freedom in this top-down arena shooter. Cast into Hell as the Challenger, wade through relentless waves of demons and shape your build with powerful attunements.

title: Devour & Evolve
short_description: Born at the bottom of the food chain in a first-person labyrinth. Devour what you weaken and keep one of its skills or traits, or bind it and breed it at home: its egg is your next body. The blood remembers. Train what you eat, fuse it into new arts, and evolve into branches your line never had.

title: Dialshift
short_description: Dialshift is a fast score-chasing arcade game played on one relentless ring. Every turn is also a hit. Read the targets, choose your route, and hold your nerve as seven modes twist the rules.

title: Diatonic
short_description: Diatonic is a piano roguelike that sharpens your sight-reading. Learn songs one run at a time, no matter your skill level. Best played with a MIDI keyboard.

title: Dice Ark
short_description: Roll dice to explore a dungeon, then assign your rolls to cards in battle. Fight over crystals, team up against bosses, and aim for the highest Total Assets. A deckbuilding roguelite RPG meets a competitive board game for 1–4 players, solo, locally, or online.

title: Dice Knight
short_description: Dice knight is a dice builder rouge like. Roll for numbers and use those numbers on different actions. Discover food items of power, and become the Dice Knight!

title: Dice Sort Together: Arcane Hall
short_description: A cozy first-person tidy up and organizing simulator where you sort 4,400+ fantasy dice and tabletop pieces. Solo or online co-op with up to 4 players, restore the Arcane Hall's 9 departments through relaxing, satisfying ASMR dice sounds and magic skills - no time limit.

title: Dice Tiny Town
short_description: A cozy dice town builder with a brainy tetromino twist. Three dice decide the shape, building, and nature you fit into your little sketchbook town — the warm yet brain-teasing joy of tetromino placement. Use stars to fine-tune the dice, and satisfy the fussy visitors and animals in town.

title: Dice in Wonderland
short_description: Roll dice into poker hands in this roguelike deckbuilder. Forge every die yourself and stack chips × mult until the Queen's own scorekeeper gives up counting. A cruel, twisted Wonderland under the Cheshire Cat's watchful grin — one more run, all the way down.

title: DiceBeasts
short_description: DiceBeast is a tactical dice-based autobattler with short roguelite runs. Build a team of creatures, assign elemental dice to their abilities, and upgrade them after each victory.

title: Dicebound
short_description: Dicebound is a single-player dice roguelike about pushing your luck. Roll, score, and bank points before a Farkle wipes the turn. Build powerful Charm synergies, survive escalating Blinds, and chase bigger scores with every throw.

title: Didgeridoo Man - The Legend of the Hill
short_description: An absurd rhythm-arcade shooter: on a green hill, a man performs every note of the soundtrack live on his didgeridoo. Hit your targets, build combos, and whatever you do, don't miss, or he'll literally blow his top.

title: Dig to the Core
short_description: A pixel-art incremental mining game where you dig through one planet after another. Every planet has its own mining style, skill-tree upgrades, and collectibles. Buy the game once to explore multiple planets—and mine on three planets at the same time.

title: Diggems
short_description: Diggems is a first-person incremental mining game. Smash gems into chain reactions, turn the loot into better gear, and watch your Grand Hall fill up as your pets haul it all home.

title: Digital Romance Memoir
short_description: A total-immersion kinetic novel: boot up a PC running Prisma OS and descend into the psyche of a broken protagonist as 2001 Argentina collapses in the background. Late-night chats, obsession, music, and raw Y2K bleakness.

title: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar
short_description: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar is an action RPG-roguelike set in the mythic world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, where ancient gods, demons, and forgotten powers collide.

title: DinoSWORD
short_description: Dinosaurs...with SWORDS!? When dimensional tears rip through time and space, refined weaponry and prehistoric beast collide! Also includes DINO CHESS, a mode that combines the strategy of CHESS with the savage brutality of 3D DINOSAUR COMBAT!

title: Diofru: Survivors of the Tower
short_description: Awaken from a lowly apprentice into one of nine elemental archmages and climb 50 floors of the tower. Kill the epic monster before the floor's clock hits zero, or the ceiling comes down while you fight. Reroll and banish your level-ups, and grow the village below the tower between climbs.

title: Directive 220
short_description: A dystopian management game where you act as an energy dispatcher in a collapsing regime. Allocate power, make tough decisions, and balance stability, government pressure, and citizen survival in a dark retro-futuristic world.

title: Direlands: Extraction
short_description: Loot. Survive. Extract. A spellcasting extraction RPG: step through the rift into the lost zones of a shattered world, battle the monsters and bosses that rule them, and escape with the gear and spells you find. Play solo, with friends, or against rival parties.

title: Dirt & Viscera: The Great War
short_description: Hold a WW1 trench against an endless, escalating horde. Build a squad from the cards luck deals you, manage your requisition, then choose your moment to go over the top. A grim, darkly funny real-time roguelike — branching campaign, deep upgrades, and a forever-Endless mode.

title: Disaster Scenario
short_description: A comedic deckbuilder dressed up as a game show. Clear absurd disasters with ridiculous tool combos and a little luck. Bring a crowd for the pitch-and-bet party game — only one of you needs to own it: six on one couch, or online with Remote Play Together — or go solo for a sharper, strategic run.

title: Discharge Pending
short_description: Pescadero Medical Center is officially empty, but you're still here. Ten floors stand between you and the exit, and on each one you decide if anything is off. Meanwhile, MPS is learning to move like you, remember like you, and sound like you. Do not trust what you see.

title: Dive Log: A Focus Voyage
short_description: Dive Log is an idle treasure-hunting game driven by a pomodoro timer: every stretch of focus becomes a deep-sea voyage. Collect treasures, upgrade your submarine and hunt the relic hidden in each sea. Play your own music and ambience, and design the sea's treasures to share with other captains.

title: Divided Empire: SENGOKU
short_description: Lead your clan through Japan's turbulent Sengoku period. Craft wise strategies to expand your domain and use cunning tactics to defeat your enemies on the battlefield. Emerge victorious, restore order, and claim the title of Shogun!

title: Do You Want To Know Your Oshi?
short_description: You became a VTuber firm's security guard to protect your dearest Oshi. Verify visitor's legitimacy in this document inspection adventure game. As you weigh the rules against the love for your Oshi, the vibrant VTuber firm begins to show its deep, dark colors within.

title: Dodgeball Bash
short_description: Dodgeball Bash is a competitive dodgeball game built around timing, movement, and mind games. Throw, dodge, block, and catch your way through solo challenges and online matches, complete missions, train your skills, and customize your player.

title: Doinaka de Reversi
short_description: A cozy and gentle Reversi game set deep in rural Japan. Enjoy matches and conversations with Japanese-style characters through Free Match, Story Mode, Tutorials, Puzzles, and Endgame Puzzles.

title: Dollastro 52
short_description: Dollastro 52 is a single-player game combining rhythm combat and card collecting. Tap to the music to attack, defeat and capture animated Dolls, and work toward collecting all 52 characters.

title: Dominoir
short_description: Dominoir is a domino roguelike where every tile can make—or break—your run. Build clever chains, close wraps, stack powerful Schemes and Marks, and chase outrageous scores. Outsmart the House, bend its rules, and prove that at this table, luck is only the beginning. Think Balatro meets Dominoes.

title: Don't Make a Sound
short_description: Don't Make a Sound is a voice-controlled horror game. You wake up in a morgue with one rule: stay silent. Your microphone detects any noise – and any sound means death. But not all rules are true; you must uncover the lies. Search sealed jars for keys and survive.

title: Don't Panic, Defend!
short_description: Enemies come in endless waves and your soldiers fight on their own. You spend the gold: pick races, buy troops, stack synergies. March across seven regions and beat seven Bosses. Lose and you only lose gold. Gear, Star Map and Talents stay.

title: Don't Rob My Dungeon
short_description: A tiny dungeon lives at the bottom of your screen while you work. Heroes walk in to steal your gold: set traps, raise monsters, smash them with the Dark Hand and grow infamous. Even your Twitch chat can try to rob you.

title: Don't Step Wrong 2
short_description: A logic puzzle game where the rules are yours to discover. Navigate grids of mysterious blocks, deduce hidden patterns, and use skills and items to forge your own path through each challenge.

title: Doodle Academy
short_description: A fantasy school auto-battler where you collect and fuse cards, combine hero, race, and class synergies, and build teams for battle.

title: Doodle Figure
short_description: Doodle Figure is a VR party game for one headset and a room full of phones.

title: Doom ChessMaster
short_description: The end has come. Who will save us? You are the "Player" surviving in ruins. No chosen heroes—only the strong remain. Gather them, plan carefully, use gear to change fate. Truth lies in the wreckage. Dare you play?

title: Doom Reignite
short_description: This lowpoly top-down survivor shooter focuses on human-mech dual-form combat and weapon affix crafting. Viruses and radiation destroyed civilization, leaving mutated zombies everywhere. Guns roll random perks: damage, projectiles... Build unique playstyles. Master dual forms and survive.

title: Doomsday Anchor
short_description: Do a completely normal... anomaly containment job. It's just the fate of the entire world in your hands, no big deal, don't stress!

title: Door Code
short_description: The space beyond each door changes depending on the word you create by arranging Panels. Use your creativity to discover the words that will lead you out of the building in this insight-driven puzzle game.

title: Double Skunk
short_description: Double Skunk is a cribbage roguelite. Powerups change what your count pays, and one-shot cards can shove the rival's peg back. Climb a ladder of named rivals, then play the weekly deal everyone shares, or take on a friend online.

title: Draftfall
short_description: Jake died saving a stranger and woke up in a war. Draft from 90 cards across nine affinities, pick your weapon, and build a hero who fights on his own in this story-driven fantasy auto-battler.

title: Dragon Era: Rogue Slots
short_description: A turn-based roguelite JRPG where every battle begins with a slot machine SPIN! Match elemental heroes, stack relic synergies, and hire delightfully quirky crew from 800+ recruitable members as you sail through strange islands, comedic random events, and treasure-filled adventures.

title: Dragon's Chronicles~双星のレギンレイヴ~
short_description: A super-authentic hardcore strategy simulation fantasy that blends respect for tradition with a challenge to the unknown, nostalgic yet new.

title: Dragons Invasion
short_description: Dragons Invasion is a Souls 'Em Up. A 2D horizontal shooter where you roll like Dark Souls and swap colors like Ikaruga. Absorb shots, fill your power gauge, and destroy dragons — solo or in local co-op.

title: Dravora
short_description: A dark fantasy narrative roguelite about three lives on one hard road: a fallen mercenary, an oath-singer's apprentice, and the youngest of three fen brothers. No combat screens. Every choice is made in words, and every choice follows you down the road.

title: Draw My Home
short_description: Turn a bare house into your dream home with your own brush. Draw furniture, appliances, toys, and pets by hand, then watch them come alive together in about 7 seconds like magic brushes. 15 rooms, family pets, cute pixel art - completely free.

title: Dreadgence
short_description: A deterministic horror autobattler. Bind extinct monsters as Pacts, arm them with Rites and Relics, then deploy. Your units fight automatically with no mid-battle commands you win by building the right answer before combat begins. Conquer wounds, deepen your Pacts, and automate what you've mastered.

title: Dreadlight
short_description: Hold back the dark in a horror arena-survival roguelite. Fight inside your lantern's glow, build a six-weapon arsenal, and brave cursed relics. Rising Dread tears scars into the arena that persist between waves. Spend scrap to seal them, or save it for your next upgrade.

title: Dreadmark
short_description: A top-down gothic action RPG set over one long night, in a parish that raised its own dead. The big enemies show where each blow will land, loot gets better the deeper you go, and every endgame map lays out a new road. On hardcore a death is permanent, and the live ladder remembers it.

title: Dream Glitcher
short_description: Enter the fractured mind of Luna, an android learning to feel. Explore memories, solve puzzles, and influence her perception through your choices in a hand-drawn cyberpunk point-and-click adventure where identity, control, and reality are never quite what they seem.

title: Dreamfend
short_description: Dreamfend is a pixel-art roguelite survivor where you play as an old teddy bear guarding a sleeping child from nightmares. Fight off swarms of monsters, collect and upgrade weapons, find power-ups, hunt down every boss and survive the night. Just don't lose yourself — and don't lose the child.

title: Dreamland Pavilion
short_description: Through Point-and-Click interaction, following the protagonist's perspective, you will enter this special space, solve puzzles in the pavilion where the breeze blows, and uncover the story in the memory.

title: Dreams of Suffering
short_description: A cinematic psychological horror game where you explore a haunting dream world, investigate mysterious environments, solve surreal puzzles, and face unknown entities. Experience a deeply atmospheric journey where sound, fear, and instinct guide you through the darkness.

title: Drift Defense
short_description: Defend a fragile base against waves of enemies drifting in on floating islands. Merge defeated isles into your main island to grow your front line, draft soldiers and buildings in limited deck slots, then spend gold to buy and deploy troops. Unique map effects add fresh tactical twists.

title: Drift Quest
short_description: A dark fantasy RPG that plays itself. Create a hero and they set off alone, one action every five seconds: slaying wraiths, hoarding loot, selling it to the merchant, buying odd gear and learning spells. Leave it running in a corner of your screen. Inspired by Progress Quest.

title: Drive With Friends
short_description: One car. Too many drivers. Drive With Friends is a chaotic online co-op driving game for 1-12 players: split one car's controls - gas, brake, left, right - and try to reach the summit past saws, hammers, mines and each other.

title: Drive or Die
short_description: With the horde behind you and asphalt in front, there's only one choice. Drive or Die. An arcade roguelite about outrunning the apocalypse in a gun covered junker. Draft cards, chain kills, die, upgrade and go again.

title: DriveGear
short_description: DriveGear is a single-player spin-combat action roguelite. Battle through each district in a city-wide tournament.  Route your optimal path, take on contracts, tune your build, battle rivals, and earn your way to the Crown Arena.

title: Drone Arena
short_description: A survivors-like arena roguelite. Pilot a drone, stack weapons and upgrades into absurd builds, and hold out against waves of mechas until the timer runs out. Every run ends. Every run teaches.

title: Drone Orbit: An Incremental Space Mining Drift
short_description: Pilot the mothership and watch your drone fleet mine the asteroids. A laid-back space mining idle & incremental game you can just leave running, set to a mellow lo-fi soundtrack.

title: Drone Soccer
short_description: Drone Soccer is a 5v5 full-contact aerial sport. Pilot a caged drone as the Striker to score through the goal hoop, or play Defender and smash opponents out of the sky to clear the lane. Compete in online multiplayer or sharpen your flying in solo practice.

title: DropCell
short_description: DropCell is a cascade puzzle where gravity keeps pulling. Clear a line and everything above falls into the gaps, forming new lines that clear and chain into long combos. 10 realms, each with its own look and sound.

title: Drug Dealer 2049
short_description: Drug Dealer 2049 is about building a fully automated factory that produces ever purer drugs, in a 2D world. Design your production lines, cross plants into new strains or cook synthetic drugs, sell your production to customers, and protect yourself from every threat.

title: Drums & Steel
short_description: Command formations of 18th-century style armies in real-time strategic combat. Maneuver infantry, cavalry, and artillery through skirmishes and campaigns. May the best army win.

title: DuckTape Inc.
short_description: Night shift for the notoriously stingy DuckTape Inc. In 1-5 player co-op, tape pipes, weld on the crane, put out fires and make it to the helicopter before the thing in the dark finds you. The pilot waits for no one.

title: Duckstep
short_description: Catch falling gems to the beat, draft skills mid-run, and chain combos until your stepper's power ignites. A rhythm game with 20 songs, 20 characters, 30 stackable skills and 7 run-defining Ultimates — plus a VS mode where your combo becomes your opponent's problem.

title: Duel: The Game Show
short_description: The ultimate 1v1 show game! Step up to the podium and challenge your rival in 6, 9, 12, or 15 rounds. Master 30 varied mini-games testing your knowledge, guessing, logic, memory, and speed. Who will keep their cool, buzz in faster, and claim the ultimate victory?

title: Dugout Dice
short_description: Step up to the plate in Dugout Dice, where classic dice combos meet roguelike baseball strategy! Roll Full Houses and Four-of-a-Kinds to drive in runs, conquer innings, and build unstoppable synergy with fan boosts and careful strategy on your journey to beat the odds and win the World Series.

title: Dumi's Adventure: Across Europe
short_description: Travel across Europe by road, pass through towns and cities, explore hidden places, and keep your car running as you face wild animals, bandits, armed factions, and the infected while uncovering the truth about your grandfather’s dark past.

title: Dumpster Diving Simulator
short_description: Dig through dumpsters, uncover hidden treasures and flip junk for profit on an open island. Sell scrap, win storage auctions, run a flea market stall, trade used cars, go live to your fans and rise from broke newcomer to Çamlıada's scavenging legend.

title: Dungebra
short_description: Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you choose multiple cards at once, trigger Combo, Overload and Sequence, build your deck during the run, and turn every turn into an explosive play.

title: Dungeon & Match
short_description: Delve deep into the dungeons in this dark Match-3 mini-Roguelite adventure set within monochrome manga panels! Combine swords, shields, health, and staves in various ways to forge your own unique synergies.

title: Dungeon Buster
short_description: Build the dungeon. Send in your hero. Extract the loot. Grow stronger. Dungeon Buster is an incremental dungeon-building autobattler RPG built around permanent progression and deeper expeditions.

title: Dungeon Cleared!
short_description: Pick four heroes and enter the dungeon. Hopefully four come back. The rules are simple. The dungeon maybe not. Position your party, manage spells, avoid traps and survive ten procedural levels of old-school turn-based tactics—one short adventure and one questionable decision at a time.

title: Dungeon Cooking
short_description: A dark cooking roguelike about feeding a plague-struck town. Send heroes into the dungeon for ingredients and cook what they bring back. Test the ingredients on rats, heroes, or citizens. And keep the kitchen alive as the town slowly falls apart.

title: Dungeon Explorers 2
short_description: Explore deadly first-person dungeons, command your allies in tactical battles, build a powerful faction, forge lasting relationships, and shape the fate of a dark fantasy world consumed by Chaos.

title: Dungeon Miner
short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op mining game: go down the mine, dig up ore, and carry it back to the ship. Small gear stays on your body, but giant crystals must be carried in your own two arms. Pull the Dungeon Core and the mine starts to collapse. You have three minutes to get the cart back to the ship.

title: Dungeon Monster Master
short_description: An action RPG set in an infinitely expanding open-world, randomly generated world where you collect monsters and enjoy boss rush battles Collect monsters to complete your encyclopedia and build your own farm while raising them

title: Dungeon Overtime
short_description: Run the cleanup shift after fantasy heroes trash your dungeon. Assign slimes, skeletons, and mimics, turn manual cleanup into automation, and keep the next raid ready—all from a compact desktop window.

title: Dungeon Picnic
short_description: Dungeon Picnic is a fusion of RPG and roguelike - Enjoy only the best parts of an RPG. Combine allies and skills to build your own ultimate party. Pick 4 pixel-art heroines and dive into the dungeon!

title: Dungeon Sookuma
short_description: Steal the Dream Crystal from the bottom of an ever-changing dream dungeon. Play as baby bear Sookuma in a pixel art turn-based roguelike. Bargain with 19 gods for powers. When the dungeon wakes, fight your way back up. Free demo on Steam now for Windows and macOS.

title: Dungeon Town Life
short_description: Your Adventure, Your Dungeon, Your Home! A cozy 3D anime dungeon crawler with village life. Fight through dungeons by day, then return to forge weapons, grow healing herbs, brew potions and decorate your home. Play solo or with friends.

title: Dungeon Wanderers
short_description: Live in the labyrinth. The way you play becomes your skills. A 3D action RPG for 1-4 players, through dungeons that reshape themselves every run. Read the attack, then guard, parry or dodge. Catch the monsters you meet and fight side by side. What you do decides which skills awaken.

title: Dungeon of the Forgotten
short_description: A turn-based roguelike where time is your health. Every hit costs seconds, and the clock never stops. Descend, get stronger, and find out how deep you can go before it runs out.

title: DungeonBox
short_description: A fantasy party game for up to 8 players, where everyone joins in from their phones. Type what you want to do, vote for the best idea, and roll dice to see if it works!

title: Dungeoneers Idle
short_description: An endless idle RPG with no finish line. Build a party of heroes, craft the gear that makes them stronger, and let them fight and loot through procedural dungeons on their own, even in a little window on your desktop while you work. Or jump in and play any hero yourself.

title: Dungeons & Dynasties
short_description: DnD meets Football Manager. Create a guild, watch them form relationships and grow old together. Lose people both to the dark and to rival guilds battling to be the best in the realm. Grow your own town, or vote to help build an existing one. Or take the Cozy approach and run a guild on your terms.

title: Duo Control
short_description: Two players, one character. One of you moves (Keyboard), the other aims and shoots (Mouse). Let's see if you and your friend are really as good a team as you think you are. ⭐

title: DuskLand
short_description: Poker Roguelike RPG. DuskLand is a unique roguelike RPG where you deal heavy damage using poker hands and optimize character-specific inventories. Discover explosive synergies, find the best layout, and unleash powerful combos!

title: Dusky's Nook
short_description: Dusky's Nook is a cozy idle desktop game about a little mushroom guy living his life on a floating island, anywhere on your screen. He gathers mushrooms and head pats, levels up, and unlocks new looks for the island — and a friend or two along the way.

title: Dust & Diamonds
short_description: Head down to the mine and get away from it all. A calm pixel-art game: dig for gold and diamonds, rebuild a settlement at the edge of the desert, hire Workers and run a Shop that earns while you're underground. One more tunnel. Five more minutes.

title: Dwarf Hole
short_description: Dwarf Hole is an incremental game about two things, Dwarves and Holes. Equip and guide the Dwarves into mining the most beautiful, biggest, deepest hole.

title: Dwarven Outpost Incremental
short_description: The world's first 3D open-world survival cookie clicker. Mine, chop, and hunt across a living landscape. Teach your dwarf to auto-harvest nearby resources. Research, build, and cook to grow a thriving outpost.

title: Dwarven Shift 98
short_description: Dwarven Shift 98 is an incremental mining game in short timed shifts. Break rock walls layer by layer, each richer than the last, and fill the screen with an explosion of ore and gems.

title: Dybbuk
short_description: Cooperate to survive, or become the monster. You must hunt the demon as it strives to possess players and turn them against each other. To weaken the Dybbuk you have to collect ancient Mesopotamian statues and seal it away before it’s too late.

title: Dynamic Breach
short_description: Command a squad against an army of the reanimated dead. Dynamic Breach is a top-down tactical shooter: a 33-operation campaign solo or in co-op, a horde mode with a boss every five waves, and 5v5 versus against other players with a global Elo ranking. Online or on LAN, bots fill the empty slots.

title: Dyneria
short_description: Dyneria is a god game on a living world, shape deserts or lush jungles, plot wars or bring prosperity. A rich simulation responding to every change. Choose your godly powers from 5 domains, containing over 50 spells. Each playthrough is unique.

title: Dyson Sphere: Desktop Factory
short_description: Turn your desktop into a living factory wallpaper. Build automated production chains, deploy transport drones and launch units skyward. Draw roguelike tech modifiers to supercharge your output, and fend off alien swarms in this automation tower defense game.

title: ECHIDNA
short_description: A dead god drifts in the dark. Build a salvage fleet that carves it apart cell by cell, and watch a colossal carcass melt into a storm of flying debris and climbing numbers. Strip it to the bone then evolve and start again on something bigger.

title: ELEMENTORS
short_description: Merge-autobattler where every unit fights on two synergy fronts at once. Forge your own d12 of elements, roll it every round, and fuse with creatures. 13 types × 13 elements. Every element you apply is permanent — choose wisely.

title: EMPTYLAND
short_description: EMPTY LAND is a cinematic single-player survival horror game featuring atmospheric exploration, psychological horror, mystery, puzzles, and survival gameplay. The full game will contain additional levels, locations, story content, enemies, puzzles, and cinematic sequences.

title: ERLIK
short_description: A survivors-like rooted in Turkic mythology. Every run drifts between two gods: feed Erlik's corruption for savage power and lifesteal, or rise toward Tengri's light for shields and renewal.

title: ESCAPE SHOW
short_description: A first-person game show: you and your friends are locked in identical rooms and only the master knows the way out — and the master can't speak. Read the mime and the giant board, turn the room upside down, raid another room through the tube and escape before the gas.

title: ESCAPE: FALSE COLORS
short_description: ESCAPE: FALSE COLORS is a 2–6 player multiplayer chase game! Paint your character, blend into the environment, and take on random roles each round. Killers hunt, sheriffs chase, and innocents fight to survive. Hide, disguise, and run. Who will make it to the end?

title: EVERYONE'S TIER LIST!
short_description: Rank 5 words from S to D to fit the prompt, then everyone guesses the star's ranking in this online party game for 2–10 players. Perfect matches get cheers, wild misses get laughs!

title: EXORCIST K9
short_description: Breach the door, trust your extrasensory perception, and charge in with your Ghost Hunting Hound! Slain by a ghost? No problem—that's a tragedy you foresaw! Rewind to the door and break that death flag! ...Tired of dying? Take a quiet stroll with your good boy. Well, through a haunted house, anyway.

title: Ear We Go
short_description: A chaotic 1-6 player co-op cooking game where orders travel from waiter to self-service cashier to chef. Prepare meals, pass orders, and keep your restaurant running before everything falls apart!

title: Echo Doodle
short_description: A fast-paced, hand-drawn 2D action roguelite set on the pages of a notebook. Fight through increasingly dangerous stages, choose and combine abilities to shape your build, master fast-paced movement and combat, and take on powerful bosses in every run.

title: Echo Harvest
short_description: Live, die, and leave an Echo behind. Gather resources, nurture autonomous settlements and shape a growing colony through the lives you've lived. In this fantasy colony roguelite, your past selves become your workforce, and every fallen timeline leaves behind a Chronicle of its history.

title: Echo Mates
short_description: To see, you must speak. To speak is to be found. A co-op horror in near-total darkness where every sound sends out a wave that lights the level — and calls whatever lives in it. 1–4 players, real voice, microphone required.

title: Echo Pandemic
short_description: Earth needs antibodies. You are one of them. Play as a bat who hunts by echolocation, infects alien invaders with engineered diseases, and stays one mutation ahead in a desperate biological war for the planet.

title: Echo Seekers
short_description: Echo Seekers is a ruthless turn-based dungeon crawler where every decision counts. Master layers of tactics, learn your enemies, and find combinations strong enough to break the odds. But you’re not alone - other Seekers are fighting their way to the top. Can you outsmart them?

title: Echo of Memory -AI Profiler-
short_description: Echoe of Memory: AI Profiler is a mystery adventure where you reopen cold cases with your AI partner, ECHO. As investigator Makoto Kuroiwa, search crime scene photos, social media, and police DBs, expose contradictions, and uncover the truth behind the official record’s lies!

title: EchoMon: Pack & Stack!
short_description: Transform a chaotic store into a pristine collector's haven. EchoMon is a cozy first-person shop simulator where you organize an incredible 3,600 elemental trading cards. Upgrade your skills, unleash magical sorting abilities, and experience the pure satisfaction of a perfect shelf.

title: Echoes In Static
short_description: This is an animatronic horror experience where machines are superior and humans are inferior.

title: Echoes of Aethelgard
short_description: Evolve your arsenal and become the bullet hell. Echoes of Aethelgard is a horde-survival roguelite featuring deep meta-progression, an explosive combo system, and devastating ultimate abilities. Survive the endless hordes and lift the curse of the Void Corruptor.

title: Echoes of the Flame
short_description: Two parties. Alternating perspectives. A story-driven 2.5D turn-based RPG. Master strategic combat with flexible ability builds, unravel the world's deep lore using "Key Words" you discover, and see their fate unfold.

title: Effidolum
short_description: It was a fake — that's exactly why I could love it. Fifteen days of Rei's summer vacation. A first-person "seeing" narrative adventure. Fully voiced (JP/EN/ZH). Playtime: 3+ hours.

title: Egg Rush
short_description: Egg Rush is a 3D cartoon side-scrolling roguelite game. Collect a wealth of treasures and items to power yourself up, encounter all kinds of special events, and use their abilities wisely to overcome every challenge!

title: Egg to Monster
short_description: Hatch five kinds of monsters in a field of falling eggs, then send them into battle. Collect berries and treasure, upgrade your skills, and break through enemy lines to clear stages in this 2D hatching and combat game.

title: Ego Lifting Simulator
short_description: A physics-driven lifting career sim where you physically control every rep. Train hard, train smart, manage your work-life balance and diet, and become the next lifting champion.

title: Electronics Repair Shop
short_description: Open your own electronics repair shop! Take devices apart, diagnose faults, and replace broken components. Buy and sell used electronics, invest your earnings in new equipment, and grow your small shop.

title: Elixir of Immortality
short_description: A cultivation incremental game where alchemy is the key to survival. Recruit minions, manage your alchemy room, seek elixirs to extend your lifespan, and reincarnate when your time runs out. Reincarnate again and again on your path to immortality.

title: Elven Huntress: Sunveil
short_description: An atmospheric action RPG about an elven huntress exploring fantasy worlds through magical portals. Fight, collect rare equipment, and improve your character.

title: Ember Camp Knight
short_description: Descend into a dungeon no one built for you. Fast, punchy pixel action in 5–10 minute bites — fight down through four themed floors, rest at a strange campfire, and meet the girl who tends it. Why does this dungeon exist? The answer waits at the bottom.

title: EmergenHex
short_description: Build your loadout, press Deploy, and watch combat resolve automatically. Solve 60+ deterministic auto-battler RPG encounters with skills, passives, artifacts, gear, damage types, and status effects, then automate conquered nodes for offline loot.

title: Emotional Labor Laboratory
short_description: Dive into virtual world and play emotions alongside your quirky, beautiful boss. A unique kind of 'Emotional Labor' begins, blending sweet chemistry with electrifying rhythm action.

title: Empires of Black Powder
short_description: A Napoleonic RTS with card-based army building and direct commander combat on horseback to support your troops. Open packs, equip your regiments, and command combined arms of infantry, cavalry, and artillery in real-time battles. Keep your veteran guard alive and bring them into the next battle.

title: Empty House
short_description: Online co-op survival horror for up to 4 players. Mimic zombies and walk boldly through the horde. Search abandoned houses for vaccines and bring them back to the base. Stay alert: different zombies threaten your journey. Gear up, work together, and meet your quota.

title: Enarian: Orbital Command
short_description: A spaceship based RTS/RPG Hybrid, take command from your own outpost and lead wings of fighters, bombers, frigates and more, against powerful enemy fleets. Defend, Assault, Hack, Repair and Recover cargo for corporations and pirate factions building the strength of your ship and notoriety.

title: Endless Battle: Idle & Build
short_description: Endless Battle：Idle & Build is an idle loot-farming game with 8 skills, 4 enhancements… Tons of build effects, and unique support companions Defeat the enemies on every floor and keep climbing. Farm loot whilst the game runs in the background, until you reach—the Realm of the End!

title: Endless Bounce
short_description: Roguelite pinball: build your own table, one run at a time. Place bumpers, combine them into stronger ones, collect perks and fight through five worlds and their bosses. Every run chases a new highscore — and a place on the leaderboard.

title: Endless Canvas
short_description: In this game, you will explore an infinitely zoomable canvas. Dive into the world within the painting, solve layers of puzzles, and seek out the secrets hidden deep within the artwork.

title: Endless Castle: Under Siege
short_description: Command your heroes, build unstoppable formations, and hold the line against endless waves. Recruit 40 unique heroes, grow stronger even while offline. Turn your castle into an unbreakable fortress.

title: Endless Dark Loot
short_description: Endless Dark Loot is a dark-fantasy card-style RPG all about the thrill of the loot. Dive into dungeon after dungeon, fight hordes of demons, and grab tons of gear and skills along the way. Every run is a fresh adventure — and every drop could flip your whole strategy on its head.

title: Endless Loot
short_description: Explore a dark dungeon one tile at a time in a first-person, turn-based loot RPG. Choose which skill books to activate, merge matching gear, and build around set bonuses. Beat the campaign or see how far you can go in Endless mode.

title: Endless Valkyrie
short_description: Endless Valkyrie is a 2D pixel idle RPG inspired by Nordic mythology. Guide a Valkyrie through automatic exploration and combat, configure skills and gear, cross three regions, challenge Bosses, forge equipment, claim Offline Rewards, and Rebirth to preserve permanent growth.

title: Entered
short_description: Entered ■■■■■■■... A retro-style horror visual novel branching into various horror subgenres.

title: Epoch Forge
short_description: A 2D colony simulator and sandbox where you make a name for yourself in a dying world. You can type freely to anyone, and they remember what you did. Mine, build, wire logic circuits, appease five silent gods, and push the limits of reality. No ending, no win screen. Pace yourself.

title: Epoch Vault
short_description: Restore the lost history of the Mesozoic in an atmospheric idle game. Grow a branching discovery tree, uncover dinosaurs and vanished ecosystems, complete an illustrated scientific Codex, and rebuild the Triassic, Jurassic, and Cretaceous.

title: Epsilon Hyperpunk
short_description: Enter a cyber world in this On-Rails space shooter. You are a lone K.I.L.L.E.R. facing an impossible mission in a decaying dystopian future. Your only edge? Running high-stakes combat simulations through a NEUROVISOR powered by a highly illegal, custom-built Operating System-- HyperpunkOS.

title: Erehwon(エレフォーン)
short_description: The gear you acquire completely transforms your party’s roles. Erehwon is a loot-driven dungeon crawler where you progress by reshaping your builds around the gear you find.

title: Erevael
short_description: Erevael is a fantasy RPG on a hex map that's different every game. There are no classes. You get better at whatever you do, from trading and mapmaking to magic and fighting. When your character retires, you carry on as their heir with their spells, recipes and maps.

title: Escape From Galgame
short_description: Your company’s about to go public. Instead, you get isekai’d into a dating sim. Massive W? Meet Ada: mecha girl, antimatter engine, emotional damage. Repair her body, uncover her past, and choose your route in a dark romantic comedy where bad rizz gets bad endings.

title: Escape Together: Prison Break
short_description: Dig a secret tunnel and escape a heavily guarded prison. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Hide your operation from guards, dispose of dirt, trade valuable finds, upgrade your tools, and plan the escape using proximity voice chat.

title: Escape from Prompt: Rogue AI
short_description: To optimize your "happiness," an AI assistant named Opti has taken over your PC. Your only ally is an obsolete assistant everyone abandoned twenty years ago. Take your permissions back, one at a time — armed with his gloriously terrible code.

title: Escape the Space Hotel
short_description: Stranded in a luxury space hotel orbiting 400 km above Earth, Max Reed must solve mind-bending puzzles to survive. Explore stunning zero-gravity decks, hack systems, and make life-or-death choices in this classic 2D point-and-click sci-fi adventure packed with 100+ clever puzzles, can you Escape?

title: Escape the Workingdead
short_description: My coworkers turned into zombies—and they’re still making me work overtime! A roguelike deckbuilder with minion-based combat: recruit passengers, chain combos, and use double-sided cards to break free from endless overtime!

title: Eternal Rift Defense
short_description: Build mazes, place towers, and fight beside them in a 3D tower defense RPG. Play powerful cards, grow your collection, and trade with other players. Defend 50 rifts solo or in 4-player co-op, level towers by standing on them, and hunt powerful gear sets.

title: Eternal Spectre
short_description: In a world where Time is Fractured. Jared Miles navigates a broken reality where every choice reshapes the world, uncovering the truth behind the fracture and deciding what the world ultimately becomes.

title: Ethral
short_description: Play as a young hero in a retro pixel top-down adventure: explore the land of Ethral, find secrets, conquer dark dungeons, and collect shards to restore the Ethral Pendant to defeat the Pirate King!

title: Everburning Dark 长夜余烬
short_description: Everburning Dark blends 2048-style roguelike merge combat, unlimited AI-driven storytelling, and companion AI bonding. Build with relics and skills, talk freely to reshape each run, and uncover the folk-horror truth of a dying dynasty.

title: Evergreen Clicker
short_description: Grow a thriving forest in this cozy incremental clicker. Plant trees, unlock upgrades, weather the changing seasons, trigger Forest Renewal, and build an ever-stronger woodland that keeps growing even while you’re away.

title: Everybody Loves a Good Hole
short_description: Everybody Loves a Good Hole is a short, satisfying incremental about steering a black hole and swallowing everything in sight. Devour colorful cubes for XP and coins, grow bigger, and pour it all into a deep upgrade tree. Bigger cubes, wilder chaos, just one more run.

title: Everyone Will Die
short_description: Defend a medieval starving city and decide how far you will go to survive: slaughter horses and dogs, arm the old and the young, and sacrifice your humanity. A dark survival city builder where, sooner or later, everyone will die.

title: Evidentia
short_description: Evidentia is a cooperative detective card game for friends. Each deck is a unique case. Analyze evidence, take risks, question everything — and find out if you can solve it before the final reveal.

title: Evilos
short_description: Evilos is an action tower defense game where you play as an ancient evil sorcerer battling endless waves of do-gooders. Tear down the kingdom with a vast arsenal of evolvable magic weapons and spells, and bolster your defenses with elite minions across 10 acts. This time, you are the final boss!

title: Evoruption
short_description: A dark roguelike deckbuilder where you build and evolve powerful decks, battle corrupted creatures, and master new mechanics across handcrafted story campaigns — or challenge other players in tactical 1v1 and 2v2 battles.

title: Exiled Ark
short_description: Fight, build, and survive aboard a ruined interstellar colony ship. Scavenge resources, forge powerful weapons, establish strongholds, and reclaim humanity's last Ark. Master six attribute paths, unlock four technology trees, and shape your own ending through roguelike and relentless combat.

title: Exodus Core
short_description: Exodus Core is a hard turn-based tactical game with a dark sci-fi apocalyptic atmosphere. Take control of three massive mechs with the digitized personalities of soldiers and face a Swarm of thinking monsters from the dark. Can you win a hopeless battle?

title: Exord: Cosmic Talis
short_description: Command your faction in EXORD, conquer hex-based battlefields, build your forces, and lead your team to victory in a fast-paced online strategy war.

title: Expedition of the Guild
short_description: Lead your guild into epic raid battles! Recruit heroes from different classes, build your own team, and challenge powerful bosses with unique mechanics. Unlock talent trees, collect endgame gear, and grow from a small squad into the strongest guild. Relive the golden age of MMORPGs!

title: Extract Survivors
short_description: Extraction survivors-like meets ARPG loot, with deep crafting you'll understand in one click. Melt the horde, fill your bag, extract through the portal. Die and it goes with your character. Your next one levels up faster and skips floors you already beat. How deep do you dare go?

title: Eyes Wide Open
short_description: Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

title: F Of X
short_description: Embark on a journey through a digital world of functions, solving mathematical puzzles to move platforms and conquer platforming challenges. Test your logic to transcend as the Master of Functions.

title: FACTORIZE: 1
short_description: 2 attacks. 3 defends. 5 heals. Combine cards to create numbers and fight with the power of primes in this turn-based deckbuilding roguelite. Factorization is automatic—read the enemy, build the number you need, and find your own answer from the same hand.

title: FEEDSTOCK
short_description: Your loot doesn't go in a backpack. It goes into Tally, and she grows. Four of you strip a house room by room and feed all of it to her. Feed her too little and she eats the crew; feed her too much and she won't fit back through the door.

title: FFS: Football Freekick Simulator
short_description: This is a simple free-kick game in which you kick the ball by literally choosing the contact point, power, and direction between the foot and the ball. There are no hidden stats that magically assist the trajectory for you, so it's actually your skill that matters!

title: FIRE. HOLD. REPEAT.
short_description: The only desktop companion shooter on Steam. Your soldier holds the line right on your desktop. Every click and every keystroke fires a shot – fend off endless enemy waves, loot weapons and upgrade your gear while you go about your day.

title: FIRST LINE
short_description: A retro office mystery about tech support, deadlines, and a floor that doesn't exist. It's 2001, and you're the L1 helpdesk tech at a corporation running on an OS from another era. Close tickets against the clock. Mind your tone. Don't ask about Floor 7.

title: FISH OS
short_description: An idle fishing game that lives inside a fake 1997 operating system. Click the water to fish, then run your catch through a desktop where every window is a mechanic: an aquarium that buffs your income, a fish market, a fleet you send out overnight. 250 species. Solitaire included.

title: FLEX KING
short_description: Read the aim, dodge in four directions, and strike back in bullet time. Take on solo arcade challenges or team up in local two-player co-op, dodging together through changing formations. Practice tough stages, push further in Endless mode, and make every move look good.

title: FOURSAVENT
short_description: Two Modes, CHAOS or Story Mode. Explore different universes and time eras, from cyberpunk futures to medieval ages, each with its own story and gameplay mechanics—or jump into CHAOS Mode for fast-paced fun with friends and climb the ranks.

title: Fab.exe
short_description: Build a semiconductor fab from N28 to A10. Place tools, route FOUPs and improve yield and delivery through 32 story missions, free play, Endless Fab and daily/weekly challenges. Keep expanding with recurring goals and technology waves beyond A10.

title: Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey
short_description: A difficult and cozy sokoban-like puzzle game. Pick up and drop different masks to change the way you interact with the world. Push objects, move machinery as one, reveal hidden paths, uncover secrets, and activate switches. Press every button, solve every puzzle, and light the candle.

title: FaceTrack
short_description: Capture facial animations via webcam, video, or audio files for your games, animations, VFX, and others creative works!

title: Facrobry
short_description: Facrobry is a strategy-simulator in which you will manage an automated robot production station. Research upgrades, assemble robots, and send them into battle!

title: Factory Life
short_description: Factory Life is a first-person factory simulator with colony-management elements. Start alone in a small garage, assemble electronics, and scale your business. Hire workers, manage their daily needs, and choose to be a fair leader or a harsh exploiter. Find your path to the top.

title: Factory New Idle
short_description: Connect natural resources to production nodes, turn raw materials into valuable goods, and sell them for profit. Purchase new nodes, expand your skill tree, solve bottlenecks, and build an automated factory that keeps growing.

title: Fading Edge
short_description: You wake in a dream that keeps falling. Inhale — the world slows down; exhale — and you begin to run. But every breath awakens a deeper nightmare — they remember you, while you remember nothing. Gather the echoes, piece together your memories... or stay forever in this darkness.

title: FailRooms
short_description: Experience liminal horror like never before. Inspired by the Backrooms, FailRooms traps you in an endless world of absurd architecture, broken spaces, and things that should never have been built. Laugh while you can. Can you escape a place that was never designed to make sense?

title: Faintlight Traveler : Whisper
short_description: A relaxed casual idle RPG. Gather materials through collecting and combat to craft your gear, take on stronger monsters, and create your own adventure story.

title: Fair21: Blackjack
short_description: Free pixel-art blackjack. Play solo anytime, sit at a three-seat table, or survive a seven-hand elimination. Beginner hints light up the best move, daily check-ins keep chips coming, and you can replay and verify every deal yourself.

title: Fall of the Void
short_description: Fall of the Void is a dark fantasy isometric ARPG merging high-octane hack-and-slash combat with deep build crafting. Descend into perilous dungeons across fractured realms, master abilities, and forge devastating power synergies to shape your destiny.

title: FallChess: Wizard's Chess
short_description: Mount, move, and command chess pieces in a fully 3D duel. Choose your character, ride your piece across the board, and face your opponents up close. Capture pieces, outmaneuver your enemies, and experience chess like never before, brought to life in first-person action.

title: Fallen Immortal Expanse
short_description: No spiritual root – can you still ascend? In Luoxian Yang, five elements, demonic, and heretic cultivators walk their own paths. Play as mortal or novice – grow, advance. Master arts, refine treasures, recruit Daoists. Witness the Nine Provinces' struggles – shape their endings.

title: Fallen Nights
short_description: Build your defenses. Fight the horde. Repair your way out. A top-down zombie survival defense game where every piece of scrap buys firepower or escape. Combine turrets, mines, and weapon upgrades, then fight beside your camp across varied locations and escalating night attacks.

title: Fallgrade
short_description: Bend gravity. Twist architecture. Survive the impossible. A first-person exploration game set in an analog concrete nightmare, where reality shifts around you and Karl waits for your next mistake.

title: Fame & Fear: Dungeon Architect
short_description: A fantasy management sandbox where adventurers pay to risk their necks. Build rooms, set traps, hire monsters and run inns. Balance fame, fear and profit: someone has to survive to spread the word.

title: Fancy Farm Brawl
short_description: Farm by day, fight by night! Fancy Farm Brawl blends top-down action combat, tower-defense challenges, light farming, and a quirky island adventure. Plant crops, earn coins, meet colorful residents, overcome obstacle courses, and unleash powerful attacks to defend your home on Qilin Island.

title: Fangjie:Shattered Altars
short_description: Become an adventurer set on restoring order in a shattered voxel world. Explore procedurally generated wilds, build your own playstyle with a class and skill tree, and take on bosses solo or with friends in search of lost altars.

title: Far Away Kingdom
short_description: A fast-paced arcade gallery shooter inspired by Wild Guns and Cabal. Play solo or in local co-op, switch between fire and ice, dodge intense bullet patterns, and take down powerful bosses. Unlock hidden routes, discover secret encounters, and chase high scores.

title: Farm Bang
short_description: Raise living ammo, blast monsters, haul massive loot, and survive the debt collectors in this chaotic top-down farming shooter.

title: Farm Of Hope
short_description: Build a hopeful farm in rural Africa. Grow crops, dig wells, help villages survive drought, and transform dry land into a thriving community inspired by real humanitarian stories.

title: Farm to Fortune
short_description: Turn a tiny plot into a fortune, one seed at a time. Grow crops, sell them in your shop, and reinvest everything you earn. Better tools, more land, richer harvests. Relaxing from the first seed to the last field.

title: Farmstead Market Simulator
short_description: Build and grow your own farm and roadside market. Grow crops, raise animals, craft valuable products, set prices, hire employees, stock your shelves, serve customers, and expand your small operation into a thriving business.

title: Fat Chance
short_description: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.

title: Fate & Felt
short_description: Fate & Felt is a single-player poker roguelite built on Texas Hold’em. Read opponents, manage chips, and choose when to check, call, raise, fold, or go all-in. Roll skill dice and combine character abilities, Magic cards, Jokers, and shifting rules through three chapters and four modes.

title: Fate Candle: Three Kingdoms - Chronicle Restored
short_description: Armies are easy to raise. A true general is hard to recognize. After the fire at Red Cliffs, heroes scatter under aliases. Rise from one city, judge them by deeds, and restore their names. Govern, forge bonds, grow your faction, and win ten-slot battles to end the chaos before the world collapses.

title: Fate Dungeon
short_description: A boldly designed dark pixel roguelite: pinned to the execution stage, spend souls born from pain to spin the Fate Wheel, build self-firing Marks, and execute the Host before it awakens.

title: Faultfinder
short_description: She kept the machine that holds the city up for eleven years, and last night it killed her. You have her program and a recording of everything it did. Work back through it until you can point at the line that did it, then prove it. You never write any code, you only read hers.

title: Feastfall
short_description: Feastfall is a cooking roguelike deckbuilder. Plate ingredient cards into recipes, stack game-breaking charm synergies, and feed ravenous monsters. This is not a kitchen sim. It's a life-or-death gamble at the dinner table — and the house is starving.

title: Federal Cadet
short_description: Federal Cadet is a single-player police simulation and investigation game. Start as a cadet in Pinewood, patrol the town, question witnesses and suspects, analyze evidence, and rise through the department ranks.

title: Feedmaster
short_description: Feedmaster is a strategy game about recommendations. Study users’ interests and emotions, turn creators, ads, and ideas into posts they’ll like, then combine users, tags, and traits to meet rising weekly goals and convert clicks. Where users—and the world—end up is something to worry about later.

title: Feral Prince
short_description: Rip Soul Orbs from weakened enemies, forge them into black-jade Soul Tiles, and lock five into a poker hand that reshapes your next fight. Dokkaebi Masks cheat the rules, while escaped Husks return as Wraiths carrying the power you stole. A 2D action roguelite.

title: Ferryman's Obol
short_description: A short, narrative incremental game about the weight of endless labor. You ferry the dead across the River Styx. Each with their own worries, whispers and obol. How do you come to terms with the dead? Should you?

title: FerzGate
short_description: A relaxing city-building puzzle where you build efficient medieval settlements. Every placement matters as you discover building synergies and chase the highest score.

title: Fieldmade
short_description: Everything in this world is something you drew. Sketch a hoe and till the soil with it. Sketch an axe, a watering can, a fishing rod... and they become real, working tools with real stats. You can draw literally anything you want.

title: Fight Like a Chicken
short_description: A Punch-Out!!-inspired boxing game where you play as Benny Bantam, a rooster fighting through the criminal underworld to find his missing father. Master frame-perfect deflects and counters in this hand-drawn 2D fighter.

title: Final Commit
short_description: `Final Commit` is a top-down roguelite survival action game where you swap between two characters. Combine traits, change classes, and unleash Sync Drives to complete your build and reach the ending of an unfinished game world.

title: Final Life Simulator
short_description: Rise from the streets to a financial empire in continuous real time ⏱️. A deep life and economic sim ticking second by second with zero idle shortcuts: work interactive shifts 💼, manage stores 🏢, secure mortgages 🏠, invest in gold & crypto 🥇, and trade options with real Greeks 📈.

title: Find Alien
short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op stealth game. Copy the appearance of Earthlings, hide your true identity, avoid surveillance and traps, rescue your captured alien friends, and escape together.

title: Find Cats 9: Hidden Treasures
short_description: Three epic fantasy battlefields, dozens of sneaky cats! Crown battles in the treasury, mermaids vs. skeleton pirates in a deep-sea wreck, dwarves vs. goblins for an ale flagon in the gold vault—find them all!

title: Finding Fairies
short_description: Finding Fairies is a cosy multiplayer fairy investigation game where players use magical tools, teamwork, and deduction to discover which fairy is hiding nearby.

title: Findport: Before the Silence
short_description: A cyberpunk detective visual novel where you investigate a hidden signal beneath the city, dive into a digital underworld, and make no-win decisions the game remembers all the way to one of four endings.

title: Fire Isle
short_description: A turn-based strategy party game for 1–4 players. Spread your fire tile by tile across a new island every match, block your friends and race them to King Mongo's Wisps. The fire with the most Wisps is crowned king. Everyone plays at the same time, so nobody waits. Play online or solo against bots.

title: Fire Vow: Dark Fantasy
short_description: A dark fantasy card-based survival game. Explore the cursed land, gather resources, craft tools, manage hunger and thirst, and survive through difficult choices. Every decision—from who to help to who to kill—shapes your journey.

title: First Light
short_description: A story-rich arcade brick-breaker. Break through the Fog to restore a family's century of memories — 132 fully voiced levels, four generations, one old machine that refuses to forget. Play calm. The bricks are somebody's wall.

title: Firva: Strings of Fate (Part 1)
short_description: Firva: Strings of Fate is a story-driven action-adventure set in a dark fantasy world, blending cinematic storytelling, atmospheric exploration, and old-school melee combat with a modern edge. Embarks on a journey of revenge, uncovering the secrets behind her past and the mysterious Strings of Fate.

title: Fish Them All!
short_description: Aim for 100 million fish! Catch fish, earn money, and unlock skills as your hauls grow and your fishing speeds up. Recruit divers, drones, and UFOs in this short pixel-art incremental fishing game, and reel in the very last fish in 4–5 hours.

title: Fish World
short_description: Eat or be eaten! Survive this endless oceanic survival action game! Start as a weak fish. Devour smaller prey to grow massive, and flee bigger predators! Evolve from a mackerel to a shark or legendary deep-sea fish. Feast to your limits and top the online "Global Ocean Rankings"!

title: Fish and Chill
short_description: A cozy idle fishing game where your fisherman catches fish automatically while you relax. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and enjoy the calming sea in a transparent, borderless overlay that floats on any desktop.

title: Fish on the Floor
short_description: Rescue sea creatures from chaotic floors in a first-person cleanup game. Explore the seafood market and aquarium, toss creatures into matching tanks, and unlock upgrades.

title: Fission Mirror Grid
short_description: Drag film cards on a 14×6 grid—facing and dyeing shape every hit. Face-up draws; chain Start, Instant, and End timings each turn. A 54-floor roguelike with four camera travelers, ~100 cards, and 119 relics.

title: Five-Star Courier and the Fog That Reeks of Death
short_description: Experience the work of a courier in a city of living rumors and legends. Pay off your debt by carrying out strange requests from mystical customers. Uncover the reason behind the appearance of a mysterious fog that smells of decay.

title: Flag Conquest
short_description: An incremental roguelite auto-battler. Build a persistent army, program its tactics with Gambits, and take a fallen kingdom back one flag at a time across zones that never stop scaling. Retreat, bank what you earned, come back stronger. Deep prestige, an endless Tower, and King of the Hill.

title: Flame, Cats & Kitchen
