short_description: Draw your ingredients, cook them, and feed hungry cats! A cozy cooking game in a colorful paper kitchen. Cut out your creations, add flavor with special crayons, and use heat and stirring to make each guest's meal just right

title: FlipBAKA
short_description: Flip floor panels and launch enemies — and friends — off the island! Top-down arcade party action: explore and power up in Dungeon Mode, play 8 solo stages and a boss, co-op, or 8-player online PvP. Just one more round! Dungeon demo has online co-op.

title: Flippy the Spider
short_description: Jump, glide, and swing your way through increasingly challenging levels, eating flies and searching for your way home. Master tight, physics-based controls, explore 5 distinct worlds, and collect trophies along the way!

title: Fliprium
short_description: Explore a hex board, gather materials, and forge artifacts in a fantasy tabletop strategy game inspired by mahjong and Yezi Xi. Turn clever combinations into high-scoring chains. Try the free demo: single-player against bots.

title: Flirt Simulator
short_description: Forget pre-written options; let your words drive the game! In this first-person dating sim, say whatever you want to AI characters with real memories and get natural responses, and experience a completely unique story every time.

title: Flow Treehouse
short_description: A tiny treehouse tucked into the corner of your desktop. Prince Tomato times your focus, Todudu keeps your to-dos, and Lily plays soft music. Focus, finish tasks and play with them to earn wish points for outfits, playlists and decorations. As the treehouse grows, new fairies move in.

title: Fluendora: The Realm of Scribes
short_description: Fluendora is a multiplayer and single-player word-puzzle. Prove to your friends you know some words (or learn some if you don't). Players can either compete for the highest score (up to 6 players) or enjoying a peaceful solo session.

title: Fluxgates
short_description: A roguelike where every run is a factory you wire together on a canvas. Draft nodes, connect them into a production line, then press Run and find out. Each room demands more than the last - build the combo engine that keeps up, or stall three ticks from the target.

title: Fly&Goal
short_description: A casual puzzle game where you play disc golf while navigating holes that showcase the changing seasons. Read the wind to choose your throw, dodge obstacles, and aim to clear all 12 courses, each with 9 holes.

title: Fool's Trigger
short_description: Welcome to the table where life is the stake. Fool’s Trigger is a tense mix of Russian roulette and a card game for 6. Load your revolver, manipulate the cards, put lives on the line, and dare to find out who will be the unluckiest today.

title: Football Manager: Auto Chess
short_description: A football management game mixed with collection career play. You manage a themed club, schedule training, recruitment and league fixtures, then drag coach cards to command near-realtime matches as you climb from lower leagues to bigger stages.

title: Football Referee Life Simulator 26
short_description: A realistic referee simulator! Show cards, use VAR, control matches, and rise through your referee career!

title: Football Star Life ! 26/27
short_description: Create your player, prove yourself season after season, sign for new clubs, represent your country and compete for football’s greatest trophies. Every performance shapes your future, every decision changes your path, and every career tells a different story

title: For My Kingdom
short_description: You are a medieval king. Keep your treasury, army, granary and church in balance with every decision. Repel invaders on the war map, pass the throne to your heir, grow your dynasty for generations.

title: For The Realm
short_description: A co-op fantasy deck-building roguelike where players build decks, coordinate card combos, battle monsters, and survive dangerous runs across the realm together.

title: Forest TD
short_description: Forest TD is a top-down strategy game blending tower defense, survival, and elemental magic. Explore a vast forest, transform trees into defensive towers, and combine elemental abilities to fend off relentless waves of enemies.

title: Forged Cards
short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where YOU forge the cards. Slot casts into molds, temper their power, and etch combo inscriptions. Pick your path, battle, bargain, or brave the unknown, then outplay your enemy in simultaneous, position-based combat. Each run is different and each deck yours.

title: Form
short_description: Feed, observe, and raise FORM, a mysterious digital entity living on the RÆLOS desktop. In this atmospheric idle simulation, time passes even while you are away. Explore files, complete quests, play minigames, and decipher the traces left by every cycle.

title: Forsaken Trials
short_description: A hard, momentum-driven platformer where every jump is final. Master sprint, vault, and precision timing through cursed ancient ruins. No air control. No checkpoints. One mistake means death. Restart instantly and try again.

title: Forteria
short_description: Gather resources, upgrade your equipment, and strengthen your base with up to 4 players. When night falls, fend off waves of monsters and protect the precious Mana Stone from destruction.

title: Fortress Breaker
short_description: Every siege starts simple. Break through fortress levels, topple bosses to unlock new upgrades, equip upgrades for your next run in the Armory, discover powerful combinations, and conquer all boss levels to unlock Endless Mode and Boss Rush.

title: Fortune Tree
short_description: Grow a little good fortune on your desktop. Fortune Tree is a cozy idle game inspired by Chinese gardens. Nurture your tree, decorate your garden, and collect uplifting fortune slips. Optional keystroke counting turns everyday typing into growth as you work or study.

title: Forturia: Trade Route Pioneers
short_description: A turn-based dice board game inspired by the Age of Exploration. Dice rolls and strategy decide your fate! Play a solo campaign or battle online with up to 4 players. As a young captain, lead a small trading company, trade at ports worldwide, explore uncharted seas, and fulfill Royal Orders.

title: Foundation: Galactic Frontier
short_description: Command Asimov's OFFICIAL Foundation universe! Live the life as an interstellar trader to exploit your trade routes! Build your starship home, crush enemies in explosive shootouts & outsmart rivals with fleet strategies in epic space wars - with new content expanding your saga!

title: Fox Idle
short_description: Go on an adventure with cute fox-eared companions! Gather resources, craft gear, fight monsters, complete quests, and most importantly, make progress together with foxgirls in this incremental idle RPG.

title: Fox Two Protocol
short_description: Hit the afterburners in modern fighter combat. Fly the campaign, duel in PvP, race through Time Attack or take on an endless mission. Build your own mix of upgrades and equipment, then find a reason for one more sortie.

title: Fragmenta: Ancient Egypt
short_description: Restore the lost treasures of Ancient Egypt in a relaxing 3D reconstruction puzzle experience. Every artifact is shattered into a unique arrangement of fragments, offering endless replayability across multiple difficulty levels, from casual sessions to expert challenges.

title: Fragments of Ember
short_description: Explore the ruins of a forgotten kingdom in this atmospheric pixel-art platformer. Light ancient torches, solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and master challenging platforming as you restore the fading flame.

title: Frankenmine
short_description: An incremental game where you dig through cursed tombs, harvest bones, flesh, and various resources; stitch together your own creature from nothing. Discover powerful artifacts, experiment with unique combinations, and bring your creation to life—piece by piece.

title: Fraudster
short_description: Climb to the top of the cybercrime world! Lure victims using various phishing methods and manage the darkest digital fraud operations from a single room. Push all boundaries and stay alive in this dark hacking simulation while evading the authorities on your trail.

title: Free Ball: Volleyball
short_description: Free Ball is a multiplayer volleyball game. Control one player and compete with your team in fast-paced 4v4 matches from an immersive third-person perspective. Choose a character with unique abilities and work with your team to dominate the court.

title: Free Company
short_description: A co-op tactical RPG set on the eve of the year 1000. Lead a free company of mercenaries across a doom-haunted medieval world. Take the contracts, win the fights, and decide what your company becomes before the millennium turns.

title: Freeze Line
short_description: Time is coming apart. You wake in a clock tower — no memory, a warm pocket watch, and your master's charge: gather time's scattered shards and mend the world. Freeze time, aim your dash, slip past all that wants you dead — then return to the one who sent you, and a truth that rewrites everything.

title: FreshSheets
short_description: Clean hotel rooms, satisfy guests, earn money, and work your way up to owning and managing your dream hotel.

title: From Zero: Idle Factory
short_description: Start with one machine and grow across five factories in this idle/incremental game. Build production chains, research better parts and reinvest your profits. Find the bottleneck, choose your next upgrade and work toward a final goal.

title: Fruit Slicer
short_description: Slice fruit with precision - using your mouse or real hand! Dodge bombs, master combos, and push your reflexes to the limit in this fast-paced arcade slicer.

title: Fruit Store Simulator
short_description: Stock it, price it, sell it, and turn a small corner fruit shop into the neighborhood's favorite fruit store.

title: Full Metal Hell
short_description: Full Metal Hell is a roguelite shooter combining physics-based collisions and active abilities. Choose from a wide variety of vehicles, weapons, and builds, and crush everything in your path through the mechanical hordes!

title: Furgon Magic Trader
short_description: Become a forest alchemist in a traveling van! Grow herbs, collect rare ingredients, create potions on alchemical machines, trade with forest dwellers, and explore new locations. From simple extracts to powerful elixirs

title: Fuse Rush
short_description: Fuse Rush is a fast-paced physics action game inspired by the N64 classic Blast Corps! Grab bombs and objects, charge your throw power, and clear obstacles. Earn rewards, unlock cool skins in the shop, and beat the highscore before time runs out!

title: GALLERY OF LIES
short_description: A first-person trap-escape game. Don't trust what you see. You fell asleep in a museum after closing and woke up on the wrong side of a wall. 23 rooms to the exit. Signs are fake, arrows lead to spikes, and the dodge that saved you last room kills you in the next.

title: GARITO
short_description: A rigged slot machine refuses to pay. Rig it back. GARITO is a slots roguelike where you edit the reels mid-spin, wire your own paylines, and beat the payout out of boss machines — one strike at a time.

title: GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown
short_description: Travel with your wolf companion in a third-person Living World RPG. Villagers live their own lives, adventurers pursue their goals, and rumors carry stories beyond your sight. Discover a fantasy world that keeps moving while you explore elsewhere.

title: GET COOKED
short_description: A multiplayer game where rival teams each run a restaurant. Cook, serve customers, and fortify your base during prep — then wage war: ram walls with vehicles, crack the enemy vault, and wreck their dining room. First team to the target score wins.

title: GO or STOP
short_description: GO or STOP reimagines the traditional game Red Light, Green Light as a social mind-game party game. Players alternate between seeker and runner. Runners shove, hide behind rivals, and race for first place, while the seeker watches for movement and stops them from reaching the finish.

title: GO, STOP
short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder built on hwatu, Korea's flower cards. It's 1999 and you owe a Busan loan shark ₩200,000,000. Match cards, stack charms, blow up the multiplier, and call "Go" to double the pot. Interest comes due every third night.

title: GOBLIN ELECTRIC LTD.
short_description: Goblin Electric Ltd. is drowning in debt. Lead a crew of up to 20 goblins across three maps, crack giant monsters' armor in semi-auto battles, knock them down and capture them alive. Wire them into the grid, sell the power, build up the company – and pay back every coin.

title: GTB: Broke to Boss
short_description: Build your empire in a living open world where every NPC has a real home and routine! Manage supermarkets, fast-food spots, and furniture stores, buy any property, decorate your dream house, and make friends with every citizen. Can you turn this town into your personal business empire?

title: GUGUGAGA: PEEKABOO
short_description: GUGUGAGA! Sudoku! Minesweeper! Combined gameplay!! Plus, you can play online with friends!!!

title: Gacha Chaos Tidy Up Together
short_description: A cozy-chaotic co-op organizing sim. Sort 7,200 gacha capsules into 900 machines across 20 color zones, solo or with 1-4 players. Throw, catch, and SLAP capsules out of your friends' hands, unlock 13 team skills, and collect 100 capsule series. No timer, just chaos.

title: Galactic Kebab
short_description: A dark survival strategy game about a celebrated chef stranded on a hostile alien world. With Nekobot, your service robot, turn the wreck of your ship into a restaurant, keep the Empire's tax paid, and decide what you are willing to serve. Survive if you can, but can you stay human?

title: Galacto
short_description: A cozy idle game that lives at the bottom of your  screen. Run a space gas station, refuel ships, hire bots,  chain combo for fat payouts, and rebuild an outpost into  the busiest stop in the galaxy!

title: Galaxiwilds
short_description: Explore a collapsing multiverse, make first contact with 75 alien civilizations, and uncover the truth behind reality’s unraveling—one discovery at a time.

title: Gallop Diva: Ladies' Jockey Academy
short_description: Gallop Diva blends realistic horse racing physics with a deep story simulation. Master high-stakes horse racing and deep visual novel choices in a world where speed meets true human nature. Ride your horses, navigate choices, and outrun dark rules of the racetrack politics.

title: Gambit Gardens
short_description: Become the ruler of the garden in this cute multiplayer strategy game! Win blind auctions and grow powerful plants before your opponents grab the best turf.

title: Gamble Hunters
short_description: A first-person casino action roguelite for 1-4 players. One wallet, four hunters, zero trust. Hunt monsters for 60 seconds to fill the shared pot, then race your friends to gamble it into your own Gold. Upgrade guns, mix traits and artifacts, beat bosses, and pay off the shared debt or go bust.

title: Game Dev Dynasty
short_description: Create the game of your dreams in this studio management tycoon. Design game covers, lead your team and compete in a living market. Outsell rivals, win Game of the Year, and build the most prestigious game studio in the world.

title: Gaming DNA & ESTI
short_description: Test your reactions, aim, tracking, and memory in short, replayable skill challenges. Chase personal bests and dodge incoming skills in classic 2D MOBA training. Quick runs, clear results, and another chance to improve.

title: Gank
short_description: WISHLIST NOW! A love letter to all fans out there who enjoy DOTA or LoL - a MOBA card game! Explore the lore-filled Eudoria, and pit mainstream fantasy like trolls, banshees, even hydras in a long-awaited showdown. Though designed for quick online matches, we also squeezed in a roguelite campaign!

title: Gateshock
short_description: Every map has a code. Build yours, paste it to a friend, beat theirs. A hex-grid tower defense with 14 towers across four upgrade tiers, a hand-crafted 16-mission campaign, and a run mode where 40 relics decide how far you get.

title: GemSlasher
short_description: GemSlasher is an action roguelite where every attack is built from gems. Combine Main Gems with Support Gems, merge duplicate gems to increase their star level, and create powerful builds capable of tearing through relentless waves of monsters.

title: Gemfire Survival
short_description: Survive endless neon waves in this fast-paced arcade auto-shooter. Collect XP gems to evolve your build with game-breaking synergies, survive brutal 60-second boss cycles, and spend banked gems in an infinite permanent skill tree to push your next run even further.

title: General Jeon
short_description: From a peasant boy in peninsula, to the most powerful man in the nation — and finally, to a criminal facing the judgment of history —— Sixty years of turbulence. One road from a thatched hut to the Blue House. How far will you go?

title: Genuine Article
short_description: Vienna, 1901. A bureau that authenticates antiques: without your certificate the piece is worth nothing. Silver, paintings, watches, papers — each carries a truth and a lie about its history. A predecessor’s debt makes bribes tempting. And you won’t get this right every time — mistakes cost.

title: Geometry Run
short_description: Geometry Run is a 3D third-person platformer with a retro synthwave style. Control a glowing cube, overcome creative and challenging levels, and perfect every run. Designed for speedrunners, each level features three modes: Normal, Reverse, and Speedrun.

title: Get It Free
short_description: An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?

title: Get Outta My Gut
short_description: A roguelite tower defense game where you protect your body from invading germs. Draft turret cards, build strong defenses, and supply them with blood to protect your heart. Fight through 10 organs and evolve your immune system between runs.

title: Get Stronger! Auto‑Chess
short_description: This is an auto-chess game. By combining units' skills, passive abilities, and synergies, units can grow infinitely stronger.

title: Ghost Express
short_description: Ghost Express" is a 2D storage-organizing puzzle game about Spooky, a ghost who's too cute to scare anyone. Fit each shop's goods into boxes piece by piece, then deliver them to the apartment next door. As the orders pile up and space runs out, can Spooky get the job done?

title: Ghost Receipt - A Cyberpunk Pawnshop Simulator
short_description: Run a cyberpunk pawn shop in a neon-soaked city and negotiate thrilling deals. Buy, sell, negotiate deals, investigate mysterious items, and piece together customer stories through the items they bring, the secrets they hide, and the risks you choose to take and the profits they bring.

title: GhostomVillage
short_description: Death has brought you to the Underworld. To avoid fading into oblivion, you must fight to survive. Hunt, farm, fight, build, and trade as you slowly carve out a place for yourself in Netherworld Village. Seek a way to reincarnate—or stay behind and build a life of your own.

title: Gift Stream: Sorting & Delivery Simulator
short_description: Gift Stream Sorting & Delivery Simulator is a logistics management simulator where gifts constantly arrive through a mysterious portal. Inspect, sort, and ship them efficiently while upgrading machines and expanding your warehouse to handle an ever-growing delivery stream.

title: Giraffe Champion 3: Halloween Party & The Ghost Guitar
short_description: Play rock and metal songs and compete against zombies, witches, ghosts in the guitar battle to get all your guitars back. You are going to perform at a Halloween party but zombies have stolen all your guitars. Collect all the guitars before the Halloween party starts!

title: Giusto
short_description: Bidding for tricks in the forest. Be perfect, or be punished. Giusto is a tabletop, turn-based, strategy card game that rewards how well a player can predict the outcome of their hand BEFORE each round starts. Players are scored based on the accuracy of their pre-game predictions. Low score wins.

title: Glaring Flaw
short_description: Glaring Flaw is a narrative puzzle adventure built around shifting perspectives. Unlock new camera angles, reveal hidden paths and clues, and explore a rural family estate threatened by both natural disaster and an approaching new era.

title: Glims
short_description: A battle pet that lives on your desktop. Your glims walk your taskbar, live in a 3D house you decorate and earn gold on their own. When you call, they hold off an invasion on your screen or dive a 20-floor dungeon. Free, light, and it works offline.

title: Glitch Hunter: L-Virus Outbreak
short_description: Glitch Hunter: L-Virus Outbreak is a roguelike deckbuilder set inside a corrupted simulation. The mysterious L-Virus has infected the game world, breaking its data and turning everything into distorted low-poly fragments. Monsters, environments, and even the rules of reality have been rewritten.

title: Global Plates
short_description: Build food factories that keep a cat café purring. Plan at your own pace, serve fresh dishes through the rush and turn your best days into upgrades. Travel through ten kitchens in a cozy cooking-automation game about tasty efficiency.

title: GloomDelve
short_description: Bring a friend to the couch: a 100-floor roguelite dungeon crawler with true local split-screen co-op (online too). Draft game-breaking power cards, die, descend again. A Mad Wizard mocks your deaths, and every wall, monster and sword is generated by code, so it runs on a toaster.

title: Gloomy Tavern Stories
short_description: A fantasy potion crafting game where you experience the life of an alchemist. Gather materials that you can craft into different types of potions. Potions can be used as bombs. Solve puzzles by utilizing the effects of your potions. Hire heroes as mercenaries to battle monsters and bosses.

title: Glow up Hero
short_description: Glow up Hero: a card roguelike where beauty = power. Recruit real-world heroes, field 4. Each: 3 standard + 2 ultimate cards (once per battle). 3 energy/turn, unused cards discarded. Glow Up transforms & upgrades all cards. Real origins. Beauty is justice? No—beauty is power.

title: Glowpits: Farmers Arena
short_description: Explore the world of GlowPits, collect valuable resources, defeat rival explorers, unlock unique characters, and upgrade powerful abilities in a fast-paced arena adventure filled with creatures, challenges, and endless progression.

title: Goalcrest: Club Management Tycoon
short_description: Build a football club from the amateur leagues to the top. Manage tactics, finances, sponsors, facilities, morale and matchdays. Strengthen your squad, earn promotion, grow your reputation and become the world’s greatest manager.

title: God Codex
short_description: A cinematic 2D pixel-art action adventure. Slay the Demon King, then awaken within her memories as two girls struggle against fate in a collapsing world. Heavy combat, environmental storytelling, and immersive cinematic presentation with almost no UI.

title: God Is Not Here
short_description: “My God, my God… why have You forsaken me?” — Psalm 22:1. Words spoken by Jesus Christ on the cross before His death.

title: God of Stock
short_description: God of Stock is deck-building roguelike. You play as a trader, use god-blessed cards to trade stocks, manipulate prices, and make money in a chaotic market. Build a unique deck, collect powerful artifacts and treasures, and eventually become the God of Stock.

title: Gods of the Grid
short_description: Fight your way up Olympus in a match-3 roguelite. Match runes to strike and heal, cast spells and claim relics, and find the weakness every foe is hiding. Nine realms, seven demigods, one life per run.

title: Gold Miner: Party Rush
short_description: Gold Miner: Party Rush is a multiplayer party game for 2 to 6 players, bringing the classic Gold Miner crane to head-to-head competition. Grab gold, outlast rivals across frantic rounds, and play with friends or get matched online in Quick Play and Ranked modes.

title: Golden Trivia Show
short_description: Enter a quiz show solo or with friends. Divide your gold bars among the possible answers; those placed on a wrong answer will fall into a piranha pool. Will you make it to the end?

title: Golf Course Architect Tycoon
short_description: Build a golf course on raw land, then watch a full field of golfers play it - or play it yourself! See where they struggle, reshape the hole and watch again, all while you run the club growing around it. No grid: sculpt the terrain and paint every surface by hand.

title: Gomoklear
short_description: Gomoklear is a Gomoku strategy roguelike: connect five to clear. Form a five, pieces leave; spawn, remove, move, transform. Collect pieces and Manuscripts, build your Library at Serendipity and the Stall. Two plays a Round, one for the Rival. Gomoku has never been this unpredictable.

title: Good Night
short_description: A good night's sleep is for one person only. Roll, squirm, and shove your friends off the bed in this 2-4 player ragdoll party game.

title: Gore Grind
short_description: A first-person roguelite horde shooter for 1 to 4 players in online & couch co-op. The city mutated, the internet is down, and dying costs money. Butcher the horde, bank the cash, upgrade your guns like the NRA intended, and keep working for the only pizza place still open.

title: Gorgeous Baby Bella
short_description: While her husband is away, Liora is forced to spend her days alone. But solitude is not as quiet as she thinks.

title: Grand Snow Rider
short_description: Grand Snow Rider is an open-world action-adventure simulator. Clear snow-covered roads, find abandoned vehicles and their missing keys, fight off troublemakers in snowball battles, and bring the cars back to safety. Use snow-clearing machinery and unusual gadgets as the storm grows stronger.

title: Grand Vista Hotel
short_description: Build and manage a growing hotel. Earn stars, upgrade rooms and elevators, add restaurants, spas, conferences and events, and transform a small family hotel into a luxury Palace.

title: Grandma Left Me A Building
short_description: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

title: Grave Profits
short_description: Auto-battler Dungeoncrawler without PvP in a Dark Fantasy setting. Recruit, Match 3 to level up, build game breaking synergies with items and unlocks. Supports 2 player online CO-OP

title: Gravefire Tavern
short_description: Gravefire Tavern is a dark-fantasy roguelite backpack auto-battler. Recruit adventurers, arrange formations, and create builds through item shape, placement, and adjacency. Brave shifting expeditions where every victory, wound, death, and legacy shapes your tavern and the party that follows.

title: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand
short_description: A dark pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. You're the mortician the night the dead stop staying dead — turn every corpse into cards, forge them to Ascended rank, and survive 22 nights, three rule-breaking bosses, and one thing that was never meant to have a name.

title: Greaselord
short_description: Build the biggest fast food empire in the world and defend it against three rival chains before the health authorities ban you. Your goal: 80% of the world market across 169 countries, with one of 14 main dishes.

title: GreeDrill
short_description: You owe the Company $2,000,000. Pay it back in ore. A push-your-luck mining roguelike: drill deeper for a bigger payout, surface before the hull cracks, outrun the Bailiff and face the five Guardians of the deep.

title: Greed Forest TD
short_description: Build huge mazes, combine towers for wild synergies, discover ridiculous spells and upgrades, and turn your Buildy into a baddie.

title: Greedspire
short_description: Build powerful gear combos in a push-your-luck roguelike auto-battler. Enchant your gear to +20 or watch it shatter. Move to the next floor, or risk your entire run for richer loot in deadlier rooms. 100 floors. One life. How greedy will you get?

title: Greedy Getaways
short_description: Grab your friends and cruise aboard Greedy Getaways! Explore tropical islands, haul gold back to the captain, and pocket a little on the side. Wobbly physics, exclusive upgrades, questionable outfits, and a good laugh on every excursion!

title: Green Breach
short_description: You awaken confused on a lifeless mining vessel. Exploration reveals mutated horrors stalking in the shadows. Your flashlight is slowly dwindling away as you solve puzzles. Can you navigate the decks and reach the escape pod?

title: Green Field Cube Island
short_description: Green Field Cube Island is a 3D action RPG. Step into the role of Chodnii, cross the mysterious teleportation portals scattered across Cube Island, explore wildly different worlds, hone your skills, defeat dangerous enemies, and ultimately find a way to escape Cube Island.

title: Green Gas
short_description: 3–5 Cells and One hidden Cancer. Which one will you become? Work together to gather money and power the main Generator to survive But the Cancer hides among you, stealing cash, spreading toxic gas or water setting deadly traps and contaminating rooms Trapped? Win the mini‑game or die!

title: Greenrise
short_description: Greenrise is a short and cozy incremental game about chopping wood, breaking stones and mining gold to buy upgrades and grow your island.

title: Grenade Party
short_description: A party game for up to 8 players where the crowd throws grenades, bombs and food onto the field. Catch grenades and throw them back to survive, and mix kart races, football, basketball, hockey, beach volleyball and obstacle courses into the same match.

title: Grench It!
short_description: One goblin wants to become the greenskin boss with a single stolen wrench. Hopeless, right? Well, that goblin is you now. Build walls and turrets, swing your wrench sometimes, and beat the pirate rats. Steal their ship, make it stronger, and let's go back proudly to the tribe who kicked me out!

title: Gridiron Grit
short_description: A deep pro-football front-office sim. Draft through a fog of scouting, build contracts that come due years later, develop raw kids into stars, and outlast 31 rival GMs who scout, bluff, and hold grudges. No play-calling. Every decision is yours, and so is every consequence.

title: Grim & Bear It
short_description: A dark comedy bureaucracy game where you're the Grim Reaper's overworked intern. Read each soul's case file, check the day's ever-changing rulebook, and stamp them to one of six afterlife destinations before the timer runs out. Eternal judgment, run like a soul-crushing office.

title: Grimoire of Hecate : Tower of Starlight
short_description: Combine cards into powerful spells in this roguelite deckbuilder. Build your strategy around four elements, read enemy intentions in turn-based battles, and grow stronger between runs as Ray climbs the Tower of Starlight to find her missing mother.

title: Grimrain MMORPG
short_description: Grimrain is an indie MMORPG with a variety of casual and challenging gameplay for solo and groups. Explore the game world, with gathering, crafting, instanced and overworld dungeons, player housing and decoration, hidden locations, and legendary foes.

title: GrindFall
short_description: A thrilling Co-op Action Roguelite for 1-4 players! Play as mischievous ghosts, create insane weapon synergies, catch humans, and turn them into pumpkins. Deliver your harvest to the crypt, expand the map, and unleash vibrant chaos in this Bullet Heaven!

title: Grindbound
short_description: A single-player, top-down 3D auto-looter set in a dark fantasy world. Explore dungeons, defeat enemies, collect randomized gear, and combine skills and equipment to create powerful builds. No complex controls or quick reflexes required.

title: Groove Core
short_description: Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter where you arrange your weapons on a sequencer. Mix and match 200+ items, build your ship, and flood the cosmos with bullet storms as deadly as they are beautiful.

title: Groovekeeper: Sort the Record Shop
short_description: A first-person record-sorting game: no customers, no economy, no time pressure. Shelve the records that come out of the crates by genre, put rare ones on the turntable and listen. As the shelves fill up, we guarantee relaxation.

title: Group Commander
short_description: Take command of a World War II heavy bomber group over occupied Europe. Read the field order, weigh the target against the men, and send your forts. A player-paced command sim where every mission is a decision and every empty bunk is one you signed for.

title: Group Idlemen
short_description: Train Skills to 99, take on key bosses for RARE LOOT, Raids, & Expeditions. Control all 5 people in your group and climb the leaderboards!

title: Grove of the Seven Stones
short_description: An old-school fantasy CRPG featuring deep party creation, tactical d20-inspired combat, dangerous dungeons, and meaningful quests. Explore a world of ancient magic, hidden secrets, and deadly foes as you uncover the truth behind the Seven Stones.

title: Growing Knight
short_description: Growing Knight is an incremental game of timing and positioning where you fight monsters, upgrade your skills and go for another run until you become unstoppable. Learn skills, spells and hire retinue to fight with you.

title: Guardian of Boss Neko
short_description: Guardian of Boss Neko is a 2D anime-style top-down survivor-like game that incorporates a gathering mechanic. You play as a maiden Guardian, guiding Boss Neko to gather Magic Crystals while beating up monsters (or getting beaten up by them).

title: Guild of the Tower
short_description: A party-based auto-battler RPG: build a guild, program your heroes' battle tactics with the Gambit system, and watch them fight their way up a mysterious tower where permadeath is real and not everyone comes back down.

title: Guildfire
short_description: Lead a party of adventurers through branching expeditions in this turn-based tactical roguelite. Learn enemy intentions, build each character with abilities and accessories, manage your upgrades, and unlock new possibilities between runs.

title: Guitar Practice Mate
short_description: Practice guitar with TAB/sheet music playback, real-time performance feedback, tempo control, looping, and a tuner. Training Mode shows timing issues and missed notes, with cute desktop characters by your side.

title: GummyGom Delivery
short_description: Carry cargo together on a shared board with your jelly bear teammates! Each movement affects the board’s balance, and a single mistake can bring everything crashing down.

title: Gunline
short_description: A tower defence you fight in first person. One road, one base, and thirty kinds of enemies walking down it. You meet them yourself with six guns and and build different kinds of defensive turrets.

title: Guns & Gargoyles
short_description: A gothic dark fantasy action RPG in a torchlit forest where you see only what your light touches. Throw knives and pull them back out of the corpse, burn wolf packs with molotovs, and swing steel when they close. Make sure you are prepared, for the beast at the end shows no mercy

title: Guttering Light
short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder in a vault that is running out of light. Descend four depths as one of four heroes, building a deck from cards, stones and draughts as you go. Your torch is a resource — let it gutter and experience greater pain. The lords of the vault stand between you and victory.

title: GymPup
short_description: GymPup is a furry-themed romance narrative game that blends desktop idle gameplay with visual novel elements. Through their journey together, you watch the two protagonists grow and change—inside and out.

title: HABAP
short_description: A cozy reseller sim where you haggle with grannies, buy mystery bags, and turn flea-market junk into profit. Grow your little shop, hunt rare finds, and buy a plane to escape a country where reselling for profit is a crime.

title: HACKING INTO EREBUS
short_description: HACKING INTO EREBUS is a terminal-driven hacking cyberpunk thriller. Jack into a hostile network and outsmart ARIA, a surveillance system that watches your every move. Breach nodes, override defenses and pry secrets from a crew trapped in cryosleep. Fight your way into Compartment Zero.

title: HAIGLA
short_description: Confined to a wheelchair, explore a hospital pulled into a distorted world beneath reality. A slow psychological horror focused on exploration, tension, and the unsettling atmosphere of this place.

title: HEAVENBREAK
short_description: A fast-paced third-person roguelite shooter. Hold the line against relentless waves, upgrade your weapons, and create devastating builds with each run.

title: HEROES' BATTLE HYMN：Demonfire Era
short_description: This retro Chinese pixel RPG is set in a fiend-infested world. Recruit heroes, use dual skill trees and team combos. Explore, battle foes, fight the demonfire plague, banish darkness and raise your battle hymn.

title: HEX: You Are It
short_description: Tag your friends, smash their hiding spots and pass the curse. Up to 10 players chase each other through breakable cities, a mountain, the Moon and a plane, on foot, in cars and on hoverbikes. Don't be the Hex when time runs out.

title: HEXHOLD: SIX FORMATIONS
short_description: Hex-grid tower defense set in the Three Kingdoms. Build your deck, summon legendary heroes, and hold the last stronghold through 20 waves of endless night.

title: HIRUGAO
short_description: A mystery psychological thriller visual novel set in 2000. Follow a serial murder case through many eyes, including the woman, the man, and the detective. With live-action backgrounds and silhouetted characters, every choice branches the story, and one wrong move means game over.

title: HOLD THE COOP!
short_description: HOLD THE COOP! is an incremental auto-battler where you protect your coop from waves of coyotes. Earn gold, buy upgrades, unlock stronger chicken units, and survive tougher rounds. Lose, upgrade, and come back stronger!

title: HOPE FALLS
short_description: This is a survival game you cannot survive. An asteroid is coming. Explore, fight, and choose who to trust in the last days of Hope Falls.

title: HOPENOTHING
short_description: A tactical RPG in search of hope. You are a traveler who is "no one," and you can wield every weapon type. Burn your foes on the grasslands, call down lightning on rain-soaked battlefields — or simply drop them into a pit. 11 endings await, and what you wish for decides how your story ends.

title: HOPIATE
short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about day trading stocks in a simulated market. Build a deck of edges, trade a tape that moves in real time, clear the week’s target. Blow the account and the evaluation fee was non-refundable. Your account manager is very supportive. He’s paid on volume.

title: HOSHIKIRI: Parry the Zodiac
short_description: Match-3 is your sword. Read each boss's telegraphed strike, then dodge, block, or land a perfect parry by shaping an L or a cross inside the danger zone. Duel the twelve Zodiac maidens, break their posture, and end them in a single overclocked blow. A tarot-driven action match-3 roguelike.

title: HOTEL10
short_description: A horror game combining the search for anomalies with an escape. If there are no anomalies, you move forward; if there are, you turn back. Aim to escape the hotel alongside your chinchilla.

title: HYPER TITAN
short_description: Sci-fi fleet combat: pilot your mothership, build modules, recruit hero captains, and wage formation war across the galaxy.

title: HYPERPIPES
short_description: Race the OUTSIDE of the pipe. Gravity pulls you around the tube, so holding the top is the whole skill. Every track is grown from a seed, so no two are the same. Draft, boost, shoot and climb six leagues in a neon anti-gravity racer built around one more run.

title: Habitat: The Endless Terrarium
short_description: Build living habitats on a clay tabletop world. Draft animals, shape the land they need, and watch your terrarium fill with life through the turning seasons. A strategy game without stress — deep enough to master, calm enough to unwind with. Alone or with up to 4 friends.

title: Halloween Poppp
short_description: Halloween Poppp is an easy, Halloween-themed connect-and-match puzzle. Space keeps shrinking — plan each move and pick the best option under pressure. Master 10 tools, chain combos for multiplied scores, and earn richer gems. Level up, then prove yourself on the Steam leaderboard!

title: Hallucination
short_description: Takumi, a high school student, gains the power to make others experience hallucinations indistinguishable from reality. What begins as a tool for revenge soon changes his fate forever. A psychological suspense visual novel where your choices shape the ending.

title: Halsey Row
short_description: People come to the shop on Halsey Row to sell the memories they can't carry and buy the ones they can't live without. Appraise what they bring. Decide what it's worth, and who you'll sell it to. Run an honest shop, or a darker one, and piece together what this street is hiding.

title: Hammered Heroes
short_description: Hammered Heroes is a fantasy Auto-Battler Roguelite where you recruit a drunken band of heroes, build your party, and descend through an ever-deeper dungeon. Choose your classes, upgrades, and path, then watch your heroes brawl automatically. Die, grow stronger, and descend again.

title: Hamsteria
short_description: Hamsteria is a difficult 2-player co-op game where you play as two hamsters in attached wheels. Online co-op, local co-op, and single-player are all supported!

title: Hamstr Protocol
short_description: Build a hamster-powered bio-mining operation from the ground up. Assemble rigs by hand, manage heat, feed your runners, and keep production moving. Start in a garage, optimize every part of your operation, and scale into a full-scale industrial operation.

title: Hand Stretched
short_description: Run a wood-fired pizzeria covering three key roles, Chef, Waiter or Manager, over frantic 6 minute shifts! Can you and up to two friends keep the customers fed and the accountants happy? Or see off a rival shop in a head-to-head, best of three/five battle with up to five other players?

title: Handset HQ
short_description: A phone company management sim. Pick a shape, swap materials, or draw the outline yourself, then develop, test, and sell it. Every change instantly shifts the cost and how buyers react. Grow a tiny startup into a phone giant, as long as people actually buy what you build.

title: Handslayer
short_description: Handslayer is a poker-inspired RPG roguelike of strategic 3-hand battles. Every battle is a tactical duel where you build not one, but three hands to defeat your opponent. Collect powerful relics, discover ancient artifacts, and forge game-breaking synergies. Every hand matters.

title: Happy Lane: The Threshold
short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror puzzle game where every door is a decision. Read the clues, follow the rules, and choose carefully inside a research facility that rebuilds itself every run. Pick the wrong door—and whatever is waiting in the dark comes for you.

title: Happy Project 12
short_description: Become the father of Hinata, a 4th-grader, and face three years of junior high entrance exams. Each week, choose study or play, raise her deviation score, aim for her dream school. But what's really being tested is your relationship, not her grades. Which of the 11 endings awaits you?

title: Harbor Water
short_description: A sudden summer flood in Shuigang City traps ordinary households under their own roofs. Face hunger, thirst, damp, and illness. Take stock of supplies, buy emergency goods from the shop, and call on your neighbors for help.

title: Harvest Exit Plan
short_description: Nico's grandparents just gave him the orchard he spent his whole childhood resenting. The plan is to strip it bare, sell it, and never touch an apple again. Six gardens, three tools, and a season system that keeps handing him a reason to start over.

title: Harvest Havoc
short_description: Harvest Havoc is an auto-fire action roguelike. Move and dodge as swarms sweep across wheat fields, frost, lava, deserts, and the endless void. Choose weapons and passives every level-up, evolve your build, craft companions, and paint your own map to battle on.

title: Harvest Story
short_description: Merge ingredients on a tiny platform, cook up dishes, and sell your way to survival. The landlord shows up every week like clockwork, and rent only gets steeper—so merging isn't enough, you need a plan. Hire robots to automate production, unlock a tech tree to expand your farm.

title: Harvest Them
short_description: No one tells you why. You are the villain: sweep a kingdom crowd by crowd for coins, blood and souls. Every weapon must be taken off the boss who carries it. Dark fantasy idle action. The game explains itself exactly once — at the very end.

title: Harvest Together
short_description: Build a cozy farm with friends or solo! Grow crops, raise animals, and ride your horse across the meadows. Dynamic weather waters your crops when it rains and blankets your farm in winter snow. Online co-op for up to 4 players — sow together, grow together.

title: Harvestide
short_description: A unique Roguelike farming game blending deckbuilding with farm management! Farm with cards, survive the Wither Moons. Build your deck, tend your farm, and reap the harvest—or starve.

title: Hasami: Moonlight Trim
short_description: Hasami is a tree pruning game where every cut cleaves through everything it crosses. Find the right angle, pull branches aside with ropes, nurture new growth, and clean endless procedural trees down to their blossom.

title: Hatch'n'Wall
short_description: A medieval board game where 4 knights race for the crown. Place walls, set traps, and outwit your rivals in turn-based dice combat. Play solo against AI or online with friends.

title: Hauntasy
short_description: Do you believe in ghosts? You and your chosen partner are top influencers invited to survive seven nights inside a haunted ancestral estate for $1,000,000. Monitor the rooms, manage your candles, and uncover what the Baron and Baroness are hiding before 4 AM in this psychological fantasy horror.

title: Haunted Echoes
short_description: Haunted Echoes is a raw psychological horror game experienced through a bodycam perspective. Explore abandoned, eerie locations, manage your limited flashlight, face terrifying anomalies hidden in the dark, and try to survive a nightmare where every single move is being recorded.

title: Haunted House
short_description: You wake up in an eerie mansion, beside the one you love. To take her home, you face six lost souls — not enemies, but tragedies to understand. Each room hides a love never spoken. But when you think you've finally escaped, some truths only appear once you walk out the door.

title: Haunted House Hellshift
short_description: Fight through a haunted house full of monsters and traps while a live TV audience watches. Collect eyeballs to open cursed doors, find the exit, and try to make it out alive—solo or with a friend in local 2-player co-op.

title: Heart Of Machine
short_description: Heart of Machine blends top-down tower defense with light roguelite elements. Face an evolving mechanical swarm thousands strong, tailor defenses, upgrade towers with chips, and use real-time support weapons to turn the tide. Build an unbreakable line and save the core from destruction.

title: Hearts Extreme
short_description: The classic card game Hearts, rebuilt as a solo puzzle. Every level sets a different goal for you to hit. Ten decks, each built from a different set of cards, played at 4, 5 or 6 player tables. And a ranked game where you compete with players around the world.

title: Heatline
short_description: Heatline is a single-player open-world cops-and-racers game. Race as an outlaw, escape police pursuits, and unlock a police career to hunt down rivals. Customize your cars, equip pursuit tech, and decide when to push for bigger rewards or return to base to bank your earnings.

title: Heavensmith: Dungeon Unbound
short_description: Explore dungeons in a single-player, turn-based RPG. Learn skills across classes, craft gear with your choice of materials, and lead a party of up to five against bosses. Develop your village and build bonds with your companions.

title: Hecatomb
short_description: Hecatomb is a mythic deckbuilding roguelike that tests how much you're willing to sacrifice. Every action produces Offerings, which can be relinquished to the Gods in exchange for powerful effects. But which Gods you worship and which you scorn have lasting effects on your journey to the Underworld.

title: Heliobane
short_description: Fly the sun-killer gunship Heliobane against a hive that eats stars, in an Amiga-style vertical shoot 'em up. Strip guns off the dead, buy the rest from a trader who calls you kiddo, and break fifteen screen-filling Heralds across three worlds.

title: Helion Conflict
short_description: Real-time strategy stripped down to decision-making: every factory builds endlessly – you decide where the ships fly and redirect them in mid-flight. Up to eight players online, with cross-platform play across Windows, Mac and PlayStation®5. Minutes, not hours.

title: HellRock Diver
short_description: Dig through Hell. Kill the horde. Choose your power. Descend deeper. A roguelike shooter-platformer where the ground is your weapon and every boss kill makes you stronger.

title: Hellmachina Railbane
short_description: Hellmachina Railbane puts you in the role of a sealed war machine reborn through a pact with humanity. Together, you’ll rise against towering futuristic races armed with advanced sci‑fi tech & ancient magic.

title: Hello Mayor
short_description: You are not merely building a city—you are governing it. Plan districts, balance the budget, investigate local problems, chair government meetings, appoint officials, negotiate with investors, and watch every decision travel from public concern to policy, implementation, and consequence.

title: Hemlon the Grey
short_description: Hemlon the Grey is a deflection-based 2D Souls-like where life and death are decided by a blade. Follow the story of Hemlon, a half-demon warrior, as she uncovers the dark secrets of the Reinz Republic and the Broken Wings.

title: Herd League
short_description: Grow a small herd into a thriving ranch in this farming strategy game. Breed and exchange animals, manage your pasture, expand your land, protect your herd from wolves, and race other ranchers to reach the cow goal first. Play solo or online.

title: Herding Adventures
short_description: Herding Adventures is a realistic, MMO herding sim where you and your dog control sheep through pressure, not commands. Guide the flock, avoid predators, and keep them together in a skill based experience where every sheep counts.

title: Heritage Flipper
short_description: Cozy house renovation simulator where you renovate historic old ruins into luxury estates. Clean, restore & decorate homes in American, French, English, Spanish, Dutch, Japanese, Chinese & more styles. Uncovering the secret history of each home.

title: Hero of the Kingdom: Echoes
short_description: Experience a lovely adventuring RPG as a humble herbalist whose home is threatened by an unknown blight. Explore ancient ruins and mysterious depths, brew potent potions, and help people in need. Enjoy the deeply gratifying feeling of gradually restoring the entire realm.

title: Hero's Guild
short_description: Your heroes are people. They form bonds, take grudges, fall in love, and die permanently. Run a guild of brilliant, emotionally unstable adventurers — and watch their story write itself.

title: Heroes And Calls
short_description: On a fantasy continent ravaged by endless war, train heroes, collect powerful treasures, summon a variety of unique creatures, build multiple one-of-a-kind armies, defeat formidable enemies, battle other players, and become the supreme ruler of the land.

title: Heroes of Aetheria: Crystal Siege
short_description: The void surges across the borders, shattering the walls and reducing cities to ash. Traditional defense games relegated you to the role of a passive spectator. Here, the rules change. Seasoned swordsman or arcane mage, you step right down onto the battlefield!

title: Hexborne
short_description: Draw one unbroken path across a hex battlefield. Tiles you cross become attack, armor, healing and gold, and how you reach each foe picks your strike. Dark fantasy roguelite RPG. Chapter 1 demo.

title: Hexwell
short_description: Hexwell is a top-down action roguelite where you use powerful magic spells to fight off hordes of arcane machines. Choose your path through the dungeon, fuse your spells together, create unique builds, and become the ultimate mage. Play solo or local co-op with up to 4 players!

title: Hi-Lo: Card Roguelike
short_description: A cozy roguelike deckbuilder where every card flip is a bet. Predict if the next card is Higher, Lower, or Equal, stack jokers, build score combos, survive story-driven events. One deck. Endless decisions. Will you bet it all?

title: Hidden Assault
short_description: Top-down hybrid of strategy and stealth action game. Espionage, infiltration, tactical combat, and resource management. Customize loadout, earn experience, and develop your squad's skills.

title: Hiss or Miss
short_description: Hiss or Miss is a poker-inspired deckbuilding roguelike where you play as a hissing cat. Build upRage, collect talents, enchantments, forge unique builds, and unleash powerful Hiss attacks against unique enemies. Every choice shapes your journey, and every Hiss can turn the tide of battle.

title: Hist Maker: ReMake
short_description: A world history you can play. Combine people, events and ideas (Emperor Napoleon + Britain = Trafalgar) to rebuild 69 eras, from antiquity to the early 20th century. Every discovery fills in the era's panorama. Build your own levels with mods, history or not, and share them on the Workshop.

title: Historiker
short_description: You have inherited a train station from a family that never mentioned it. Walk its platforms into Berlin, Paris, New York and Hong Kong across the last century, and learn how a single clue found in one decade rewrites the meaning of another.

title: Hit the Anvil
short_description: Hammer the anvil, forge gear, sell it for gold and grow your forge. Advance to Swordmaster, Mage, Necromancer or Shadow Rogue and unleash class skills that fill the screen and reinforce all your loot at once. A pixel-art incremental crafting game with masteries, gems, charms and puzzles. Free demo.

title: Hivekeepers
short_description: A relaxing and strategic beehive roguelike. Collect honey, hatch bees, and unlock powerful upgrades as your bees defend the hive from hungry invaders.

title: Hold My Cargo
short_description: A first-person smuggling sim. Buy low, sell high, stash the good stuff where customs won't look and talk your way past inspection. Grow from a rust bucket to a freighter, escape the galaxy, then do it again. Online co-op for 1–4 players arrives in the first major update.

title: Hold The Roost
short_description: Build by day. Defend by night. Command a flock of chickens in a tactical tower-defense survival game where every bird has a job. Gather resources, hatch and recruit stronger chickens, customize weapons and targeting, and outsmart predators with tricks of their own.

title: Hold the Dawn
short_description: Build by day. Survive the horde by night. Hold the Dawn is a 3D wasteland tower defense with unique auto-fighting heroes, tactical towers, zombie waves, and co-op over Steam, LAN, or local play.

title: Holdline: Last Gate
short_description: Holdline: Last Gate is a third-person tower-defense survival game. Harvest resources, craft and place towers, and hold the gate across a chain of diverse alien maps as the wave fights you on every front at once.

title: Holiday Alliance
short_description: Stop Santa's hordes from taking over the Holiday Lands in this festive, fun Tower Defense game. Drop roman candles, sparklers, snowblowers and deploy heroes to hold the line across a storybook campaign.

title: Hollow
short_description: Hollow is a dark fantasy action RPG inspired by old-school dungeon crawlers. Descend beneath a cursed mining town, battle the dead, collect loot, build your character through abilities, and uncover the fallen angel buried below.

title: HollowCity:EscapeFromSeoul
short_description: 'HollowCity' is a PvE top-down extraction shooter set in a ruined city. Solo or with up to 4 players, you must explore various zones and gather survival supplies. Hostile humans aren't the only threats to your life. Fight through monsters born from unknown causes and escape safely.

title: HolyMoly
short_description: Protect the Holy Cow in a chaotic third-person roguelite defense shooter. Play solo or online co-op, build absurd heroes, smash through enemy waves, survive boss attacks, and push into fantasy maps that only get more ridiculous.

title: Homeplanet
short_description: Homeplanet is a space combat simulator with Newtonian physics and a story-driven campaign. Step into the boots of a combat pilot of the Troiden clan! Take part in the saga of exile from your home world—and the struggle to conquer a new one.

title: Homesider Survivors
short_description: HOMESIDER SURVIVORS is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. You find yourself far from home against countless hordes of aliens...but they're the ones who have to survive, because they kidnapped the wrong guy. Kill, die, level up, and try again until you get home.

title: Homestead: Deckbuilding Academy
short_description: Build your homestead with cards in a strategy game of turn-based management and real-time auto battles. Link buildings to multiply production, chain upgrades and empower your squad. Explore ruins, conquer settlements and bring new cards home.

title: HomunCat: and the Blind Mansion
short_description: HomunCat: and the Blind Mansion is a co-op horror game where you play as plush cats and try to escape a mysterious mansion. Shout voice commands like “MEOW!” and “KICK!” to play, but beware of monsters that react to sound. Collect mana and work together to escape!

title: Honest Work
short_description: Play as the frontier's least qualified cattle outfit. The herd spooks at everything, the wilderness wants you dead, and your posse's lassos are a bigger threat than the wolves. Drive the cattle, rope your friends, get paid. It ain't much, but it's honest work.

title: Hood
short_description: England, 1216. Experience the true story behind the Robin Hood legend as you control Williken of the Weald in this 2D pixel art stealth platformer. Explore, sneak, and fight your way through the forests, villages, and fortresses of Kent to take down the ruthless Castellan and save your family.

title: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
short_description: Build your player's basketball career in a single-player management sim. Manage training and recovery, develop skills, weigh contract offers and build relationships with your team. Earn a starting spot and follow simulated games in 2D with play-by-play and stats, or use quick simulation.

title: Horde Up Ahead: Survivors TD
short_description: Tower Defense against massive zombie hordes. Build turrets, defend your tower, and discover roguelite and survivor-like progression.

title: Hostile Takeover, Inc.
short_description: Fight as the CEO, hire employees, and build offices to survive waves of disgruntled enemies in a top-down action tower defense about corporate "leadership" at its most predatory... and least competent. Maximize shareholder value, then fend off the hostile takeover before the board forces you out.

title: Hotel 13
short_description: The corridor looks the same every time. But does it really? Maybe something has changed. Observe your surroundings carefully.

title: Hotel Carnivalia
short_description: Hotel Carnivalia is a first-person social deduction game for 4-15 players. Roam a gothic hotel on foot, hunt your prey as a predator, or follow the traces left behind to find the predators hiding among you.

title: House of Pips: a Domino Roguelike
short_description: A turn-based domino roguelike where you draft rule-bending perks, combine their effects, and shape your playstyle through a skill tree. Read the board, plan your placements, and adapt to each hand to outwit opponents in single-player or online multiplayer.

title: How To Ride Elevators Like A Human
short_description: A chill puzzle game about an alien trying to understand one of humanity’s strangest social rules: why does everyone avoid eye contact in elevators?

title: HueTrix
short_description: HueTrix is a colorful block-stacking puzzle with a roguelike twist: clear lines to earn cash, then spend it in the shop on powerful mythic relics. Chain combos across seven colors, stack permanent upgrades, and build a game-breaking run. Easy to learn, endlessly deep, full controller support.ㄴ

title: Hullstorm
short_description: Survive relentless waves and push your ship to the limit! Level up, collect scrap, unlock new hulls, and combine weapons, upgrades, and evolutions to create devastating builds. Face hordes, elites, and bosses… or enter Endless and discover how far you can go.

title: Humans & Vampires
short_description: Survive the night together. Claim your own haven, build towers, chop wood and upgrade your door while Varkolak, an ancient vampire lord, hunts you until dawn. Online co-op for 1–8 players, with roguelite upgrades and bots for any empty seat.

title: Hundredfold: Hero's Ascent
short_description: Hero, the hundred-floor abyss awaits. Keep jumping down, dodge enemy attacks, and use special platforms to fight back. No grand prophecy. No complicated mission. Just one hero, one adventure, and 100 floors of monsters to beat.

title: Hunted Within: Terminal Rust
short_description: In a wasteland consumed by sandstorms, gravity anomalies, and grotesque biomechanical horrors, blast your way through a brutal survival horror experience to hunt down your worst enemy, the psycho Doctor.

title: Hunters Origin
short_description: Oldshool MMORPG foundations, sprinkled with modern gameplay! Hunt dangerous beasts, claim legendary loot, and customize your build with deep skill trees. Develop your hub at Archer’s Pond, craft gear, collect rare mounts, and forge your own legend alongside other players!

title: Hunters Trial : One Breath
short_description: Fixed-position, scope-only hunting. One position, one breath, one shot. Read the wild, allow for bullet drop and land the perfect heart shot across 120 levels, plus Endless, Daily, Gauntlet and Clay modes.

title: Hunting Contract
short_description: A co-op horror game for 1–4 players about hunting monsters to meet a company's quota. Kill the beast, seal it in a coffin and drag it back to the truck—while your friends scream in proximity voice chat.

title: Hunting Simulator 3
short_description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

title: Hush Piñata
short_description: She got tired of being hit, blindfolded herself and came back thirsty for revenge. A horror-comedy party game for up to 9 players, the blind Piñata hunts by sound, and even your voice on the mic lights a silhouette in her darkness. Do the chores quietly and rip off her tail before she notices.

title: Hyperline
short_description: High-speed space arena for 2–8 players. Your ship leaves a permanent trail that fills the arena — touch any trail, wall, or ship and you're out. Play online with friends or solo against bots. 20 unlockable ships, host-configurable matches, Steam achievements & leaderboards.

title: I HATE trees, so an ANCIENT VAMPIRE hired me to DESTROY EVERY last ONE
short_description: An ancient vampire hired you to destroy every tree on an island. Chop, burn, automate the logging and turn it into cash. Along the way, uncover the island's secrets, meet its eccentric residents and try not to anger your employer.

title: I Only Moved My Mouse
short_description: An incremental roguelite where your mouse cursor is the blade: hack and slash through the horde and hold the crystal at the center, tower defense style, wave after wave. Wield three weapons, draft awakenings, raise the forge and your relics, or switch on IDLE and let it play.

title: I'll Keep It
short_description: I’ll Keep It is a first-person management game about running a neglected Mediterranean getaway. Welcome guests, plan their stays, clean, repair, restock and serve - and somehow turn the place into something worth keeping.

title: I, Spy
short_description: A social deduction spy-hunting game where you blend into crowds of NPCs to track your assigned target while avoiding your own pursuer.

title: IAI // BREAKER
short_description: Turn your enemy’s strike into your opening. Deflect bullets with iaido slashes in this bullet-hell swordfighting action game. Press the attack or hold your ground? Read your foe’s attacks and break through with a decisive counterstrike.

title: IDEA:20Q
short_description: A game of Twenty Questions against an AI running entirely on your own computer. Ask and answer with Ganymede and Europa — two beings piecing together the last records of a vanished humanity.

title: IJIN: History Survivors
short_description: Who's the strongest in history? Become Napoleon, Musashi, or Cleopatra and mow down huge hordes in survivors-style action. Just move — attacks are automatic. Evolve each legend's weapon into their myth. Ice at Austerlitz, fog at Sekigahara rewrite the battlefield. 4-player online/local co-op.

title: IMITATORS
short_description: Co-op horror for 6 players (playable solo) and multiplayer for up to 20 players. Search for items on a randomly generated map and send them into the tube. But be careful: Imitators (Mimics) hide among ordinary things, ready to attack the moment the lights go out.

title: IN
short_description: If this message still exists, then we didn’t. Restore the station’s emergency power, explore abandoned laboratories and industrial sectors, solve the failures we left behind, and remember—every generator you restart brings the station closer to life… and something closer to you

title: INKBORN
short_description: You wake inside an unfinished comic, with paper underfoot and ink lines all around. Trace outlines by hand in your sketchbook to create tools and weapons. Every stroke costs ink, and your accuracy matters.

title: INORIGAMI HACK DOWN
short_description: A point-and-click horror adventure where you battle evil spirits to escape. You take a part-time job at the "House of Saschiumi," a place said to grant happiness through prayer. Instead, you find yourself hacking into the vengeful spirits' data to survive.

title: INTUS
short_description: Afraid of losing your job, you agree to work over the weekend and rent a cheap apartment to get it done. Soon, keeping your job will be the least of your worries.

title: IRON EDEN
short_description: Iron Eden blends Roguelite progression, Loot Shooter mechanics, and deep Mech Customization into a unique experience where every run shapes your machine and your strategy.

title: IRON SHADOW : Survival Protocol
short_description: Jump. Dash. Survive. A Survivor-Like With Platforming where you battle massive enemy hordes and create devastating builds.

title: ISKRA
short_description: You take on the role of Alice, who wanders through a dark forest in search of a way out. On her journey she meets many figures — each one a reflection of her own personality, an echo of her fears, and a manifestation of her subconscious.

title: IT BEGAN
short_description: IT BEGAN is a single-player tactical horror shooter set in a sunken world of cults, monsters, and your own fears — where escape is no longer an option.

title: IT Outage Desk
short_description: Start as a help desk technician and build your way to the top. Resolve tickets, hire staff, automate your department, and survive the increasingly absurd chaos of corporate IT in this humorous incremental clicker.

title: IT THINKS! - Build Your Own GPU
short_description: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

title: Ice Cream Shop Simulator
short_description: Run a seaside ice cream shop solo or in co-op with up to 6 players. Make ice cream, serve unpredictable customers, earn money, unlock new equipment, and expand and customize your shop as each day gets more chaotic.

title: Idle Agency
short_description: Steam Community Market ➕ a solo idle looter: set lineup and positions on a 4×4 board, heroes auto-battle, and resources and gear pile up even offline. Build and research in the Fortress, sell at the Market, buy back what you lack as prices move, and test your limits in the Trial Tower.

title: Idle Camp Tale
short_description: A fantasy idle RPG. Manage your camp, recruit heroes, and let auto-battles fight for you. Farm gear and materials from every fight, then strengthen, enchant, and customize affixes to forge your own powerful equipment as you conquer the frontier stage by stage!

title: Idle Casino Empire
short_description: An idle casino tycoon where you build the floor, then rig it. Turn casino psychology into upgrades. Play blackjack, roulette, and slots in Owner Mode. Use the Owner's Edge to cheat: nudge reels, peek at hidden cards, read marked cards. Eight venues, a prestige loop. The house is you.

title: Idle Clicker Tower
short_description: Idle Clicker Tower is a single-player idle tower defense with a retro neon aesthetic: defend your central tower, unlock new towers and abilities, grow your power, defeat waves of enemies and increasingly deadly bosses, and open packs to expand your card collection.

title: Idle Commander
short_description: Build your own path in Idle Commander. Discover powerful gear, experiment with wild builds, and reshape your strategy with every drop.

title: Idle Demon Lord II
short_description: Idle Demon Lord II combines idle progression with dark fantasy loot hunting. Fight automatically and earn rewards offline. Choose from five classes, each with unique skills and mechanics. Hunt six tiers of gear, customize affixes, gems, runes, and Legendary Powers, and build your endgame character.

title: Idle Golf
short_description: Idle Golf is a laid-back idle game where you upgrade your golfer, unlock powerful balls, and watch the money roll in as shots fly automatically down the range. Retire your runs to earn medals, unlock new gear, and push your earnings further with each swing.

title: Idle King: Loot Together
short_description: IdleKing is a dark fairy-tale idle loot RPG with online co-op. Auto-battle monsters and bosses, collect and upgrade your gear, and grow ever stronger. Adventure solo or team up with up to three friends to take on tougher challenges!

title: Idle Legend
short_description: A retro pixel desktop idle RPG. Warrior, Mage, and Taoist. Auto-combat, offline gains, and it can hide on your desktop.

title: Idle Necronomics
short_description: Incremental Idle Souls Gambling Investing Clicker. You are the Necromancer. Reap the living, turn their Souls into supernatural capital, and build an undead operation that keeps the harvest going around the clock.

title: Idle Reef
short_description: Transform a barren seabed into a vibrant, colorful coral reef! Manage your resources to unlock new marine species, grow your ecosystem, and build your ultimate underwater paradise while listening to soothing soundtracks.

title: Idle Slots: Casino HQ
short_description: Ever wanted to build a casino empire without the risk of actual luck? Start with a single Penny Slot and click your way to a multi-trillion-dollar galactic syndicate! Automate your floor, exploit corporate synergies, and sell the whole lot for a profit in this dangerously addictive idle clicker.

title: Illyrium: Chronicles
short_description: Recruit heroes and craft powerful builds from masteries, classes, spells and equipment. Use these systems to build each character your way, then command your party in challenging turn-based tactical combat.

title: Immortal Rebirth
short_description: Hunt for treasure and face formidable foes in an ink-wash fantasy world. Fit your gear into a limited inventory to create powerful combinations, and forge your own playstyle with a wealth of affixes and an expansive talent tree.

title: Immortal Sect Defend
short_description: Guard the Sect Eye or lose everything. Build immortal towers to defend against demon hordes. Explore dangerous realms, slay beasts, and upgrade your defenses in this unique cultivation tower defense game.

title: Imperial Kingdoms
short_description: Build. Supply. Conquer. Master the logistics of a medieval kingdom in this 4X grand strategy game. Optimize production estates, design custom military templates, and expand your empire through strategic sieges and raids. Deep strategy in pausable real-time.

title: Imperium
short_description: Imperium is a single-player 4X space strategy game. Colonize alien worlds, design your own spaceships, research exotic technologies, and outmaneuver rival empires through diplomacy or open war. Build a galactic empire and rule it your way.

title: Imperium Sine Fine: Eternal Emperor
short_description: Your generals grow old. Your cities grow restless. Your empire need not end. Lead one of 14 factions in a living fantasy world of grand strategy, where populations migrate, crime festers, and every grain shipment matters. Build, conquer, and rule, without end.

title: Imperium of the Stars
short_description: Rebuild a scattered empire in a Gothic galaxy of distant beacons and lost colonies. A real-time 4X with four distinct playable factions, empire-wide command, and Living Sagas shaped by how you govern and conquer up to 10,000 star systems.

title: In Vino Veritas
short_description: Explore a desecrated cathedral to find your missing wife in this psychological horror adventure. Uncover the dark truth behind the Elohim, solve ancient puzzles, and survive a chilling journey where faith and reality collide. The Bible was mistranslated; the truth is much darker

title: InFlood
short_description: Raise your sails and set forth across an endless ocean, vast and perilous, filled with submerged mysteries and unexpected adventures. Fight your way through danger, upgrade your ship, recruit a crew, explore the world, and decide which coalitions to support—and what will be built upon the ruins.

title: Incident Reports: Millers Residence
short_description: A late-night call sends you to the Millers Residence. What begins as a routine investigation turns into a descent through buried records, missing evidence, and a house arranged to hide something far worse.

title: Incremental Magic
short_description: A 2D action clicker where you click, drag, and scroll to hunt monsters yourself with your mouse. Aim your skills to break the bosses of 8 dungeons, and grow your skill tree into a build of your own. Not idle — aim, shoot, smash.

title: Incremental Pachinko Heaven
short_description: Launch balls! Upgrade the board! Earn mountains of medals—and keep paying off your debt! A short pachinko incremental with a skill tree that keeps giving you new ways to earn!

title: Incremental RTS
short_description: Semi-idle incremental RTS. You don’t micro units. You build factories, pick upgrades and let your army flood the battlefield. Start with nothing, research tanks, artillery, flankers and mega units. Scale and survive enemy surges. Pure auto-battle chaos.

title: Industry Unbound：无界工业
short_description: A factory automation strategy game on an infinite canvas. Mine resources, route logistics, balance power, supply settlements, and research new technologies to build a self-sustaining planetary industry.

title: Inearth
short_description: Environmental interaction and turn-based tactics in a roguelite card game loop. Descend into the Hollow Earth. As above, so below.

title: Infinigon
short_description: Two triangles make a square. Cultivate a living field of neon polygons that fuse when they touch and split when they break. Socket facets into your own polygon lens, chain breaks into melodies, and climb from triangle to the circle. It keeps growing while you're away, too.

title: Infinite Loop
short_description: Infinite Loop is a top-down bullet-heaven survival × idle game. Fight off endless hordes, loot, and level up in a world of endlessly running code — levels, skills, talents, and chips are all permanently kept. No run resets. The longer you play, the stronger you get.

title: Infinite Loop: Incremental
short_description: A purely minimalist, text-based idle incremental game! Focused on time management and strategic planning, carefully prioritize your action queue under strict time limits. Death is inevitable, but every loop makes you stronger. Build your automation routines and break the infinite loop!

title: Ink & Lore
short_description: A 99-floor roguelike of cards that vanish the moment they're played. Lead two guardians of living stationery into a picture book someone stopped drawing. Your cards are finite: choosing when to spend them is life or death. And at the end of the world waits the one who…

title: Inn Over Your Head
short_description: An incremental game where you run a tavern with a deadly secret beneath it. Serve ale, expand your tavern, dig deeper into the dungeon below, and lure adventurers to their doom with irresistible treasure. Then harvest their souls to do it all over again. Ready to get Inn Over Your Head?

title: Interzone
short_description: Branded a deserter, you are thrown into the Interzone, where survival is the only law. Technology dies here, orders fall from the sky in artillery-fired capsules, the last voice from outside. Face anomalies, radiation, contamination, the infected, rebels, and ruthless military forces.

title: Into the Country
short_description: When your grey world has wearied you, start over in picturesque Seishin Village. Build a life with your own hands, form complex relationships, and search for meaning in a story-rich life sim and visual novel as the world beyond—and beneath—the mountain slowly erodes.
