title: Into the Planet's Flesh
short_description: Hatch parasites and infest the earth in this incremental game. Create a gruesome spectacle as your colony spreads like a disease through the planet. Discover what happens when your parasites VENTURE TOO DEEP.

title: Investor Incremental
short_description: From 0 to Hero investing simulation game. Start as a dead end job worker and work your way to financial freedom. Supports both minmaxing and relaxing playstyles.

title: Iris's Idle Log
short_description: An idle RPG for the corner of your screen. Follow Iris's long adventure, battle for equipment and resources, and grow Life Skills like Mining, Logging, Fishing, Cooking, Farming, Writing, Painting, and Commerce. Play or step away—Iris's day goes on.

title: Irish Sport Manager
short_description: You’re the bainisteoir. The county is yours, and so is the blame. A management sim for Gaelic football, hurling, camogie and ladies’ football: pick your fifteen from the county’s own parishes and answer to a board whose patience runs out.

title: Iron Frame
short_description: A bullet-heaven roguelite fought in a single ship. Nine frames, each one rewriting a rule of the run rather than its numbers. Ten guns across forty tiers, ten bosses to break, and a hull that visibly grows with every level. Survive long enough and the swarm stops being the problem.

title: Iron Ledger: Deterrence Has A Price
short_description: A high-pressure management sim where you build a defense contractor from nothing, secure contracts, expand production, manage staff and supply chains, and fight to stay ahead of cash flow, compliance, and collapse.

title: Iron Remnant
short_description: Command troops in real-time battles, upgrade the orbital starship Asgard, and fight alongside anime-inspired companions across a war-torn world in this story-driven action strategy RPG.

title: IronFlux
short_description: Three stranded civilizations fight for the ancient Monoliths of a living moon. Build a streaming economy, field armies on land, sea and air, and hold the map to ascend in a large-scale real-time strategy game.

title: Irondrive
short_description: A vehicular roguelite where you manage a crew inside a moving fortress. Your base is on the move, your crew is at the breaking point: automate repairs, manage priorities, and survive relentless attacks as you cross a hostile, post-apocalyptic wasteland. Keep moving.

title: Ironfields
short_description: A single-player RTS where you capture existing structures instead of building a base from scratch, and success comes more from good decisions than fast reactions.

title: Is This Reversi?
short_description: Is This Reversi? is a Reversi tabletop sandbox where you can freely use the board and pieces. Place, move, flip, and remove pieces without the system enforcing legal moves, turns, or the end of the game, and play by your own rules.

title: Isentroth
short_description: Swear an oath and walk into the Isenmarch — a cold Norse frontier that does not explain itself. A Machine Game Master narrates your saga, answers the choices you make, the engine rolls, and the model can't fudge a result. No two sagas are alike. What breaks first — your isen, or your troth?

title: Iskarn
short_description: Build and defend a medieval colony in a vast, infinite voxel world. Gather resources, craft gear, train citizens, and survive brutal zombie hordes. Dig deep, explore wild biomes, and turn a handful of survivors into a thriving settlement.

title: Island Core
short_description: The Otherworld invasion left one island base standing. You are the Core, a central AI with the personalities of fallen scientists. Mount lasers, saw guns, flamethrowers and drones, and hold the line through snowfield, desert and swamp. Single-player horde defense × character builds.

title: Islandry
short_description: Turn a wild island into a thriving, self-running production network. Gather resources, build farms and machines, automate with drones and conveyor belts, process goods, manage interconnected production, earn profits from trading, and ship your products across the sea in this cozy automation game.

title: It Could Be Worse
short_description: Speed bends time. Build momentum with weapons designed for movement to slow the world around you and tear through enemies at superhuman velocity.

title: It Was Not a Suicide
short_description: A psychological horror detective simulation set in Rainier Falls in 2005. Uncover the truth behind Adele's death by finding contradictions in the case files. Are you brilliant enough to expose the suspects' lies in a single attempt? Because you only get one chance to make an arrest.

title: It's Just a Rescue, Bro! — Idle Hell RPG
short_description: An idle ARPG for loot goblins. Slaughter monsters automatically, hunt build-changing gear, craft ridiculous builds, unlock new classes, then rebirth and do it all again—stronger.

title: Italian Street Food Simulator
short_description: Run your own street food stand in a lively Italian coastal town. Prepare Italian street food, serve walk-up and seated customers, manage supplies and equipment and grow your business day by day in this first-person cooking simulator.

title: Item TD
short_description: Every Tower Is a Backpack! Item TD combines Tower Defense and Inventory Management in a strategy game featuring 15 stages, 3 difficulty levels. Arrange weapons and support items in your character's and Towers' inventories to maximize their synergies and fend off waves of monsters.

title: It’s Just 45 Seconds
short_description: You are the cursor, and enemies can grab, punch, and throw you. Protect Bit in intense 45-second rounds, buy cards, and shape your deck in an action roguelite where every attempt brings a new plan and bosses change the rules.

title: JETGRAVE
short_description: JETGRAVE is a fast-paced side-scrolling shoot ’em up for 1-3 players inspired by the arcade and console shooters of the 16-bit era. Blast through hostile skies, overwhelming enemy forces, massive war machines, and an abomination that should have stayed buried.

title: JIGSEUM: Assemble Jigsaws with Magic
short_description: JIGSEUM: Assemble Jigsaws with Magic is a single-player 3D jigsaw puzzle game set in an art museum. Collect 2,576 puzzle pieces scattered throughout the museum and complete colorful works of art. Use helpful magic skills to make puzzle-solving easier and more fun!

title: JMT -DUeL-
short_description: A super-serious Rock-Paper-Scissors game, JMT DUeL. Rock-Paper-Scissors + Stats + Skills + Transparent AI Patterns. It will rewire your Rock-Paper-Scissors brain. Let's Duel!

title: JOCKEY RISING: BLOODLINE
short_description: JOCKEY RISING: BLOODLINE is a jockey life sim with deck-building races. Start at 18 as a rookie, ride and raise horses at your family stable, breed your own bloodline, then retire and pass the stable and its legacy to your child.

title: JYSTICE
short_description: Build and configure. Enter Edenbyrg. Get out alive. Build your own cybernetic JYSTICE in this lawful-but-awful roguehate top-down shooter where you get to eradicate crime in the never-sleeping megacity of Edenbyrg. Now includes 2-4 player versus mode!

title: Jade Simulator
short_description: This is a hardcore jade processing simulator. Players inspect raw stones for color and cracks, then operate machinery to cut and polish them. Learn to distinguish natural jade from fakes while upgrading equipment. Experience the full journey from a rough rock to a translucent masterpiece.

title: Japanese Swordsmith
short_description: From tamahagane to a finished katana. Become a swordsmith in Bakumatsu Kyoto—sumikiri, mizuheshi, folding forge, the quench, polishing—finish a Japanese sword with your own hands. A hardcore swordsmith simulator. It will not be easy.

title: Jesus Christ: A Gospel Visual Novel
short_description: Step into the age of the Gospels and witness the teachings, miracles, and redemption of Jesus Christ. This visual novel, centered on biblical stories, presents a journey of sacrifice and hope through dialogue and chapter-based storytelling.

title: Jin Ping Mei: Qinghe Reverie
short_description: In Qinghe County during the Northern Song, manage businesses and household affairs, build relationships, gather rumors and evidence, and set schemes in motion. As Ximen Qing, balance time, wealth, reputation and favors while your choices reshape lives, fortunes and endings.

title: John Whisk
short_description: John Whisk is a chef who wields kitchen tools and harbors a grudge. Dive into a dungeon of hostile produce, harvest ingredients off everything you kill, then decide: bank the haul or go deeper. Extract alive, cook the loot, eat it for permanent power or sell it for cash.

title: Joker's Last Call
short_description: A dark casino card roguelike: match suits or ranks against two AI rivals. Stack attack cards to pass on a growing draw penalty, or reflect the chain with a Joker. The 54-card deck is fixed; relics change rules for the whole run, and each battle gives you one single-use trick card.

title: Junk Rush
short_description: You’re a degenerate gambler with 28 days to pay your vig to the mob with your hotdog stand! Embark on a chaotic adventure with your mocking AI and schizophrenic Goblin. Explore the island, find bizarre ingredients, create insane hotdogs, break rules, cause chaos and do whatever it takes to survive!

title: Junkpot
short_description: A roguelike about bidding on random storage crates. Read the odds, buy the crate, then stack charms that multiply what falls out. Type combos, rarity bonuses and odds boosts compound into one engine. Build it fast - the quota doubles every round.

title: Junkyard Astronauts
short_description: Scavenge a junkyard at night, weld the scrap into a rocket and press the big red button. Play PVP, where the highest flight wins and the guns work, or SANDBOX, with no clock. The Moon is 384,400 km up, and your fuel tank used to be a water heater. 1 to 4 robots, Mac and PC together.

title: Just Dots
short_description: The classic pen-and-paper game of Dots — place dots, close the loop around your opponent's, claim territory — now against a neural network that taught itself from scratch and beats its own creator. Grow from beginner to master. Any board size, local 2-player.

title: Just Dying
short_description: A Roguelite survivor starring streamers. Rescue your followers to stay off the unemployment line, unlock unique characters, stack powerful runes, and become a wrecking ball of total chaos. Learn. Die. Repeat.

title: Just Make Sense: Instinct Lab
short_description: A laboratory for your gut feeling, most rounds over in 15 seconds: eyeball distances, nail the timing, predict trajectories, count at a glance. 12 instincts, a main map that grows tile by tile, and 570+ everyday scenarios. No trivia, no math — just your instinct. It's sharper than you think.

title: Just Up: 2D Platformer
short_description: Just Up: 2D Platformer is a vertical platformer where the goal is to reach the top. Jump and dash across platforms as you climb higher. Discover new places, explore changing environments, leave the atmosphere behind, and find out what awaits you at the top...

title: Just Weeding
short_description: Pull 100,000 weeds! Zone out solo or chill and chat with up to 6 players in this endless weeding sim. Feed your goat to earn cash and unlock better weeding gear!

title: K-Duel: The Anti-Cheater
short_description: Face ruthless cheaters who break every rule. To survive this brutal tactical card battler, you must out-think the hackers. Position units down strategic rows and use instant fusion to evolve cards into colossal boss monsters. Fight hard, fuse power, and destroy the rigged system.

title: K-God Robot Hunters
short_description: A Korean-fantasy poker roguelike where you build hands from five elemental suits and harness the powers of mythic goddesses. Refine your deck, discover powerful combinations, and battle through a robot uprising one hand at a time.

title: KAREI - ENDLESS DEATH MATCH
short_description: A grid-based, turn-based puzzle roguelike. Play a lone kunoichi ascending an endless castle — read each floor like a puzzle, arm yourself from its walls, and cut down the oni in your path. One wrong move ends your run.

title: KAYFABE
short_description: Run a small indie wrestling promotion where every wrestler has a life outside the ring. Book matches, build rivalries, manage show costs and earn your roster's trust. Follow their careers and keep the next show alive in this single-player management sim.

title: KISI: The Deja Vu
short_description: 〈KISI: The Deja Vu〉 is a 3D anomaly-detection psychological horror adventure game based on the eerie sense of familiarity felt in a sanity-bending experimental facility—the phenomenon known as "Déjà Vu."

title: KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War
short_description: KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War is a logistics-driven strategy game. Govern cities, recruit officers and move armies across a grand map, then command formations, Battle Arts, Stratagems, sieges and duels in real time. Choose a faction in seven sandbox starts and unite the realm.

title: KOE - Beyond
short_description: A first-person Japanese horror adventure with multiple endings, where the truth is rewritten with each playthrough. Trapped in a realm resembling a Japanese village from the 1970s, uncover its hidden truth and find your way back to the world of the living.

title: KRIS: The Last Good Summer
short_description: Kris has thirty days before the scrap press. Play as Sam, the fifteen-year-old who found him in an attic, and explore Cedar Falls together. Solve point-and-click puzzles, change what he can do with old floppy disks, and decide which memories you dare erase to give him a future.

title: KRUSHPIT
short_description: KRUSHPIT is a Real-Time Indirect PvP roguelike survival set among brutal concrete blocks and rusty garages. Obliterate mutants, evolve skills, spin slots, and create OP builds! Survive the chaos or join the PvP ladder to crush everyone and dominate the leaderboard!

title: Kachow Kart Racing
short_description: Race with friends, customize your kart, and create and grow your clan! Drift, boost, and use abilities to outplay your rivals in Kachow Kart Racing. Battle it out online or in local split-screen, and fight for the top spot in ranked races!

title: Kaironia
short_description: Relive the golden age of MMOs in this friction-free 2D idle RPG. Chop trees, forge armor, and slay monsters to reach level 99. Play solo or hang out with friends in multiplayer and utilize the offline Time Bank to fast-forward the grind. Pure nostalgia, built to respect your time.

title: Kankao in Action
short_description: Kankao in Action is a 2-player co-op adventure with local and online co-op, where teamwork, coordination, and chaotic fun are the only way forward.

title: Kaperfahrt
short_description: Sail an open Caribbean where every choice matters. Plunder ships in fierce naval battles, trade between rival houses, and build yourself from a humble sloop into a feared legend. Kaperfahrt is your pirate sandbox on a grand scale.

title: Kart League Manager
short_description: Manage a Division 4 kart team and lead your drivers to the title. Raise six drivers, ban and pick maps, set your 4v4 grid and karts, then watch bumps, drafts and last-lap boosts turn the race around. Climb to Division 1, or let each driver shine in the Winter Solo Cup. Play solo or with friends.

title: KasaSaburo's Secret Fishing Spot
short_description: Pixel frog fishing with a relaxing rhythm. Let KasaSaburo help you fish, collect curious species, and build your secret fishing spot

title: Kasane
short_description: Layer colors to recreate a target pattern exactly. Red, blue and yellow blend where they overlap, and the same color layered twice cancels out and vanishes. Every puzzle has exactly one solution, verified by an exhaustive count — 1000 of them, from three pieces on a 4x4 board to twelve on a 5x5.

title: Keep Drawing: Webtoon Tycoon
short_description: Start as a solo webtoon artist and build a studio empire. Draw chapters readers love, grow hit series, hire specialists, and negotiate publishing deals across a 25-year career. A cozy creative journey with the depth of a management tycoon.

title: Keep to the Blue
short_description: Explore a flooded post-apocalyptic world, battle your enemies, and upgrade your ship with the loot you find. But watch out for pirates!

title: Kennel Chaos: Daycare Simulator
short_description: You and your friends run a dog daycare and pet shop. It goes badly. Feed them, wash them, walk them, and scoop what they leave behind, before somebody props a gate open and eleven dogs discover the front door. Co-op chaos with very good pups.

title: Kepler Protocol
short_description: Kepler-186e, 1989. An Imperial colony on a world that wants it gone. Turn-based strategy and hard survival: secure water and Flux power, keep the supply lines alive and hold out against the Ordo Arachnis, a swarm with no commander.

title: Keyboard Companion
short_description: A tiny pixel monkey that types along with you. He sits at the bottom of your screen, hits the same keys you do, and when you take a break he snacks on bananas, yawns and dozes off. It never records what you type.

title: Keyboard Curse
short_description: Keyboard Curse is a 2D rage-platformer where every key you press spawns a physical keycap into the level. Jump, run, panic, and try not to trap yourself — because every press makes it worse.

title: Keycap Co
short_description: Run your own keyboard shop. Choose what to stock, set prices, hire staff, and arrange the shelves. Grow from a small store into your own keyboard brand, designing new boards and selling them in your shop and through wholesale orders.

title: Kick The Dungeon
short_description: Kick the Dungeon is a card-based tactical roguelike game based on the Uses the 5E SRD rules. Assemble a unique party, tailor your own build, and enjoy the thrill of combat. Use cards to cast familiar spells like Fireball and Magic Missile — every run offers a different experience.

title: Kill You Again
short_description: A choice-driven psychological horror visual novel. Wake up as Haru, a streamer trapped in a beautiful fantasy world that resets with every death. Uncover hidden scenes, revisit familiar moments with new memories, and escape an endless death loop alongside the mysterious Elinia.

title: Kintsugi Cottage
short_description: A cozy 3D jigsaw restoration game. Hundreds of shards lie across a cottage museum floor, and every glaze, curve and pattern is a clue. Work out which pieces belong together, rebuild the artifacts by hand, and restore the full artifact collection.

title: Knead a Break
short_description: From its cozy bed, Knead watches over a human who sits too much. When you sit too long, this grumpy cat pops up to cause mischief. But it's smart: it senses your flow and waits for a natural pause to nudge you. It isn’t being naughty—it just wants to get you out of your chair so you can move around.

title: Knock Again
short_description: This is not a normal clicker. It’s a psychological horror game where mechanical progress hides something dark, twisted, and unsettling. Knock on the door to earn money, upgrade your abilities, and keep knocking. It all seems simple… until it isn’t.

title: Koishi’s Fishing Journal
short_description: A Touhou Project fan-made desktop idle fishing game starring Koishi Komeiji. Relax and fish, collect varied fish and rare merfolk, cook ordinary fish, gather precious merfolk ingredients, and sell dishes. Keep upgrading and unlocking your collection as Koishi’s fishing life unfolds on your desktop.

title: Kritsana
short_description: A Thai anomaly-spotting horror game. In 1997, a man swore something was in his house. His psychiatrist said no. Now the case is yours. Go through his old CCTV tapes, report every anomaly, and figure out why this case never made sense.

title: Kyle Coral
short_description: A breathtaking cave-diving adventure where your air is the only clock. Read each new cave, find the air pockets, and reach the exit before your last breath. Five biomes, four guardians, and gear you keep. Out now. Dive in.

title: LEG DAY: Four Steps Through Hell
short_description: Control a single leg in a brutal physics-based precision platformer. Balance, jump and master momentum through four increasingly absurd stages. One bad move can send you falling.

title: LET'S GO! PANJANDRUM
short_description: Britain's greatest super-weapon rides again! An online two-player co-op action game where you each take one wheel. Pull together and it runs straight. Fall out of sync and it charges off at full speed in entirely the wrong direction. 50 stages. Get there in one piece — or several.

title: LIANYAO:The Formless One
short_description: A first-person deckbuilding roguelite inspired by Chinese folklore. Defeat monsters and refine their souls to claim their abilities as your own. Build powerful combinations, shape your supernatural form, and forge a different playstyle with every expedition.

title: LIMINAL: Within
short_description: Boot up Black & White Limbo! Become the Prince of Might and reclaim your ruined homeland in a pixel-art RPG. Beyond the screen, Shuuichi Hirata’s life takes a sinister turn. A murder. A game to blame? Explore, battle, and shape the story in this cinematic mystery adventure. What will you choose?

title: LINE WARLORD
short_description: A real-time lane-defense roguelite. Spend rations to send troops down the line, stack relics, promote your units, and break the enemy stronghold with a different army every run.

title: LINETAIN
short_description: Build transport routes to supply the front and evacuate the wounded. Assign a limited fleet, respond to attacks announced 25 seconds in advance and pause to rethink your routes. Loading, transfers and combat are automatic in this single-player logistics strategy game.

title: LOOPFANG
short_description: A snake roguelite where your body is your arsenal. Collect weapon segments, fuse matching neighbors into higher tiers, and reorder them until they react with each other. Then close a loop with your own tail: everything trapped inside dies.

title: LOOPY
short_description: LOOPY is the lab’s daily Slitherlink arena: Outrun neon, nine ranked protocols a day, arcade rules that shift under you, weekly/monthly circuits (Gauntlet, Megaloop, Throne Rush), and a synthwave score locked to every mode. Close the loop. Climb the board. No ads. No IAP.

title: LOTH
short_description: Drag chains of gems before the hourglass runs dry. Close a loop and everything inside erupts. Recruit ushabti, the clay servants of Egypt's dead, and stack them into an engine that turns three gems into millions. Then face the gods. One tomb. One run.

title: LYSSA: Goddess of Rage
short_description: A tactical PvP card RPG in a world run by mercenaries. Climb the rankings in short, brutal real-time battles, recruit legendary fighters, and build a deck around your Commander. Seize territory with your alliance and get to know your crew off the battlefield.

title: La Bidouillerie
short_description: A real electronics simulator: build robots, a 1970s pinball table and a 1980s dart machine from real parts (solenoids, gears, connecting rods, relays, transistors). Wire the circuit, switch on, find out why it won't run: every current is computed, every fault has a cause.

title: Labyrinth of Doom
short_description: A dark fantasy multiplayer dungeon crawler with real-time combat — fully playable solo against challenging AI bots. Fight, scavenge, and outwit rivals in procedurally generated labyrinths — Battle Royale or Co-op, up to 10 players, with legendary artifacts drawn from world mythology.

title: Lagan Salvage Run
short_description: A co-op roguelike deckbuilder about salvaging sunken ships. Loot cards from flooding rooms, break into sealed holds for better treasure, and pick your route across open water. Every run comes from a seed you can share. Get out while there's still a way back.

title: Lairs & Lordships
short_description: This time the towers shoot at you. Lairs & Lordships is a reverse tower defense game: plan your monster horde’s assault wave by wave, break seven human fortresses, raise lairs where their keeps stood, then hold the land when the kingdom raids back.

title: Lakeside Idle
short_description: Lakeside Idle is a cozy idle fishing game. Wait for a bite and combine rods, floats, bait, and gems to create your own build. Explore a forest lake through changing seasons and times of day, catch fish of every rarity, and record their star ratings, lengths, and weights.

title: Lami: A Cup of Code and Coffee
short_description: Inherit your grandpa’s old café and meet Lami, an adorable robot girl! Craft gadgets, upgrade your café, serve customers, and face unexpected challenges as you uncover the story behind Lami.

title: Lanelord
short_description: You ever wanted to feel how a road feels? Now you can! Either team up with a car or try to shake it of. Solo and Multiplayer fun guaranteed!

title: Lanternfall
short_description: Defend a handcrafted gothic Halloween world across fifteen haunted realms. Build and upgrade distinctive towers, counter armour and immunities, link aura towers to empower their neighbours, and carry your hard-won arsenal from one nightmarish battlefield to the next.

title: Last Choice Hero
short_description: Is that choice really heroic? Guide an immortal Hero through absurdly cruel ultimate choices in this dark-comedy fantasy ADV.

title: Last Civilization: Inherited Flame
short_description: Build a village around humanity's last flame. Gather, build, and research by day; defend against Shadows at night. When a village falls, pass its records and memories to the next civilization. Learn from each generation and survive the night that stopped the last.

title: Last Contract
short_description: Last Contract is a fast paced 2D action game set in a pixel art cyberpunk world that you need katanas, shurikens and quick reflexes to survive.

title: Last Exit Diner: Edge of Known Space
short_description: Keep a battered ship flying at the edge of known space. Take jobs from the Last Exit Diner, escort freighters, hunt rogue Progenitor Tech, and follow ancient gates through a living neon frontier.

title: Last Exit Diner: The Last Train
short_description: Defend an armoured diner train through six-minute runs across ten hostile biomes. Aim the Dreadnought cannon, deploy bombs, survive flying monsters, and choose rail upgrades while automatic roof guns keep the Last Train moving.

title: Last Lawn Standing
short_description: Choose from garden gnomes with different stat bonuses and defend your shrines against the forces of evil. Spend the day upgrading your towers and weapons and placing flower towers to shape the path of the hordes that arrive at night. How many nights can you survive? Every run is unique.

title: Last Man Running
short_description: Outrun the zombies. Betray your friends. A chaotic parkour party game across deadly rooftops. Tackle, grab and toss your rivals in free-for-all or team elimination, or stick together in co-op survival. Play locally or online, with solo score chasing when your friends stop answering your invites.

title: Last Offer: Car Dealer
short_description: Explore an open world, find cars for sale, inspect them, negotiate, buy, customize, and sell for profit. Build and grow your own dealership, deal with customers, and know when to make your last offer.

title: Last Paddle Standing
short_description: Pong meets battle royale. Last Paddle Standing throws up to 12 players into a chaotic arcade arena that shrinks with every elimination. Draft abilities and perks as you survive. Knocked out? Return as a vengeful spirit and sabotage everyone still standing.

title: Last Ride
short_description: Last Ride is a paranormal game of investigation and capture. As a new member of the agency, you explore the scenes of anomalous events and collect clues. From a spirit's story and its motive, you find a way to counter it, and in the end you contain it.

title: Last Shuttle
short_description: A 2-to-4-player online co-op and competitive action-adventure. Battle enemies and gather keys to navigate through perilous ruins. Outpace the opposing team to be the first to board the last shuttle!

title: Last Stream
short_description: Stream a haunted house with up to 3 friends. The clues to every puzzle only appear inside the ghost's room, so one of you has to describe what's on the walls while the others solve it across the house, with a minute on the clock and the ghost hunting you all.

title: Last Warrior Arena
short_description: Build your warrior. Outsmart your next opponent. Last Warrior Arena is a 1v1 roguelike auto-battler where equipment, skills, and enemy choices shape every run. Combine elemental powers, discover powerful builds, and take on deadly bosses as your warrior fights automatically.

title: Last Zone: Quarantine
short_description: A co-op survival game set amid a grim post-Soviet apocalypse. Assemble a squad to battle hordes of mutants and ruthless raiders. Explore a mysterious world, master a deep crafting system, and build a base capable of withstanding any assault.

title: Last convoy
short_description: A survivors-like auto-shooter where the hero is an armored convoy. Grow it car by car, take a crew on board and mow down hordes of thousands of enemies. The fate of the planet rides on your choices — and your convoy.

title: Late Night with Ken Hayes
short_description: Host the graveyard shift at a small-town radio station in 1998. Callers keep describing the same pale man—and every time someone talks about him on air, he seems to get closer.

title: Law Firm Simulator
short_description: Law Firm Simulator is a business management sandbox where you build and run your own legal empire. Hire lawyers, take on clients, manage complex cases, expand your offices, and grow a small practice into the city’s most prestigious law firm.

title: Layered Loop层叠环道
short_description: Draft modules, stack your defenses, and keep firepower supplied as heroes travel the loop. Every new layer changes your build.

title: Lazy Drawer: Line Survivors
short_description: No guns. No swords. No aiming. Your weapon is the path you walk. Enemies touching your trail get shredded — and the instant it closes into a loop, everything inside blows up at once. Survive 15 minutes, slay the boss, grow your charm deck — a survivors-like where walking IS attacking.

title: Lead the Charge
short_description: Ride at the head of a living army. Lead one of 5 legendary commanders, recruit 23 more generals, switch between 8 formations and sound the charge across 8 historical battlefields in a fast single-player army roguelite.

title: Leeway
short_description: An age-of-sail trading sim where the sailing is the game. Real wind you have to tack through, a hold that makes her sluggish and swamps sooner the fuller it gets, and a note that comes due whether you made port or not. Trade honestly, or fly the black flag. Solo, or with friends over a room code.

title: Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes
short_description: Turn-based martial arts RPG set in the mid-Ming Dynasty. Play as Cyrus, an Azure Peak disciple, to recruit companion heroes in a corrupt world. Master tactical party-based combat to defeat foes, unravel imperial conspiracies, and choose between personal vengeance and state righteousness.

title: Legend of Gaia: Rebirth
short_description: Legend of Gaia: Rebirth is a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure. Journey across the Eternal Continent, where the Theocracy, Gaia faction, and forces of Sin struggle for power. Explore dangerous regions, battle powerful enemies, and collect the scattered fragments of the Rebirth Relic.

title: Legend of the Godslayer
short_description: The world has fallen into an age of darkness. Creatures of the abyss emerge across the land, sent by the Gods to bring about humanity's destruction. But amidst the chaos of the battlefield, a legend rises—the Godslayer.

title: Let Rat Be
short_description: Press countless keyboard keys simultaneously to help the little rat escape!

title: Lexip
short_description: Lexip is a cozy fantasy factory game about magic, rail logistics, and questionable sustainability. Build production chains across the overworld and underground, power machines with local magic, fulfill contracts, and keep Null pollution under control.

title: Life Core
short_description: Life Core is a roguelite action game where you explore uncharted planets. Fight, eliminate your enemies, and when you fall, unleash the power of the Core in your new body. But remember… the system is always watching!

title: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.
short_description: Choose one of four adventurers, each driven to clear dungeon floors in a different way. Set a destination or take direct control, then combine equipment with powerful—but sometimes troublesome—random skills to shape every expedition in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.

title: Life in the Kingdom
short_description: Take the throne at twenty five. Rule until you die. Marry, raise heirs, free your towns from scheming rivals, and carve through dungeons with an evolving arsenal. One ruler, one lifetime, one unforgettable reign. An adventure packed kingdom life-sim where every year counts.

title: LifeStock
short_description: You are a god. Mortal lives are stocks. A godlike life-trading strategy game. Draft mortal lives, trade their futures, manipulate fate and wage war against rival gods in a living medieval village.

title: Lifeguard Simulator
short_description: Guard the beach, react fast, and save lives using quads, jet skis, motorboats, drones, and a helicopter. Patrol the bay, help those in need and uncover a hidden criminal intrigue beneath the waves.

title: Lifelines
short_description: A cozy puzzle game about the lines beneath a growing town. Homes move in and ask for water, power, internet and gas. Draw the pipes that reach them, dig under the busy parts of town and cross rivers on aqueducts. Every five years, the town votes on whether you keep the job.

title: Lightspire: Cards
short_description: Lightspire Cards is a dark fantasy tactical card battler where deckbuilding meets board control. Summon units, fuse cards, exploit terrain, complete quests, and battle through Luna’s story-driven campaign of saints, schemers, monsters, exiles, and broken vows.

title: Liminal Angel
short_description: Demons have possessed the wildlife, turning animals against humanity. As an angel in human form, you must prepare for a perilous journey. Meet the survivors without revealing your true identity, gather your gear, and evade demon-possessed beasts before dawn breaks. (Roguelike)

title: Line Clear
short_description: Line Clear is a mechanical signal box simulation set in 1990s British Rail. Pull levers, exchange bell codes and read the instruments to route trains through your junction, keeping every service running safely and on schedule.

title: Lineup, Dark Lord! : Auto Battler
short_description: "One line for battle, infinite possibilities for strategy!" Reclaim the top of the Demon Army with the ultimate combination.

title: Lingyun Cards: Between the Clear and the Turbid
short_description: Each additional card you chain makes your next strike hit even harder! Lingyun Cards: Between the Clear and the Turbid – an Eastern fantasy roguelite deckbuilder. Dive into mist-shrouded spirit realms, match wits with restless spirit beasts, counter their every move, and cut your way through!

title: Linlang's Ledger
short_description: Linlang's Ledger is an idle RPG game with an ancient Chinese trading theme. Starting as a penniless merchant, you will travel across vast countries, learn professional skills, and build connections with all sorts of people, writing a colorful business legend in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.

title: Lintbreakers: Night Shift
short_description: Survive a haunted laundromat in a top-down bullet-heaven roguelite. Move, dodge, collect lint sparks, build automatic cleaning tools, evolve weapons, defeat machine bosses, and spend quarters to make every night shift last longer.

title: Linwu: Spirit Beast Ranch
short_description: Summon a spirit beast, raise it week by week, and take it up the tournament cups. It has a mind of its own, and every choice shapes how long you get together. A monster-raising sim drawn from Chinese myth. Free demo out now.

title: Listening Post: Typing Tower Defense
short_description: Master English listening with the ultimate dictation challenge! This real-time tower defense game lets you build and upgrade defenses by typing what you hear. Use 12 tower branches and the Fever system to sharpen your intuition. The faster you listen and type, the stronger your defense!

title: Little Bettas
short_description: Little Bettas is a cozy aquarium simulation and creature-collecting game where you breed, care for, decorate, and discover beautiful betta fish. Unlock unique colors, patterns, mutations, rare legendary Bettas, and build your own peaceful underwater collection.

title: Little Cat Goes Fishing
short_description: This is a relaxing and cozy auto-fishing game. Choose your character, prepare your fishing rod, cast your line, watch the fish bite, collect your catches, and build your own fishing journey step by step.

title: Little Elementals
short_description: A chaotic escape of little elementals who want to become human! The Fire Elemental and the Water Elemental secretly visit the human world…but get caught and thrown into prison! Who came to rescue them? Can they escape and reach the human world? Join the little elementals on their adventure!

title: Little Lua & The Lost Six
short_description: Six kids are torn from their world and dropped into Everbloom, a realm poisoned by the Blight. Build your squad, master fire, ice, and lightning magic, and fight your way through shifting seasons to free everyone the Blight has taken — including your own parents.

title: Lizard Slayer
short_description: A pixelated adventure doom-like RPG set in Slavic mythology.

title: LoHa Adventure Remake
short_description: A charming 2D platformer remake starring LoHa, a brave little cat. Explore colorful worlds, collect fish, and enjoy smooth gameplay with improved visuals in a cozy, classic adventure.

title: Loading Dock Simulator
short_description: A first-person logistics sim set on a distribution center's loading dock. Sort a flood of incoming boxes into rolltainers by area, and when a count won't add up, track down the misplaced box with your PDA. Work solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players, and hire staff to grow your dock.

title: Loadout Rush
short_description: Build the perfect loadout — before the wave hits. Cram items into a grid backpack, buff them with neighbor synergies, and merge them into something greater. Chicken + Molotov + Heart = Dragon. We had rules. It happened anyway. Monster waves are coming, and your bag IS your weapon.

title: Loamlets
short_description: Untangle a garden of colorful worms in 1,500 logic puzzles. Find a clear path, click a worm and make room for the next one. Solve untimed campaign levels, return for a daily puzzle, or chase combos and high scores in Rush mode.

title: Logical Cat Logistics
short_description: Let yesterday's you lend a paw! Deliver curious parcels as a cat courier, then record your footsteps and team up with your past self. Conveyors, gates and sorting switches move one beat at a time. Take your time, try a new route, and turn a tangled delivery into a perfectly timed handoff.

title: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry?
short_description: A near-future visual novel — No androids. No cyberware. Only an LLM girl, the world, and you.

title: Long Voyage
short_description: After storms and disease leave only nine people aboard a ship bound for the New World, food and water are running low, and illness has taken part of your memory. Get to know the eight remaining crew members again, face conflict and dwindling supplies, and survive the voyage.

title: Long Watch
short_description: A short incremental game about an old relay station waking up from deep hibernation. Collect signals, decode the messages they carry, and grow your station into a network across nearby sectors.

title: Loop Spot
short_description: Build your groove in Loop Spot—a pure logic puzzle game where your moves build the music. Rotate, shift, drop, and slide blocks to solve handcrafted grid challenges. Every match triggers dynamic audio loops, letting you mix live tracks across 4 music styles to keep the party going.

title: Loopfall
short_description: Hardcore reflex arcade. Two buttons, three modes, one brutal neon tunnel, and a new Daily Challenge every day on the same tunnel for every player. Dodge endless gates, blast electric time-attack, or thread capsule mines on a track engineered for skill, not luck.

title: Loot & Bolt
short_description: A dungeon strategy party game for up to 8 players online. After each room, everyone chooses at once: press on or retreat with your gold? More treasure—or more trouble—awaits. Use items to grab gold and turn the tables. Your “teammates” may be the real danger! Play with friends or solo against bots.

title: Lord of the Tiles
short_description: Gradually uncover the world, discover new cities, connect them with roads, and turn a humble settlement into a prosperous kingdom. Develop your economy, unlock new mechanics, and explore the map at your own pace — with no combat and no unnecessary stress.

title: Lordum Bizi Kurtar!
short_description: Mordagan forces are marching toward Derinchai Castle, and you have only a few days to prepare for their arrival. When the enemy finally reaches these walls, every choice you have made will follow you onto the battlefield.

title: Lost Ball
short_description: Roll, jump, and turn enemies into helpers in a 2D physics puzzle-platformer. Unlock new abilities throughout the campaign, then create levels with the same editor used to build the game. Script custom game modes and share your creations through Steam Workshop.

title: Lost Floor — Not My World
short_description: An auto-battler dungeon crawler with visual novel elements. A tired office worker got off on the wrong floor and ended up in another world. The locals look suspiciously like his coworkers, and to get out, he'll have to do some work.

title: LouLan Kingdom
short_description: Loulan Kingdom blends survival city-building with real-time strategy. As the ruler of Loulan, build your city in a procedurally generated desert oasis, prosper through trade along the Silk Road, and fight with all you have to defend your kingdom until the very end.

title: Lucky Crafter
short_description: A potion-brewing roguelite on a four-ring wheel. Every combination of ingredients is its own potion, with over 4,000 to discover. Ingredients add up, bottles multiply the price and boosts push it further. Pick runes and reach growing delivery targets before your spins run out.

title: Lucky Debt
short_description: A roguelike about debt. Eight deadlines, one rigged slot machine, and a simple problem: the money that keeps you alive is the money that makes you stronger. Build a deck of symbols and charms, chain multipliers, and pay what you owe — or don't.

title: Lucky Dog Rise
short_description: Bring a lucky dog to your desktop! It stays in a screen corner, keeps you company while you work, and lets a little luck into your day. Take a break with a quick card game, win rewards, open blind boxes, collect outfits, and make your desktop a lucky nook for you and your pup!

title: Lucky Hell
short_description: A dice game scored on Yahtzee hands. Roll, hold what's worth keeping, roll the rest again. Clear the target score and you move down a stage, and a shop opens in between. On the way down you hit stages where the dealer has bent one rule.

title: Lucky Pocket
short_description: Adjust your strategy to match the shop list that changes with every playthrough, combine equipment to create powerful synergies, and defeat monsters and bosses with a variety of options!

title: Lucky Sip
short_description: This is a time-management restaurant simulation game with roguelike elements. Master a wide range of tasty drinks, meet all kinds of customers, and learn diverse management skills. Combine your options wisely to conquer both casual stage runs and the rent challenge!

title: LumaEdge
short_description: Reactive ambience - no hardware required. Transform your desktop into dynamic ambient lighting that reacts to games, movies, streams, and more. No LED strips. No hubs. Just your existing displays.

title: Lumenal: A Photo Break
short_description: After a stressful day, grab your camera and hit the road. In Lumenal, you photograph animals and lovely moments, from forests full of birdsong to glaciers under the northern lights. Go solo or bring three friends, and fill your board with your best shots.

title: Luminara: The Second Dawn
short_description: Medieval fantasy daughter-raising sim with adventure and romance elements. You are a single father, and every step of your daughter's journey is yours to guide. Study, adventure, make friends, fall in love… 70+ endings, each playthrough a new story. Ready to raise the most wonderful daughter of all?

title: Luminons: Seeds of Starlight
short_description: Farming sim meets monster taming. Grow crops to feed and strengthen your Luminons. Compete in beauty contests or strategic 3v3 battles.

title: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon
short_description: A survivors-like roguelite action RPG where you master the power to grow giant or shrink tiny. Build your character by collecting weapons and companions, then challenge colossal legendary monsters. Supports 2-player local co-op.

title: Lunar Wardens
short_description: Build a team of elemental creatures and fight for the league title with up to 8 friends. Hire, hunt and evolve your creatures between matches, then set your line-up and watch every bout play out live in the moonlit arena.

title: Lurks Beneath
short_description: Investigate a little girl's disappearance at a rundown trailer park. Play as Detective Partridge and cross examine three suspects to find the truth with fully freeform interrogation. Type anything and ask anything you want.

title: Lynayly
short_description: Lynayly is a cooperative, roguelike deck builder set in the mystical realm of Tovycri where four players build their own decks while exploring a new land built exclusively for real-time cooperative play. Team up and set forth on your journey to defeat the Gludites and save the world of Gichiman!

title: Lynxwood: The Secrets Beneath
short_description: Lynxwood: The Secrets Beneath is a first-person survival horror game. Your grandfather vanished chasing the secret of a dying Oregon town: a cult that never left, and something breeding in the tunnels below. Follow his trail through the forests, the old factory, and what waits beneath Lynxwood.

title: MALAM: School
short_description: Selamat MALAM. A slow-burn psychological horror set in a Malaysian Chinese school at night. Observe each space from four directions, investigate subtle changes, and uncover fragments of a buried past. No combat. No chases. Just observation, and the feeling that something is wrong. AI assisted.

title: MAMA DOUGH
short_description: Cook under pressure as the Chef while the Hunter attacks, blocks, and subdues ravenous zombies. Match every order, time each bake, and throw the right pizza to purify your target before it goes stale. Play solo or coordinate both roles in local shared-screen co-op.

title: MARSTEAD
short_description: A Mars colony sim starting with three crash survivors. Supply oxygen, water and power; grow food, cook meals and make equipment. Manage colonists with their own traits and relationships, trade with alien species, defend against raids and research new ways to expand.

title: MEGA TAG PANIC
short_description: Tag — but IT keeps GROWING. The giant tagger can't fit through narrow doors, and that's your way out. Charge your slap, release it in the RED, send a friend flying. 2-10 players, 12 maps, 6 modes, 10 characters with 10 special powers. Nobody online? The bots don't go easy on you.

title: MEHEN
short_description: MEHEN is a boss rush game set in the mysterious fortress city of Mehen, a place shrouded in eternal night. Guard, parry, or dodge the stars' onslaught, and strike back with a counter to bring them down.

title: MIA: Memory Fragments
short_description: MIA: Memory Fragments is a story-driven psychological horror adventure where you explore fractured memories, interact with the environment to progress, uncover the story through the world, and escape from MIA’s darkest side. Survive the memories… or remain trapped forever in the past.

title: MMA Tactics - Martial Arts
short_description: A tactical turn-based MMA simulation with (optional auto-battle) and perma-death. From your backyard to a world title. Recruit Fighters, Assign Perks, Train Stats, Build Synergies, Manage Injuries, Unlock strategies, Upgrade your Gym, Bribe the Commission and create a roster of MMA Champions.

title: MOGUMOGU! POOP BATTLE
short_description: Control a 🥕, gather 🐰, and feed them to 🐺 with your teammate! Eaten 🐰 turn into 💩 and get SHOOT at the enemy! 2v2 online battle for up to 4 players. Play solo or with friends!

title: MOLY
short_description: MOLY is a VR puzzle-solving immersive rowing simulator that uses VR rowing gameplay to represent the authors' perceptions of the world and their aspirations for the future as they come of age.

title: MOP’N SPARK
short_description: Try, rewind, and rebuild! MOP'N SPARK is a 2D puzzle platformer built around clever thinking, where you coordinate a cleaner and an electrician to piece together the solution.

title: MSO FreeCell Arena
short_description: Real-time multiplayer FreeCell. Same deal, real rivals: everyone gets the same shuffle and races to solve it, every race timed to the millisecond. Race the nightly Arena Hour, take the worldwide Daily Challenge, and try to beat the dev. Free to download and play. No microtransactions.

title: MUTARIUM: Mutant Aquarium Defense
short_description: Feed them and they mutate. Overfeed them and they turn on you. Mix MEAT, GLOW and ORE to grow your fish into adorable little horrors, then let them fight the failed experiments breaking into your tank. You never control a unit — what you feed is the whole strategy.

title: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES: Tidy Videogame Supermarket
short_description: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES is a tidy up organizing game. Put 5,158 games and consoles back on the shelves, restore your video game store, and free your mischievous cat from the claw machine. Play by yourself or with up to 3 friends in co-op!

title: MaMills
short_description: The 3D four-in-a-row game I played with my grandmother - now in a digital form. You can outsmart the Machine across five difficulties, solve 40 one-solution puzzles, or challenge a friend on the couch, over LAN or with Steam Remote Play Together.

title: Mad Toy House
short_description: Mad Toy House is a roguelite build game that combines Brotato-style wave survival with a The Bazaar-style build system. With over a hundred weapons and items to choose from, you can forge your own unique build and face a fresh challenge every run.

title: Mafia: Night falls
short_description: A Mafia social deduction game for 8 to 16 players in a moonlit village. By day, accuse and vote at the plaza. By night, hidden roles kill, revive, jail, and investigate while a werewolf hunts and the Mafia plots. Everyone has a secret. Someone is always lying. Survive until dawn.

title: Mage Cat:Endless Breakout Survivor
short_description: Mage Cat: Endless Breakout Survivor is a 2D cartoon action survivor. Play as a magic cat, dodge foes, and build power with strategy cards and bonds. Upgrade talents and gear, then conquer campaign, Abyss, and Endless modes.

title: Mage's Adventure
short_description: A roguelike auto battler of misfit heroes and warped realms. Recruit your party, defeat monsters for gear, hoard godly artifacts, and put down the colossal evils at the end of every road.

title: MagiMine Orchestra
short_description: Smash ore by clicking or holding, scoop up scattered resources, and automate the mine with four specialist classes. Chain combos, flood the screen in Fever, then prestige for permanent power in this active incremental mining game.

title: Magic Cards Duel
short_description: A wild party card game for 2-4 players. Jumpscare, stun, and blur your friends, but watch out: they can counter, reflect, or even steal your attacks. Chain epic combos and outplay everyone!

title: Magic Color Merge Puzzle VR
short_description: Magic Color Merge Puzzle blends classic color sorting with a magical twist. Pour vibrant liquids your way - click or drag by hand! Complete levels to earn crystals and craft powerful magic potions. Two games in one: solve puzzles and become a master alchemist!

title: Magic Portals
short_description: A fast, elegant card game of elemental drafting. Draw from the shared Animus, forge crystals, and ignite sleeping portals. Blue attunes, Purple pays, Green multiplies, Yellow improvises. First to seven portals ends the duel - but only the sharpest planner wins. Solo vs AI or online duels.

title: Magician Alisa
short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder that combines elemental spells into powerful attacks. It features flexible, easy-to-trigger Elemental Combos alongside rarer, stronger Unique Combos. Combine spells, relics, Lore and hand-type upgrades to conquer every Boss.

title: Magua: Twenty Sorrows
short_description: An autobattler focused on the creating synergies to buff your team. Upgrade your units and defeat increasingly stronger enemies in this rogue-like game.

title: Mahjong Rush
short_description: This isn't your typical Mahjong game! Build sets and sequences to score points, land a winning hand to send your score soaring. Every run brings new shops, bosses, and challenges. Never played Mahjong before? You'll pick it up in just three minutes!

title: Maiden Covenant: The Infernal Citadel
short_description: A solo rogue-lite combining deckbuilding and board tactics. Build a deck and play cards governed by movement and combat rules. Seize Magic Ore, manage resources, and face relentless foes. Lead allies across four territories, challenge the Infernal Citadel, and restore order to a shattered world!

title: Main Street Operator
short_description: Buy a tired neighborhood laundromat and turn it around. Walk the floor, clean and repair machines, manage prices and cash flow, modernize the store, win back customers, pay down the seller note, and decide when the business is finally worth keeping—or selling.

title: Man vs. Gary
short_description: Row out. Shoot the enormous sea monster. Drown. File the incident report. Do it again, a little angrier each time. A hand-illustrated idle comedy about losing to Gary, a kraken with opinions and a HR complaint, until one day you don't.

title: Mana Boom
short_description: Magic meets physics, and the world is yours to mess with! Battle or race with up to 8 players in real time. Lob spells with your choice of elements and projectile behaviors, swing on ropes, and destroy or create terrain. Win your own way. Play dirty, but don't let it backfire!

title: ManaBorne
short_description: Defend your campfire in a rogue-like RTS where strategy meets deckbuilding. Earn runes, build a powerful card deck, and adapt your army to survive relentless waves across diverse biomes. Build fast. Defend smarter. Choose your cards carefully.

title: Manala: Equinox War
short_description: The swords are fake, the hits don't count and the monster is just a guy in a costume. Manala is a deckbuilding game about live-action roleplay (LARP): fight monsters or other players, argue over armor points, or play the whole thing solo.

title: Mancalero
short_description: Plan one perfect move and watch it chain into millions of points. Mancalero is a roguelike built on Mancala, the board game of moving stones from pit to pit. Collect marbles that burn, multiply and swallow whole pits, build a combo engine and climb 8 tables, each with a boss that changes the rules.

title: Mangrove Express
short_description: Pilot a delivery boat through the lively waterways of a tropical cyber world. Master momentum, discover villages, and chart your own routes in a speedboat delivery adventure. It’s a simple job—until it isn’t :)

title: ManiWheel
short_description: A mani wheel is a Tibetan Buddhist prayer wheel said to grant the same virtue as reciting scripture when spun. Arrange letters, spin the wheel, accumulate Virtue and Mercy, and reincarnate again and again. Discover powerful interactions and find your own path to enlightenment.

title: Manual Teller Machine
short_description: In this office simulator, you play as an employee hiding behind an ATM, taking care of all the tasks assigned by your manager. Complete quests to unlock rewards and even get a raise! Manage your daily diet, maintain your body shape, and treat yourself with your paycheck.

title: Mapping Creator
short_description: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!

title: Marble Mill
short_description: An idle game where every coin is a real collision. Build a marble mill, watch it grow into a roaring machine — and finish it in one satisfying evening. 100% achievements in ~3 hours, endless sandbox after. An idle game that ends.

title: Marbled Memories
short_description: Marbled Memories is a psychological horror game based on true events.  Play as Derek, a young man severely mistreated and neglected by his mother.  This game contains a story, puzzles, dark humor, many objects to interact with, collectibles, along with a few startling moments.

title: Marco, Polo, SHOTGUN!
short_description: Marco Polo Shotgun is a chaotic, four-player arena shooter. You're equipped with the latest and greatest in personal protection: a bucket. Arm yourself with your trusty double-barrel, embrace your severely restricted visibility, and try to figure out where the hell everyone else is.

title: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim
short_description: What would life look like as a florist on Pont Notre-Dame in late 15th-century Paris? Personalize your home and shop, carry on your legacy, and grow flowers using real cultivation principles. The final page of the Guide Book may just be the first page of your real-life botanical journey.

title: Mark My Spell
short_description: Mark My Spell is a gesture-driven action roguelite about drawing glyphs, typing commands, and building wild spell synergies against a relentless ghost horde.

title: Market Manager Simulator
short_description: Build and manage your own market. Fill the shelves, set prices, serve customers, manage online orders and grow your business. Hire employees, check stocks and turn your market into a large business.

title: Market Moe
short_description: Work the night shift on a Japanese street… where something shouldn’t be there.

title: Market Panic
short_description: Market Panic is a turn-based portfolio roguelite about surviving economic chaos. Build a fund across public markets, private equity and crypto, and read the companies inside it. Answer to clients who can leave, rivals who want them, and a committee that comes looking for you.

title: Marque & Reprisal
short_description: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

title: Marry Anyone
short_description: Get married within one month—or lose your job!? Solve puzzles, use items, and change your stats (Intelligence, Age, Cleanliness, Height, and Income) as you work your way toward marriage in this matchmaking puzzle game!

title: Master of Chaos: Beat or Break the Game
short_description: Pulverize your enemies for underestimating this cute little wizard by counter attacks, deflecting projectiles, unleashing face-melting ultimate abilities and building insane combos boosting your power until you are strong enough to beat the boss or break the game - Either way you win.

title: Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush
short_description: Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush fuses match-3 puzzles with physics-based Pachinko action! Match tiles to drop bouncy balls through pegs into multiplier slots for massive combos. Unleash powerful boosters, buy permanent upgrades, and dominate global leaderboards!

title: Match & Ruin
short_description: Plan the flow of cards across three mercenaries' hands in a roguelike card battler. Match ranks or suits to set up the next attack, defense, or skill. Reshape the shared deck and combine relics to fight through fallen kingdoms.

title: Matchinko
short_description: Match glowing crystals to build a pachinko board, then rain your ball loadout through it for an exploding score. A cozy winter roguelite of fairies, tiles, and fate: light every town on the climb to the boss — but miss one target and the run is over.

title: Matchy Star
short_description: Match stars along your ship’s flight path in a colorful match-3 roguelite. Plan your moves, chain big matches, and collect quirky upgrades as you chart a changing route through space. Guide Zippy, Skippy, and Bob toward Xanadu, one run at a time.

title: Math Defense Protocol
short_description: Deploy characters across a fractured mind, combine numbers and operators into equations, and turn every result into firepower. Build your squad, trigger bonds, and defend the last memories through story battles and endless challenges.

title: Mayhem Duck Simulator
short_description: A relaxing yet chaotic, physics-based rubber duck simulator! Free superpowered ducks from their cages, wreak havoc with dragon fire and UFO beams, or just sit back and watch. Made by a dad, with ideas from his 4- and 5-year-old kids. 🦆

title: Mechanis Obscura
short_description: MECHANIS OBSCURA is an indie psychological escape-room thriller game, blending FMV cutscenes, 2000s horror vibes, and intricate puzzle mechanisms. After unknowingly enrolling in a deep-web trial, you have been abducted into a nightmarish escape room. No choices, only one reality remains...ESCAPE!

title: Medieval Ascendant
short_description: From a serf bound to the soil to the head of a noble house. Farm, trade, build an economic empire across five provinces, claim land through war, intrigue or wealth — and forge a dynasty that outlives you.

title: Megachest
short_description: Megachest is an incremental game about opening chests, discovering legendary loot, and building your ultimate fortune empire! Start with simple rewards and grow into a master of magic and riches as you unlock rare items, upgrade your power, and hire helpers to automate your chest-opening journey

title: Megashootsplosion
short_description: A fast, physics-drunk arena shooter that never stays the same. Throw your gun to reload, wall-jump to stay alive, and stack chaotic upgrades until fights get gloriously out of hand. Duel 1v1 or brawl up to 4 players across 8 modes.

title: Memento Resonance
short_description: Forge a Resonance with enemy monsters and welcome them into your party. Equip their skills with relics to shape your own battle style, then climb an ever-changing tower as you follow the trail of lost memories in this monster-collecting roguelite turn-based strategy game.

title: Memory Cyphers
short_description: Online co-op Survivors-like for 1-4 players. Take on the memory-drained hordes with your friends. Memory chips, weapon upgrades, rule-breaking relics. Nobody clears a swarm this big alone! Fast roguelite action.

title: Memory Dive: An 3xscape Game — Chapter One
short_description: A first-person investigation inside a rebuilt memory. You are not a man in a room — you are the scan of one. Reconstruct what happened to him object by object, link the evidence, and learn to spot the parts the machine invented to fill its gaps.

title: Meow Defense War
short_description: Newly appointed Meow Construction Manager, it's time to get to work! Can this thing you built withstand the mice's next shot? Build fortifications, glue materials, trick the mice. Protect the meow, chase high scores. The mice have bad eyesight, but the projectiles are real.

title: MeowRig
short_description: MeowRig is a mining-themed incremental game. Follow Me(ow) and search for Meow God's great treasure.

title: Meowgic Laundry
short_description: Run a magical laundry on the verge of chaos! Toss single-use detergents into a physics-driven washer, chain collisions into escalating scores, buy machine parts, sign contracts, and survive nine rounds of increasingly unruly laundry.

title: Meowxia: Idle Wuxia
short_description: Meowxia: Idle Wuxia is an idle martial arts game with a feline desktop companion. Master inner arts, mix skills, collect gear, and fight automatically. Refine your build, unlock meridians, and reach new realms as your cat pursues its heroic dream.

title: Merc Commander
short_description: Merc Commander is a real-time tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenary mech pilots. Command your forces in battle, customize and upgrade your mechs, salvage enemy machines, and manage your growing outfit. Inspired by the classic era of mech command games.

title: Mercenary Brotherhood
short_description: A deep turn‑based tactics RPG featuring emergent stories, procedural world events, enemy factions, magical loot with drawbacks, and a fully simulated fantasy sandbox. Build your mercenary company, survive brutal battles, and uncover new content. Solo‑dev indie project with active development.

title: Mercenary Guild Manager
short_description: Raise a banner and run a mercenary guild in a grim medieval fantasy realm. Recruit and read your blades, negotiate contracts, send them into procedural missions, and survive a living political web where every payday bites and nothing is ever certain.

title: Mercyrail: Haven Bound
short_description: A railway survival management game on the real UK rail network. Choose who gets a seat on the last train out of a dead London, send crews into empty towns for supplies, keep the sick alive and the engine fed, and find your own way north to Haven. Every choice on the line is remembered.

title: Merge Day: Office Girls
short_description: [Merge Day: Office Girls] is a bishoujo puzzle game where you merge items to blast through a mountain of work. As a rookie in a secret department, get tangled up with 4 unique heroines. Merge items to finish your tasks, and merge your bonds to spark a thrilling office romance!

title: Metabolis
short_description: Build a city shaped by water. Bring clean water uphill, collect sewage, and treat it before it pollutes the river. Expand neighborhoods, trace problems through your pipes, and grow a thriving low-poly city.

title: Meteor Spin
short_description: Meteor Spin is a cosmic roguelike deckbuilder where slot mechanics meet planetary defense. Spin the defense slots, trigger explosive module synergies, and protect your planet from incoming meteor storms!

title: Method in the Witchness
short_description: A cozy game of sorting, riddles, and puzzles on a little witch’s table. Arrange magical objects, discover hidden secrets that may help in later puzzles, and uncover a gentle story—one uniquely sounding item at a time.

title: Metro Anomaly
short_description: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.

title: Metromino
short_description: Build your own metropolis from tetromino pieces! Start with a small village, grow your city, build roads and upgrades, earn millions, and keep your residents happy.

title: Mewtations: Dogma
short_description: Build a cat colony on a cluttered board of cards. Craft, farm and gear up your crew, send them on roguelite expeditions with automatic battles, and stand up to Boss Huohuo's dog mafia, before the next tax note comes due.

title: Michael Test
short_description: This is a test about sin. An audio-driven horror mystery where you reconstruct the hidden timeline inside a painting through sound and expose the sin concealed within.

title: Micro Party
short_description: 150+ micro-games, 5 to 15 seconds each. 2-4 players on one keyboard. Most of it built with AI and I am not going to pretend otherwise.

title: Midnight Arcade Orchestra
short_description: Midnight Arcade Orchestra takes you back to arcades full of retro games. But they’re all rhythm games. No idea why.

title: Midnight Toybox
short_description: Welcome to the playroom, newcomer. At midnight, twisted toys come alive, locking a deadly collar around your neck. One wrong move, and your head rolls. Take their pieces, bait them into taking yours, and fight for survival in a lethal battle of wits.

title: Mighty Mahjong
short_description: Still playing mahjong with 13 tiles? Mighty Mahjong is a next-gen twist where you start one tile short — and that missing tile becomes a wild card! Outsmart opponents with bold strategy and sharp reads. Anime-style online battles, special rules, team modes, and fast-paced matches. Free to play!

title: Mike goes on hike
short_description: Leave the city behind in a first-person hiking adventure. Explore mountain trails, take photographs, and fill Mike’s travel journal with memories — from a thrilling zipline ride to a quiet evening by the campfire.

title: Minatro
short_description: Minatro is a roguelite deckbuilder where you open tiles to reach the target. Synergize items, Boss rounds, and cursed items.

title: Mind the Goo
short_description: One tower. A thousand hungry slimes from every side. Mind the Goo is a cute tower-defense roguelite: pick 1 of 3 Powerups every wave, stack Charms, chase huge Combos, and turn a lone turret into a screen-clearing goo machine.

title: MindGate CornerGet
short_description: A free-to-play hack-and-slash that fights on in your taskbar. Chibi heroes meet the enemy inside a thin strip at the bottom of your screen. All you do is swap the gear they picked up and respec their skills when you feel like it. No connection needed; the rest happens in the corner of your screen.

title: Mindless as the Mountains
short_description: Mindless as the Mountains blends platform jumping, lite roguelike and Tarkov-style collection. Embark on an adventure, improve yourself and beat tough challenges. What lies beyond the mountain? Characters join you with different motives, and many mysteries are waiting to be revealed.

title: Mine It All!
short_description: Mine blocks across the screen, gather resources, and upgrade your tools. Build furnaces and automation systems to improve efficiency, then trigger chain reactions with special blocks to clear huge sections of the screen at once.

title: Mine Mine Mine
short_description: Minesweeper, but the mines fight back. Descend an endless shaft where the numbers lie, monsters burrow, and one wrong dig can end the run. Recruit 28 companions, hoard relics, and outsmart the Mole Queen. Survival is solvable by logic — going deeper is the gamble.

title: Mine the Deep
short_description: Battle relentless drone swarms, mine valuable resources, and upgrade your ship into a devastating weapon platform.

title: Mineblader - Spin. Mine. Upgrade.
short_description: A short but packed incremental game where you use a spinning top (spinner) to mine, make money, upgrade, get special powers, and defeat bosses.

title: Minesweeper 2007
short_description: The future of minesweeper games we were promised. Minesweeper 2007 is a mine flagging puzzle game with new mechanics and a nostalgic 2000’s Frutiger Aero aesthetic. Flag your way through dozens of original puzzles, relax, and pretend it's still 2007…

title: Mini Grid
short_description: Build and operate a minimalist power grid across Wuhan. Match voltages, connect riverbanks, manage limited supplies and keep growing demand powered. Plan in Normal mode, handle faults in Hardcore, or experiment with custom settings and hand-drawn maps in Sandbox.

title: Mini Mart Survivors
short_description: Survive 10 minutes on the night shift at SHIFT24, where cup noodles, snacks, and coffee turn the aisles into a bullet heaven. Fight off nightmare customers, pay off your debt, and uncover what SHIFT24 is hiding in this survivors-like roguelite.

title: MiniCook
short_description: Play as a street food vendor at a night market, grilling and selling skewers. Earn enough to buy a fried rice cart and expand your business. Save more to open your own bubble tea shop. The game focuses on the experience of running a food business, with management as a secondary element.

title: Miracle Mage: Awakened Elements
short_description: "Awakened Elements" is a match-three strategy RPG where chaos spreads as the Demon King shatters elemental balance. As a young mage, awaken lost powers, rally elven allies, and battle through thorny paths to restore order before darkness consumes the world.

title: Miramar
short_description: Set in a hard sci-fi universe, Miramar follows a group of Tac Marines sent to investigate why contact has been lost with a far off colony. Exploration, turn-based combat, and roguelike gameplay collide. Can your squad survive?

title: MirrorBullet
short_description: A shot that has not reflected cannot kill. Place mirrors to turn the sentries' shots back on them. 144 hand-built stages across twelve sectors of Greek myth. Every par is proven minimal.

title: Misohagi Crossing
short_description: On his first visit to his father's rural hometown in seven years, Hotaru reunites with his first love—only to learn that she died three years ago. Explore Yokomizo, uncover the truth behind a family tragedy, and escape supernatural otherworlds in this Japanese horror mystery adventure.

title: Misplaced
short_description: Misplaced is a historical detective puzzle game about sorting case files and uncovering hidden connections. Read letters, witness statements, and official records, figure out where each document belongs, and piece together the truth behind a murder case inspired by real events.

title: Mithril
short_description: Explore and mine in procedural caves. Master using struts to delve deeper and support the ceiling before it falls. Build automation chains to process ores. Then manipulate lava and trigger Dormancy to crystallise new ore where lava once flowed. Same world. New cave. New dangers. The world remembers.

title: Mo Juan
short_description: Mojuan is a single-player roguelike deckbuilder blending deck construction with Qishu board space management. Enter painted scrolls, plan around cards, relics, consumables, and the Nine Gates, and face forest spirits, strange formations, and eerie encounters.

title: Mom! I'm gonna be a black hole when I grow up!
short_description: From dust to a black hole. Use gravity to gather resources and combine evolution paths and skills to grow your own celestial body. In this physics-based growth game, gather safely or shatter and devour larger planets to grow faster. Manage resources, choose when to fight, and shape your own build.

title: Momoawase
short_description: A memory game with strange rules my 3-year-old daughter decided on all by herself. Match pairs of "も" (mo), spell out hidden animals in Japanese for big combos, and relax in quick solo rounds♪

title: Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator
short_description: Travel through 2010–2025 and trade historical stocks and cryptocurrencies with the benefit of hindsight. Build a fortune, survive unexpected costs, and uncover the story behind it all.

title: Monmusu Rush
short_description: Gather Monmusu, train them, and battle! Combine Monmusu and learn skills to build the strongest team! In the asynchronous PvP mode Auto Battle Rush, you can also challenge teams registered by other players!

title: Monster Breeder Battler
short_description: A monster-breeding factory game with a tower-defense lane. Build a line that breeds, buffs and routes monsters, then send them up into the lane to hold the wall against the rift. Retool against next round's preview. 65 species, 61 recipes, permanent deaths, 45 rounds to seal it.

title: Monster Emblem: Vision Impossible
short_description: A 2D pixel-art Monster Tamer RPG set in a medieval realm scarred by centuries of war. Catch, train, evolve, and breed over 200 monsters, master tactical grid-based combat, collect every Faction Emblem, and earn your place in the Great Monster Tournament.

title: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
short_description: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

title: MonsterGirl 3:Wukong
short_description: "Monster Girl 3: Wukong" is an interactive narrative game that combines strategic battles with branching storylines. Collect various mystic elixirs for trading, and unlock enchanting demoness characters to keep as desktop companions.

title: Mool: Chroma
short_description: A top-down roguelite where you are the monster. Absorb colors, mix them into impossible forms, and tear down the "heroes" who farmed your kind. Nine apex awakenings, hand-built rooms dealt fresh every run, and an altar that trades your curses for power.

title: Moon Basketball
short_description: This is basketball.  On the moon.  Gravity is different and also there's jetpacks.

title: Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model
short_description: When I was sunken in a deep depression, I set off on a journey.

title: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights
short_description: A cozy little Sudoku for quiet nights. Solve tonight’s puzzle with a cat by your side and earn a new star for your sky. Come back tomorrow for another, and watch your stars slowly come together as constellations. Or settle in with 5,000 more puzzles, Easy to Expert.

title: Morpheus
short_description: Locked, loaded, on the beat — reclaim the boy's lost memories! Morpheus is a futuristic arcade rhythm game built around heavyweight impact.

title: Morphsea: Abyssal Evolution
short_description: Begin at the bottom of the food chain. Shape your body as you hunt, grow, and evolve across a vast ocean. Journey from sunlit shallows to the lightless abyss, surviving changing environments and deadly predators as you explore the deepest reaches of the sea.

title: Mortal Chess
short_description: Every piece is living on borrowed time. In Mortal Chess, each piece's life counts down with every move. Collect the coins from expired pieces, buy extra turns, deploy reinforcements, and earn the queen you don't start with. Play vs AI or local split-screen PvP. Checkmate isn't the only way to lose.

title: Mortal Realm Survivors
short_description: Stranded in the fallen Mortal Realm, resistance fighter Li Anbang teams up with Luo, an intelligent entropy beast. Merge relics, activate powerful synergies, choose mutations, and survive escalating battles. Defeat the Entropy Beast King and reclaim the portal out of the Mortal Realm.

title: Mossu
