short_description: Mossu is a botanical cubesat terrarium floating through the real solar system, with you and your friends as it's caretakers! Hands on plant growth, cubesat construction and exploration in your shared, persistent craft. Go from Earth orbit to the Martian surface!

title: Motel 51: Papers, Keys & Aliens
short_description: Motel 51 is a motel management sim set near Area 51. Your uncle left you the place, and his debt to the bank. Work the night desk: check IDs and alien transit permits, decide who gets a key. Some guests leave a tip. Others leave a repair bill, and a few bring trouble to your door.

title: Motion De Censure
short_description: Step into the French National Assembly and lead your campaign in this strategic card game. Unlock new political parties, expand their decks, then challenge the AI or another candidate online in tactical debates where every card can overturn the majority.

title: Motive Power
short_description: Run British Railways' locomotive fleet from 1955 to 1994. Order the classes history built — or take your own choices. Manage overhauls, depots, budgets and withdrawals across four decades, and answer for it in a graded annual report against the real record. Deterministic, deeply researched.

title: Moto Courier Simulator
short_description: Ride real-sounding motorcycles through a living island city. Wrench on your own bike in a hands-on garage, take orders, pack them right and deliver before the clock runs out – solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Motocross The Force
short_description: Motocross The Force is a physics-driven motocross game that's easy to pick up and hard to master. Race online, push your limits, and chase the perfect lap.

title: Motor Sport Unbounded
short_description: Motor Sport Unbounded is an open-world arcade racing game inspired by the legendary street racers of the early 2000s. Explore a vast nighttime city, compete in a variety of events, upgrade your cars, challenge the Street Crown bosses, and reclaim your place at the top after a devastating betrayal.

title: Mountainhall
short_description: The dwarves have chosen you. Will you lead them? A new land, a new start, and a mountain waiting to become a home. Dig it out from the inside, lead a colony of dwarves with lives of their own, and stand with them when the goblins come. Build a settlement, a fortress, a Mountainhall.

title: Mournhill
short_description: Who will be the first to open the red door and find THE TRUTH? Mournhill is a comedic noir card game: swipe left or right, keep four factions happy, and collect 100+ endings. Everyone wants a favor. Nobody mentions the door. Something is counting down behind the jokes.

title: Mourning House
short_description: After a terrifying encounter on a lonely road, you awaken inside a mysterious house—and your wife is missing. Explore its dark rooms, solve disturbing puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and discover what happened before the nightmare consumes you.

title: Moving Castle
short_description: Build a moving castle—or a vast mobile city—and explore a post-apocalyptic world. Live aboard your creation: gather, mine, explore and fight. Travel with your residents, face fearsome monsters, grow crops, cook meals, and share sunrises and sunsets.

title: Multiworlds
short_description: A world torn apart by one mistake, help pull it back into one. A 2D puzzle game where you control multiple player remnants in parallel, jump between dimensions and avoid obstacles to put back the world together.

title: Murder Your Friends
short_description: A party horror game for you and your friends, except one of you is a masked killer. Doors are locked, find the key before the killer finds you! Chaos will ensue as you stumble into each other, find whimsical items, and sacrifice your best friends for survival!

title: Music Empire Tycoon
short_description: Build your own record label from the ground up, release music, grow your reputation, expand into global markets, and turn a small music business into a worldwide empire. Manage your catalog, discover opportunities, and make the decisions that shape your success.

title: Music Manager
short_description: Sign artists, develop talent, release music and steer careers through tours, festivals and changing trends in a detailed music industry management sim set from 1952 to 2026.

title: Music Maniaz
short_description: Play the drums in a rhythm game anyone can pick up, packed with lo-fi. (Over 20 lo-fi songs alone!) 50+ original tracks across all kinds of genres! Besides drums, play Melody and All Mix at three difficulties! Add your own favorite songs, auto-generate the chart, and play as much as you want!

title: MusicDamage
short_description: MusicDamage is a top-down multiplayer music shooter. Move, aim and fire to your weapon's rhythm in team battles and casual matches. Use cover and hazards, and enable optional fragment progression to collect rhythm fragments and upgrades that change how you play and build.

title: Mutation
short_description: Upon waking, he finds a world transformed. Now, he must face the manor's horde of the undead alone and unearth the terrifying truth behind the nightmare.

title: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge
short_description: Brokk has set up a tiny forge just above your taskbar. You tap the keys, he swings the hammer. Mostly it is horseshoes or kettles, sometimes a legendary sword. Brygida sells it all in their shop. You type, he smiths. Together, the work goes faster and feels better.

title: My Dirty Little Lake
short_description: Cozy, short and relaxing: cast your net to clean up a dirty lake and bring nature back. With dogs as helpers, recycle trash and earn money to upgrade your gear. Lots of hidden treasures to find and wash, in a satisfying mini-game to decorate your house. Wildlife appreciates your work.

title: My Little Empire: Cyber Lounge
short_description: Build your own computer club from an empty lot: rows of gaming PCs, console and VR corners, a bar and a kitchen. Hire staff, keep gamers happy, deal with 21 city factions — and don't forget to pet Luna, the club cat.

title: My Snake Likes Apples
short_description: A short, minimalist incremental game about raising a foolish snake and helping it go the distance.

title: My Summer Project Together
short_description: Build your first car from scratch in a cheerful summer adventure, solo or with up to 4 players online. Earn money from odd jobs, explore the countryside for hidden parts, buy supplies, assemble every system, and enjoy the freedom and chaos of summer with friends.

title: Myriad Strategy
short_description: Myriad Strategies: a turn-based strategy game. Rule a nation amid wars, famine, plague, and refugees. Manage cities, talent, economy. The world shifts. Win by holding cities, stabilizing lives, solving refugee crises, building food systems & spy networks, or surviving the chaos.

title: Mystery Box Simulator
short_description: Run your own mystery box business! Source returned shipments, storage finds and second-hand treasures. Hunt for hidden gems, identify valuable items, restore them and create the perfect mystery boxes to satisfy your customers while maximizing your profits!

title: Myth-OS
short_description: Step into a limitless sandbox governed by a dynamic AI Game Master. Merge the total freedom of a Tabletop RPG with the mechanics of a Grand Strategy epic. Whether exploring dungeons or ruling empires, your choices ripple across a deep, living, and fully persistent universe.

title: Mythia Wild Bonds
short_description: A monster-collector roguelite. Pick a Mythia. Fight the horde. When creatures fall, escort their Exposed Souls to forge permanent Bonds in your Grimoire. Bond the same creature enough times and it reaches its Ascended Form.

title: NABERON
short_description: Build a galactic empire and fight your battles alone or with a friend. A real-time space 4X with spectacular clashes in space and on the planets.

title: NARROWS: Naval Checkpoint Simulator
short_description: Trade has flowed through the Narrows for centuries, now it's yours to command. Inspect every ship, check for contraband, deal with smugglers and pirates. With war on the horizon, every choice has its cost, choose well.

title: NEBULA BREAK
short_description: A family-friendly space shooter that refuses to stay the same. Clear five stages and new modes keep unlocking - side-scrolling, then a full-3D SPACE DIVE. ASSIST mode adds lives and bombs and slows the pace for younger players, while eleven galaxies and 50+ minigames keep veterans busy.

title: NEKO MAKER 2: Starlit Girl
short_description: Her story starts with the name you give her. Raise a cat-eared girl from six to eighteen: plan her learning each term, respond to everyday moments, and choose how to spend the holidays. Balance time and money, nurture her talents and bonds, and uncover the mystery of the starlit cage.

title: NEUROBROOD
short_description: «NEUROBROOD» is a visual novel in the cyberpunk‑horror genre. Those touched by the abyss of neurodream never wake up the same.

title: NO CLEAN, NO EXIT
short_description: A 1-4 player online co-op horror game about cleaning. Scrub the floors, haul out the trash and exterminate the man-eating bugs nesting in an abandoned house. The truck does not leave until the place is spotless.

title: NO KING IN HELL
short_description: Awaken as the late Demon King's children, a brother and sister with no realm of their own. Explore an HD-2D demon world, recruit monsters, and reclaim a home. Seize weakened enemies mid-battle, raise them through classes, evolution and fusion, and lead squads in a turn-based strategy RPG.

title: NODE: PROTOCOL
short_description: A full immersive hacking sim based on real exploits and C2 tools. Choose missions or pure free-roam. The world adapts to your every move and strikes back. Accept contracts. Hack servers. Earn BTC. Upgrade your gear and avoid getting traced. Play solo or in Co-op / CTF with your friends.

title: NODGE
short_description: Every song is a boss fight. A neon rhythm shooter where bullets, lasers and walls hit on the beat, every track brings its own monster, and one hit too many ends the song.

title: NOT Home Free
short_description: A 4-player online co-op game set in a uniquely crafted liminal world. Pay your bills, fortify your home, and try to survive the uninvited “guests” waiting for you after dark.

title: NUGU?NUGU!: A HIDE AND SEEK BATTLE ROYALE
short_description: A real-time hide-and-seek battle royale. You must blend into a massive crowd of NPCs on a single shared screen. Act like an AI to hide your identity, pickpocket for gold, pick up weapons, and assassinate your opponents. Survive the escalating chaos of sudden death and become the last one standing.

title: NULL FACTORY Survival Horror
short_description: NULL FACTORY, terk edilmiş bir endüstriyel tesis hayatta kalmanız gereken birinci şahıs bir korku oyunudur. Notlar aracılığıyla fabrikanın karanlık sırlarını açığa çıkarın, zorlu bulmacaları çözün ve sizi avlayan varlıktan saklanın. Gerilim dolu bu tesisten sağ olarak çıkmayı başarabilecek misiniz?

title: NULL VECTOR
short_description: Defend a central core in a neon geometric survival tower defense. Move and aim your operator, construct fortifications, research permanent upgrades, collect enemy ability modules, face evolving bosses, unlock endless mode, or cooperate online with up to four players.

title: Nail It Or Fail It
short_description: The clock is ticking, and the construction never stops! Team up with friends, overcome wacky obstacles, and build your heart out amidst the chaos. But watch out: one wrong brick or a late delivery could bring it all crashing down!

title: Nana's Game Dev Diary
short_description: Nana's Game Dev Diary is a relaxing life sim about making games. Join Nana in her cozy little home as she follows her dream, planning each day around development, learning, part-time work, and rest. Enjoy the simple pleasures of everyday life with Nana.

title: National Volley
short_description: Take charge of Japan's national volleyball team in this management sim. Discover promising players, select and train your squad, and pursue the world title. Watch the team you built take the court in fully simulated 3D matches. Japanese language only.

title: Naval Supremacy
short_description: Design warships, build your naval industry, and lead a nation through a turn-based grand strategy campaign of diplomacy, fleet deployment, and automated naval warfare.

title: Necro Rising
short_description: Defeat the horde. Raise the fallen into a skeleton legion and lead it with your spells. Reclaim the Seal of Return, bring the dead home, and rebuild a workshop and a camp where people await your return. Eastern dark fantasy action. Play the free demo.

title: Necro-Matcher
short_description: A match-3 rogue-lite! Traverse through multiple floors battling baddies and discovering secrets in every unique run.

title: Necromancer: The Fallen Serve
short_description: Command a growing undead legion in a dark fantasy RTS where every fallen enemy can become your next soldier. Raise skeleton armies, harvest bones and souls, build your necromantic stronghold, and overwhelm fortified kingdoms through relentless conquest.

title: Necromancer´s Ruins
short_description: A hand-painted 2D roguelike platformer about treasure hunting, magic, and dangerous ruins. Fight monsters, collect upgrades, and try to go further each run.

title: Necrotel: No Checkout
short_description: Necrotel: No Checkout is a unique management and crafting simulator set within the walls of a grim, gothic hotel. You play as an underground surgeon managing a getaway for eccentric nobles and monsters to fund your forbidden necromantic experiments.

title: Necrovoid
short_description: Necrovoid — a dark post-apocalyptic tactical RPG with 2d6 turn-based combat. In a world shattered by nuclear fire and Rifts, you carry a Black Parasite in your chest. Every death makes you stronger… and less human.

title: Neko Room Days
short_description: Care for cats, collect furniture, and create a room of your own in this cozy 2D pixel-art simulation. Enjoy 60+ lo-fi tracks, a Pomodoro timer, and a stopwatch while you work, study, or unwind. You can also switch to Mini Mode and enjoy your cats’ company as they stroll along your Windows taskbar.

title: Nemorsys
short_description: Light exposes you. Shadow arms you. Nemorsys is a punishing stealth-action RPG where ambient light drives every ability, every enemy's eyes and every route through the world. Charge in and you die. Snuff the lights, master 20 Shadow abilities, and take a tyrant's throne from the dark.

title: Neo Tokyo Rush
short_description: Forgive me father, for I have synthed... Buckle up, son! Slam the pedal to the metal and show who is the king of the neon streets in Neo Tokyo Rush, the ultimate synthwave retro arcade racing experience!

title: NeoRunners
short_description: NeoRunners is a playable cyberpunk comic and roguelite deckbuilder. Combine 🔥 Burn, ⚡ Volt, and 💧 Flow into explosive reactions, then build relationships that unlock new cards, modifications, services, and story paths.

title: Neon Armada - Solar Storm
short_description: A top-down arena roguelite you can learn in one wave and spend a hundred hours mastering. Waves close in from every edge; the shop between them decides what you become. 32 ships, 28 weapons, 115 mods to combine — then endless mode, where the caps come off.

title: Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade
short_description: Blast through escalating fleets in a wraparound twin-stick arcade shooter built for rapid destruction, evasion and kill combos. Merge power-ups and face 20 unique bosses solo or in local and online co-op. Chase Classic high scores or stack risk-reward mutations in roguelike Anomaly runs.

title: Neon One-Man Army
short_description: High-speed neon action! Swing with your grappling gun, blast rogue robots, and stay airborne. Shoot while flying, chain movement and combat, and feel the rush of unstoppable momentum. Choose powerful cards, unlock skill chests, and master your movement to become an unstoppable force.

title: Neostalker
short_description: NEOSTALKER is a tense turn-based first-person puzzle experience that combines grappling-hook movement, lethal machinery, and tactical planning in a series of dangerous spatial challenges on the way to the heart of a factory that has become a threat to everything around it.

title: Nerobreak: Cult Fall
short_description: A neo-noir adventure set in October 1983, as the influence of the criminal gang "Cipher" grows in the city. They are involved in the distribution of illegal substances and causing mass disappearances. A plot-driven retro action film with elements of quest, novella, cyberpunk, and neo-noir

title: Net Raiders
short_description: Net Raiders is a strategic roguelike deck-building game where you play by performing Card Merge.To survive the dangers of a crumbling virtual world, merge the cards in your hand and find the best moves to defeat the enemies you face!

title: Net Worthless
short_description: A satirical life-and-money sim. One turn is one month: budget your hours, work the job, ride the market, outlive inflation and your own decisions. Pick a character and make their dream come true. Or at least don't die trying.

title: Network & Cyber Security Simulator
short_description: Tired of boring network diagrams? Network & Cyber Security Simulator takes networking and cybersecurity into an interactive first-person (FPS) simulation game! Learn by doing, configure realistic CLI terminals from scratch, solve technical puzzles, and become the digital architect!

title: Neural Defense
short_description: Neural Defense is a sci-fi Tower Defense where you can sync with any of your towers and take manual control in third-person to defend your base against waves of corporate drones.

title: Neural Drift
short_description: Play as an emerging AI inside a motherboard grid. Buy, place, and combine programs to make money, build powerful synergies, and decide whether the AI becomes ethical or ruthless.

title: Neural Goblins
short_description: Explore a one-of-a-kind fantasy 3D brain world built with Gaussian Splatting—messy, noisy and lost in fog. Pick a goal, pilot a Brain Bubble Jellyfish through 11 mind caves, find five Neural Goblins, tackle bizarre minigames and build your own nest. What the hell are they up to?

title: Never Be Alone
short_description: Never Be Alone is an open-world zombie survival game for solo play and seamless co-op. Explore a world reclaimed by nature, protect a fragile safezone, and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past 10 years after the outbreak.

title: Never Wither
short_description: Experience unprecedented creature collection gameplay—Transform into almost any creature you see! Collect and raise fantastical creatures, and command them to farm, build, and craft. In this open world survival crafting game, Establish your settlement, become the last hope against the Corruption.

title: New Game+ - Game Store Simulator
short_description: Run the game store you never wanted to leave, from the late ’90s to today. Buy, sell and repair games, haggle over trade-ins, and hunt for rare finds. Customize your shop and fill your shelves with parodies that make you laugh, cringe, or remember the games you grew up with.

title: New Zombie Era
short_description: A visionary tyrant shattered civilization with an engineered airborne pathogen, ruling the ruins with an infected horde and elite mercenaries. As one of the rare "Immune" you must fight through the chaos, shatter his empire, and unleash the cure to reclaim our future.

title: Next Acre
short_description: A cozy farming card merge game where you grow crops, raise animals, complete orders, and build efficient production chains to expand your countryside farm.

title: Night Gig
short_description: The boss needs the product shipped before the deadline and hires people for the night shift at high pay. At your workstation you handle post reviews, file sorting and audio repair; meanwhile the office lights dim, devices cut out, and a ghost closes in on sound and sight. Finish the night's work — and avoid the anomalies.

title: Night Portable
short_description: Night Portable is a night-shift survival horror set in a used game store. Clean, restock, and hide from ■■■ until 6 AM. Play three retro handheld games and cash out for items—or risk losing them. Manage light, noise, and resources as a side-scrolling adventure uncovers the past behind the curse.

title: Nightclub Security
short_description: In this absurd first-person bouncer game, you have 10 seconds to decide who gets into the club. Check IDs, catch drunks and hidden contraband, confiscate forbidden items, then let them in - or slap, shove, grab, and throw them out.

title: Nightshift; Nowhere
short_description: Welcome to Nowhere Medical! The pay is terrible, the night shift may be your last, and workplace safety has officially gone off the rails; grab whatever weapons you can find and get the hell out!

title: Nine Thrones
short_description: A party-based fantasy RPG in a living world where NPCs pursue their own adventures. Fight tactical battles, explore, trade, raid, or rule. Speak to characters in your own words with optional offline AI dialogue, while kingdoms and rival adventurers follow their own ambitions.

title: Ninja Noboken Episode 2
short_description: A brutal 2.5D ninja action game built by a solo developer. Fast combat, precision platforming, and intense boss fights inspired by classic hardcore ninja games.

title: No Man's Mines
short_description: A survival crafting game set on a small round planet you can dig into anywhere. Start with sticks and stones, work your way up to copper, build a base and survive the raid nights. Play solo or with up to 3 friends.

title: No More Cards!
short_description: A roguelike built around poker hands, with no fiddly math: just get your hand smaller than your opponent's—or empty it completely. Villagers cheat by stuffing cards into your hand, but your animal cardsharps cheat too. Eat cards, paint new ones, and rig the table your way.

title: No Mortal Space
short_description: Rise from a mortal to a cosmic deity in this voxel-based, open-world survival craft game. Master the power of OverDeity to level forests and shatter mountains, traverse black holes with your physical body. The universe is your resource—conquer it.

title: No One Gets Through
short_description: The full game is out now! A free-placement tower defense game with roguelite card upgrades. Redirect enemies, choose one of three upgrade cards, and buy upgrades and supplies at the Battlefield Shop. Shape your build and hold the line with overlapping fire.

title: No Rest for Thieves
short_description: No Rest for Thieves is a first-person party game for four. Split the loot after midnight—or steal your friends’ share. Nod off, lose your cash! Use wild gadgets to stay awake and put rivals to sleep. The highest total coin value wins. Watch your eyelids—and your friends.

title: No Return Address
short_description: Night shift at a distribution center. Ordinary packages go forward, strange ones go to reject. Just don’t make a mistake when the boxes start containing things that should never be there.

title: No Scope CEO
short_description: No Scope CEO is an esports FPS team management game where you start from nothing with a single goal: become world number one. Recruit and coach your players, manage your budget and sponsors, live with the consequences of your choices, and watch your decisions come to life during matches.

title: No Such Person
short_description: 一款以清末民初的上海为时代背景的社会派推理游戏。你在一台历史悬案核查终端前接手这项任务：为墙中无名遗骸重建家族谱系。翻阅泛黄的婚书、讣告与老照片，看清旧秩序崩塌之际每个人的选择与挣扎。

title: No Survivors
short_description: Play the bad guy in a VHS anthology of horror and action. Hunt your targets, evolve your arsenal and tear through destructible worlds in an isometric bullet heaven. Each tape brings a different villain, setting and story, with more movie-inspired nightmares in development.

title: No Way Back
short_description: No Way Back is a turn-based strategy game with roguelike and deck-building elements. Survive on a limited battlefield by acting flexibly, and build your character between enemy attacks until you fall or defeat all enemies.

title: No Witnesses
short_description: No Witnesses is a 2-16 player party game. Play online or with your friends. Somebody in this lobby is a Killer. Nobody saw it happen. Killers hide in the crowd, Bystanders scramble to survive and a Detective works the forensics - while buffs and debuffs drag every round into chaos. Trust no one.

title: NoWay
short_description: You wake up in a dark underground labyrinth. Zombies roam, hunters wait. Stay silent, run, fight, or survive by acting like one of them. You’re not even sure there’s a way out.

title: Nobody's Erde
short_description: After the death of his parents, a seminarian returns to his ruined village. Between the disappearance of a priest and ancient secrets, Brendyk investigates local tragedies and discovers hidden forces at work beneath the devastation. There are horrors that should never have been unearthed.

title: NonSense
short_description: Defeat nightmare shadows and restore senses to help Fran navigate through pain and reconnect with everyday life in this cute-dark 2D narrative adventure RPG.

title: Nonogram Art
short_description: Classic & variant nonogram puzzles with a collectible twist: solve number puzzles, piece fragments together, and light up themed albums.

title: Nonogram Detective
short_description: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

title: Nooodles: Brutalism Edition
short_description: A laid-back idle network-building game. Lay connections, build nodes. Tokens flow through your network, constantly meeting and merging, generating revenue at ever-higher values — revenue builds more nodes, nodes pass more tokens, tokens... you get the idea.

title: Nordic
short_description: Nordic is a PS1-aesthetic "foddylike" cross-country skiing game that can be online or single player.  Nordic captures what makes cross-country skiing great; rhythm & cadence, the calm of nature and exploring the natural world with your friends! Race, ski and discover the beauty of winter.

title: Not My Base!
short_description: Build, defend, adapt… or just watch your base burn. Not My Base! is a Tower Defense game where you build up your defenses and fight through various levels. Strengthen your fortifications, choose your upgrades, and craft new strategies to withstand the chaos and havoc unleashed by angry armies.

title: Not a Duck
short_description: Night shift, Line 3. Squeeze, float, stamp and weigh every rubber duck that rolls down the belt, then ship it or shred it. Shelve the good ones in a dark warehouse where the lights only come on when you move. Some units are not ducks. Don't look away.

title: Notoris 2: Warlords
short_description: A dark meets high fantasy strategy RPG. Play as ruler, administrator, or officer. Wield influence to sway allies and rivals alike. Command vast armies in tense tactical turn-based battles. Inspired by the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

title: Nova Survivors
short_description: Blast through endless alien hordes in space and climb the Steam leaderboards. Pick from 21 ships, each with its own weapon and ultimate, stack cards and weapon evolutions, and push through a 100-level campaign or endless Survival until your build breaks the game.

title: Nowhere Rooms
short_description: An asymmetric multiplayer horror game where survivors must activate switches and escape the Backrooms while one player hunts them down as the Entity — disguising itself as a human to earn your trust.

title: Nozie Tower Defense XL
short_description: Defend against waves of invading balloons in this colorful tower defense adventure. Place and upgrade 8 unique towers, including fire, slow, explosive, and sniper types, across 20 challenging levels. Mix strategies, complete goals, and try to beat the developer’s high score!

title: Nozile
short_description: Nozile is a fast-paced hack-and-slash roguelike where you start with a fully realized build. Pick 2 styles, swap in real-time, absorb Stat Orbs directly from fallen enemies, and break the game in intense 5-minute runs.

title: Noël macabre
short_description: Noël macabre is a narrative-driven horror FPS that blends dark comedy with cosmic horror. Play as Georges, a police officer forced to return to work on Christmas Eve. Investigate a mysterious threat and save those who can still be saved. Will you see your duty through to the end?

title: Nuts Pipeline
short_description: Deliver nuts to the hamster at the goal! Switch converters on the pipes each turn to create the right combination. Clear 10 turns per level within a 3-minute limit. Starting easy for anyone, this endless puzzle grows harder with every level.

title: NyanDrop
short_description: NyanDrop is a physics puzzle: connect four or more blocks with the same pattern to clear them. Stack cleverly and aim for chain reactions. One more round with the cats!

title: OAN
short_description: A Vietnamese folk horror in pixel art. Return alone to the abandoned family house for your grandfather's death-anniversary vigil. Light three sticks of incense before dawn, and keep the oil lamp burning. Something folded from paper is already in the house, and it does not want the rite finished.

title: ODD ODDS
short_description: A single-player roguelike gambling game set entirely in one room. To clear a crushing debt, win coins at the claw machine, cash out at the ATM, and upgrade at the typewriter before the devil collects. Then the doorbell rings. Ally, or scammer? Who you deal with decides whether you get out.

title: ODDSTABLE
short_description: Read six-horse fields, lock fixed odds, and survive a twelve-race tour in a single-player offline horse-racing roguelite. Build tickets with virtual coins, take underground contracts, and turn charms into a payout engine. No real-money gambling or in-game purchases.

title: OFF SOUNDINGS
short_description: A trading and sailing RPG where you buy and sell in port, schedule your crew on the voyage, and aim your broadsides at sea. When the hulls collide, boarding becomes a card battle fought by the sailors you raised.

title: OKTORAID
short_description: Survive the AI robot uprising, solo or with a friend on one couch. Scavenge scrap, build a turret fortress, then auto-blast endless hordes in a roguelite siege, while the live power cable that ties you together fries every robot that crosses it.

title: OMEA
short_description: Your words shape the adventure. Omea is a revolutionary AI-powered narrative game where your personal Game Master responds to everything you write. No menus, no limits. Just type and forge your own legend across fantasy, sci-fi, mystery, and beyond.

title: ONE LAST BEAM
short_description: Aim your flashlight. Let your weapons fire. Survive escalating zombie hordes in this objective-driven survivor roguelite. Restore the power grid, evolve your arsenal, and reach dawn—but brighter light attracts more danger.

title: ONE STEP WAR
short_description: One Step War is a modern minimalist tactical board game. Different pieces have different effects, creating meaningful tactical choices. The game includes standard battles, campaign puzzles, and roguelite expeditions.

title: ORK
short_description: One day, a mighty quake shakes the land — Colors fade away, this wasn’t planned! “This is bad!” cry five odd friends in stride, They gather, rise, and run side by side. Use their skills, push through each stage, Reach the goal in a 2D side-scrolling rage!

title: ORU IN THE VOID
short_description: A story-driven atmospheric platformer about loneliness, memories, and the struggles we carry within ourselves. Guide Oru through a mysterious void and overcome precise challenges in a journey shaped by symbolism and hope.

title: Objecipher
short_description: A competitive team game of clever clues, questionable logic, and wildly different interpretations. Identify your team's objects before your opponents identify theirs.

title: Obolus
short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a party of three. Every hero has their own deck, their own hand and their own obols to spend, so each turn you choose not just what to play but who plays it. 22 heroes, 787 cards, six lands — and a path made of cards, where picking one burns the rest.

title: Observer's Mobius
short_description: Survive inside a sealed cube. Every action you take is observed by AI observers, and their judgment decides the next punishment or blessing.

title: Oda's Ordinary Lives
short_description: Live a thousand lives, make choices, and discover their consequences. From childhood to old age, every encounter, every decision, and every twist of fate will shape a unique life.

title: Odd Eggs
short_description: Build a bustling island with hundreds of hardworking cats in this cozy automation and management sim. Set up production chains, meet quirky residents, and enjoy fishing, flowers, and cooking. Play at your own pace, or visit friends and help their islands grow.

title: Odd Happenings at the White House
short_description: You are a reporter attending a White House press conference. After the meeting, you "accidentally" open the side door leading to the Oval Office, which is empty.

title: Odd Stories: Backyard Mountain
short_description: Dig into a mysterious mountain in your backyard. Mine valuable resources, sell your discoveries, upgrade your digging equipment, and venture deeper to uncover what lies beneath.

title: Of Dice and Minions
short_description: Roll five dice and chase poker hands to summon a minion army, then watch it fight. Hold, reroll, recruit, and counter your way down 100 floors in this roguelite auto battler.

title: Offside Deal: Football At Any Cost
short_description: The match is only half the job. Build a squad that fits the way you want to play, keep the dressing room together and make the right calls when matchday arrives. Egos, rivalries and loyalties can make or break your season.

title: Old Money – Build Your Dynasty
short_description: You're 18 with €2,500. Work your way up, trade stocks and crypto, buy property, build companies, run for office. Then your life ends, and your heir gets what the taxman leaves. One life is short. How long can your dynasty last?

title: On The Hook
short_description: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

title: On Time In Full
short_description: Manage dev teams. Hit deadlines. Deliver quality. OTIF is a kanban board simulation where every hire, every card, and every decision has a cost — and the client is watching.

title: Once Upon a Swagman
short_description: A relaxing survival experience where you journey from place to place, camping along a pixel art coastline as a traditional Australian swagman. You will face a realistic simulated coastal bush environment, follow in the footsteps of the old swaggies, and discover what lies at the end of your journey.

title: One Bard Move
short_description: One Bard Move is a comedic 3D precision platformer where every jump can become a disaster. Master increasingly demanding movement, survive absurd oversized obstacles, and endure a narrator who always has something to say about your failures.

title: One Last Draw
short_description: One Last Draw is a thrilling roguelike card game: HIT or STAND? Keep drawing to boost your score, earn money, and discover powerful Cards, Chips, and Items. But the more you draw, the greater the chance of hitting a Bomb Card and losing everything. Score enough to advance!

title: One More Claw
short_description: 3D physics claw machine + roguelike building. Land it in the chute; blast the target with base times multiplier.

title: One More Volley
short_description: Survive the horde, get greedy, and decide: extract with your gold or stay for one more volley. A dark-fantasy survivors-like where leaving rich is harder than dying — and the portal only opens one way.

title: One Second Hero
short_description: One Second Hero is a first-person puzzle game where one second is all the time you need. Observe the world in an instant, interact with objects, use the environment, and turn danger around—before that second is over.

title: One Week Left : Last Days at the Office
short_description: Only 5 days until you quit. Plan your daily schedule, chat with coworkers, and make choices as you prepare to resign. Will you hand over your duties perfectly, or slack off in the breakroom and cause chaos? Experience a hyper-realistic K-office drama shaped by your choices!

title: OneMore
short_description: Can you tell which definitions are fake and which aren't? OneMore combines traditional word-building games with rounds where you try to pick the one true definition out of four - three of them built by an AI.

title: Only Booze: Liquor Store Simulator
short_description: When an alcoholic opens a liquor store… what could go wrong? Run, manage, and grow your own liquor empire in a dynamic market where prices change daily, trends shift overnight, and your reputation lives or dies on social media. This isn’t just another shop simulator. Welcome to OnlyBooze.

title: Oops, All Tanks!
short_description: Build a tiny 2×2 RPG warband, draft and upgrade gear, forge powerful weapons — then watch your terrible ideas fight other players’ saved builds and somehow turn four questionable heroes into an unstoppable wall of tanks.

title: Oops, No Floor!
short_description: Bring your own floor in a chaotic co-op platformer for 1–4 players. Carry, throw and place floor panels, spring over gaps, dodge factory machinery and a claw-armed robot, and pull your friends out of trouble before the clock runs out.

title: Operation: Horumus
short_description: Combine eight modules into 120 defense builds in a deadpan political-satire tower defense. Clear a 10-stage story campaign, master a 100-stage maze, and stop every tanker crossing the Strait of Horumus.

title: Orb Rush VR
short_description: Hit incoming orbs with your virtual hands, dodge bombs, and chase high scores in active VR! Seven game modes, six fixed Rush challenges, and a fresh Daily Challenge put your reflexes, precision, and memory to the test.

title: Orbisphere
short_description: A cozy arcade idle game about one small astronaut alone in a forgotten corner of the cosmos. Slingshot around planets to gather stardust and spend it to keep your machines humming while you're away. Every idle hour is earned. Navigate an asteroid belt, slice feral space worms and find your way home.

title: Orbit Crisis
short_description: Master orbital navigation to protect Earth in this atmospheric space simulation, where careful timing, experimentation, and patience matter more than quick reactions.

title: OrderlyWorld
short_description: Build a supply chain. Roll an elemental army. Survive the waves. Choose a finite hero pool, produce resources for hero draws, and build deeper chains for rarer heroes. Adapt your formation to every roll and enemy threat.

title: Ore Legacy
short_description: A retro CRT-style incremental mining game set in deep space. Expand your station, automate extraction fleets, harvest stars, and pay down an impossible debt.

title: Oreship Stellar Frontier
short_description: Start as a manager, in the solar system, or on Mars. Build your business, pilot spaceships, and explore Mars on foot or in vehicles. Mine, trade, research, and furnish your home. Economic management and idle progression meet hands-on exploration.

title: Origins Trading Card Game
short_description: Outplay rivals in a fast PvP card game where both players move at once. Adapt your strategy and battle for three of 100+ rotating locations. Build decks with reimagined legends like Robin Hood and Mulan. Every competitive card is free. Rip packs for rare, limited-edition variants to trade on Steam.

title: Otherhold
short_description: Otherhold is a fantasy voxel sandbox action RPG. Explore, fight, gather resources, build your base, venture into dungeons, and prepare your defenses to survive invasions and increasingly dangerous threats.

title: Otherworld Shards
short_description: Otherworld Shards is a xianxia action RPG with floating-island building. Saved by the Core of Shards, you explore void isles, fight in real time, recruit unique Nayin disciples, build your sect and rebuild the broken immortal realm.

title: Outposters
short_description: OUTPOSTERS is a 1-4 player co-op zombie shooter with a rogue-lite core. Hold the line against escalating waves, then push into the dead city to scavenge weapons and upgrades before the next assault lands.

title: Overdue
short_description: Work the night shift at a haunted library, alone or with up to three friends. Help strange patrons, finish your duties, and survive what waits between the shelves. Earn your pay, follow the rules, and uncover the past Bellweather tried to bury.

title: Overrafted!
short_description: Over rafted! is a co-op multiplayer game for up to four players. Divide the work as you steer, fish, gather supplies, and make repairs. Brave the chaos of shifting winds, currents, and sea creatures, and sail your crumbling raft as far as you can across an endless, unknown ocean!

title: Overseas Wars
short_description: Overseas Wars is a fantasy real-time strategy game set in the era of galleons, pirates, and new world. At the head of a colony, gang, or tribe, you must develop your base and fight to destroy anything that threatens it.

title: P2W : The Party Show
short_description: "Forget skills—buy your way to victory!" <P2W: The Party Show> is a chaotic multiplayer party game where cash is king. Grab gold in hilarious minigames and shop for overpowered items to wreck your rivals. Ready to test your friendships? In this flashy show, the deepest pockets win it all!

title: PAGANS
short_description: A fast strategy card battler from Slavic myth. Commit gods, spirits and curses to locations that bend the rules, outguess your opponent, and win in minutes. Try the free demo now.

title: PARRYGON
short_description: Deflect energy orbs, land a perfect parry, and survive as the arena collapses around you. Take on 36 campaign missions, chase Steam high scores in endless Arcade, or challenge friends in local Versus for 2–4 players.

title: PAWN SHIFT
short_description: You're working the night shift at a pawn shop on an isolated road. Haggle with every customer who walks in, inspect what they bring you, and decide what goes on your shelf. Some of it should not be here. Nothing is supernatural, and that is the scariest part. A PSX-style horror shift.

title: PEEMAN
short_description: When aliens descend upon Earth, who will you be? Whatever you choose, the world will know you name—PEEMAN! Upgrade your hose, grow plants capable of fighting aliens, then sit back, crack open a bottle, and think long and hard about how to save the world.

title: PERIHELIA
short_description: One ring, one gap, and a wall closing in. You rotate a ship around the center and find the gap before the wall reaches you. Four modes, and in MUSIC every wall sits on a beat of the track. The longer you run clean, the higher the multiplier, and at x8 the whole plane tilts.

title: PHILSEQUE DIVISION
short_description: Pilot powerful combat ships in this 3D space action roguelite. Face ever-growing enemy hordes, collect experience, install modules, create devastating builds, and survive intense battles against minibosses and bosses across hostile regions of space.

title: PIGMENT LAB
short_description: Chase the world’s colors with paint, not sliders. Scoop red, yellow, blue, black and white by eye, stir them together, and see how close you land. The color difference becomes your score. 66 studies take you from the atelier to world flags and landscapes, plus a sudden-death Scoop Challenge.

title: PIYO PIYO CHICKEN
short_description: How far can you fling a chicken? Drag to launch, then use limited Egg Bursts to fight gravity and beat your distance record. Grab egg boosts, ride a bike through the sky, and turn every landing into a postcard—from a 50 m pool to a trip around the Earth.

title: PLANETOON
short_description: Grab planets, place them into orbit, and grow a galaxy in this space puzzle game. Watch life and civilizations emerge, encounter UFOs and black holes, and discover over 60 endings across 12 billion years of cosmic surprises.

title: PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED
short_description: Psychological horror at a morgue's night intake desk. Every body arrives with paperwork that has to match it. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature, listen to its chest. Some still have a pulse. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.

title: PLEASE STOP THE RAIN
short_description: A survivor-like with no timer. Wren, an orphan of the last dry circle in a world that has rained for 31 years, learns to write weather instead of swinging a sword. Walk out for a harder run, walk back to breathe, and decide whether the Rain should stop at all.

title: PLOW
short_description: Drive an armed snowplow through a possessed toy apocalypse. Shred enemy fire, crush corrupted Christmas toys, overheat outrageous weapons, and upgrade your machine across five escalating winter regions.

title: POOLSIDE MEMORY
short_description: A first-person chase horror set in endless liminal poolrooms. Scattered memories, multiple endings — and a world that rebuilds itself into a new nightmare every run.

title: PRIDEBLOOD -Born of Claws-
short_description: Real-world horse racing, swapped for monster battles in a fantasy world. Raise them, fight them, reach the top of 2,000 rivals. Calendar, classes and five-generation pedigrees stay as in racing, so little to learn. 576 battles a year, up to eight at once, all automatic. Upload one to the Workshop.

title: PRINCESS VANGUARD
short_description: Control five elemental princesses, unleash spectacular Special Skills, and battle massive enemy hordes in this fast-paced 15-minute 2D top-down action RPG. Upgrade your weapons, defeat powerful bosses, and save the world!

title: PRO: Push React Outgun
short_description: PRO: Push React Outgun, is a next-gen tactical FPS with realistic visuals. Experience the raw impact of close-quarters combat where every bullet counts. Master strategic positioning and razor-sharp reflexes to win. See the unseen, hear the unheard, and survive under pressure.

title: PROCEDURE ZERO
short_description: You uncovered a fraud, so they locked you up. Prisoners are quietly disappearing, and you're next. Sneak past the guards, trade cigarettes for information, fight when you have to, and take over the prison before they come for you.

title: PROJE ARAF
short_description: Step into the shoes of a detective trapped in a chilling psychological nightmare. Investigate dark corridors, examine cryptic clues, and crack intricate puzzles while an unseen tension hunts your every move. Can you uncover the truth before your sanity shatters?

title: PROTOCOL: NOAH
short_description: SINEN STUDIO presents PROTOCOL: NOAH, its first despair-filled fantasy. As a “Tuner,” command girls in battle and tend to their bodies and minds. A story-driven adventure set around Academy City Ark, where girls fight Phantoms. “Beyond the cycle of death lies hope—but for whom?”

title: PROTOCOL: Zero-day
short_description: Dive into a brutal isometric Action-Roguelite set in a cyber-apocalyptic world. Master fast-paced Hack'n'Slash combat during intense 5-to-8-minute incursions. Face infected hordes, optimize your build, and break the loop. Death is part of the protocol.

title: PSYCHOBYL
short_description: Survive the irradiated Zone. Raid hostile territories, loot rare gear, craft powerful equipment, and upgrade your bunker in this dark atmospheric idle RPG. Die, undergo Genesis, and return stronger. Turn-based combat, deep prestige layers, and endless progression. The Zone demands evolution.

title: PUCKVPUCK
short_description: Arcade sports with pucks: SOCCER, DODGEBALL, a top-down SHOOTER and co-op ZOMBIES in one game. Boost, slam and charge your shots, or grab a gun off a pad and chase a kill streak. Up to 8 players, online or all on one PC, or solo against bots. A minute to learn, and the skill ceiling keeps climbing.

title: PUSH MID
short_description: PUSH MID is a roguelite auto-battler where MOBA heroes fight on their own. Pick your team, send each hero to a lane, equip them with items, choose powerful perks, and watch your strategy play out as they push toward the enemy base.

title: Paceweaver
short_description: Backstab for double damage. Every enemy move is telegraphed in advance. Paceweaver is a turn-based deckbuilding roguelike fought on a single lane, where distance and facing decide everything. Slip between telegraphed attacks and get behind your foe.

title: Packfall Chain Arena
short_description: Connect four orbs of the same color to clear them, and your gear of that color fights in sync — a single-player auto battler where falling-block puzzle meets backpack building. Buy gear in the shop, arrange your backpack so the effects link together, and edge out your enemies in battle.

title: Pactum
short_description: Summon angels and demons, fuse them and watch them evolve on a floating island. A calm, relaxing incremental to unwind: upgrade without limits, watch your creatures grow, and enjoy the journey at your own pace.

title: Paint The World
short_description: A casual, first-person painting simulator with multiplayer, timelapse, and unlockable colors, tools and worlds!

title: Pample
short_description: Play as Pample, a tiny gardener, in a colorful 2D tower defense! Sow seeds that sprout into living defenses and hold back a horde of sweet-toothed monsters. Grow your garden and keep it sugar-free!

title: Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling
short_description: Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling is a 2D fishing sim rooted in real Taiwan-style logic. Explore diverse waters—from city rivers to wild lakes. Adapt your rod, float, line, and bait—every detail shapes your catch. Hand-painted art and immersive play invite you to find joy in nature and self.

title: Panda Gambler
short_description: In this post-apocalyptic survival challenge, your goal is to earn money on a slot machine to stay alive and rescue more refugees. Every winning streak lets you save one extra refugee. While scavenging for supplies, beware of the mutant zombies lurking in the city.

title: Panda vs Meow
short_description: Play a round little panda fighting off cat hordes in this top-down survival roguelite. Mix weapons and relics, unleash active skills, and buy traits between waves. Collect matching archetype traits to activate synergies that change how you fight.

title: Pandora's Lantern
short_description: A dark-fantasy 2D action-adventure platformer where you explore mysterious regions, overcome hazards, solve environmental puzzles, fight strange creatures, and use Pandora’s lantern to reveal paths through the darkness.

title: Parcel Panic
short_description: A VR arcade frenzy at the world's worst delivery hub. Sort fast, keep your combo alive, don't flip the fragile ones, and never leave your post. Just one more shift…

title: Party Tycoon: Takeover
short_description: Build a nightlife empire one event at a time. Book the night, stock the bars, open the doors and keep the guests happy. Start in a damp basement and work your way up to a dome on the moon.

title: Passage 5
short_description: Easy to learn, hard to put down: place tiles, match color or symbol, clear passages from the board. The casual classic is back — completely revamped, with four modes, over 400 levels, and for the first time for two players: together or in a duel – or solo against the computer.

title: Passed by Censor
short_description: The letters between two pen-pals who have never met cross your censor's desk behind a nameless front. Their romance exists only on paper, so a line you strike is gone from it for good. Partway through, a letter answers a question you only asked in your head. A melancholy epistolary romance.

title: PatchWorld
short_description: Patching is programming made physical: Build games, instruments, machines and interactive worlds by patching sound, visuals, logic and physics together in 3D. Grab blocks, connect them and see what happens instantly, alone or with others.

title: Path of Broken Builds
short_description: You don't control the hero. You control the skill tree. Grow an endless, procedural passive tree in real time while your hero fights the dungeon alone — every point you spend lands as a hit. Chain keystones and ultimates into a build broken enough to break the game itself.

title: Path of the Retired Adventurer
short_description: A semi-idle crafting sim inspired by Path of Exile, for when you still love the loot but not the grind. Forge gear, gamble on affix rolls, and equip the adventurers who quest and delve in your place. Craft their gear, seal their fate.

title: Path of the Yaoguai
short_description: Path of the Yaoguai is a Journey to the West-inspired roguelike that blends deckbuilding with RPG progression. Begin as an unknown little yaoguai, grow through countless adventures, reshape familiar legends, and rise to become the mighty King of All Yaoguai.

title: Path to Catakombs
short_description: Build and defend an armored train through ever-changing underground routes. Recruit gunners, alchemists, and mechanics, upgrade your wagons, choose your path, and survive relentless kobold raids and colossal bosses.

title: Path to Power
short_description: Path to Power is a political turn-based strategy game with visual novel elements. Choose your candidate, implement reforms, strike deals, manage resources, contain protests, and pave your way to the pinnacle of power in 1992 Kazakhstan.

title: Pathogen
short_description: The Specter has kidnapped the doctors who once experimented on it and ordered them to extract essence from pathogens. You are one of those doctors. To survive the Specter's deadly experiments, you must extract enough essence before it's too late. Will you make it out alive?

title: PawTop Cats
short_description: PawTop Cats is a cozy app with animated cats that live on top of your windows. Choose different skins, interact with your fluffy assistants, and add a little cute chaos to your desktop.

title: Pawcel: Bounce
short_description: In this country, dogs duel by shooting targets: calculate the angle, bounce the bullet off a wall, hit the impossible target, need to solve every problem with geometry. Along the way you travel with a cat who firmly believes she's a dog.

title: Pawns into the Dark
short_description: Everything is visible but the Dark. Reveal tiles beside your pawns, step by step, in an 8×8 board-game-inspired tactical puzzler. Uncertain exploration meets deterministic combat. No misses, no critical hits: 3 ATK defeats a pawn with 3 HP. Read what's visible, use limited resources, and survive.

title: Pay Your Space Debt
short_description: An incremental survivor-lite where you must earn your way out of debt by mining entire asteroid fields, upgrading your spaceship and surviving the debt collectors.

title: Pay or Die: Cartel Simulator
short_description: Run your illicit arms dealership in the lawless desert in PAY OR DIE: Cartel Simulator. Fulfill cartel weapon orders, customize firearms, defend your stash from rival raids, and bribe corrupt cops. In this business, you either pay your dues or pay with your life!

title: Pay the House
short_description: You owe The House, and the only trade you have is cigarette cards. Rip packs, complete sets, and cover a payment that doubles every third time. Pawn what you need, borrow from the shark, keep opening. A Prohibition-era pack-opening roguelike about a debt that grows every time you pay it off.

title: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han
short_description: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han is a Three Kingdoms–themed survivor action game. Lead the heroes of Liu Bei’s cause through armies of enemies, build powerful weapon and gear combinations, forge legendary arms, unleash Oath skills, and fight to restore the Han.

title: Peak Slayer
short_description: A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder on a grid. Climb an ever-changing tower floor by floor, where every attack is a card in your hand. Push enemies into pits, combine six elements with terrain, and build your run with relics and card fusion.

title: Pedal Pedal Pedal
short_description: A chaotic physics racer where two tiny riders share one oversized BMX. Each pumps, steers and brakes, and the bike only goes where you both agree. Race a friend on one keyboard or online, or ride solo and control both riders yourself.

title: Peeling Feeling: Sticker Galore
short_description: Peel stickers, earn cash, collect them all. A cozy incremental game about the most satisfying feeling in the world: lifting a sticker in one clean pull. 250 stickers, holographic pulls, upgrades, workers, and a prestige system where the numbers get delightfully out of hand.

title: Pegs & Sorcery
short_description: Aim your orbs. Power your party. Build your deck. In this pachinko roguelike deckbuilder, bounce through pegs to earn mana, then unleash cards in turn-based battles. Combine heroes, cards, and upgrades as you choose your path through each run.

title: Pegs of Hell
short_description: A physics roguelike where you build the pachinko board yourself. Place and upgrade pegs, arrange powerful Arcana, split balls, trigger elemental chains and create absurd scoring machines before Hell's rent catches up with you.

title: Pencil Pursuit
short_description: Outrun the eraser. A hand-drawn runner across 26 notebook pages: flee five stationery villains, topple the WAR MACHINE they bolt together, then turn the chase around in PENCIL REVENGE and claim the page in REDRAW.

title: Pending Review
short_description: Every applicant needs the money. Most of them are lying. Find it in the paperwork, stamp APPROVE or REJECT, call the next one in. The rules change every morning and nobody explains why. You are reviewing them. Somebody upstairs is reviewing you.

title: Penguin Fury
short_description: Penguin Fury is a chaotic roguelite auto-battler. Draft penguins, merge three into stronger forms, and arm them with increasingly ridiculous weapons. Stack powerful Jokers, chain kills from FRENZY to GODLIKE, and see how long your squad can survive.

title: Penguin Weapons
short_description: Penguin Weapons is a dynamic action roguelite about penguins that collect artifacts, creating absurdly crazy weapons, fight monsters and bosses, unlock stylish clothes, and explore increasingly difficult worlds full of unique combinations and unpredictability alone or with friends.

title: Per My Last Email
short_description: You are the new hire. The account you inherited is not new — it belonged to E. Vale, who is no longer with the company. Ten business days of email in which you choose what you say, then choose who sees it. The routing is permanent. Someone is still reading.

title: Perfect Route
short_description: Perfect Route is a billiards puzzle game centered on route planning. Plan the direction and path of each shot, make use of various special mechanisms, overcome carefully designed challenges, and find the Perfect Route through each level.

title: Perfectly Fair
short_description: A precision platformer where spikes, lava, Portals, and Switches turn every jump into a puzzle you can only blame yourself for missing. Build your own devious levels in the full in-game Level Builder, then publish them for the whole community to play.

title: PhDing in the UK
short_description: A pixel-art life sim about surviving a PhD in the UK. Manage your time, write your thesis, go fishing, fall in love, and push your luck at the casino. Turn cruel reviewers, looming deadlines, and your viva into turn-based card battles. Build a deck from your research and see how far you get.

title: Phantom Cardia: Astral Card Duel
short_description: Phantom Cardia: Astral Card Duel is a turn-based card RPG. Build 30-card decks from 168 cards, fuse duplicates into permanent Startraces, and cross an eight-chapter campaign. In co-op, you and an AI companion or friend command separate decks and boards, chaining turns against multi-phase Bosses.

title: Phantom: Hidden Sins
short_description: As an independent police consultant, you're pulled into the hunt for a serial killer leaving cryptographic ciphers. Play as a detective, analyze crime scenes, and master real decryption methods. Your choices determine if you catch the killer and how many lives are saved.

title: Pheles Rebirth
short_description: Pheles Rebirth is an RPG where you play as Pheles, a fallen angel who rebelled against God, and lead two knights into battle. Make their choices for them and turn the tide with over 250 skills and abilities in total, plus Unleashed Thoughts, powerful effects triggered by conditions in combat.

title: Phroller: Cross-Platform VTT
short_description: Touchscreen native, controller tested, battery efficient, cross-platform with tablets and mobile, offline enabled, 2.5/3D VTT, Dice Roller and RPG Companion!

title: Pichhal Peri
short_description: A haveli frozen since 1985. No one who enters ever leaves. Dare to face the darkness of an abandoned Indian heritage haveli — where Pichhal Peri hunts you through every shadow, every corridor, every room. "YOUR VOICE IS YOUR ONLY WEAPON"

title: Pick Squad
short_description: A strategy game blending deckbuilding, auto-battler, and roguelike elements. Recruit and upgrade units to build your squad. Draw random numbers to activate matching units’ skills on the board, earn points, and defeat the boss. Test your strategy and arrangement — with a little luck.

title: Pickie Grappy
short_description: A satisfying claw-machine arcade sim where every click counts. Time your grabs, chase rare prizes, and get rich by catching every satisfying item.

title: Pickup Point Simulator
short_description: Run your own parcel pickup point and manage the daily flow of deliveries. Scan incoming packages, organize them by number, verify customer identities, and provide fast, accurate service. Grow your business, improve efficiency, and become the neighborhood's most trusted pickup point.

title: PicoCat
short_description: This is a cozy, relaxing idle game that can float anywhere on your screen. A group of adorable stray cats live on this island. Care for them and give them forever homes, so you can enjoy heart‑warming cat‑petting moments amid your busy daily life.

title: Pig Up
short_description: Pig Up is a third-person 3D platform adventure game. Control the piglet to climb floating platforms, travel through fantastic worlds to find lost companions and uncover the truth hidden behind the temporal chaos.

title: Pigeonhole Principle
short_description: Meet a pigeon who dreams of flying to the Galápagos. That flight needs one thing — the legendary golden sunflower seed. But right now that pigeon has fallen into a stranger's storage room, and is in real trouble. Cook the things around you, wear them, and climb a little higher.

title: Pin A Million
short_description: Permanently fuse pegs into monstrous hybrids, let weather and moon phases rewrite your board, and hand your Twitch chat the keys to the chaos. Pin a Million is a pachinko roguelite with arcade neon glow — no run ever plays the same.

title: Pinball Hero
short_description: Pinball Hero is a turn-based roguelike RPG on an arcade cabinet. Everything is a marble — heroes, skills, talents, all marbles colliding with each other. Piece them together into your build.

title: Pinebrook Ski Resort
short_description: Run a ski resort as a real business. Shape trails on the mountain, string up lifts, and set prices against weather, snow and weekend crowds. Keep lifts running, skiers safe and the books in the black, from a gentle beginner hill to desert dunes and a volcano.

title: Pineview Drive 2 - Rising Storm
short_description: For years, Lisa has been haunted by dreams of a burning mansion. When she recognizes the place from a late-night television documentary, she decides to uncover the truth behind the nightmare in this story-driven first-person horror adventure.

title: Pinfinity - Incremental Pinball
short_description: Combine classic pinball physics with addictive incremental progression! Place bumpers, unlock massive skill trees, and watch your score skyrocket into the millions!

title: Pip sellfish
short_description: Catch fish by drawing circles around them, sell them in Pip's little beach shop, and reinvest everything. Fish, sell, upgrade, repeat. A cozy fishing incremental game.

title: Pirate Royalty
short_description: A free to play fantasy pirate MMORPG where you choose one of four classes, assign your own stats, learn skills, hunt rare loot, forge gems into gear and enter timed dungeons with other players. Every advantage is earned through play, with no power for sale.

title: Pirate Treasure: Tidy Up!
short_description: Attention, greenhorn! Prove you’re worthy of joining the crew by tidying up our chaotic treasure vault. Sort every piece of loot into its rightful place, upgrade your sluggish hands with hooks and peglegs, and discover hidden skills along the way!

title: Pit Purge
short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. In the pit, the creatures are the loot. Hunt them or capture them alive, then send them up to get paid.

title: PixaMixa: Desktop Sandbox
short_description: Decorate your desktop with any stickers. Literally any: want memes, want cats, want that GIF you downloaded from the internet at 3 AM. Yes, that one too! Customize sticker behavior, add useful stuff like notes, counters, and alarm clocks.

title: Pixel Metropolis
short_description: Guide Paris through 10,000 years of history in a cosy city builder where your people build their own homes. Lay roads, provide services, shape society, and watch a tiny prehistoric settlement grow into a bustling modern metropolis.

title: Pixel Motion Studio
short_description: Pixel Motion Studio is a complete pixel art and animation suite. Draw sprites, animate characters frame by frame or with rigs and keyframes, create effects and scenes, manage palettes, and take your work from first pixel to finished animation.

title: Pixel Nightshift: The Vesta Protocol
short_description: You are on the night shift at a desolate robot logistics facility. Prepare orders, pack them, and deliver them. The routine appears simple, yet every night something shifts a little more out of place. Ten nights. Two endings. Free demo: the first 3 nights.

title: Pixel Ping Pong
short_description: A relaxing idle incremental game where you break tiles, earn coins, and upgrade your growing swarm of balls. Aim your shots to speed up your progress, or sit back and let the game play itself.

title: Pixel Worker
short_description: Pixel Worker is a pixel-art work-life simulation where you take jobs, earn money, appraise gear, raise pets, mine, fish, cut jade, trade stocks, and play casino mini-games as you build your own path through a lively city.

title: PixelFall
short_description: A living pixel sandbox where every grain simulates - and every world hides its Keepers. Dig to the abyss, sail past the clouds, tame a horse, farm, brew, and build. Face seven sim-bosses you defeat by reshaping the world itself, and mend the heart of your world.

title: PixelHeroScramble Plus
short_description: Intercept the surging waves of pixels with a variety of units! Experience the ultimate fixed-route tower defense! Summon a wide variety of units to defend and conquer the battlefield. Where and when you deploy, upgrade or replace your units is up to you. Discover synergies and hone your strategy.

title: Pixelbound
short_description: A cozy idle game where every click creates art. Mine pixels, unlock powerful automation, and evolve your canvas from simple 4x4 blocks to stunning 256x256 masterpieces. No stress, no timers—just satisfying progress.

title: Pizzeria: The Pizza Restaurant Sim
short_description: Build your own pizzeria from scratch! Roll the dough, slice the toppings, cook your sauce in a pot, bake the pizza in the oven and serve your customers. Tweak your recipes, furnish your restaurant, manage your money and become the neighborhood's favorite pizzeria.

title: Plamo Kits
short_description: Plamo is Japanese for plastic model kits. Snip parts from the runner, snap them together, and finish them with paint, panel lining, edge highlights, decals, and weathering. Build 30+ original kits, from mechs and racers to spacecraft and jets, then pose them, set up dioramas, and fill your shelves.

title: PlanetOrbit
short_description: Turn a bare rock into a neon-lit casino planet. Win chips at poker, baccarat, blackjack, chinchiro, roulette and slots, then spend them on buildings and watch the dry ground turn green. Drawn by the lights, NPCs begin to visit. Grow the liveliest planet in the galaxy, your way.

title: PlankTap
short_description: There's a cartoon jellyfish living on your desktop. It floats above your windows, makes coins while you type, then trades underwater stocks and unlocks more skins. It won't interrupt your work. It's just there to be cute. That's it.

title: PlayCard Football
short_description: A football strategy card game where you are the coach and the cards are your plays. Level up your coach with perks, use your team's roster to pick the best play possible against your opponent. You manage your team, the recruits, their development from high school to college and the pros.

title: Pluck Em!
short_description: Fight off annoying feathered pests in this addictive arcade shooter inspired by the classics of the 8- and 16-bit era. Explore strange biomes, discover bizarre bird species, earn medals, upgrade your gear and uncover secrets that are probably better left undiscovered.

title: Plug: Build your Empire
short_description: Build a drug empire on a real-world map. Grow, cook and deal across actual streets, launder the cash through front businesses, smuggle product between real cities and stay ahead of the cops. From one corner to a transnational cartel.

title: Plum
short_description: Plum is a 3d cozy platforming and collectathon game where you will have to roll and bounce through the valley in search for home. On your way, meet different ghost plums each which a story to share. This game is a colorful stylized short adventure (about 1h) made to chill or speedrunning.

title: Plunder Bay
short_description: An online pirate board game for 2–6 players. Sail scattered islands, blast rivals with cannons and rockets, and STEAL their treasure when you sink them. Spin the helm, claim islands, and win wild minigames — first to 4 treasures wins. Grab your crew and plunder the bay!

title: Plunderfall
short_description: Betrayed and stranded on a raft, fight back in this open-seas pirate survivors-like roguelite. Plunder resources, upgrade your hideout, unlock ships and weapons, rescue your crew, defeat traitor captains, and claim their relics to conquer new waters.

title: Plura Ingenia: Patient 16
short_description: Face yourself, endure surreal trials, and survive an evaluation that adapts to how you think and behave. Your evaluation starts here. This is the first episode in a series of short psychological horror games where your fears and personality shape what awaits you.

title: Pocket Adventurer
short_description: Your desktop's tiniest hero. A cozy idle RPG that lives above your taskbar: heroes delve dungeons and haul loot home while you work, companions fill your camp, and every retired legend makes the next hero stronger.

title: Pocket Aquarium 方寸水族
short_description: Build your own cozy desktop aquarium. Collect dozens of charming fish, shrimp and snails, decorate with plants, rocks, lighting and substrate, and watch your little creatures swim, forage and grow. Unlock rare, dreamlike fish — or set them free to drift across your desktop.

title: Pocket Chef: Asia
short_description: Pocket Chef: Asia is a cozy, hand-drawn ramen shop game. Start at a little Japanese street cart, make every bowl with your own hands, crack riddle orders, count out the change and keep your quirky customers happy. In the full game, the journey continues across Asia.

title: Pocket Cultivation
short_description: Pocket Cultivation is a strategy cultivation game centered around “Storage Bag Building.” Journey through a vast world of cultivation, collect items that suit your path, and carefully arrange them within the limited slots of your storage bag.

title: Polemista
short_description: Polemista is a tactical action game with stealth elements, set in a cyberpunk Polish coastal city. You are K, an enhanced super-soldier from a defunct corporate program designed to protect Europe. Now abandoned and hunted, you must find a way to clear your name and regain your freedom.

title: Polish Pierogi
short_description: Run your own pierogi restaurant! Prepare delicious Polish dumplings step by step, serve hungry customers, upgrade your kitchen and master the art of keeping everyone fed, happy and coming back for more.

title: Pomo Valley
short_description: Pomo Valley is a cozy pixel farming game you can only tend on the breaks between focus rounds. Focus to grow your crops, then step out to till, plant, harvest, mine, chop, trade and build up your valley.

title: Portal Time Traveller
short_description: As Subject 247 of a mysterious laboratory, you are tasked with stepping through time portals to retrieve requested artifacts. Hunt dinosaurs, survive empire of Middle Ages, gather critical materials in streets and navigate a neon lit dystopia. Will you obey scientists or start your own rebellion?

title: Portentum
short_description: The cryptid deck-building auto battler. Hunt for broken combos with cryptids like Bigfoot, Jimothy, Nessie, and the Chupacabra. If somebody's uncle saw it in the woods in 1973, there's a good chance it's a card in Portentum.

title: Portrise Idle
short_description: Build a quiet fishing harbor in an atmospheric idle strategy game. Send your fleet to sea, sell the catch, expand warehouses and buildings, collect captain and ship cards, and sail from a peaceful bay toward dangerous depths.

title: Pot O' Gnomes
short_description: Pot o' Gnomes is a destruction-based pot-building roguelite, where you draw lines of falling gnomes to blow up plants, rocks, and everything in between. Craft your run from various biomes, choose from powerful items, and set off ridiculous explosion chains!

title: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
short_description: Brew potions, compete with fellow alchemists, and save the magical world from destruction in the digital adaptation of the beloved board game.

title: Potrero - Football life sim
short_description: You are a footballer, straight from the youth ranks until your last season. One decision at a time: when to shoot, when to pass, what to say to the press. A whole career decided by what you choose, and a little by your luck.

title: Potventure
short_description: Open a restaurant on a fantasy continent and build a culinary empire, one dish at a time. Explore, gather, cook, and expand — while six rival empires plot their own rise. Survive crises, seize opportunities, and carve your own path to victory.

title: Pre-Warp Age
short_description: A turn-based economic strategy game about settling space, from the first flight to the invention of the warp drive. Plan the development of your colonies, assign workers, research technologies and mine resources in randomly generated star systems.

title: Press Me Up
short_description: Press Me Up is a crazy hydraulic press simulator! Crush all kinds of objects, earn money, upgrade your equipment, and unlock even more powerful ways to flatten everything. Just don’t destroy the press!

title: Pretty Home Run Derby - Re: Return of KUSOGAKI
short_description: A high-tempo batting game with an overwhelmingly satisfying hit feel. Master the "Mystery Skills" that trigger all kinds of phenomena and take on powerful foes! Can you defeat the pitchers across all 20 stages?

title: Prevail
short_description: A turn-based tactics roguelike on a hex board. Command a group of miniatures, outmaneuver enemies, and spend your gold between fights on weapons, gear and potions. Lose your party and the run is over. Every run is completely different than the last.

title: Price War
short_description: Price War is a low-poly retail management game. Build your stores, arrange shelves to boost sales, hire and manage your staff, then grow your empire district by district across an entire city waiting to be conquered.

title: Primal Heir: The Mortal Realm
short_description: A story-driven retro JRPG where you build a party, explore a fantasy world, fight in classic turn-based battles, complete side quests, craft equipment, and uncover the legacy of the Primal Heir in a handcrafted pixel-art adventure.

title: Primal One
short_description: Primal one is a first-person dinosaur survival horror set in an installation in the cretaceous period. Hide and evade dinosaurs that are hunting you, while you try to find a way to go back to the present alive or contact survivors in other installation.

title: Prison Chain: The Unredeemed Thought
short_description: A text-driven psychological horror visual novel. You wake up in a strange living room. Two silent men stand beside you. On the wall, blood writes: “Confess your sins, and you shall be redeemed.” Every choice changes the ending. Over 80,000 words in the base game, plus 4 standalone character DLCs.

title: Pro Football Referee
short_description: Pro Football Referee is a football referee simulation game.Start as an unknown grassroots referee and experience the full career of a football official. Officiate matches, make crucial calls, build reputation, and climb the ranks.

title: Procession Engine
short_description: Not another turn-based deckbuilder. A real-time tug of war where you command a whole army: your buildings spawn it, your cards shape it, and two lanes decide whose stronghold falls first.

title: Programmable Theft Action VI
short_description: Code the perfect crime — even with Vibe Coding.

title: Project Burnout
short_description: A turn-based management strategy game about leading a traveling fixer crew hired to rescue game studios in crisis. Plan the week, split dependent tasks across five disciplines, beat deadlines, and protect your crew from burnout.

title: Project Legend
short_description: Play one footballer's career, from the under-15s to the farewell match. Earn your coach's trust, make the call in key moments of the live match and negotiate every contract. 686 clubs in 30 countries, around 21,000 players who age and move.

title: Project Poker
short_description: Project Poker is a single-player poker experience with smart opponents, memorable personalities, and tons of quality-of-life features.
