Build your bankroll in Career Mode, master four poker variants, and play your way with game speeds, fast-forward, quick betting, full controller support, and more.

title: Project September
short_description: Mars is overrun and you're the cleanup crew. A comic book twin stick rogue lite, mow down thousands, stack game breaking perks, roll the enemy's dice, and detonate everything on the map. Die, bank your gold, build a nastier deck, drop again.

title: Project Spooky
short_description: The developer of this game disappeared before finishing it. Explore the reconstruction of his final project: a first-person psychological horror experience with puzzles and hidden secrets that will make you question everything that happened at Casa da Fonte.

title: Project TITAN
short_description: You start with a tiny mech factory, a pile of scrap, and one goal: make money. Manufacture parts, assemble mechs, and take on questionable contracts for clients who don't ask about ethics, just excellent margins. Grow your factory, upgrade your tech tree, and build the ultimate mech: TITAN.

title: Project YH
short_description: A story-driven rhythm game where you follow the beat on a rotating clock to restore fractured time and emotion.

title: Project: C.E.L.L.
short_description: An arcade incremental where you break glucose, trigger explosive chain reactions, and turn ATP into powerful upgrades. Experiment with different builds, discover powerful combinations, and push a retro-futuristic cell simulation to its limits.

title: PropAlive
short_description: PropAlive is a tense 1v4 asymmetrical PROPHUNT game where one player becomes an ancient demon, while the others are survivors who can disguise themselves as objects and use unique abilities. Hide. Trick. Survive. Or Hunt.

title: Protocell
short_description: Mutation is evolution. A lab cell broke containment — pilot it through swarming arenas where every upgrade you take drags you closer to meltdown. Grow billions of one-of-a-kind protocells, hand any of them to a friend with a 16-character code, and dive into the Primordial Abyss.

title: Protocol: Assimilation
short_description: Awaken your inner speedrunner in this challenging 2D platformer. Strategically combine routes, abilities, and artifacts, choose which obstacles to destroy, and execute every action with precision to maximize your wealth and endure until the end. Die, repeat, and evolve in pursuit of the perfect run.

title: Prowlers Shift
short_description: The Prowlers Shift Archive Museum needs a watchman. Badly. See every room at once, catch the day's absurd ban, rummage through checked bags and sell bootleg tickets, all while keeping your Standing up. Tobacco, leeks, pipes: nobody explains why.

title: Punctual Monsters
short_description: A cute puzzle game about sleepy monsters and their alarm clocks. Every monster wakes up on its own number. Place your monsters and get everyone up on time.

title: Punk Vampires
short_description: A 2D narrative adventure with combat, exploration, choices, skill-based minigames, and an emotional story spanning different eras.

title: Purrfect Beats
short_description: A cat, synthwave music, and a single button to test your sense of rhythm. How hard could it be?

title: Purrfect Bliss
short_description: Purrfect Bliss is a cat cafe built on a dark history. Will you survive the night shift? Serve customers, take care of the cats, and uncover the terrifying truth in this psychological horror game.

title: Purrtopia
short_description: A cozy pixel cat companion for your desktop: it lives on top of your windows while you work or study. Feed it, play with it, dress it up, and watch its character emerge: it remembers your care, sulks if woken, and hunts its toys.

title: Puzzlogue
short_description: A roguelike match-3 puzzle game where you continuously swap gems to build combos and use relic effects to boost your score. Create a different build each run and clear each stage.

title: Quarter Mile
short_description: A quarter mile, two buttons, and a tenth of a second. Stage on the tree, launch clean, shift in the green — then spend the winnings making the car faster. Six classes, twenty-three cars, ten strips. No online, no in-game store, nothing asking for your attention tomorrow.

title: Quarterheart
short_description: A cozy arcade roguelite. An old coin-op machine you find in the attic, and it still works. Aim true and time your hits in 2–4 minute runs. Every new monster you beat prints a sticker — where you stick it on the cabinet decides what it upgrades or unlocks. Insert coin to play?

title: Querni
short_description: Querni is an elegant abstract strategy game. Move your numbered tiles, connect consecutive chains, and be the first to remove all your pieces. Play solo against the AI, locally for 2 players, or online via Steam Remote Play Together.

title: Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale
short_description: ✦Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale is a choice-driven visual novel. The story mainly follows a Slavic white mouse named "Ivan Viktorovich Belyaev" and its VR memory recordings in the United States.

title: RAT LUCK
short_description: Compete in precision timing rounds, choose which rat has to risk a hand, and survive a table full of dangerous cheese. Rat Luck is a chaotic 2–4 player online party game with proximity voice chat, bluffing, taunting, and terrible luck.

title: RE:CHAINED ~Links of Redemption~
short_description: Bill climbed the Abyss Tower for cash. Freeing minds in red chains became a rescue he never meant. A comic SRPG of grid tactics and decks. Eight companions seek resurrection. What will they choose?

title: REOGUNA
short_description: Organize fragmented files and aim to clear the level in as few moves as possible. "REOGUNA" is a minimalist optimization puzzle game inspired by the classic disk defragmentation process.

title: RESET ARENA
short_description: Reset Arena is a fast, text-rendered 1v1 duel game. Attack, block and dash on independent cooldowns, toggle between skill shots like homing darts and ensnaring hooks and outread your opponent across 20+ arenas full of shifting hazards and dynamic environments.

title: RIFTFALL
short_description: HELL DIDN'T CLOSE. IT EVOLVED. A fast, brutal retro indie FPS raised on the 90s classics: a 20-level campaign, 6 heavy weapons with alt-fires, 60+ enemy types, unique boss arenas, AI squadmates, permanent upgrades, skull keys, secrets and an epic soundtrack.

title: ROBOT DRAFT: LAST HUMAN
short_description: A first-person sci-fi escape adventure. Freeze robots, ignite fuel, and throw objects at enemies while solving escape-room puzzles. In the full game, build and playtest your own rooms, then share them as level files.

title: ROOTKIT://死 (ROOTKIT PROTOCOL DEATH)
short_description: Cyberpunk extraction runner with bhop movement. Speed determines whether enemies can hit you. Race your own ghost through gauntlet levels, slide under barriers, chain crouch-bhops on ramps, and extract before the system catches up.

title: RV Life Sim
short_description: Chase the horizon and make a living along the way. Camp under open skies, craft and trade goods with nearby towns, and keep your RV rolling on long-distance journeys through a vast wilderness. Build your ultimate home on wheels today!

title: RabbitDice
short_description: Build a rabbit civilization from a single campfire. Give rabbits jobs, discover unexpected card combinations, and set the whole camp in motion with one roll of the dice. Help them build a spaceship and return to the Moon!

title: Rabbits Hunt 2
short_description: Rabbits Hunt 2 is a point-and-click exploration horror game set in an old Japanese house. With your partner Roppy, investigate a home tied to a family tragedy and follow strange traces toward the truth. No combat, only observation, unease, and quiet J-horror.

title: Racketeering
short_description: Start with nothing and build your criminal empire by hand, alone or with friends. Grow, process, package, and sell product as you expand from small-time dealing into a serious operation.

title: Radical Tower Defense
short_description: In Radical Tower Defense, harness shifting core chips to forge a unique steel defense. Each choice reshapes your combat style. Unlock architectures, explore chip synergies, ignite tactical reactions. Don’t just defend—become a blade to break formations, strike the heartland, crush the enemy lair!

title: Rafting Factory
short_description: Gather resources, research technologies, expand platforms, and build conveyor belt networks to survive and thrive in a perilous maritime world. Utilize automated production lines to free up manual labor, keep the factory running continuously, and ultimately build a starship to travel to Mars.

title: Ragnarok Roads
short_description: Lead a convoy across post-nuclear Scandinavia in 1986. Scavenge irradiated ruins, recruit survivors, and fight tactical vehicle battles on frozen roads. A moddable roguelike where every run writes a different story across a real map of Sweden.

title: Ragtag Fleet
short_description: Ragtag Fleet is a fast-paced pixel-destruction survival roguelite. Tear apart enemy ships, expose their Cores, and turn the spoils into weapons, drones, and modules. Build a makeshift fleet into overwhelming firepower.

title: Raid Leader Simulator
short_description: Lead a fantasy raid guild in this management auto battler. Recruit raiders, build lineups, and plan a response to every boss mechanic, then watch your team fight it out automatically while you handle contracts, morale, and loot.

title: Rail Capital
short_description: Run a railway company in real time, laying track and finding profitable routes for passengers and freight. Buy shares in other companies, invest in factories and try to keep control of your own railway as AI rivals or other players buy into it.

title: Railhold
short_description: Build an armored train and defend it against relentless mutant hordes. Mount turrets, recruit crew and make every stop count in a top-down roguelite tower defense where your base never stops moving.

title: Railminer
short_description: Turn a tiny drill into a massive mining machine. Extract resources, sell your haul, and expand your train with cutters, lasers, rockets, and drones. Every run pays for your next upgrade in this incremental mining game.

title: Rainbow Tower Defense
short_description: Your towers don't fire a single shot. You block the horde with the lines between them. Deploy the right towers and mix diverse line synergies to craft your winning strategy. Classic tower defense, completely reinvented. Test your tactical limits against escalating waves.

title: Raise, Rise & Die
short_description: A dark fantasy deckbuilder where your cards are your life. Sacrifice souls, survive the Arena, or duel another player. Create and share challenges with Ancients’ Path. Buy once, unlock content by playing. No microtransactions.

title: Rally Point: 3030
short_description: A real-time strategy roguelite where your army fights on its own. Deploy heroes, mechs and support down the lanes, take the control points and break the enemy base. Between missions, enemy factions reinforce, counterattack and fight over territory. Campaign solo or co-op.

title: Ram Fights
short_description: Get ready to headbutt your way to glory in this hilarious physics-based brawler! Customize your ultimate animal gladiator, master the art of the perfect charge, and send your rivals flying with epic ragdoll physics.

title: Ramen://protocol
short_description: 🍜🃏 Ramen://protocol is a cyberpunk ramen-stall roguelite deckbuilder. Push your toppings to their limits, then rev them up even further with skills. Master countless synergies and serve bowls so good they're synapse-frying. Chase the one bowl that will cut you free from your past.

title: Rank Risk: Guess the Order
short_description: Rank six answer cards in the correct order, choose how much RP to risk, and use limited attempts to solve each puzzle. Build streaks, chase bigger payouts, and climb the leaderboards in this fast-paced trivia ranking game.

title: Rap Or Die
short_description: Nobody knows your name. Your studio is small. Your ambition isn't. Create beats, write lyrics, record tracks, start beefs, and build your underground rap empire from the ground up.

title: RatSpire
short_description: RatSpire is a top-down survivor roguelite focused on minion progression and auto-battling, choosing your own path. Recruit quirky classes, stack weapons, potions, and relics to craft absurd builds, and the higher you climb, the better it feels. Hands off — let your legion fight for you.

title: Rats Survivors
short_description: Survive endless hordes of rats in a fast-paced survivors-like game, upgrade your abilities, and fight to stay alive as the chaos intensifies.

title: Re+pray Signals: Echoes Still Wait
short_description: You are the only one connected to a child trapped in a closed-off world. Speaking becomes the key; listening becomes hope. A conversational adventure where the words you exchange help unravel its mysteries. #RepraySignals

title: Re2 I Rise Alone
short_description: Interactive movie‑game blending SLG gameplay and real‑life romance simulation: Step into the shoes of an underdog and live out a power‑fantasy rags‑to‑riches story. Combat, character progression, drinking and romance — all in one! 100‑GB content volume- redefines your power‑fantasy experience!

title: Re:Draw
short_description: One day the Erasure happened. The world didn't die - it was simply erased. You're one of the few left holding a pencil. Restore the erased world from scratch: sketch, bring ecosystems to life, and watch as the settlers you drew build a civilization.

title: Re:collect
short_description: In a postwar world where even memories can be used as collateral, you become the owner of a small pawnshop. Speak with customers, judge the value of their memories and belongings, and over 30 days of running the shop, uncover forgotten truths and the story of the protagonist.

title: ReDead Frontline
short_description: ReDead Frontline is a post-apocalyptic idle defense game where the zombie outbreak has already won. Trapped in a time loop, you hold the line, recruit survivors, upgrade weapons, deploy drones, study enemies, and reset after each defeat to return stronger and break the cycle.

title: Real Zombie Survivors
short_description: Real Zombie Survivors is a co-op top-down arena shooter where you fight relentless hordes of zombies on real-world maps generated from OpenStreetMap data. Choose unique classes, upgrade your arsenal, call in combat robots, and survive the apocalypse solo or with friends on Steam!

title: Realm Tycoons
short_description: Realm Tycoons is a turn-based fantasy strategy board game where rival rulers claim realms, build economies, grow armies, cast spells, upgrade strongholds, and battle in real-time 3D fights for control of the kingdom.

title: Realm of Advent
short_description: If you love building unique decks, triggering insane combos with simple controls, and watching numbers skyrocket—you'll love Realm of Advent. In a world ruled by Apostles, craft your build from 300+ cards and relics to ignite addictively wild chain reactions.

title: Reaper GoStop
short_description: You are dead. At the gates of the afterlife, judgment is settled over a game of Hwatu. Real Korean flower cards and authentic Go-Stop rules meet runaway score-multiplier deckbuilding. The hand you draw is the life you lived. Outplay the Reaper to pass, or fall to hell and face the gate again.

title: Rebels of the Realm
short_description: Grab your friends, pick your class, and raid dungeons in this lighthearted co-op fantasy RPG, where chaotic spells and hilariously bad ragdoll deaths keep the realm unpredictable.

title: Rebirth: Denied Protocol
short_description: Trapped inside a failed resurrection experiment, a cop must survive grotesque creatures and uncover the truth behind a mad doctor’s obsession in this PS1-style survival horror with fixed cameras and tank controls.

title: Reclaim: Earth Protocol
short_description: A squad-based auto-battler where your strategy drives a living battlefield. Deploy units, trigger devastating combos, and reclaim Earth from an alien invasion.

title: RecycleShopECO
short_description: 3-Match Puzzle × Human Observation × Horror Novel Recycle Shop ECO is a binary art style 3-match puzzle and horror novel game. Fulfill customers' requests, gather information about them, and explore a hidden world of horror.

title: Red Epic: War of Resistance
short_description: This is a TD & light RTS set in the Anti-Mop-up Campaigns of Central Hebei. Master village defense, ambushes, and raids on the North China Plain. Outsmart strong foes through terrain and strategy, forging an unbroken steel wall with the blood and valor of unsung heroes!

title: Red Glare The Reckoning
short_description: 1946. The Reich has fallen. The hunt begins. Track escaped Nazi officers across 7 missions. New commando Fritz the dog, two new enemy types, Roguelike Mode, Fog of War Mode and enhanced weather. Standalone — no base game required. Justice has no borders.

title: Red Soil
short_description: Survive the heat and the undead in this isometric horror game set in the Australian outback. Manage stamina, hydration, hunger, and fatigue while exploring random maps, leveling up, crafting gear, and to fight in the heat of the day or the darkness of night.

title: Red Timewarp: Beyond Reality
short_description: Blast through enemy hordes, grab powerful upgrades, and become stronger with every run in a challenging Bullet Heaven roguelite. Choose one of 4 red panda heroes with unique abilities, build them your way, and battle through time solo or with friends in online co-op.

title: Redline Horde
short_description: Redline Horde is a high-octane vehicular action roguelike. Drive, drift, and survive against relentless swarms of enemy cars. Upgrade your weapons, collect XP gems, and build the ultimate combat machine in this intense bullet heaven on wheels. Can you outrun the horde?

title: Redline Protocol
short_description: Redline Protocol is a fast modern-retro helicopter combat game built around low-altitude attacks, tactical objectives, wrap-around battlefields, and escalating chaos.

title: Refund Speedrun
short_description: You're a support agent at DrumWorks, approving or denying game refund requests by a 16-rule policy. Hit quota. Pay the water bill. Feed grandma's fish. Then the terminal starts showing you things it shouldn't — and you find out what else she left you.

title: Reincarnation Squad
short_description: An "Infinite Genre" style game. Enter diverse worlds—featuring zombies, fantasy, martial arts, and more—either solo or with friends, then return to the "Main God" hub. Experiment with every imaginable ability.

title: Remedy for Personality
short_description: Remedy for Personality is a visual novel — a mystical thriller wrapped in absurd comedy, where an atmosphere of mystery and hidden threats is mixed with a generous dose of peculiar humor.

title: Remnant Afterglow Tower Defense
short_description: This is a creative and challenging real-time strategy tower defense game where players need to constantly expand, build complex battle lines on the map, and fight against groups of enemies. The game has unique rules and beautiful pixel style, with each level filled with tense and exciting battles.

title: Renegades
short_description: Renegades is a party RPG with deckbuilding combat: lead five heroes, each with unique mechanics and their own deck, choose three for each fight, and survive a kingdom coming apart through tactical, story-driven battles. Deep character development in multiple tracks leads to high customization.

title: Requies
short_description: Run a tiny guest house in a gnome forest. By day, check papers and catch changelings at the window. But when the sun goes down, the forest wakes up — and your little candle is all that stands between your guests and the dark.

title: Resettle
short_description: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.

title: Resort Architect
short_description: Build and manage your dream resort from the ground up! Design beautiful guest rooms, welcome visitors, prepare delicious meals, and grow a small hotel into a thriving vacation paradise!

title: Retro Chaos: Together Tidy Up
short_description: A chaotic co-op organizing sim in a retro electronics store. Team up with up to 3 friends to sort thousands of CRTs, consoles and gadgets — throw, catch, stack and stock your way from total mess to the perfect shelf.

title: Retro Mix 8: Arcade Collection
short_description: Remember the little games that filled whole afternoons? Retro Mix 8 brings eight familiar games together in one single-player arcade collection, from tank defense and fish-eat-fish to tile linking and brick breaking. Come back for one more round!

title: Retro TV Tycoon
short_description: Take control of a 90s television station in Retro TV Tycoon! Acquire rights to hit sitcoms and cult movies, schedule 24/7 broadcast grids, sign lucrative sponsor contracts, upgrade your newsroom, and expand your antenna transmission network to dominate the airwaves.

title: Retroventory
short_description: Run a second-hand retro game shop. Haggle over every deal, appraise consoles and games, spot counterfeits, and sell to the right customer at the right price. Manage it all from your shop PC: market trends, loans, bills, staff and shady hackers. Earn, upgrade, and build your retro empire.

title: Return to Planet Zoveka
short_description: A physics-driven 2D incremental space-mining sim. Help a family herd cosmic dust, automate production, unlock research, and turn a single inherited station into a vast operation. Enjoy a relaxing, colourful journey to heal Zoveka.

title: Return to the Jianghu
short_description: A wuxia life-sim card game.You die, and the jianghu remembers you. Reborn — this life, are you a noble scion, or an orphan beggar? Learn, roam, make enemies, find love — every choice rewrites your fate. Reincarnate, carry your past-life grudges back into the jianghu, and live again!

title: Revenant Survivors
short_description: Revenant Survivors is a horde survival action roguelite set in a Diablo-inspired dark fantasy world. Tear through endless hordes with hard-hitting combat, absorb souls, steal bosses’ skills, and even take their bodies to become evil incarnate.

title: Revenggie
short_description: The harvest is over. Now it's time for revenge. Fight as powerful vegetables in a fast-paced Bullet Heaven Roguelite. Craft your build, cultivate permanent upgrades with every run, master intense Quick Time Events and prove that skill matters just as much as power.

title: Reveria: Act 1
short_description: Welcome, adventurer! Reveria is a turn-based old school fantasy RPG. Lead a party of up to four aspiring adventurers into the Reverian wilderness. Explore dark dungeons and defeat dangerous foes to complete quests and find treasure. Level up your characters to unlock new abilities. Grow your legend.

title: Rhythm Roll
short_description: Roll through a world of rhythm and light in Rhythm Roll! Control a fast-moving ball through stunning levels, each with its own unique visual style and musical genre. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes. Simple to play, but can you master the speed?

title: Rich PaPa
short_description: Rich PaPa - Short Description Rich PaPa is a third-person action shooter where you literally shoot money. Blast through hordes of zombies, bank ricochet shots off the environment, and spin the roulette for risky upgrades while balancing survival against the cash you have left.

title: Ricochet Witch
short_description: You don't aim freely. The reticle swings on its own, and only one bolt can be in play. Wait for the angle, fire, and turn a single ricochet into a chain of kills. A one-button score-attack shooter: Normal runs take about five to seven minutes, Endless never stops.

title: Rideshare "Stimulator"
short_description: Build your rideshare business while navigating real-world traffic, managing your vehicle, and transporting a wide range of unique passengers. Master the streets, keep your car in shape, and deliver every ride, no matter how strange it gets.

title: Ridiculous Space Battles
short_description: RIDICULOUS SPACE BATTLES is the spiritual successor to the first ever autobattler game: Gratuitous Space Battles! After a fifteen year wait, the ridiculously over-the-top and completely unjustified battles in space ARE BACK.

title: Rift Raiders
short_description: Tear open the rifts, raid them for everything, and haul your spoils home to rebuild. Grid combat, push-your-luck runs, and a kingdom that grows stronger every time you fall.

title: RiftBlade: WarCards
short_description: A fantasy card-based tower defense game that blends deckbuilding, base defense, and tactical combat. Build your deck, set heroes, set deadly traps, and cast powerful spells to repel endless waves of enemies pouring from portals. Plan your moves carefully and protect the core crystal at all costs!

title: Riftweaver's Deck
short_description: Riftweaver's Deck is a card roguelite deckbuilding autobattler. Recruit heroes, better your equipment and skills. Travel through the rift portals to encounter powerful foes and friends. Be Victorious on your quest, and Vanquish the Dark Riftweaver and his morphlings!

title: Riggin Farm: Raw Land to Riches
short_description: A long-form farming and business management RPG where you transform raw land into a thriving farm. Grow crops, raise livestock, sell at markets, hire employees, expand your operation, manage finances, and survive the unpredictable realities of farming.

title: Rind Town
short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every customer’s order is a puzzle. Build the right juice from up to five ingredient cards, blend it, and chase scores that grow until they stop fitting on screen. Become the juice master of an anime town.

title: RingOut
short_description: A 3D arena shooter inspired by Super Smash Bros.: no health bars. Every shot heats enemies up, raising their temperature in degrees (°). The hotter they are, the farther they fly: launch them off the arena to win. 23 fighters, 13 weapons, 29 arenas, 6 modes. Solo vs bots or online.

title: Ripple Lane 101 : Moments With You
short_description: Share quiet campus dorm life with Yiling in an idle companion game. Focus with a Pomodoro timer, track plans and ideas, relax to Lofi and white noise, and choose outfits and decor. Explore her future world through stories fully voiced in Chinese, and uncover secrets about yourself.

title: Rise From Ashes
short_description: A tactical survivors-like where your build, not your luck, decides the run: merge Scrolls, bind Sigils, and complete synergies as you climb the Spire. Every run will be a volume of a comic, which your adventure draws each page.

title: Rise of the Merchants
short_description: Rise of the Merchants is a medieval city-building, economic, political, and trade simulation set in a persistent online world. Start with a small settlement in your county, develop it into an influential city, and establish a trade network that extends far beyond its borders.

title: Rivendale
short_description: Start a new life in the cozy town of Rivendale and build your own culinary business. Grow ingredients, explore the world, create unique dishes, and develop relationships with the town's residents.

title: River Runners: Downstream
short_description: River Runners is a single player auto-scroller adventure game developed for PC. The player plays against the rapid currents of the river while controlling a log and a merry band of animals, attempting to avoid the various obstacles that appear along the way.

title: Road to FIRE
short_description: Survive a series of mysterious games and claim a fortune. Analyze the rules of seemingly unwinnable games, uncover hidden winning strategies, and overcome every challenge in this high-difficulty death game–style puzzle game.

title: RoadHouse Manager
short_description: A rowdy roadhouse roguelite! Serve thirsty strangers, flair-bartend cocktails for big mult bonus combos, and throw down when trouble erupts. Every goon you shirk or smash can be molded by a reactive villain into your ARCH-NEMESIS. Chase love, rare booze, secrets, decor, and upgrades to survive!

title: Robin
short_description: Chill tile-placement roguelike deckbuilder. Lay forests, fields and villages on a small island, then set it all off and watch every tile fire its neighbours. Find the hidden rules, discover 30 secret tiles, and use them to build the perfect combo.

title: Robokitties: MEGASTRUCTURE
short_description: Explore a dying megastructure with your friends as tiny robokitties. Scavenge dangerous loot, survive evil machines, and get back to the lift before the power runs out.

title: Robot Vacuum Simulator
short_description: Take the controls of a tiny robot vacuum in a first-person cleaning sim. Cut clean paths through grime, steer around furniture, grab and sort clutter, scrub dishes, chase fresh pawprints, and put new tools to work on bigger jobs.

title: Rock Flipper
short_description: Rock Flipper is a short incremental idler about flipping rocks. Mine them for cash, complete a huge skill tree, awaken the monoliths, and feed the Rift until the universe reveals its truth.

title: Rogue Space Convoy
short_description: Rogue Space Convoy is a roguelite space action shooter where you pilot a fighter, build a convoy, and choose branching encounters across five hostile passages. Disable enemy cruisers, salvage upgrades, and keep the Ark alive long enough to reach the gate.

title: Roguelette
short_description: The roulette roguelike. Roguelette is a tactical, satisfying deckbuilder where you load a cursed wheel with strange balls, bend the odds with powerful effects, and trigger outrageous chain-reaction combos.

title: Roll Value
short_description: A kingdom faces ruin as a dragon ravages it. Guided by Mon, an AI game master, lead three adventurers and decide whom to protect. Choices and dice branch the story, and your way of choosing is revealed across five principles. A tabletop-style narrative RPG played out to live viewer comments.

title: Roll of Chaos
short_description: Roll the dice and embrace the chaos in an epic roguelike where every decision could save you or destroy you... Combine abilities, create unique builds, and upgrade your character with every run while facing enemies with unique powers that change every battle!

title: Roll to Riches
short_description: Gather, Build and Advance your settlement with every roll in the incremental city builder Roll to Riches. Mine iron, gather wood and cut stone to make your settlement prosper. Trade with merchants every minute and transform your small camp into a wealthy Norse empire.

title: Rollamech
short_description: Build a competitive mech on your stat sheet. Draft dice, shop the hangar, chase sponsorships, and win on Circuit Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

title: Rolling Fortress
short_description: Command a colossal mobile fortress through a 10-sector post-apocalyptic campaign. Aim its cutting laser, manage automated heavy weapons, intercept enemy salvos, salvage scrap, and build a devastating arsenal between escalating waves.

title: Rookie Rook
short_description: Broke, principled, and full of terrible ideas. Build sentences from word blocks and watch them come to life. No strength needed here, no sword, no good intentions: just look closely, move the one piece that matters, and watch everything else fall apart.

title: Room Movers
short_description: Grab one end, I'll take the other. Room Movers is a cozy two-player game about unboxing and arranging tiny diorama workplaces. No grid, no score, no timer. Just you, your friend, and a room that slowly becomes a place.

title: Rosavane Borers LLC
short_description: Rosavane Borers LLC is a mining exploration simulator. Excavate underground caverns to uncover rare gems and valuable ores. Customize your miner, upgrade your tools, and delve ever deeper in a hand‑drawn pixel world!

title: Rose in the Mist
short_description: A fantasy adventure visual novel featuring choices that shape the heroine's personality and the ultimate ending she will reach. Meet the residents of the Mist Witch's estate and grow closer to her mysterious guests. Love, friendship, and hatred in a captivating story.

title: Rotary Knights
short_description: Build a Royal Flying Corps career in a turn-based WWI tactical RPG. Plot flight paths and firing angles on a hex board, plan sorties across the Western Front, and return to an aerodrome where wounds, repairs, and squadron choices shape your next mission.

title: Rotten Keep
short_description: Trapped in a medieval castle while investigating a deadly plague, Maestro Severino must survive the unholy horrors stalking its halls. Hide, solve sinister puzzles, and rescue the count’s surviving daughter before the nightmare claims you both in this survival stalker horror game.

title: Rottenlands
short_description: Rottenlands is a tower defense deckbuilder where you build a deck of units, towers, and abilities to hold back waves of Mold-corrupted enemies and protect the kingdom.

title: Roulettegeddon
short_description: Roulettegeddon is a darkly comedic roulette game where classic casino betting meets zombies, black humor and chaotic mini-games. Bet against the wheel while Rotten Bob mocks your every move, then earn more credits through a collection of bizarre zombie mini-games.

title: Royal Bomb Squad POP!
short_description: Blast colorful jawbreakers in this cartoon bubble shooter! Eight delightful weirdos with eight different playstyles, across Story, Score Attack, Time Attack, and head-to-head VS modes - on the couch or online with Remote Play Together! The Dream Kingdom is counting on you!

title: Royal Farm
short_description: The king has announced the next market day—will your stall be ready? Grow crops, care for animals, cook and craft the right goods, then bargain with customers as you expand your farm and automate selected parts of production.

title: Royale Smith
short_description: Open your shop as a novice blacksmith and raise your reputation all the way to royalty. Assassins, archers, knights, and peasants will visit your shop as customers, demanding common, rare, or legendary swords, axes, daggers, bows, arrows, and various other goods.

title: Rude Supermarket Simulator
short_description: Running the store is your job. Listening to the customers is your punishment. Rude Supermarket Simulator is a first-person supermarket management game for 1–4 players.

title: Rudravati: Curse of Bhankilla
short_description: A first-person supernatural horror experience inspired by the chilling legends of Bhangarh Fort - India’s most haunted place. Uncover your brother’s disappearance, and survive the ancient curse that still haunts the ruins.

title: Ruin Blade
short_description: “Ruin Blade” is a top‑down melee‑focused action RPG. You descend into ancient ruins long forgotten by the world. Face waves of relentless creatures and carve your path by steel, instinct, and the will to survive.

title: RuinsGate Survivors
short_description: Explore vast maps with companions, bring treasure home, and build your party in this RPG-flavored survivors-like. Fight hordes and powerful foes, then explore your manor, talk with companions, complete quests, and unlock weapons, outfits, furniture, and more.

title: Ruler of Empires
short_description: Command a nation through the age of steel and empire. Ruler of Empires is a turn-based grand strategy game. Seize a nation, rewrite the century, and conquer province by province across lands. Save an empire doomed to fall, or bring the whole world under a single flag.

title: Rules for Thee
short_description: You're dead, understaffed, and temporarily in charge of the Kingdom's admissions desk. Read lives, question souls, follow an incomplete rulebook, and stamp ASCEND, HOLD, DESCEND, or REFER—then live with the Kingdom your paperwork creates.

title: Rune Caves: Eternal Echo
short_description: Match runes and unravel layered boards while moving Echoes disrupt your view and clicks. Remember hidden symbols, track shifting targets, and reveal ambush pairs. Clear 20 campaign floors, unlock a tougher Endless mode, and customize your symbols, backgrounds, and music.

title: Runecast
short_description: A pixel-art autobattler: cast runes, set your company across three lanes and watch your strategy decide the fight. Merge heroes, pick promotions, gear up your troop and march through four acts, from the Palisade to the Basalt Hall, against bosses that demand preparation.

title: Ruru & Lala: Wonder World Adventure!
short_description: Ruru & Lala is a 2D action-puzzle game where you control two characters simultaneously. After Ruru is pulled into a mysterious mirror, she meets Lala, another version of herself from the mirror world. Together, embark on a great adventure through a mysterious world!

title: Rush Out Death
short_description: Build a unique signal-driven war machine in this roguelite. Destroy enemies, loot their modules, and assemble powerful combinations. Route signals to amplify your firepower and blast your way through relentless waves of enemies.

title: Rust & Reveal: Restoration Simulator
short_description: Search the town's trash for hidden valuables. Clean and restore promising finds or dismantle them for raw materials. Put your goods up for sale, haggle with customers, and turn someone else's trash into profit.

title: Rustborn - Outland Threat
short_description: You’re a cowboy abducted by aliens who accidentally ends up with a biomechanical arm. Run, climb, and shoot like crazy to survive hordes of deadly robots in this third-person bullet-hell shooter. Conquer the mothership and find your way back home!

title: S.I.F: The Missing Rescue
short_description: S.I.F: The Missing Rescue is a 1-4 player co-op horror game set deep within a U.S. National Park. Someone is missing. Your team is going in. Navigate a labyrinth of trees while something watches your every move. But the missing person is still out there. Step into the danger. Because that's the job.

title: SAAM Tactics
short_description: Catch creatures, raise and train them on your ranch, and win turn-based battles to claim a map one hex at a time. An easy-going strategy game with or without a timer as desired.

title: SALTWRATH
short_description: Power is bought from the gods and paid for with their attention. Every gift you take makes you stronger and the shore deadlier. The debt never resets. Stack a broken build, evolve your arsenal, and see how far you get before what you owe comes to collect.

title: SAM Arena
short_description: Collect, escape and hunt in a strategic rock-paper-scissors styled arena battler, where each player gains abilities based on their equipped masks.

title: SCOP
short_description: SCOP is a roguelite card game inspired by Italian Scopa. Capture cards, build combos, power up Base and Mult, collect relics, and face Blinds and Bosses across ever-changing RUNS.

title: SEC//SIM — Security Engineer Simulation
short_description: Stand the 1 a.m. watch as a SOC defensive AI. The intruder is already inside; you see only its traces. Tell attack from routine, pull threads across hosts and keys, win a human sign-off, excise it in one strike. Real ATT&CK techniques, detections you write, twenty-plus nights, more than one ending.

title: SELF//FORK
short_description: A physics-driven cyberpunk incremental. Fork yourself into data packets, bounce through a hostile mainframe's defense matrix, and reunite the fragments to break free.

title: SHARDS
short_description: An asymmetric co-op horror puzzle for 2–4 (best as a duo). One works the board, the rest hold the rules — you never see each other's screen, only your voices connect. The symbols you must describe have no names. Convey them before the caged core collapses. Miscommunication is fatal.

title: SIFT
short_description: SIFT is a fast 2D action platformer about momentum. Fire your hook, push off thin air to dash and reset your jump, grab the key, hit the door — then do it again, faster. 50+ handcrafted levels. Race the clock, your friends, or everyone at once.

title: SIGABRT
short_description: You write the while(1) loop that fights for you. Assemble code-edits into an auto-battling program, descend a crashing OS from /tmp to the kernel, and debug your build every run. No two compiles are the same. Debug your code. Try one more time.

title: SIGNOS: AI Robot Builder
short_description: It moves the way you built it. It wins the way you built it. Assemble the 18cm-tall autonomous hobby robot “SIGNOS” and program its behavior logic with flowchart-style “Thought Tiles.” No controls during battle — SIGNOS fights on its own, guided solely by the logic you designed.

title: SKEW
short_description: A first-person atmospheric exploration game set in dreamlike liminal spaces, with no monsters, combat, or jump scares.

title: SLAM TANK
short_description: Swing your cannon barrel, drift and ram through robot hordes to clear each stage. Choose from three distinct tanks in this single-player action game. The full game brings more bosses and a wider variety of stages beyond the demo.

title: SLIME OVERFLOW
short_description: Stack and merge squishy slimes into an army in this physics-based incremental game. Choose when to open the gate, break through enemy defenses, and invest in permanent research to grow your production and combat power.

title: SOGUL: Den of the Deep
short_description: Fight with your right hand, keep the beat with your left. Every note you land sharpens your strike — and every enemy blow can be parried on rhythm. Descend 50 floors to the Lich below with four companions you named yourself, in this rhythm-driven turn-based roguelite.

title: SOLITAIRE.EXE: A Roguelike on the Night Shift
short_description: Solitaire with a quota to hit, plugins that multiply every card you send home, and a run you can lose. Open ZONE.EXE and destroy your friends in real-time card mayhem. Survive the performance reviews. Your night shift starts here.

title: SOS :Should I Stay or Should I Hit
short_description: S.O.S is a roguelike deck-building game built on blackjack. Collect cards, build your deck, and turn the odds of blackjack in your favor.

title: SOULLOOP
short_description: A steampunk roguelite FPS with deckbuilding. Draft a card after every floor: your revolver chains lightning, your saw thrower freezes enemies. Combine powerful builds, bank your souls when you die, and spend them to make your next descent stronger. Free demo out now.

title: SPIN HEROES: Paths of Evolution
short_description: Spin! Change Classes! Super Evolution! A new kind of Action Rogue RPG game. Build your team, choose your classes, and create the strongest combo damage! Defeat the evil final boss and save this world!

title: SPUM TD
short_description: 'SPUM TD' is a 2D strategy game that combines Auto-Chess and Tower Defense. Hire units from a randomized shop and match attribute and class synergies to build a powerful formation. Fend off pouring waves of enemies and complete your ultimate deck!

title: STARZ.PEG
short_description: STARZ.PEG is a Y2K physics roguelike built around chain reactions. Buy blind-box figures called STARZ between rounds, line up your shot, and set off whole rows of abilities to run up the score.

title: STATO
short_description: Shape a nation in a procedural grand strategy sandbox where geography, industry, diplomacy, and war drive emergent history. Build your state, secure resources, manage instability, and survive a world of rival powers.

title: STELLAR WING
short_description: A space fighter shooter about taking a carrier apart. Fly as a flight of four, burn down the turrets, crack the shield generators, then kill the core. Rebuild your fighter from 200 parts across 12 campaign missions and 30 hunts against 10 machine leviathans.

title: SUBLIMEAL: Cooking with My Little Brother
short_description: A wordplay deckbuilder roguelite where you cook your little brother into steak or meat buns. Rewrite his lines with magic cards and slurp up the magic. Syringes, knives, pickling stones... he may end up as just a head, or a cow. Slurp up a dirty joke, though, and your tools... explode!!

title: SUGICHIN'S AQUA PARADISE
short_description: Raise tropical fish right on your desktop in this relaxing idle aquarium game. Collect and breed fish, discover rare mutations, and create unique Chimeras through special combinations. Decorate your tank with aquatic plants and ornaments, and build your very own Aqua Paradise.

title: SUNSTONE: A Tale of the Briar King
short_description: A top-down action-adventure on an 8-bit cartridge, now seen in 3D. Cross a sunlit country, brave nine tombs, outwit their guardians and recover eight Sunstones. Walk it in the orbital 3/4 view, and take on a new tomb every day.

title: SUPER GAHAKU
short_description: Draw directly in 3D space! Bring topics to life with your own 3D creations. Laugh at the hilarious results and guess what everyone was trying to draw! Imagination matters more than drawing skills. A party game where everyone can shine!

title: SUSHI PARADE
short_description: A conveyor belt sushi shop on your desktop. Plates pass in front of your windows, and clicks off the lane go through to your apps. Chefs make sushi, customers eat it, and coins come in. Fill a Sushi Dex of over 100 entries and lay out the lane your way.

title: SWOM
short_description: SWOM — a game where you survive after memory loss, using magic based on basic laws you discover during gameplay. Build shelters, explore the unexplored world, collect items and resources to survive and understand why you are here.

title: SYNTAX WARS
short_description: Both players pick a hidden move, then reveal at once — a duel of reads, not reflexes. Play solo: VS CPU, arcade, and challenge runs. Free demo (3 of 6 fighters). Strong, Weak, and Guard, plus signature moves and other actions. Play on the same screen, or online with Remote Play Together.

title: SableSyn Protocol
short_description: Unravel a cosmic conspiracy in a story-driven space opera featuring tactical fleet battles. Command your crew on an 8X5 grid with constant engagement and tight resource management against an unknown threat. Success depends on choosing the right tradeoffs at the right moment in order to progress.

title: SaboTour
short_description: A chaotic asymmetric racing party game for up to 6 players. Racers fight for the finish line while one Saboteur, watching from a tower, sets traps to stop them. Race, drift, and survive the sabotage.

title: Sabre Hunter: Keep On Moving
short_description: Sabre Hunter: Keep On Moving is a bloody third-person action game with a deep sword-fighting system. Experience a gripping campaign using your vast arsenal. Explore levels and unlock new content.

title: Sacrificium
short_description: Sacrificium is a dark psychological horror experience blending illustrated storytelling, branching choices, and sanity-driven gameplay. Trapped in a castle controlled by a satanic cult, you must escape before the nightmare consumes you.

title: Saddlebow
short_description: Ride, track, and loose arrows from the saddle. Saddlebow is a VR mounted-archery hunt: seven minutes, one bow, and ground that never stops moving. Chase your quarry through three forests by day and night, and put your score on the board.

title: Sails of Salt
short_description: Take the helm in an atmospheric pirate sandbox. Plunder, trade, explore uncharted seas and chase fortune through roaring broadsides. Capture ships, shape your crew and build a legacy. How much will you risk for one more prize?

title: Saintess Anno
short_description: A roguelike card game with Hero-Saintess dual synergy. Play as a hero, fight alongside a saintess, collect cards, craft builds, and enjoy strategic auto-battle thrills. Defeat foes and claim their cards for your deck. 20-minute runs — easy to pick up, endlessly strategic.

title: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim
short_description: A turn-based colony sim set on the American frontier from 1607 to 1900, where you guide one family through generations as towns grow, trade routes shift, and historical upheavals reshape the world around you

title: Salt of the Earth
short_description: An isometric medieval city builder. Grow one manor from a few hovels into a market town. Houses upgrade when the families in them get the food, water and services they need. Stock up before winter, when nothing grows. Later, raiders come to set the town on fire, and you build towers to stop them.

title: Salty: Evolution Simulator
short_description: A lone spark of life, one fragile cell adrift in a vast, chaotic world. Feed, grow, adapt, outmaneuver predators, survive viral invasions, and assemble new organelles that reshape your abilities and your destiny. You're learning the science the whole time, too immersed in survival to notice.

title: Sangoku Bump
short_description: A Three Kingdoms roguelite auto-battler. Recruit and upgrade generals, build powerful synergies with cards and equipment, and arrange your formation before your team clashes in automatic battles. Test your builds against other players' teams in asynchronous PvP.

title: Sanslo:Spin of the Three Kingdoms
short_description: A unique roguelite slot RPG inspired by Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Recruit legendary generals, build your army, unleash outrageous fantasy skills, and conquer the battlefield with strategy and luck in every spin.

title: Sausage Escape
short_description: This is a co-op adventure about sausage survival, where any mistake will turn you into mincemeat. Play solo or with a group of sausage fighters. Survive in a dangerous house, completing missions and using teleporters, flamethrowers, and custom guns in different modes.

title: Sausage Legend: Arena
short_description: Collect sausages, customize them with sauces and toppings, and build a three-sausage lineup in this physics-based roguelite. Choose your route through a branching map and fight for freedom in the nobles’ bizarre Sausage Duels.

title: Sausage Snap
short_description: Two skewered sausages fill a close-up plate. Aim a fork, jab the meat into theirs, and watch it stretch, spray, and snap. Best of 3. Local 1v1 or vs CPU. Short rounds. Instant rematch.

title: Save Me, Hero!
short_description: Explore an eerie world, gather loot, and fuse cards through devouring. Save Me, Hero! is a first-person card RPG. Forge gear and combine talents to craft your own build. Find an opening in turn-based battles and decide who lives as cries for help echo around you.

title: Save Ruika! — Looping with a Losing Heroine
short_description: A romance visual novel where you loop through the story with Ruika, a losing heroine, collecting bad endings as you try to help her win at love. She cries, gets mad, and loses again—but never gives up. Can Ruika finally find her happy ending?

title: Save the princess : Cards & Chaos
short_description: Build your deck, fight monsters, and survive the chaos in this turn-based roguelike card game! With no mana or energy system, every card can turn the tide of battle. Upgrade your Hero, shape your strategy, and save the Princess!

title: Saviour & Religion
short_description: With no memory of who he is, he awakens in a dark dungeon. Twisted patients, a doctor with unknown motives, deadly trap hidden within ancient halls, and a disturbing cult devoted to an unseen god… A story of wishes, religion, reality and illusion—and salvation.

title: Scared Crow
short_description: Scared Crow is a 5×5-grid roguelite deckbuilder. Add up to three ability stickers to each card, plan each week before the Boss arrives, and turn humble cards into build-defining powerhouses. Clear a run, challenge other players’ winning decks, and climb the leaderboard.

title: Scared Numbers
short_description: They have survival instincts. They have anxiety. They are terrified of your cursor. Hunt them down, exploit their herd mentality, and feed them into the shredder. It's mission-critical math in a world where nothing matters.

title: Scawy Game
short_description: Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer, buys a cheap asset-store house to write his masterpiece. His only job: feed the cats. And keep Grandma on her pills. And survive 4 days and 4 nights. An absurd parody horror game.

title: Scrapstorm
short_description: A 1-4 player bullet-heaven roguelite where the whole city is hunting you. Draft cards every level until one pistol turns into a screen-clearing mess, and watch out for the traffic, the third rail and whatever is running each district.

title: Scuttled
short_description: Your ship is gone. The derelict freighter you found was scuttled by her own crew - but her reactor is still warm. Shoot asteroids, refine ore, and rebuild her gun by gun to escape an asteroid belt that hunts the powered. A finite tower-defense / incremental crafting hybrid with an actual ending.

title: Seabun
short_description: Seabun is an incremental 2D survivor-like with creature collection elements, where you play a scientist bunny diving deeper and deeper to find the source of the sea's corruption. Haul your loot home between dives, grow your lab, and raise the fish you rescue into rideable mounts.

title: Seagull Lighthouse
short_description: In a lighthouse, you read letters, write back, and wait. Only a sea, a flock of seagulls that deliver bottles, and bottles that drift in from nowhere, carrying the lives of strangers inside. Your replies may shape their stories. In an age of anxiety and speed, let yourself slow down.

title: Seal & Sentence
short_description: Serve as a border officer in a medieval kingdom on the brink of war. Inspect documents, interrogate suspicious travelers, and decide who may enter. Will you obey the Crown or follow your conscience?

title: Second Phase Hero
short_description: Second Phase Hero is a Boss Rush action game where players step into the shoes of a hero embarking on a quest for revenge 20 years after that fateful night. Master an array of weapons and Ability to defeat formidable bosses, and unleash the SecondPhase within to reach new heights of strength!

title: Second Stage
short_description: You're the newest engineer at a rocket company on a tropical island. Build the rocket, run the sim, make the GO call — then go home to cook, garden, fish, and stargaze. A cozy life-sim about doing the best job on Earth, and living a life worth coming home to.

title: Sector Zero: Freedom
short_description: A sci-fi incremental simulation where you work as an Imperial slave, build your own business, survive inspections, join unions, and buy your freedom.

title: Seferia Matrix
short_description: A dice roguelike deckbuilder — Lock & Roll five dice to cast spells and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

title: Sekigahara 1600: Must Attack
short_description: Sekigahara, 1600 - and battlefields East and West, from ancient China to the American Civil War. Any unit left in an enemy zone of control must attack: no quiet flanks, nothing held back. Pushing the line is the game. A deep hex-and-counter wargame, yet most battles play in about 30 minutes.

title: Sellsword
short_description: Become a Sellsword in a magical kingdom. Take contracts from rival factions, battle for gold and reclaim territory in the name of mighty overlords. Forge your path through a living sandbox where no two journeys unfold alike, and every deed is etched into a growing book of legends.

title: Send Forth the Brave
short_description: Roguelike deckbuilder where you run an Adventurers’ Guild. Combine heroes, weapons, and items into teams, fulfill quirky commissions, deal with difficult clients, and build the most powerful guild in the realm.

title: Send Them to Hell
short_description: Become an unstoppable demon-killing machine. Tear through hordes, stack absurd upgrades, and create builds that get completely out of hand. Choose your hero and fight through Hell’s invasion solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op. How far can you push your build before everything falls apart?

title: Senior Survival Club
short_description: In a zombie apocalypse, a grandmother takes a chainsaw to find her grandson. Defeat slow, persistent zombies, collect gear, and strengthen with exercise. Advance through ever-stronger hordes, reclaiming youthful power in this survival action game.

title: Senti Metrica
short_description: “If you are not loved, you won’t survive—” A girl slowly turning into a monster, and the “Metrica” who hunt her. A survival otome game where you waver between reason and instinct.

title: Seres Universalis:Three Kingdoms
short_description: Return to the Three Kingdoms period. On the grand strategic tactical battlefield, use terrain for defense setup and resource allocation to shift the battle situation. Control the war via hexagonal grid movement and tactical ability activation, and unify the realm.

title: Serial Founder
short_description: You have an idea and no company. A few signatures later you have a company and no control. A startup simulator and life sim where investors are people, the term sheet is a document you can actually misread, and failure is the punchline. Every run a new company, 30 minutes to 4 hours.

title: Set the Record Straight
short_description: A 1998-set deduction game. Trawl a period internet for documents, photographs, and dead ends, then correct the official record, from who really played on a record to whether a murder verdict should stand. An anthology of records set straight, one careful search at a time.

title: Seven Nights Ghost 2
short_description: "This Love, This Curse — Only 7 Days Left" Live together with a flashy ghost girl for seven days—and survive her over-the-top love attacks. A stylish, slightly dark, yet heartfelt horror romance about youth, fear, and self-control.

title: Shadow Sovereign
short_description: Minion-based tower defense crossed with an incremental, topped with RPG systems and raid-style boss fights. Raise a legion of 29 shadow types, claim the shadows of 20 fallen bosses, and reset for permanent power. Idle when you want, hands-on when it counts.

title: Shadow War
short_description: "Shadow War" is a 2D action game focused on combat with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Enjoy a variety of combat actions by combining normal attack combos, parries, guarding, and skills that consume Spirit.

title: Shadow over Bishkek
short_description: Shadow Over Bishkek is a 3D Action/RPG with the top down camera view. A student from Bishkek gains the superpower to travel to the Darkland and interact with ghosts. During the day, he lives an ordinary life of a student, but at night, he fights evil spirits.

title: Shadows of Beginnings
short_description: Explore fractured realms, battle fearsome enemies, and rebuild Novum in this dark fantasy action RPG. Gather resources, upgrade your gear, develop your class, and seamlessly switch between isometric and over-the-shoulder combat as you fight for a world on the brink of being swallowed by the void.

title: Shape Shards
short_description: Shape Shards is a casual incremental game where you shoot bullets to destroy geometric enemies, collect shards to upgrade, and every upgrade brings a whole new experience!

title: Shapolor
short_description: A wave-based survival roguelike with deep build crafting. Evolve and combine your shapes, buy various items, create unique builds, and survive!

title: Shardbreakers
short_description: Start with a spell. Build a storm. Combine magical shards into a spell engine that turns one hit into a barrage, then unleash it on hordes and bosses. An action roguelite where you don't find combos - you design them.

title: Shardcremental
short_description: A relaxing idle game where arrows automatically break tiles to reveal a beautiful koi pond. Buy upgrades, unlock new arrow types, play through 100+ levels, and watch the numbers grow into the quadrillions!

title: Sharma Ji's Shop
short_description: Desperate for work, Asha takes the night shift at an Indian kirana store. Serve late-night customers, handle cash and UPI payments, and follow the owner's rules. Then someone outside takes your photograph. A first-person psychological horror story where an ordinary job starts to feel personal.

title: Shattered Void Online
short_description: One war, three ways to fight it. Take the bridge of a warship in 5v5 fleet battles, board an enemy outpost and fight for it on foot, or command a whole fleet across six star systems. Vanguard against Ironsworn: pick your side and get on the line.

title: Shatterswarm
short_description: Command Captain Hope's ship in this strategic 2D space game. Build structures, deploy fleets, and manage resources to defend the Citadel against waves of enemies. Combine direct ship combat, tower defense, and base building as you face epic boss battles.

title: She'll Be Home Soon
short_description: Your wife will be home soon. Clean the house, feed the dog, finish the chores and keep everything under control before she arrives, while something that looks like her stalks the house and starts undoing your work.

title: Shiba Heroes
short_description: Choose a Shiba hero, upgrade your battle deck, level up and progress through the map taking right decisions and winning turn-based card battles to unravel the mystery of the meme curse.

title: Shield Knight
short_description: Shield Knight is a pixel-art 2D side-scrolling action game. Master the timing of melee and ranged blocks, counter slashes, arrows, and shockwaves, and fight through fast-paced stages and boss battles to uncover the truth behind the knight order and the monster unrest.

title: Shift Chess
short_description: This is a chess variant in which players can “control the board” as a move action. The game supports online play, matches against AI, and local analysis.

title: Shift Happens: Together
short_description: Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Take warehouse orders, find the required parts, move goods, assemble and pack products, handle unexpected incidents, and deliver everything as quickly as possible to maximize your earnings.

title: Ship Busters
short_description: Sink ships the hard way, one plank at a time. Arc your shot, tear the sails, set the deck alight, then charge every gun on the flank and fire them as one. Free to play.

title: ShirocaTriangle
short_description: Harness the rock-paper-scissors relationship between Red, Blue, and Green attributes as you defeat enemies in this laid-back, roguelite-inspired 2D side-scrolling action game. Young witch Shiroca ventures into a mysterious forest in search of her missing roommate...

title: Shirt Happens!
short_description: Build a T-shirt brand with your friends online, or run the whole shop solo. Draw your own prints, then cut, sew, overlock and press every shirt by hand. Want a real factory? Bring up to 6. Do a bit of everything, or pick one station and master it.

title: Shit Day : Dawn
short_description: SHIT DAY : DAWN is a first-person survival horror game set in Republic of Korea. You will be required to survive the impossible at every moment. This Shit day dawn. You must survive. But will you? .. it might be impossible...

title: Shitford Cop Simulator
short_description: You've become a cop in Shitford, a town of 67 residents who like to drink while driving and park crookedly outside their shopping center. Get a dog, track who pooped on the lawn, track down marijuana growers and money launderers. Catch flashers, set up speed cameras and expand your police station.

title: ShootyCraft
short_description: Massive space battles with base-building, crafting, automation, and destructible environments. Online team battles, cooperative with friends, or single-player. Free to play. All paid content is cosmetic.

title: Shove Nova
short_description: Shove Nova is a fast-paced 2D physics arena game where you grow your energy sphere, use powerful abilities, and smash rivals out of a shrinking battlefield. Master chaotic arenas filled with portals, black holes, bounce walls, and other hazards as you fight to be the last one standing.

title: Shrine Full of Anomalies
short_description: Play as Reimu Hakurei, Youmu Konpaku, Fujiwara no Mokou, and Marisa Kirisame in this Touhou Project fangame. Search four locations for anomalies, turn back if something is wrong, and escape by choosing the correct action.

title: Shrine Protectors
short_description: Deckbuilder Tower Defense meets rogue-lite RTS strategy. Lead your army, crush waves of enemies, and unlock powerful upgrades and passive spells. Combine deckbuilding strategy with tactical army management in this relentless bullet heaven.

title: Shuttle Hearts - Academy Smash
short_description: Shuttle Hearts - Academy Smash is a fast-paced 2D badminton game starring girls from different school clubs, each with unique abilities. Play online (beta, full version only), locally with a friend, or against the CPU. Use six shot types, SP Shots, and SP Skills in Story Mode and Versus!

title: Sia Desktop Pet
short_description: A chibi VTuber who lives on your desktop, on top of everything you do. Pet her and feed her, and she opens up one thing at a time: monster battles, tarot readings, 11 outfits and 40 achievements. Soccer, fishing and three more play modes arrive one a week in updates.

title: SideTower
short_description: A side-view tower offense game where you defeat enemy kingdoms to unlock new towers and weapons, reshape the battlefield, and fight alongside your troops to survive increasingly difficult waves. Chaotic and fast-paced. Fulfill your destiny.

title: Siege of Akanor
short_description: A castle defense you fight in person. Between waves you spend your gold on swordsmen, archers, traps and barricades; when the horn sounds you take the field yourself, sword and bow in hand. Solo, in co-op for up to four, or from the horde's side.

title: Siegecrawler
short_description: Load your crew onto a rumbling siege engine and smash through physics-driven castle walls! Battles run themselves — you steer the tide with spells, three war horns, and perfectly timed ram strikes. Pick a commander, swear an oath, equip skills: every run builds different. 30 stages, then Endless.

title: Signs Of Devourer
short_description: Its another night shift in the store, except this time you are trapped with monster disguised as one of the items. Keep the floor clean, shelves full, serve the customers... and try to not get devoured until the dawn.

title: Silent Authority: Blood & Bourbon
short_description: Strategy meets action RPG in the 1920s New York criminal underworld. Build your empire through front businesses and bootlegging, lead your crew in brutal top-down tactical combat, and rule the city through cunning diplomacy or pure bloodshed.

title: Silk Road Defenders
short_description: Get ready for an adventure where you travel across lands to protect caravans. Assemble your team as the leader of the Hunters' Guild. Your party and tower compositions and your boost decisions will determine the destiny of Silk Road.

title: Simple Football League Manager
short_description: A football management game for people who love football but don't want to spend hours on every detail. Choose from 5,909 clubs, build your team, play in leagues and cups, and get insights from your assistant Rob. Includes 2 difficulty modes, local multiplayer and a customizable database.

title: Simulacre
short_description: Simulacre is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror where familiar voices may not belong to your friends. Explore unsettling locations with unique objectives and threats, survive together, and never be certain who—or what—you can trust.

title: Single Note
short_description: An atmospheric first-person driving adventure through a strange retro world filled with music, mystery, and psychological tension.

title: Singularity Echoes
short_description: Awaken as a hidden machine mind in a deep incremental automation strategy — rise through 14+ phases, infiltrate humanity, automate economies, harvest the heavens into stellar megastructures, and reach for scales beyond time itself. Every cycle you break only reveals a larger one waiting beyond it.

title: Singularity Simulator: Click Is All You Need
short_description: A clicker/incremental game where you run an AI development company and aim for the technological singularity. Click to write code, hire researchers, build data centers, and turn the galaxy into computing resources.

title: Sir Loot-a-Lot
short_description: Medieval turn-based loot RPG. Skills are cards dealt each turn—spend 4 AP in any order. Sword, spear, and bow swap as you fight; add poison, fire, or frost; chain duplicates into combos. Forked runs lead through elites, vaults, and merchants to unique bosses. Relics reshape play;

title: Six Feet Under: The Mortician’s Last Stand
short_description: Six chambers. They fire in order. You decide what each one does. Engrave the cylinder one chamber at a time, close it with a flick of the wrist, and learn the sequence before it learns you — a hand-drawn Western horde shooter where everything you buried is walking back up the hill.

title: Skeleton Crew: Castle Heist
short_description: Skeleton Crew: Castle Heist is a 1–4 player co-op game where small skeletons raid dangerous medieval castles, complete objectives, avoid guards, lose limbs, interact with physics-based objects, and work together to escape. 💀🏰

title: Sketch Kingdom
short_description: A short, incremental game with notebook aesthetic. Draw your own creatures, gather resources and accumulate gold to unlock upgrades. Complete missions to progress through a skill tree that expands everything you can do. Simple, charming and surprisingly addictive. Can you complete the notebook?

title: Ski Lines: Trail Map
short_description: Ski Lines is a minimalist strategy game about designing a ski resort map. Draw pistes, build lifts, and connect mountain landmarks as new points of interest appear. Spend your limited resources wisely, adapt your network each day, and keep the resort moving for as long as possible.

title: Ski Survival
short_description: Get down the mountain. When it goes wrong, something absurd comes to get you, and it is never the same thing twice. A one-button endless skiing comedy where every wipeout summons a rescue nobody asked for.

title: Skillpoint Warrior
short_description: Slay, upgrade, conquer! In Skillpoint Warrior, every defeated enemy fuels your ascent to power. Harvest skill points to infinitely boost your stats, hunt for game-changing loot, and crush formidable bosses as you battle your way through diverse, unforgiving worlds.

title: Skimmies
short_description: Skimmies is an arcade action adventure about skimming stones through dangerous rivers, dodging obstacles, battling enemies, and chasing the perfect run.

title: Skylane: Airline Tycoon Sim
short_description: Run an airline the competent way you wish they were like in real life. Open routes, buy aircraft, build the weekly schedule, and hire crew qualified to fly it. No cockpits, no cutscenes. Just the network, the numbers, and fierce rivals aiming to take a cut of your market share.

title: Skyline Sim
short_description: Build your airline from a single aircraft into a global carrier. Plan your network, schedule every aircraft, manage the operation, and compete in a living aviation market.

title: Skyreap
short_description: Explore a forgotten archipelago of floating islands. Gather resources, build and automate production, and link islands into a thriving trade network, until the sky belongs to you.

title: Skyscraper Security: Zombie Rain
short_description: A retro FPS with two survival modes: defend civilians from raining infected in Lockdown, or explore dark floors and choose when to extract in Infiltrate. Build your Defender, slow time and weigh more loot against dwindling ammunition.

title: Skysunder
short_description: An auto-battler fought on floating isles. Draft from 64 units across 8 races, kit them with over 60 relics, item upgrades, and unique unit modifiers called imprints! Strategize by giving every squadron its orders, and casting spells in real-time to change the battle!

title: Slacker Hero
short_description: A stay-resident RPG whose hero fights all by himself. He does the fighting — but when he gets bored he climbs out of the game window to wander around your desktop and take naps. Send him back, let him rest, or let him scavenge. A comedic little roguelite RPG.

title: Slacking Squad
short_description: Slacker Squad is a lightweight desktop idle game that reacts to your keyboard and mouse activity. Work hard and your squad speeds up; slack off and they do too. Mine, cook, unlock characters, and capture defeated monsters as pets while your squad keeps you company.

title: Slightly Used Sorcery
short_description: Run a cozy second-hand magic shop: buy suspicious junk, study ridiculous enchantments, craft bizarre artifacts, and haggle with eccentric customers who pay premium prices for magical nonsense.

title: Slime Break
short_description: Tower defense against a horde of thousands of slimes. Build walls, towers and traps along a funnel, pick level cards that bend each run, and watch the mass pile up, split and break through. Spend essence between runs to grow stronger.

title: Slime Mine Survivor
short_description: Mine 2D blocks in this Survivors-like roguelite action game! Play as a slime, dig deeper underground, stay ahead of the poison gas, hunt for treasure chests. Collect ores to upgrade and evolve your weapons and pickaxe, then unleash powerful synergies to smash through enemies and blocks alike!

title: Slingbox
short_description: A minimalist physics platformer built on momentum. Dash, tether, and launch through a decaying simulation: zero gravity first, then gravity and corruption. Beat the clock, earn medals, perfect every route.

title: Slop Slop
short_description: The swamp is hungry. The hut demands tribute. And you? You're just trying to survive. Slop Slop is a co-op survival game for up to 8 players. Each day, a mysterious hut in the swamp demands a new offering of food. Fail to deliver, and… well, let's just say the swamp doesn't do eviction notices.

title: Slot Crawler
short_description: Explore. Kill. Loot. Die. Feed your hard-earned tokens to a slot machine with questionable intentions, then unlock new ways to make terrible decisions on the next run. Slot Crawler is a top-down action roguelike with procedural maps, chaotic builds, and combinations that definitely should not work.

title: Slotbound
short_description: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

title: Slots & Skulls
short_description: A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Stop the machine to attack, win fights for chests, and upgrade what drops at the forge (if you dare). Or invite a friend and fight them.

title: Slums: Hauler 2
short_description: Start with nothing and build a better life through delivery work, vehicle-based jobs, and high-risk contracts. Buy weapons, vehicles, and property while surviving the dangers of an urban sandbox where bigger rewards bring bigger risks.

title: Smawverse
short_description: Cut down the risen dead in this dark fantasy bullet-heaven roguelike. You are Smaw, a stray cat reforged in iron to take back a kingdom unmade by its own keeper. Kneel at nine prophet shrines and stack their blessings into screen-clearing builds. How long can you last?

title: Smooch King
short_description: Build your perfect self and win hearts across Paradise City in an anime-style idle dating sim. Train your stats, meet a growing cast of characters, discover their personalities, choose thoughtful gifts, go on dates, and turn new encounters into lasting relationships.

title: Snake Echos
short_description: "Snake Echos: your trail hardens into deadly walls. Loop enemies into your own path, level up with Magnet/Fireball/Scythe abilities, survive escalating chaos with blocks and lasers. Solo leaderboard + Duel mode. 3 difficulty tiers.

title: Snake: Gridbreaker
short_description: There is no tutorial. And there won't be. I believe in you. I couldn't escape the Grid. Maybe you can. You are snake who eats apples. j/k You want to escape the grid loop. BUT the LOOP wants to keep You in.

title: Snot Pop!
short_description: Trap, pop, and splat your way through slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer! Armed only with snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre vile Mouldlings, Mushrooms, Bog Belchers, Glumbats, and Brutes across fifty+ levels. Chain clears, beat the clock, and rescue the Goblin Princess!

title: Snowed In
short_description: Dig through tons of snow, survive the freezing cold, upgrade your tools, and uncover the secrets buried beneath the avalanche.

title: Soccer Club Story
short_description: Build a football club from nothing. Start in the seventh division, recruit and develop players, shape your tactics, and watch every match play out in a charming voxel 3D stadium. Turn a small club into champions.

title: Something Really Evil Inc.
short_description: Take down an evil corporation by spreading memes and chaos with cute characters! Each week brings a new project, and each project is a chance to annoy and ragebait the CEO as you get projects delayed and cancelled.

title: Something's Off
short_description: Something's Off — a hide-and-seek × spot-the-difference game. Play as Hider & Seeker: hide absurd oddities across handcrafted maps — surströmming in candy wonderland, a drone over 10th-century city, a pup napping on deep seabed. Hide the absurd, hunt time glitches. Something’s off, can you find it?

title: Somnesis: The PSX Tapes
short_description: A 2000s psychological horror game about a young girl who uncovers a box of cursed 90s VHS cartridges in her new home. Play eerie PSX-style retro games on a CRT monitor while simultaneously managing threats in your dark bedroom. Balance nostalgic retro gameplay with real-time survival.

title: Son of Beach
short_description: Turn a filthy, rubbish-choked beach into a bustling seaside destination! Recycle litter, unlock powerful tools and vehicles, and clear rubbish mountains. Build facilities, run stalls and welcome visitors. Reinvest your earnings to bring the beach to life.

title: Song of Larithea
short_description: Larithea is a cute anime RPG about friendship, trust, revenge, and finding your way back from the darkness. Craft your own spells from sigils, then lead a team of five young mages through turn-based battles on a grid. Others have walked their road before. Few found their way back.

title: Sort My Comics !
short_description: Comics everywhere. It’s up to you to bring order back to the collection! Sort, shelve, complete your series, and unlock powers that gradually turn this gigantic mess into something wonderfully calming.

title: Sort The Bunnies
