short_description: A cozy organizing simulator for 1–4 players. Sort 500 bunny designs, fill colorful shelves, and turn a messy shop into a collection worth admiring. Unlock handy upgrades and make a little mischief along the way.

title: Soul Link - End and Rebirth
short_description: An offline turn-based RPG of card-framed battles, party growth, and a two-act story. Unlock memory fragments, face trials, and choose among three finales. No energy gates or daily login chores—buy once and play through.

title: Soul Tides
short_description: Command dark armies in this tug-of-war auto-battler. Build your base, summon units, customize abilities, and push the battlefield toward your enemy’s stronghold. Adapt your strategy each match and dominate in PvP, co-op, or Trials mode.

title: Soul of Slime
short_description: Build your slime with cards, combine six elements and watch your strategy unfold in automatic battles. Survive 10 rounds, then take the same build into Endless mode and push on for as long as your lives last.

title: Souls Caps
short_description: A rhythm-driven roguelite deckbuilder. Hit the beat to drop your caps, chain throw after throw, and earn your job at Soulbuster!

title: Souls Divided
short_description: A single-player puzzle game where you divide your soul into two forms, each perceiving a different dimension. Switch between them, manipulate ancient instruments, and solve layered puzzles across overlapping realities in a mysterious astral world left behind by a failed civilization.

title: Soulstack
short_description: Card-stacking RPG: gather, forge weapons and fight through dungeons. Pick an evolution path for both you and your pet: 48 classes (9 cursed), 140 pet forms. 300+ weapons, from a stone on a stick to a hand-held ballista. Yet still feels like a Jira and Trello child.

title: Souq Boss Simulator
short_description: Every Sheikh-sized fortune has to start somewhere. Yours starts with a tiny baqala. Manage your shop, meet the locals, build your fortune, and invest across a 2002 Gulf city inspired by Old Dubai & Riyadh. Solo or with friends in online co-op. Become the Souq Boss.

title: Space Daram
short_description: Become a cute space chipmunk and manage your ship with companions as you explore alien planets, build and upgrade your base, and craft gear by generating power and refining resources. Meet unique alien species, grow your foothold in the universe, and play solo or with friends in multiplayer.

title: Space Travelers
short_description: Mine asteroids, trade minerals and chart an endless, procedurally generated galaxy in a relaxed 2D space sim. Then pin it to your desktop as a live wallpaper: your ship keeps flying, mining and discovering while you work

title: SpaceShooter
short_description: Survive 20 escalating stages of meteor chaos in a fast-paced 2D arcade shooter. Master unlockable weapons, face unique meteor threats and powerful bosses, customize your ship, then push your limits in Endless Mode.

title: Spear Dive
short_description: Take up your spear in this first-person freediving simulator. Study fish behavior, manage oxygen and body temperature, and upgrade your gear to dive deeper. Explore seas that change daily with temperature, turbidity, and waves. Complete your fish encyclopedia and unlock new fishing grounds.

title: SpecterMancer
short_description: A multiplayer horror game for 1 to 6 players set in a dark Victorian era. As a ghost, you must terrify the others and prevent them from escaping alive; as a survivor, explore, solve puzzles, survive, and find a way to escape.

title: Speed Rivals - Model Trains
short_description: Choose your route and deliver wagons, then process different materials to get the specific wagons you need. Create your own maps and levels, and play solo or in co-op with up to 4 players.

title: Spell Cage
short_description: Spell Cage is an action roguelite that packs the hands-on combat and deep buildcrafting of hack-and-slash ARPGs into short runs. Fight through randomized dungeons without quests or complicated navigation, and combine skills to develop a build of your own.

title: Spell Death
short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where the alphabet is your deck. Draw letters and spell words to strike, block or hex. Print them on paper stocks that change the rules, and learn each demon's true name to banish it from an art deco city that stopped reading.

title: Spell Unbound
short_description: A pixel-art roguelite where your only spell is the circle you draw. Loop a whole pack at once, draw shapes to cast, and tear bosses apart piece by piece. Three runs, 19 bosses, hidden places and 43 scribes who each break a rule. Draw tight. Something is always crossing your line.

title: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem
short_description: A fast-paced, top-down PvP arena brawler where up to six mages compete across seven rounds of magical mayhem. Draft new spells and items between rounds, create increasingly powerful builds, and outlast your opponents as the arena crumbles beneath your feet.

title: Spellk
short_description: Spell a word. Smash an enemy. Turn random letters into attacks and stack strange items into ridiculous builds. Make rare letters hit harder or long words pay off in this turn-based word-combat roguelite, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

title: Spellworks
short_description: Spellworks is a single-player dark fantasy tower defense game where tactical real-time decisions shape every battle. Build and upgrade powerful elemental towers, defend the realms from relentless enemy waves, and defeat epic bosses.

title: Spike Force
short_description: Spike Force is a roguelite deckbuilder soaked in 90's action anime. Build your volleyball team, draft your cards, and represent your school in a supernatural battle for the fate of humanity. Every match is a fight for survival, and every card is a move in the game.

title: Spill The Ink
short_description: Draw one continuous line, then watch gravity turn your ink into the solution. Guide the paper ball through handcrafted chambers, chase three-star clears, and build, test, and share your own puzzles.

title: Spirefall
short_description: A single-player roguelite deckbuilder where your fortress fights back. Deploy units, cast spells, and unleash fortress weapons in turn-based card battles. Play five factions through three tavern Gauntlets, each ending with a boss who has a few tricks of their own.

title: Spirestorm
short_description: Dive into enemies and rebound skyward in this arcade action roguelite. Climb a 25,400-metre tower, forge upgrades, and decide when to bank your haul.

title: Spirits: Wake Up!
short_description: SPIRITS: WAKE UP! is a 2–8 player online horror party game. Speak into your mic to chase as a Hunter, or float through retro sewers, complete tasks, and rescue friends as a Ghost. Just don't let your screams give you away!

title: Splorbit
short_description: Splorbit is a physics-driven horde survival game. Bounce, split and explode balls through swarming enemies, build a loadout from upgrade cards, break the gold off named bosses, and survive 20 minutes per world across 5 worlds. Solo or local co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Sponge Bridges
short_description: G-City has fallen. Survivors are hiding in scattered corners of the city, and food, and everyday supplies are scarce. You make a living delivering cargo for others—and, along the way, try to find out what happened here. For now... just get the cargo delivered. And try not to starve on the way.

title: Spook & Sell
short_description: Stage the haunt. Sell the house. You’re the world’s most desperate real-estate agents — hide the ghosts, mop the ectoplasm, and keep buyers calm in this chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics party game before the haunting meter tips over.

title: Spot the Difference Stadium
short_description: Find the one that doesn't belong. A board packed with near-identical characters hides a single odd one out — spot it fast, alone or against up to 8 players online.

title: Square Colosseum: Cell B201
short_description: A gladiator deck-building strategy game where your gladiators may die, but Cell B201 lives on. Fight in the arena, improve your inherited prison cell, and leave a legacy for future generations.

title: Squarelings
short_description: A chaotic co-op puzzle platformer for 4–12 players, where every level is a new test of communication, teamwork and friendship.

title: Stack Haven
short_description: Stack Haven is a cozy card-stacking cultivation game. Manage spirit animals to farm, mine, and alchemize, restoring a lost paradise. Master automation with Magnetic Channels, breed mythical beasts like the Nine-Tailed Fox, and bond with wandering spirits in this heartwarming roguelike sim.

title: Stackade
short_description: Tower defense where your towers fall as blocks. Drag each piece onto the board, wall in your HQ and turn the gaps into kill zones. Every enemy comes at you its own way, bosses test your build, and between waves the Armory never has enough money for everything you want.

title: Star Claw
short_description: A claw-machine roguelite where you fling a cat's stretchy paw to grab treasure. Bounce off bumpers and reach each room's cash target before time runs out. Combine powerful upgrades, battle bosses, and unlock new cats and decorations between runs.

title: Star Colony
short_description: StarColony is a resource management & incremental space colony building game.

title: Star Raker
short_description: Welcome to Star Raker, a multiplayer social deduction for 4 to 12 players. Take part in a psychological experiment aboard an evacuation ship. Use logic, communication, and social engineering to save the gene pool or survive the paranoia of hidden betrayal.

title: Star Seed Protocol
short_description: Star Seed Protocol is a bullet-heaven horde survival shooter where you aim your own weapons, deploy turrets and drones, reshape your build with implants, research new technology, and fight through alien swarms across varied mission types.

title: StarCinder
short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer space combat where three factions battle across arenas, ore runs, and sector conquest with customizable ships, gunships, squadrons, NPC fleets, and progression.

title: Starcore Survivor
short_description: Starcore Survivor is a top-down arena auto-shooter roguelite. Move, dodge, collect materials, and shape each run through 20 waves of combat, upgrade choices, between-wave shops, weapon fusion, evolution recipes, relics, bosses, and escalating Danger levels.

title: Stardust Protocol
short_description: Blast through bullet hell in a sci-fi roguelite shooter. Chart a branching star map, combine scatter shots, missiles, homing fire and lasers, and build your arsenal with upgrades and items. Weigh risks at black markets and unknown events. Face colossal mechanical bosses. Play the free demo.

title: Starfall Samurai
short_description: Starfall Samurai blends slash-based action with incremental progression. Drag the mouse to aim your slash, then release as asteroids cluster together. Clear the screen in one strike, collect carrots, hone your sword techniques, and venture ever deeper into space.

title: Starforge Pirate
short_description: Starforge Pirate is a fast-paced arcade roguelite in which you will battle cosmic enemies, forge wild weapons, manage weapon heat, upgrade your ship, face deadly bosses, and chase the perfect run.

title: Starfort
short_description: Defend your empire in a sci-fi tower defense game. Build deadly combinations of railguns, lasers, gravity wells, drones, and cannons across three maps, 50 levels per map, and four difficulty modes.

title: Starhand
short_description: Most deckbuilders take your health. Starhand takes your options. Every card runs on a ship system, and enemies shoot those systems offline, locking cards out of your hand mid-fight. Six pilots, 295 cards, eight zones. Learn to win with half a ship.

title: Starherald
short_description: Explore thousands of planets, gather resources, craft warships, and battle space pirates. Form factions, conquer worlds, and build your galactic empire in this vast sci-fi sandbox. Captain — are you ready?

title: Starhold: Last Light
short_description: <Tower Defense × Roguelike> — Resist the Endless Swarm from the Stars Build along the surface of spherical planets, where every angle matters. Expand into space for more building grounds, but risk unknown disasters. Choose 1 of 3 cards, build your deck, and adapt your strategy with every choice.

title: Starting a Village from Zero
short_description: “This is your own little village.”You are a familiar summoned by the apprentice witch Lily. In her place, build houses and create a thriving village.A new kind of “garden world × roguelite × turn-based strategy” game.

title: Stay with me
short_description: Answer a late night call to care for an elderly woman with dementia. Explore a haunted house, solve environmental puzzles and uncover a terrifying truth in this first person psychological horror experience.

title: Steal & Sell Simulator
short_description: Steal valuable goods by night and sell them in your own shop by day. Turn stolen loot into profit, upgrade your store, and grow your criminal business. Take on bigger, riskier heists to keep your shelves stocked and your profits rising - but watch out, the police are closing in.

title: Steel Company
short_description: Steel Company is a tactical-scale wargame covering all major theaters and powers of WWII, with hundreds of units and detailed modeling of weapons and equipment. It features advanced tactical AI for single player, online multiplayer (PvP and co-op), a powerful scenario editor, and mod support.

title: Steel Wolverines: Modern Armored Combat
short_description: A turn-based tactical wargame inspired by the classics of the 1990s. Build your own battlegroup and fight on a modern battlefield where detecting the enemy, choosing the right weapon, and landing the first accurate shot decide the outcome.

title: Stellacore Defense
short_description: A 2D pixel art tower defense game with unparalleled strategic depth. Deploy modules to redirect enemies, use tactical chips to command the battlefield, and upgrade towers with multi-branch modifications to protect humanity's vital Stellacore energy.

title: Stellar Courier
short_description: Arcade space shooter. You are a courier with one package to deliver across a broken galaxy. Plane-like flight, fights with pirates, the old army and aliens in a 20+ mission story campaign. Pick your ship and mods between missions. No grind, no filler.

title: Stellar Nursery
short_description: Relight a dead sun and tend the worlds that circle it. Earth comes back to life, builds a city you name, and keeps a written record of all that follows. P.O.R.T.I.A., the caretaker who waited a hundred thousand years, keeps the watch with you. A calm idle game: close it, and she counts the hours.

title: Stellar Orbit
short_description: Mine deeper than your fuel can carry you, while solar flares scramble your instruments. Strip an ore belt with the same guns that fight the pirate swarm, race your fuel home, and push each run deeper toward a dying star. A top-down mining-survival score chase.

title: Stellar Smash
short_description: Save the universe from complete darkness by destroying bricks one by one in this brick breaking game. Challenge bosses, master ball control and upgrade your ship. Let the main character, Astra, guide you through the game.

title: StellarMythos:TheJourney
short_description: 《StellarMythos》blends auto-chess synergies with lane pushing. Explore hex maps, expand territory, deploy producers, and activate race/element buffs. Your army advances automatically. Defeat bosses to unlock planets and commanders.

title: Stelvyr: Colony Defense
short_description: Build and defend a space colony where every unit of power and every crew assignment matters. Expand production, research new technologies, shape the battlefield with walls and weapons, and adapt your strategy against alien swarms across nine campaign operations.

title: Stewart The Fox: Swing it!
short_description: A fast-paced speedrun platformer where you play as Stewart The Fox, improve your runs, and compete on worldwide leaderboards. Master the movement across 15+ maps, race against your ghost, and beat your personal best. Can you become a World Record Holder?

title: Stick A Fork
short_description: A cute incremental game packed with dopamine! Just hover. Stab forks into giant fruit for gold, buy more forks, and pick Boons that stack into big synergies. Smash the fruit into jam and spend it on powerful skills!

title: Stick Crisis
short_description: A stickman roguelite shooter where every run reshuffles combat. Fight from cover across rain-soaked city streets, a hidden jungle base and a desert pursuit, build a powerful loadout, and uncover Project Obelisk’s connection to an impossible artifact.

title: Stickman & Wildland Chariot
short_description: This is an action‑survival game that combines highway exploration, vehicle customization and roguelike shooting. Your war chariot is your only hope. Fire up your engine and embark on this endless survival dash

title: Stickville
short_description: Stickville is a gritty 2.5D life-sim brawler. Start broke in the slums and punch, hustle, and gamble your way to the top of a hand-built city where people keep their own hours and remember what you did. Master deadly martial arts. Crack rare strongboxes.

title: Still Inside
short_description: You came to view a property. The floors don't match the listing. Explore an aging Korean commercial building, examine objects, read abandoned records, and solve puzzles in this first-person 2D point-and-click horror game. This building is not vacant.

title: Still working？
short_description: 《Still Working?》 is a roguelike extraction game that keeps you grinding the 9-to-5 long after you've clocked out. Gear up, then stand off against coworkers from mildly annoying to unbearable — one auto-battle at a time — until you face the Boss and take back what's yours.

title: Stinky Tofu: Kitchen Survivor
short_description: A chaotic kitchen action-roguelite where you play as stinky tofu, auto-aim through hordes of mutant ingredients, fuse kitchen weapons, mutate mid-run, and fight to stay fresh before you spoil.

title: StoneEra
short_description: Build a medieval voxel colony in an editable world. Guide villagers, research technologies, craft supplies, trade with a travelling merchant, raise animals, and engineer flowing water. Shape the terrain and create reusable building plans as your settlement grows.

title: Stop Reading the Cards
short_description: Build a deck, define its priorities, and watch your strategy execute itself. In this satirical single-player roguelike, cards become parts of an automated combat system. Create absurd synergies, adapt your rules, and survive a tower that treats every run like a badly managed show.

title: Store Life Simulator
short_description: Store Life Simulator is a management simulator where you start with a small store and build your own retail empire. Manage products and prices, restock shelves, serve customers, hire employees, expand your store, and open new locations.

title: Stranding Echoes
short_description: STRANDING ECHOES is a minimalist colony sim. Manage the non-corporeal creatures called echo to build your base and survive the heat.

title: Strange island
short_description: You come to on a tropical island, unable to remember your name or how you got there. Explore the island and search for answers, but stay alert: someone is watching you, and the more you learn, the harder it becomes to trust your own conclusions.

title: Strato Alto
short_description: Strato Alto - high flying arcade rogue-lite with classic round survival and permadeath campaign modes. Take off with a variety of aircraft, weaponry, special abilities, to zap, blast and smash your way to victory! Upgrade, repair, and outfit your aircraft to master the stratosphere in Strato Alto!

title: Street Food Restaurant Owner
short_description: Build your own street food business! Cook delicious meals, serve hungry customers, manage ingredients, unlock new recipes, and protect your reputation as you transform a small local food stall into a legendary destination.

title: Strike Wings
short_description: A top-down modernized retro space combat epic. Choose from over fifty warships and be part of massive fleet actions with hundreds of ships on the field. Fly for Earth's church-state or the Martian forge that armed it. Play solo, in split-screen or in co-op.

title: Stuck in a Trench
short_description: You are the High Command. Guide generals as they send soldiers through wartime trenches, make agonizing strategic choices, learn from campaign outcomes, and build a lasting legacy across many fronts.

title: Studio zero
short_description: 《Studio Zero》is a first-person cyberpunk FMV thriller. In a future ruled by megacorporations, every choice you make dictates your fate. Will you shatter the system, become a corporate puppet, or vanish into the neon night? Step in—your choices shape the ending.

title: Studs Up! Win Ugly
short_description: Score goals. Break bodies. Collect teeth. A five-a-side football brawler where pub-league glory comes with broken noses. Recruit a squad of misfits, survive the season and spend your opponents' teeth on the club.

title: Stupid Tankers
short_description: Play as “Ze Germans” in World War II: four friends, one tank, and a chaotic co-op adventure blasting your way to the front.

title: SubSurvival: SSN-13 "Grendel"
short_description: A deep, detailed combat submarine simulator with a lo-fi aesthetic. Manage crew, nuclear reactor, radio, sonar, radar and power all while remaining undetected and completing the mission.

title: Submundus
short_description: A deckbuilding roguelike where your deck is your body, inventory, and clock . Fight, scavenge, and forge your way to the surface. . Wounds, hunger, and exhaustion become cards. When fate deals you a bad hand, you must play it right.

title: Suburban Manager:From Corner Store to Regional Price Cartel & Supply Chain Trust
short_description: Suburban Manager is a hardcore supermarket sim based on Chinese business logic. Scout locations in a 3D sandbox and build a gridless store. Procure goods via App, manage logistics, and handle realistic payrolls including net salary and social security. Experience a pure retail journey.

title: Sudokiller
short_description: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.

title: Suits of Fantasia
short_description: A card-battle RPG built on the "trail game": keep playing cards as long as they connect by suit or number, mixed with poker-hand bonuses. Peek at the deck, reorder fate, sneak in a Joker—bend your luck and chase the 52-card Perfect Chain. A comic fantasy quest with a heartfelt ending.

title: Suixun 01: The Last Customer
short_description: A linear paranormal mystery visual novel driven by dynamic text presentation. As timid but earnest rookie Mao-Rabbit, explore a mall after closing, rescue a customer the night guard cannot see, and uncover the anomaly rules already at work. No branches or bad endings.

title: SumMon
short_description: Capture monsters and shapeshift into them, several at once. Combine their elements in turn-based battles on a hex-grid battlefield. Embark on an adventure to defeat the Summoner Masters and become one.

title: SummonFall
short_description: Build a summon-powered warband in a single-player fantasy horde-survival action RPG. Dodge while your weapons and summons attack automatically, survive five-minute floors, defeat bosses, collect ranked gear, and grow stronger between attempts.

title: Sunborn
short_description: A cosmic incremental about feeding a tiny spark until it goes SUPERNOVA. Drag fuel in yourself, let your colonies and their fleets haul it for you, or do both. Stack 158 upgrades, ram rogue planets, merge with dead stars and slingshot matter out of black holes.

title: Sunday Fighter Pilot
short_description: Take the scenic route or blow stuff up. Fly warbirds and jets across a colorful open world, discover airfields and unlock new aircraft. Enjoy relaxed exploration in Casual flying, or unleash guns and rockets to destroy ground targets and capture territory.

title: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator
short_description: Run your own TCG Card Shop! Crack open surprise eggs, collect rare cards and toy parts, and raise birds to produce eggs on your farm. Stock shelves, set prices, and serve customers as you grow your store in this shop simulator.

title: Super Marble Machine
short_description: Super Marble Machine is a marble-shooting Roguelite. Collect unique Marble Cores, customize your own marble board, and combine different items and marbles to create powerful builds and chase massive scores! Forget your worries, fire away, and challenge your high score!

title: Super Piotr Deluxe
short_description: Piotr got flushed into a test world built by a scientist who won't let him leave. Jump from platform to platform while your weapons fire on their own, survive enemy waves and bosses, and push your run through five worlds as far as you can.

title: Super Survivors
short_description: A superhero roguelite. Equip a power to each part of your body and combine them with hundreds of items that can change everything. Transform powers, upgrade your attributes, modify the shop, or alter the rules. Survive 20 waves against the minions of a corrupt president and defeat their leader.

title: Supercar Collection Together
short_description: Manage your own diecast store with friends! In this 1-4 player collection game, open surprise car packs, build your collection, race against customers, trade cards online, and grow your business together.

title: Supernatural Archives：The Frontrooms
short_description: A first-person light psychological horror exploration game. Explore unknown spaces, observe environmental anomalies, discover hidden clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets behind the Frontrooms.

title: Survindust
short_description: Stranded on a tiny island, craft new land tile by tile and grow a bare camp into an automated industrial base. Fend off raiders and sea creatures, capture them and put them to work, then build the ship that gets you out. Survive solo or with a friend.

title: Survival Billiards
short_description: One cue ball. A table full of red balls. Enemies closing in. Survival Billiards combines billiards physics with turn-based tactics: push enemies back with the cue ball, deal damage with red balls, and bounce shots off the rails to chain hits. Plan your moves and find a way out of the encirclement.

title: Survival Fund Manager
short_description: Senior fund managers put their pride on the line. Read the market first through your own intel network. Reveal or conceal information to steer stock prices your way. Outwit your rivals, earn the highest return, and prove you're the best fund manager.

title: Survival Of Runt
short_description: An open-world PvPvE survival shooter where cooperation and betrayal coexist. Choose between Chaos and Order to claim victory, and if you fall, revive as a formidable Mutant Player to hunt down the remaining survivors.

title: Survivor's Log: N17 Shelter
short_description: Survivor's Log： N17 Shelter The apocalypse has begun. You must survive until rescue arrives — or find a way to evacuate. Explore the ruins, manage resources, and face events and the dangers of unknown lifeforms. Endure to the very end alongside your beloved dog and lover.

title: Sven Rescues a Princess
short_description: Sven Rescues a Princess is a 3D co-op horde brawler for 1–10 players. Hack and slash through 30–45 minute runs to save six princesses, then live with whatever you brought home. Hordes keep time with the music. Unlock everything by playing. No microtransactions or loot boxes.

title: Swarmbreak
short_description: Swarmbreak is a Twin-stick survival shooter/bulletheaven with a swarm that never stops. Grab weapons off the floor, pick perks every level-up, and perma unlock new characters, weapons and harder Threat levels with every run. Then push past your best time.

title: Swarmdle
short_description: A survivors-like roguelite. Fight down through three areas, collect weapons and upgrades, and unlock permanent upgrades between runs. Plus a twelve-minute daily run that is identical for every player in the world.

title: Sweet or... Sweet?
short_description: A story-driven visual novel with point-and-click elements about one evening shift at an unusual candy shop. Talk to customers, figure out who is human and who is supernatural, and make sure everyone gets the right sweet.

title: Swimcraft: Fishing Simulator
short_description: Turn your favourite swims into virtual fishing venues in a cozy angling sim grounded in real watercraft. Snap any water, stock it with fish, tie authentic rigs, read the swim, and land the specimen of a lifetime. Your swim, crafted.

title: Swirl Together
short_description: A mesmerizing cooperative exploration for two to eight people, or a sandbox for one. Explore the colors and motion dynamics, save presets of your favorites to enjoy later and swap with others, and share a canvas with a friend, or a stranger, and make something neither of you could have made alone.

title: Sword and Sweep
short_description: Every enemy is a hidden board puzzle. Find the weak points, avoid the traps, and figure out how it fights before it kills you. Roguelike dungeon crawler with deep build customization.

title: Symbiosis: Criticality
short_description: Start with a click. Collect the bits. Build a machine that does the work for you. Grow a reactor full of drones, beams, and automated machinery. Upgrade your firepower and keep collection moving as the screen fills with activity.

title: Synapse Grid
short_description: A neon light-cycle combat racer where the wall you leave behind becomes the arena. Amber kills. 90-mission campaign, 2–4 player split-screen, online beta (unproven). Out now in Early Access, with a free demo.

title: Syncline
short_description: Roll a line of cubes across the board until a cube touches every goal. Stand it on end to climb, break it against walls, and pick up the cubes you left behind. Inspired by Bloxorz and Cuboid, with over 90 hand-made levels, a level editor, and community packs on mod.io.

title: Synemancy
short_description: Sling spells to overwhelm your opponents in card-based online duels, or immerse in a deep single-player story about the pursuit of knowledge and power, where every choice matters. Stake your very mind and become a Synemancer!

title: System Arrival
short_description: Top-down co-op survival action RPG for 1–4 players in a world the System turned into a game. Earn levels, quests and psychic powers, scavenge the ruins, fight zombies and build an underground bunker for survivors — then find out what the System really wants.

title: TAJRISH 1994
short_description: Someone's old computer. Tajrish Metro Underground, 1994. The video files on it aren't videos — they're tapes you walk through, first-person, as the person holding the camera. Read the files. Play the footage. Repair what's corrupted. What the damage was hiding is worse than the damage.

title: TAKTAKTOP
short_description: Vertical jump action to escape the sky! Shoot projectiles to pave your way in Build Mode, or adapt to shifting tiles in Random Mode. Pass tokens via missiles to aid or revive allies—stay immune while tokenless. Reach the top exit with tokens to win! (Up to 12 players online)

title: TCG Card Chaos
short_description: Sort 5,000+ collectible cards scattered across a chaotic card shop. Inspect their types, rarities, numbers and symbols, open card packs, discover graded cards, and find the correct place for every card.

title: TCG Card Collection: Tidy Up
short_description: Organize and restore a special collection of 3,200 TCG cards. Clean each card and reveal their true glory. Match and sort them to sixteen themed sets. Turn a room full of chaos back to a collector's gallery.

title: TCG Card Market Simulator
short_description: Take charge of your very own local trading card shop! Order booster packs, hunt for ultra-rare foils, design your store layout, and set market prices. Rip packs to display holy grail singles or sell sealed boxes to build the ultimate card collector's paradise.

title: TCG Shop Life
short_description: Run your dream TCG shop! Stock shelves, open card packs, customize your store, and hire staff. Collect cards, build powerful decks, and even compete in tournaments all the way to the World Championship!

title: TEST 5
short_description: Act as AIB Test 5, operate within a surreal virtual skyscraper, wield an extensive arsenal of weapons and gear, defeat hostiles, collect loot, and complete an infinite stream of test trials.

title: TEXAS DOMINOES
short_description: Play classic All Fives dominoes with a Texas twist. Score in multiples of five, control the Spinner, draw from the Boneyard, or block the game.  Play against friends or solo. Relive your best rounds with game replays, stats, and badges.

title: THE BOY'S WORD
short_description: “The Boy's Word” is a visual novel about growing up in a Moscow suburb in the 2000s. Lena, 16, is pulled into the local courtyard crew, where friendship, first love and family secrets come at a price. 10 characters, 5 endings — your choices decide everything.

title: THE FIGHT BUSINESS: BOXING PROMOTER
short_description: Build a boxing promotion from small halls to huge stadiums. Sign fighters, negotiate fights, build cards, manage broadcasting and finances, and compete in an evolving boxing world. Play as a Promoter, or control both gym and promotion as a Trainer + Promoter.

title: THE OCCULT PROTOCOL
short_description: THE OCCULT PROTOCOL is a paranormal investigation horror game for solo or online co-op. Gather evidence, identify the entity, survive its hunts, and prepare the right ritual to banish it.

title: THREE KINGDOMS: STRATEGY SIMULATOR
short_description: Three Kingdoms Strategy Simulator is an AI-native historical strategy title. Every NPC possesses independent cognition and persistent long-term memory. None of the regional warlords are pre-scripted routines hardcoded into the game engine。

title: TIDE OR HIDE
short_description: Three minutes of daylight. Ninety seconds of night. TIDE OR HIDE is a 1-4 player co-op survival game where the deep water guarding your camp drains away every night - zone by zone - and armed hunters come for what you stockpiled. Gather, arm up, and hold until dawn.

title: TILEZ
short_description: A 2D creative logic sandbox where every tile is a tiny machine that can tell other tiles what to do. Inspired by Redstone, LEGO, and Tabletop Simulator. CREATE and PLAY SOLO or with FRIENDS.

title: TIP or RIP
short_description: TIP or RIP is a fast-paced action roguelike where you serve hungry monsters before they lose patience and eat you. Dash between tables, throw food, build ridiculous serving abilities, survive three increasingly dangerous restaurants, and feed the final mega-boss.

title: TOKYO WANTED
short_description: Hide-and-seek meets tag, in a crowd of 100. The stage is TOKYO. Slip through unseen and reach the goal, or work the wanted poster and stop the escape. A 3v3 team game between fugitives and hunters. Up to six players online at once; CPU fills any empty seats, so you can play solo.

title: TOWERMOUTH
short_description: Couch co-op bullet heaven inside a tower that talks back. Two knights on one screen - or online with Remote Play Together - climb twenty floors on the clock to its mouth, then fall into endless HELL. Your weapons fire themselves: you hop walls, stack cards into absurd builds and get mocked.

title: TOWERTOWER
short_description: Stack. Mislead. Wipe them out. A punishing tower defense about building a fortress out of stacked blocks. Every tower is a weapon, a wall, and a piece of terrain that leads enemies astray. Let 50 through and it is over.

title: TOX-17
short_description: Analyze real video footage to solve a poisoning case. Discover the country, city, neighborhood and final location. Every detail may be a clue.

title: TROUBLE SHOOTERS
short_description: Four WARDEN contractors against an alien incursion. A 2D roguelite run-and-gun: procedurally assembled zones, stacking gear that gets out of hand, and five bosses that fill the screen. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

title: TV Station Tycoon
short_description: Build and manage your own TV station. License shows, create schedules, attract viewers, sell advertising, grow your audience, and compete for the top spot in the ratings in this broadcasting management tycoon.

title: Table of War
short_description: A tactics roguelike deckbuilder where you command an army, not a hero. Units move and fight on their own action points; your deck calls in reinforcements, ordnance and orders. Every soldier has a name, a rank, and exactly one life. Build the army. Read the board. Lose them anyway.

title: Tabletop Shop Simulator
short_description: Tabletop Shop Simulator is a simulation game where you manage your store by offering tabletop gaming experiences to customers and selling collectible figures. Complete collections through your sales to earn rewards and grow your shop!

title: Tabletop Survivors
short_description: Tabletop Survivors is a turn-based roguelike card RPG driven by random events, where every playthrough tells a new story. You will survive and fight in a zombie apocalypse, making difficult choices and writing your own survival journey.

title: Tabletop TD
short_description: A random tower defense around a tavern table, where everyone defends their own board. Spend gold to draw towers, place them by hand and merge three of a kind to raise their grade. Survive 30 waves to win, or lose when enemies fill your board. Play solo or online with up to 4 players.

title: Tai Chi Tarot
short_description: In just three minutes a day, draw Tarot through an original Bagua spread and receive a symbolic daily reading — a daily ritual where Eastern wisdom meets Western Tarot. Explore nine life themes across twenty-eight cards and eight palaces, framed by a quiet, ink-wash world built for reflection.

title: Tailor Hotel
short_description: Tailor Hotel is a management simulation game where you build and run your very own one-of-a-kind hotel.

title: Tainted Tide
short_description: The world is drowning, and the Tainted are evolving. Scavenge, upgrade your raft, and survive each passing day in this roguelite survival RPG. Master match-3 combat, dodge deadly attacks, craft powerful abilities, and fight to finish a mission humanity cannot afford to lose.

title: Taiyi Saga
short_description: Taiyi Saga is a deck-building roguelike set in Chinese mythology. Pulled into a god's private realm, you build your deck, battle rival gods' invaders, and collect relics forged from ancient beasts — fighting your way toward the truth, and a way home.

title: Takeout Mania
short_description: Build a food-delivery empire in a real city. Sign its restaurants, dispatch couriers down actual streets, and out-market two entrenched rivals — from a lone scooter to a city-spanning operation. Play any city on Earth and watch a living economy boom, franchise, or go bankrupt.

title: Tale Sweeper
short_description: Tale Sweeper blends incremental progression with light loot mechanics. Hack and slash monsters, complete quests, and gather gold and materials. Use your loot to upgrade a massive skill tree, craft powerful weapons, and buy potions to gear up for your next adventure!

title: Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592
short_description: A 3D tactics RPG set in a fantasy retelling of the Imjin War of 1592 in Korea. Command your squad across height-based grids where elemental matchups and terrain turn the tide. Branch through a three-tier class tree and forge deep equipment builds to make every unit your own.

title: Tale'Switch
short_description: Change a book's keywords and rewrite its ending. Trapped in an unfamiliar study, investigate locations, deduce the properties of objects, and connect clues across different tales. Can you unlock the witch's story?

title: Tank Them All
short_description: The ultimate tank party game! 2–6 players blast each other in quick one-hit rounds — on one screen, online or via Remote Play Together. Grab 16 wild power-ups, survive spike traps, tornadoes and air raids across 90+ arenas and 4 modes. Bots fill every empty seat.

title: Tank of the Fittest
short_description: Tank of the Fittest is a dark aquarium roguelite. Twist heat, pH, oxygen, and pollution to cull the weak, trigger new traits and evolutions, set off chains of devouring, and forge one apex specimen powerful enough to turn the tank against itself.

title: TapTrapGrow
short_description: Light up a pest-filled garden, send turtle shells ricocheting and protect your cakes. Turn short hunts into permanent upgrades and elemental chain reactions in this arcade incremental game, then take on a six-boss finale.

title: Tapis
short_description: Tapis is a score-chasing roguelike played on a game table. Tokens fall onto the board, each with its own effect based on its position and family. Your goal: score a huge amount of points. To help you, you'll have repositioning moves to strategically place your tokens and maximize your score.

title: TaskFall
short_description: In TaskFall, you and your friends take on tasks from the mysterious Citadel. The work is not difficult. At least, that’s what they say in the Citadel. Complete tasks on fully destructible levels, make it out alive, buy new equipment, and gradually uncover the secrets of the Citadel.

title: Tatomic
short_description: Drop linked atoms, build color chains to critical mass, and ignite spectacular combos in a kinetic falling-block puzzle game with 30 escalating levels. Three gameplay modes: Critical Mass, Radioactive Survival, and Puzzle.

title: Tattie Bogle
short_description: You are the scarecrow. On a small farm at the edge of the woods, a Tomte's magic pulled you off your post and gave you a job: keep the harvest alive. Can you turn the place around before it all falls apart? A challenging fairytale roguelite, solo or 2-4 player online co-op.

title: Tavern Deep Cauldron
short_description: Become the owners of a mythical tavern where you'll have to brew magic potions together for extraordinary creatures, consulting an ancient book of recipes. It’s a dynamic co-op game where every drink does more than just quench thirst—it holds its own special secret

title: Tavernia
short_description: A strategy board game for 2–8 players. Answer trivia to claim empty tiles, then beat your opponents in minigame duels to take theirs. Play cards to challenge them to typing races, word puzzles, reaction tests, and more.

title: Taxi Shift
short_description: Rent a taxi, cover your 8-hour in-game shift costs, and try to finish with a profit. Navigate without a GPS route line by reading the map, street names and landmarks, then choose the best route for each fare.

title: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive
short_description: TEACH MY LITTLE SISTER HOW TO DRIVE is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads. Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice.

title: Teach, She's Really Mad!
short_description: Text your girlfriend during class in this funny first-person stealth game. Type your replies, watch the teacher, and hide your phone before they check your desk.

title: Technologia
short_description: Lead your civilization from the Stone Age into the future in a card-driven strategy game. Gather resources, manage workers, build a settlement, discover technologies, and shape history through trade or conquest.

title: Teen Hustler
short_description: Pay off your family's $78,150 bank debt: work, hack, mine crypto, launder cash, build a rig and dodge the police. A story-driven hacker sim with 5 chapters and 4 endings.

title: Tempus Inceptum
short_description: Compete in daily global economic strategy challenges. Build production chains, manipulate markets, and outscore rival AI factions on shared leaderboards.

title: Terraform Co: Factory and City
short_description: One pod, one core, and an unsurveyed plot on a green world. Clear the ground, trap native grazers, mine metal and rock, and belt it all into a factory — then build the city that buys what you make. Fill contracts, climb the S&G-15 index, and keep the raiders off your core.

title: Terrahold
short_description: Build an autonomous colony on a living procedural planet. Gather resources, command robots, reshape the terrain, expand your power grid, and defend the teleporter from an ecosystem that reacts to your growth. Establish the link — or lose everything.

title: Texas Oil Baron
short_description: Oil tycoon game, where half the action takes place underground. You buy land, prospect for oil, drill, pump, and transport the product. You can sell at local buyer or sign supply contracts at fixed prices. Profitability is dictated by market forces - politics, weather, and collusion.

title: That Mountain Needs to Fall
short_description: An incremental game about dwarves and mining. Send your dwarves against the mountain, watch the ore fly and turn a single house into an army of different dwarves. Call the heroes of Ragnarok, conquer the mountain, unleash Ragnarok and start over stronger with Odin's blessings.

title: That pricing Man
short_description: During a series of negotiations with the local old aristocracy, his partner is poisoned and killed. After several days of deliberation, he decides to use his remaining advantage as the caravan manager to manipulate the town’s economy and uproot every local faction that stands in his way.

title: That's Not My Bowl
short_description: Cook homemade cat food and serve it to the pickiest customers on Earth. Learn every breed's tastes as you feed your way across the world's cities, one perfect bowl at a time. A cozy cooking and collection game.

title: The Abyss’s Last Breath
short_description: The Abyss’s Last Breath: blends survival, escape‑room gameplay and immersive simulation into a unique psychological horror experience. You control John, the only volunteer in a secret mission to descend to the edge of the Earth’s core.

title: The Adventure of Spyke
short_description: Join Spyke where the worst day of his life suddenly takes a turn and becomes an epic adventure. Solve challenging puzzles, use mystical tools, and fight robots, venom-spitting organ harvesters, terrifying creatures, and much more in this low-poly, top-down, action RPG puzzler.

title: The Adventurer's Guild Idler
short_description: Manage your adventurer's guild and send your party to the frontlines against demon foot soldiers and powerful commanders. Watch your tank, warrior, mage and ranger battle monsters, collect loot, train, grow stronger and set out again.

title: The Art Keeper
short_description: Restore forgotten galleries, create art, decorate your space, and turn 3D sketches into physics objects in a puzzle sandbox—while uncovering the quiet mystery behind more than 400 paintings.

title: The Attending
short_description: You are the attending on the night shift in an emergency department. Your doctors work the cases and bring you their plans to sign. Read the chart, find the patient who is sicker than the workup says, and decide which of your doctors you trust.

title: The Bastard Who Rewrote The Empire Season 1
short_description: Fully voiced in Cantonese. Free demo with the full Chapter 1 out already! You wake as a bastard prince facing execution—and you can read more than what people say. Use Inner Voice, Sincerity, Appraisal, and X-Ray Vision to expose lies and secrets, win allies, and rewrite a kingdom’s fate.

title: The Berliner
short_description: The Berliner is your quintessential bakery and cafe simulator set in 1980s west Berlin. You can explore the walled city, bake pastries, brew coffee, serve and deal with customers. Grow your business or spend it all at the bar its up to you. And don’t forget this is Berlin! Don't let your guard down.

title: The Big Suck
short_description: An arcade incremental where you ARE the tornado. Suck up cows, flatten cities, and spend the cash on upgrades between runs. Become fire, flood, winter or void. Start with a blade of grass. Tear Earth apart, then take your storm to an alien world. Raise cows on a farm of your own.

title: The Canon Keeper
short_description: Papers, Please, but you're inspecting Scripture instead of passports. In a world where the Bible is outlawed, examine smuggled verses, uncover alterations, and decide what to preserve or burn. Every mistake strengthens demonic forces threatening the last surviving underground churches.

title: The Child Who Serves the Hanul
short_description: A linear, story-driven 2D adventure set in Korea's Donghak era. Deliver secret letters, evade soldiers, and talk with villagers as the story unfolds through illustrated cutscenes blended with live-action footage, in one boy's coming-of-age journey.

title: The Cinder Throne
short_description: The Cinder Throne is an Idler RPG where you passively kill enemies, level up, loot enemies, change pieces of equipment and find spells. Create powerfull synergies. Rebirth and come back stronger than ever

title: The Clownhouse
short_description: Solo or co-op for up to 4 players: break into a cursed, procedurally generated mansion, steal everything you can, and escape before the horrors inside find you. A no-combat stealth horror extraction roguelite where greed kills more players than enemies do.

title: The Clues
short_description: The Clues is a challenging logic deduction game set in Paw Town. Play as a cat detective, read the clues, and identify every Criminal and Innocent. No guessing, no luck—every handcrafted puzzle has a unique solution.

title: The Crown
short_description: From humble beginnings, rise up to take your place in the city's underworld! Your choices will decide how the story plays out in this Visual Novel about crime in the 2000s East Coast. Choose-Your-Own-Adventure, Stat-driven, Deep Meta-progression.

title: The Crown of The Vermillion Devil
short_description: Follow an Emperor's bounty to a rain-soaked island where the locals are going strange, an ancient god is waking, and you are exactly where you were meant to be. A narrative text RPG with real consequences.

title: The Cup: Creature Card Battler
short_description: A free roguelike deckbuilder and 1v1 creature card battler, with the dice printed on the cards. Draft a line of real North American animals and a few cryptids, make your swing, and watch the die TV decide how hard it lands while the booth calls every roll.

title: The Dark Forest Calls
short_description: The world forgot Psara, but the island did not forget you. In this story-driven first-person survival horror, explore its fog-shrouded shores as Elias Whitmore, evade creatures drawn to light and sound, manage scarce supplies, and uncover why Psara vanished from human memory.

title: The Dark Layer
short_description: You are an investigator granted access to the "Paranormal Event Archive Management System." Browse century-old case files. Search for clues. But be careful—the archives are watching you now. >_ Files that watch back. Disappearances unexplained. Messages never sent.

title: The Dawn Forge
short_description: Keep the last forge burning. Buy iron, hammer blades, sell to the travellers who walk in — and every spark you throw makes the dark see you further. Arm your neighbours, direct turn-based battles, and cut ten expeditions into the Long Night. Nothing advances while you are away.

title: The Day I Became a Werewolf
short_description: Your latest scientific research has gone horribly wrong. Fix it before it catches up to you, or face the consequences.

title: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest
short_description: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest - a standalone story set in the world of The Derailed. While investigating a mass disappearance, you find yourself at an abandoned factory. Answers lie within - but they come at a high price. Are you ready?

title: The Endless Harvest
short_description: The Endless Harvest is an idle village-builder crossed with a tower defense. Build a farm that earns money on its own, invest it in towers and upgrades, and survive waves of raiders that grow stronger every round. Production continues while the game is closed — how far will you get?

title: The Final Exhibit
short_description: Explore a mysterious museum, restore corrupted works of art and uncover the truth behind the presence lurking within in this psychological horror game.

title: The Final Like
short_description: THE FINAL LIKE. A fruit machine with a mind of its own. An authentic UK AWP simulator built around the world of social media - where the machine’s AI is watching, and has no intention of letting you walk away a winner.

title: The Final Stamp
short_description: Papers, Please in the afterlife. Question the dead, uncover their sins with strange instruments, and decide: Hell, Heaven, or Purgatory. Even Johny Goldstein has a story that makes him innocent. Check it before you reach for the stamp.

title: The Fixer
short_description: Football star on Saturday, match fixer the rest of the week. Rig matches for the syndicate, buy the referee, and keep your suspicion from hitting 100. Free demo: play your first 10 weeks, then carry the save into the full game.

title: The Fly's Fantastic Adventure
short_description: The Fly’s Fantastic Adventure is a 2D run-and-gun platformer about an innocent little fly who finds a weapon shaped like a fruit fly and sets out to defeat the spider that has always been chasing him.

title: The Fox Vanishes: The Mystery of Mistveil
short_description: Writer Wang Ran ventures into the isolated Mistveil Village in search of a missing girl. There, an ancient rite — the Rite of Sui-Banishing — is being held. Amid the mist, villagers die one by one, and everyone hides secrets of their own. Who can you trust?

title: The Frog Prince: Unfrogged
short_description: Once a prince, but accidentally turned into a frog. Lash your tongue to collect insects, feed the witch’s cauldron, and turn catches into magical essence. Upgrade your skills, survive nasty bugs to restore your prince status in this cozy incremental clicker.

title: The Goblin Path
short_description: A single-player action RPG about a goblin serving the Demon King. Scout the next party at night, steal their gear, and prepare poisons and traps. By day, defend your lair and loot the heroes you defeat.

title: The Grid Detective
short_description: A hacker-noir logic deduction game where you mark grids True or False to deduce the one solution hidden in unlimited, freshly generated puzzles, each proven solvable by pure logic before you ever see it.

title: The Guidelines : Hotel Napoli
short_description: “High Pay, Simple Work, Room and Board Provided.” Trapped in an isolated room, monitor hotel CCTV and report anomalies. As the days repeat, strange events and memories of the past begin to connect. Follow the hotel's manual. It may be your only guide to survival.

title: The Heir: Steampunk Escape Room
short_description: 1895. In this first-person escape room, you play as Dr. Voss's aspiring scientific heir. Explore an immersive Victorian laboratory, solve ingenious puzzles woven into the environment and the story, and unravel the dark secret behind Voss's experiments.

title: The Highest School: Don’t Look Down
short_description: Your school is waiting at the very top - but to reach it, you’ll have to climb through history itself. Ascend from the Ancient World to the distant future, overcome obstacles, and whatever you do… don’t look down.

title: The House on Grisewood
short_description: A top-down survival horror shooter set in a haunted manor. Explore room by room with a failing flashlight, scavenge ammunition and batteries, and fight or evade what stalks the dark. Reach the ballroom and end what laughs there, or hold out in an endless Zombie Survival mode.

title: The Ice is Watching
short_description: One last GPS pin. One final hope. Following a GPS pin to the cabin, she thought she was coming for a rescue. She didn't know she was stepping into a frozen trap. Stranded and hunted by 'The Ice', you must keep the fire alive to survive the night. Uncover the chilling truth before you become his art

title: The Inconvenience Store
short_description: Explore an endless, procedurally generated furniture store where daylight gives you time to scavenge and build—but after dark, hostile employees begin to hunt. Gather supplies, craft tools, manage your needs, and survive each night.

title: The Infinite Library
short_description: A narrative incremental where the UI tells the story. Discover rare Words, craft Phrases, fill shelves until reality buckles. Each prestige resets the world, but the Library remembers.

title: The Island of Jiji
short_description: After losing his job, Hu Yi drifts into Jiji Island, where an old scammer, a boy obsessed with love, a meat-eating monk, and a girl named Yan become part of his life. Days pass between beaches, salt fields... until he can no longer avoid the question: What kind of life do I want to live?

title: The Kharzov Effect
short_description: CHAPTER 1: 1985. Your friend has vanished into Professor Kharzov's fog-filled estate. Escape-room puzzles. Stalking monsters. Mysterious lore. Now get him out alive.

title: The Last Admiral
short_description: A turn-based space tactics roguelite with no grid. Your own Alliance cut you off without a shot, so you break away with four ships. Fight from behind asteroids, win hulls from the fleets you beat, mix ships from 14 factions, and take the galaxy sector by sector. Lose the run, keep the fleet.

title: The Last Bastion: Beyond the Frontier
short_description: A vertical space shooter about a combat pilot who must break through an enemy armada and warn their homeworld. Maneuver through hostile fire, battle commanders and bosses, upgrade your ship, and assemble powerful equipment synergies.

title: The Last Days Of Ming
short_description: The Jiashen Cataclysm: the empire falls. A motley crew of those with nowhere left to go forms a southward exodus. Turn-based battles, camp management, permadeath—through the blizzards of the late Ming, bring them alive to the south.

title: The Last Helm
short_description: The Last Helm is a management and trading simulation where you build and run your own shop in a fantasy world. Start from scratch, purchase goods, craft weapons and potions, hire employees, and organize expeditions to expand your shop.

title: The Last Lunch
short_description: A psychological cooking horror game set in a post-Soviet school. Cook meals, explore the school and its surroundings, and uncover the disturbing story hidden behind an ordinary cafeteria shift.

title: The Last Match
short_description: Her profile looked perfect. The woman sitting across from you is anything but. What begins as an ordinary date soon turns into a disturbing fight for survival. Watch her behavior, choose your words carefully, and uncover the terrifying truth behind your last match.

title: The Last Station - Baku
short_description: A first-person psychological survival horror set in the abandoned Baku subway. Explore dark tunnels, solve puzzles, investigate disturbing mysteries, and make emotional choices while trying to survive against terrifying horrors.

title: The Last Train: End of the Line
short_description: A dark, story-driven game with elements of visual novel, exploration, and survival. Explore an old train and an infested sector, scavenge for supplies, make decisions, and discover whether you can trust a girl named Mia—and your own memories.

title: The Last Zeppelin
short_description: A casual, retro-inspired 2D shooter with an alt-history twist! Pilot the last German Zeppelin in a parallel universe against a reptilian army. Master your Zero-Energy Impulse and blast through biplanes, pterosaurs and flying saucers. Simple controls, escalating difficulty, and pure arcade action.

title: The Lies: Impostor Heiress
short_description: A mystery-driven interactive drama where you take the place of an heiress who died in a supposed accident. Every choice shapes your relationships and the story. Keep up the act, earn their trust, or uncover the truth. Your fate is in your hands.

title: The Lifeline
short_description: To escape this terrifying hospital, you must leave your fears behind. Can you do it? Explore, face zombies, use weapons, avoid traps, and react fast to survive.

title: The Little Stomping Girl
short_description: Tiny stomps. Explosive combos! Mine ore before your match burns out in this incremental mining game. Fit gear into limited equipment slots, collect unique items, and combine skills to turn a little girl's stomps into powerful chain reactions. Light another match, grow stronger, and dig deeper!

title: The MachinEGG
short_description: Welcome to The MachinEGG, a relaxing idle/clicker game where eggs are your greatest treasure. Buy chickens, feed them, sell their eggs, and automate your way to retirement!

title: The Maze: In Dark
short_description: Rely on a single flashlight to recover important documents from a factory shrouded in darkness. Escape without being seen by 'Him', who roams the factory at random. Overcome the intense fear of the unknown that lurks in the dark, and complete your mission safely.

title: The Neighborhood Liars
short_description: A cozy cul-de-sac. Twelve neighbors. Everybody lies — and the street writes it all down. Bluff any card, slam LIAR! at the right moment and search the garden of whoever got caught, before the impostor buries a bomb in yours. Social deduction for 4-12, with voice, rooms with friends and bots.

title: The Next Room
short_description: The Next Room is a fast-paced 3D action roguelite where every room is a new challenge and every decision can mean the difference between survival and death. Fight your way through relentless monsters, avoid deadly traps, uncover hidden secrets, and defeat powerful bosses guarding the path ahead.

title: The Night Kitchen
short_description: The Night Kitchen is a psychological horror game. You just started a new job - the night shift in a kitchen. Grill, oven, deep fryer. Take orders, prepare the food, talk to the customer. Simple work. Seven nights. Each one stranger than the last.

title: The Ninth Cycle
short_description: This is an incredibly smooth 3D roguelike. If you're looking for fast-paced, satisfying roguelike gameplay, this game is well worth a try.

title: The Nugget
short_description: Search the Australian outback for gold in a first-person prospecting survival simulation. Tune your detector, dig up targets, wash paydirt, manage food, water, heat and fuel, and keep your camp running.

title: The Observation Exit
short_description: A first-person psychological horror where you must identify anomalies, choose the correct elevator to progress, and escape an endless loop in a hospital corridor while avoiding deadly entities.

title: The Odd Cafe Case Files
short_description: Pick up “words” from conversations and combine them with evidence to uncover the truth behind the cases. A former detective turned coffee shop owner takes on a series of baffling cases. As you get closer to the truth, your own “lost memories of the past” begin to unravel—

title: The Off-Season
short_description: The seaside hotel is shut from October to March, and the winter caretaker is you. The owner's rules are pinned beside the key board: no guests. Somebody knocks anyway, after the last bus, in the rain, with cash and no booking. You decide who gets a key, and which room.

title: The Offering
short_description: The Offering is an incremental game where you grab creatures to collect offerings, buy upgrades and defend your shrine at night. Stack boons, forge weapons, catch goblins and ascend through worlds!

title: The Offering Hour
short_description: A strategy-action roguelike where time is your only currency, and your life. Every summon, spell and deal costs seconds; even opening your grimoire costs one. Summon monsters against cunning hero bosses, then sacrifice three of your own to become a demon and fight in person.

title: The Order Of Serenity : Cult Simulator
short_description: The Order of Serenity is a psychological horror simulation where you play as an undercover journalist infiltrating a secret cult, carrying out disturbing duties, making unsettling choices, and earning trust to uncover the truth from within.

title: The Park Keeper
short_description: Become a ranger in a national park where people have doubles. Check visitors, explore the forest, and help its strange inhabitants. A copy might be better than the original. But does that give it the right to take their place?

title: The Previous Owner
short_description: Run a secondhand bookshop in London, 1994. Every book remembers who owned it before — pressed flowers, letters, notes in the margins. Across books that should never have met, the same hand keeps writing. You inherited the rules with the shop: shelve carefully, and do not read the margins.

title: The Proxy
short_description: The Proxy is a narrative political simulation game set in a fictional nation, Leviah. The president is dead, and the office is yours. Sign papers that decide the fate of your nation, trade on secrets only you know, and juggle the ones who all want something. Protect the country, or protect yourself?

title: The Queens
short_description: The Queens is a fast-paced party game for 2–4 players who take turns playing cards and race to slap the pile first when they spot a match. Overcome challenges, avoid wrong moves, and grab the final card to become the queen of the table!

title: The Red Weight
short_description: A story-rich mystery on Mars where your choices matter. You play as a geologist in a Martian habitat investigating a secret that has been ten thousand years patient.

title: The Rouge Casino
short_description: Eight crooked casino tables, one roguelite spine. Rig the wheel, load the dice, mark the cards — stack charms, omens and gilded editions until the house edge is yours. Eight antes, eight stakes, eighty challenges, Endless beyond. No real gambling — just a casino you finally get to cheat.

title: The Rug Racket
short_description: Inherit a rundown rug-cleaning shop and master a satisfying craft. Dust, wash, rinse and revive rugs one stain at a time. Build a reputation, keep the lights on, and squirm out from under the mob family that owns your debt. Every rug's a small win, and every tribute payment says you're not free yet.

title: The Rule of Adult
short_description: Unable to find work, you unwittingly join ruthless HarborTech. A strange contract traps your soul. Manage time and resources, meet KPIs and fight turn-based battles to reclaim your soul and quit within 10 weeks. Uncover its secrets in this workplace psychological horror RPG.

title: The Scarlet Thread
short_description: A Victorian manor mystery in fine 1-bit ink, touched with scarlet. Read the accounts of different narrators, examine clothing and ledgers, and re-enact the night. Spotting lies is only part of the case: how much does an honest account really prove?

title: The Serena Villa Files
short_description: 'FMV Queen' Wang Han's First K-FMV! At your new job as a security guard in a women's only residence, feelings blossom between you and the charming residents, but strange events also haunt you from your first day. What mystery awaits you and the five ladies of Serena Villa?

title: The Seventh Day at the Tsubaki House - Whoever You Accuse Is Guilty
short_description: A Japanese mystery adventure where any of the four could be the killer. Holding the dead man's will, you stay in his estate until the seventh-day memorial. Question the household across 13 locations, but you get only ten moves. Motive, opportunity and proof decide what your accusation is worth.

title: The Sixth Die
short_description: The Sixth Dice is a dice-building roguelike with poker hands. Roll five dice, re-roll and modify them to form pairs, straights, or five-of-a-kind. Collect runes, skills, and relics to forge unique builds. Defeat the final boss to unlock the Sixth Dice—showing any number you choose—and endless mode.

title: The Sixth Sin
short_description: The Sixth Sin is a horror game set in a suspense-filled atmosphere where you battle demons, supernatural beings, and puzzles, surviving through your own ingenuity. The voice guiding you is one of them. Manage your inventory, complete rituals, and never let go of the light or your magical items.

title: The Son of Stone
short_description: Play as Sosruko, a warrior born from stone, and fight through mythic battles using three distinct combat styles and stone bending abilities.

title: The Soul of Cosmos
short_description: "The Soul of Cosmos"is a dark fantasy adventure game that combines plot choices, tower strategy, and simulation management gameplay. As an extraterrestrial soul, you will coexist with the young girl Yunxi, accompanying her on her journey to find her mother and explore different soul worlds.

title: The Sword in Stone
short_description: You are the heroine of a fantasy story… except you're a sword! Světlavoda is an old historical city, and you're just a Sword in Stone, asleep in the local library. None of it ever seemed to matter to you — until you woke up. You're given one chance: take human form and live in this city.

title: The SwordSmith
short_description: Forge every blade with your own hands. Build your sword formation, battle demons from all sides, and protect the one who waits for you — a heartwarming wuxia journey of crafting, roguelite runs and auto-battles.

title: The Tally
short_description: A PS2-style life sim about being a small, busy person in a mid-sized city. Get a job, buy a home, pet a dog, make some choices. Every one of them is being counted. You will die in about 90 minutes. Then you get the receipt, and the afterlife sorts you accordingly. A life, itemized.

title: The Tram
short_description: Discover tram driving on routes inspired by Eastern and Central Europe of the 2000s. Realistic physics, demanding weather and operating conditions, and a richly detailed city turn every trip into a true driver’s challenge.

title: The Turbo Crown
short_description: Drive cannon-equipped toy cars, jump across giant furniture, and fly with nitro in arcade battles for up to 10 players. Fight online or against bots, master four game modes, and customize every piece with no pay-to-win advantages.

title: The Turing Choice
short_description: Can an AI create a video game and star in it at the same time? The Turing Choice is a sci-fi conversational adventure where your choices change everything. Evaluate K.A.I.R.O.S., an AI that claims to be a SASS, and uncover what is really happening, because nothing is what it seems.

title: The Unhidden
short_description: A third-person survival horror. You wake up bleeding in a fog-drowned park, remembering nothing. The night doesn't end at the cabin: graveyards, caves, sewers and a city hiding something worse. Few bullets, your kicks and something you can't kill.

title: The Unskilled
short_description: Die. Retry. Learn the trap. A brutal precision platformer where every level is designed to trick you. Survive hidden traps, impossible surprises, and troll mechanics that punish confidence at every step.

title: The Unworthy
short_description: What if Hell made a mistake? Based on the testimony of a man who survived clinical death, this cinematic psychological horror challenges you to confront your fears and fight your way back to life, while something lurking in the darkness does everything it can to keep you among the damned forever.

title: The Veiled Atlas: A Cycle of Falls
short_description: A turn-based 4X of rival governments contesting the dim Atlas through economy, war and an Influence-weighted Council. At the edge of sensor range, the Shadow does not lose - it only rises.

title: The Winery - Winemaking Simulator
short_description: Build your own winery, craft exceptional wines, and grow your reputation with every vintage. Unlock recipes, master new technologies, host winery events, and weather the seasons — because great winemaking is an art, and every bottle tells a story.

title: The Wrong Way Round
short_description: You’re trapped in a town where every way out brings you back from the other side. Explore with up to 5 friends, uncover the mystery and find a way home before the freezing fog takes over.

title: The Yard: Escape from Prison
short_description: Break out of prison with up to 6 friends — or leave them behind. Blend into the daily routine, smuggle contraband, craft your tools, and slip past the guards. Every escape is planned. Not every escape is shared.

title: They’ll Hang You for That Face
short_description: Tomorrow, you burn at the stake as a "Werewolf". To save your family, you gladly accept a false execution. But after death, you witness them being ravaged in a living hell. Through a time loop triggered by your absolute despair, you must weave the world's kindest lie.

title: This is Sparta
short_description: An action RPG with roguelite elements. Explore the levels of Hades, battle the hordes of enemies, and unlock new abilities and unique items that will increase your chances of survival. Solve puzzles scattered throughout the levels, culminating in a final confrontation with the Titans.

title: This mountain? Got it from my gramps.
short_description: A tactical SRPG where positioning is everything. Every companion has two passive auras that power up allies nearby – guaranteed hits, first strikes, extra attacks, healing and more. Line them up for devastating synergies and conquer the cave. Demo: 5 hours. Full game: 20 chapters.

title: Three Kingdoms Classic: Korea
short_description: Lead Goguryeo, Baekje, or Silla in 660 in a real-time strategy game with pause and speed control. Manage treasury and provisions, raise armies, and march by land and sea as Tang and Wa pursue their own aims. Command field battles and sieges yourself, and carry every result back to the front.

title: Three Kingdoms Reimagined
short_description: Rule a house in China in 196 AD, alone or with a friend. Expand across a pausable real-time map of the Han realm, command thousands of soldiers in field battles and sieges, then press C and fight on as your general, in duels where the blades lock and clash.

title: Three Kingdoms Story
short_description: Choose a faction, recruit officers, raise troops, and conquer rival strongholds across board-style maps in large-scale real-time battles.

title: Three Kingdoms: March
short_description: Three Kingdoms: March is a tactical strategy simulation where you command troops with drag-based orders and build your realm through officers, policies, and research. Outmaneuver enemies in real-time battles, strike their flanks and rear, and prepare your path to unification.

title: Throneforged
short_description: Forge your empire. Claim the throne. A competitive 4X strategy game where every tile matters, every decision counts, ZERO RNG, and one win condition exists. Claim the central Throne and hold it for 10 turns.

title: Throneguard: Last Stand
short_description: Become the last guardian of the kingdom and defend the throne! Fight on the front lines with your sword, build barricades and towers between waves, and upgrade your hero. Throneguard: Last Stand is a 3D medieval action tower defense game.

title: Thump: Tiny Heart Flutters
short_description: Thump: Tiny Heart Flutters is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. Complete puzzles one after another to uncover the hidden feelings and secrets of the girls hidden in daily trivialities. Here it’s only you, a puzzle, and a girl who’s been waiting for you.

title: Tianyan Jie: Relics of Qiankun
short_description: Tianyan Jie: Relics of Qiankun is a wuxia action roguelike in ink-wash style. Choose your sect, enter the heavenly tribulation, clear linked rooms, and stack secret manuals with Qiankun relics into brutal melee combos. Every run reshapes your build—fight through mist and ink, and survive.

title: Tick & Tired
short_description: Tick & Tired is an incremental game about overcoming your to-do list. Complete short desktop tasks like sorting emails and organizing files, hire interns to automate the work and get massive combos at the end of the day to upgrade your workflow in a skill tree.

title: Tide and Crown
short_description: Command a ship in an open-world pirate trading RPG. Exploit a living economy, run dangerous cargo, fight tactical turn-based naval battles, capture vessels, build a fleet, and choose a life of commerce, piracy, or power.

title: Tides of Empires
short_description: Two empires, one sea. Tides of Empires is the tower defense roguelite game you can finally play competitively. Command warships, aircraft and submarines in ranked 1v1 & 2v2 duels, in a challenging campaign and endless Survival. Rule the tides.

title: Tidy Arcana
short_description: Tidy Arcana is a cozy first person organizing game about restoring a magical library. Return 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions to their matching shelves, working at your own pace with help from a customizable wizard cat.

title: Tidy Up Her Toys
short_description: Alice’s toys are scattered across a haunted mansion — 6,000 of them, hidden in heaps, drawers and dark corners. Explore 20 eerie rooms with Alice’s gentle ghost by your side, gather every toy and return each one to its shelf in the Lobby of Toys. A cozy-spooky hunt for tidy minds.

title: Tidy Up Together: Banknotes
short_description: Turn scattered bundles into neatly filled shelves. Pick up banknotes, recognize each design and find its matching spot. Discover world currencies and imaginative collections, then earn helpful sorting tools through hands-on practice. Build your collection at your own pace.

title: Tidy Up the Magic Mess
short_description: 4,600 spells are scattered across the floor, and they're all yours to put away. Shelve each one in its element's cabinet, then fuse two elements together to create a spell no one has seen before.

title: Tight Tactics
short_description: Be ready for turn-based combat in this roguelite to kick off with the enemy opening fire on you first, trying to keep you from regrouping, and one bad decision leading to the death of your entire upgraded squad

title: Tile Conquest
short_description: Tile Conquest is a turn-based tile area control strategy game. Compete in online multiplayer or fight against advanced bots. Claim territory and dominate the map in multiple win conditions. Win matches to climb the ranked leaderboards, earn exclusive rewards, and unlock items in the shop.

title: Tile Crawl
short_description: Tile Crawl is a tactical roguelite, with spatial puzzle-like battles, free exploration and a catch: you can only hold 6 items and they wear out with each use - so make every hit count!

title: Tilemancer
