short_description: Build a deck of the dead, solve battles disguised as tactical board puzzles, and defeat an even more evil version of yourself, again and again.

title: TimbrianGuard
short_description: Build a colony that is yours, block by block. Shape the terrain and craft detailed homes with sub-voxel building tools, then assign settlers to gather, craft, and prepare for the night. Lead eight settlers in Survival or build freely in an unlimited sandbox.

title: Time Collage: Focus Puzzle
short_description: An ADHD-friendly, low-distraction focus and productivity game built around instant feedback. When distraction or procrastination makes starting hard, this quiet desktop buddy keeps you company through Pomodoro study and work sessions, with to-dos, white noise and puzzle rewards.

title: Time Dungeons
short_description: Team up in 1-4 player co-op to defend relics across shattered timelines. Build deadly towers, unleash hero abilities, grab run changing upgrades, or dive into endless arcade survival and chase the leaderboards before reality collapses.

title: TimeKov
short_description: TimeKov is a third-person survival action game where time is your life. Explore the unknown planet Ananke, fight hostile creatures, recover resources, and grow your base and factory before your core runs out.

title: TinSpring Soccer
short_description: TinSpring Soccer is a physics-driven metal spring table game with ten authentically different boards — from a warped ~1890s oak table to a floating hologram pitch — an opponent AI that plays like a real person, full national tournaments, and local multiplayer for up to four players.

title: Tiny Banners
short_description: A charming pixel-art RTS. Gather wood, gold and meat, raise a village, train units, and go to tiny war against rival banners on a fresh procedural island every game — solo against cunning CPU kingdoms, or with friends over Steam. Be the last tiny banner standing.

title: Tiny Fishing Club
short_description: A cozy desktop fishing companion you can leave beside your work. Fish solo or hang out online with friends, catch rare fish, customize your tiny angler, collect pets, and grow your little club.

title: Tiny Garden Café
short_description: Sow seeds and nurture them, harvest fresh ingredients to cook meals, and serve them to your guests. As the seasons turn and dusk falls, the café lights glow—enjoy a peaceful day in your very own little garden café.

title: Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal
short_description: Your master got pulled into a crystal, so go get him back. A simple, chunky survivor roguelite where your knight swings on his own and you decide what he swings with. Blend fire, frost and lightning into every hit and fight through five biomes.

title: Tire Dealer Simulator
short_description: Take over your father’s debt-ridden tire shop and turn it into a thriving business. Buy and manage stock, negotiate with customers, change and balance tires, hire mechanics, upgrade your shop, take on contracts, and make the financial decisions that determine your future.

title: Titan Bash
short_description: Fight through a sci-fi campaign or battle friends in 4-player local multiplayer. Pilot powerful tanks and mechs, unlock devastating weapons, rescue survivors, and destroy relentless alien hordes in this fast-paced top-down twin-stick shooter.

title: Titanic Survival Simulator Together
short_description: 🚢 Titanic Survival Simulator Together is a cooperative survival game aboard the sinking Titanic. Explore the massive ship, find a way to safety, and survive the cold, darkness, rising water, and deteriorating sanity. Play alone or with up to 4 players. 🧊🌊

title: Toast Cat: Scratch & Win
short_description: Raise a Toast Cat on your desktop that spits out all sorts of scratch cards. Whatever you're doing, it hops along with you; once it's earned enough affection, it'll pull out a scratch card just for you. No need to watch it constantly — scratch one in a spare moment and unwind.

title: Toe-tal War
short_description: TOE-TAL WAR is a platformer where you kill people with your foot smell. Run and jump to make your feet smelly, change your shoes and socks to control the smell — then get close to enemies and stink them to death.

title: Together in Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: A cozy jigsaw puzzle game for solo play or online co-op with up to 8 players. Turn your own images into puzzles, assemble them together in real time, discover community creations, and share yours through the Steam Workshop.

title: TohKago
short_description: Throw it, aim it. Watermelon?—BOOM! A fresh take on a staple of Japanese school sports days. The rules are simple: Pick up fruits and throw them into your team's basket. In a chaotic free-for-all, a single watermelon can make all your steadily collected fruits go BOOM. Who will have the last laugh?

title: Tomb Zombies
short_description: Chaotic Republican-era China shrouded in dark fog. Play as a wandering Taoist with peachwood tools and cinnabar talismans, defeat ghosts and flying jiangshi to calm evil spirits.

title: Tomori: The Lampkeepers
short_description: When the lamps go out, the world turns to ash. Follow Hina, an apprentice Lampkeeper, as she searches for her vanished master. A dark-fantasy adventure RPG of command-based exploration, escape-room puzzles, and tactical turn-based battles — 10 chapters, 5 to 8 hours.

title: Tomorrow Never Comes
short_description: Tomorrow Never Comes is a choice-driven first-person narrative thriller. Trapped in a time loop, Noah must relive the same day, manage his injuries, use items, unlock new paths, and find a way to finally reach tomorrow.

title: Top of That Thing Called Mountain
short_description: Who would you go with on the toughest adventure? Team up with a friend in this 2-player, 2D co-op platformer and guide two dolphins up an impossible mountain. Shoot harpoons, blast air cannons, and swing your way up. Every climb demands perfect teamwork, and one wrong move sends you both tumbling.

title: Topdeck Duel
short_description: An incremental card roguelike where every victory expands your deck! Position cards for powerful buffs, claim enemy cards, and merge them to increase their rarity. Accumulate gold for permanent meta-upgrades between runs and master the Topdeck Duel!

title: Torizon Telecom
short_description: Torizon Telecom is a text-based FPS game set in a vast world composed entirely of text. “Telecom”—a world where everything is text. “Telecom”... But does any other world exist beyond “Telecom”...? Or is “Telecom” the only one that exists...?

title: Torque Trails: Beyond Limits
short_description: Drive a variety of vehicles through challenging platforming tracks across diverse environments. Master precision driving, overcome dynamic obstacles, and conquer unique levels in this single-player driving adventure.

title: Total Club Manager
short_description: A love letter to the football management games that stole your nights. Sign players, build tactics, run the youth academy and the finances, and live every match minute by minute. Take a club from nothing to the top of Europe.

title: Touhou Bansho Cards
short_description: Fight to the end! Once a card is played, don't stop. Push the Combo higher, break the damage limit, and blast through anything in your way! Touhou Bansho Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder. Collect cards, explore the Bansho Card Corridor, defeat Echoes, rescue Gensokyo's girls, uncover the truth.

title: Touhou Sky Cruiser
short_description: Run a sky cruiser built by Tenshi. Expand it room by room with new floors and terraces, offer dining and entertainment, and carry guests from port to port as you grow your business above the clouds.

title: TowOrbs
short_description: TowOrbs is an incremental tower defense game where where you face down hordes of wolves. Master unique tower paths, unlock powerful permanent upgrades and slice through your foes with spinning orbs of destruction!

title: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell
short_description: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell is a roguelite dungeon-crawler where the only way to escape eternal damnation is to climb a seemingly endless, interdimensional tower filled with monsters and temptation. Reforge your soul and climb ever-higher, or become corrupted by the evils lurking within.

title: Town Crazy
short_description: Get across town before time runs out in different levels, find shortcuts, and dodge traffic and obstacles. Fast runs, unpredictable collisions, and leaderboard competition.

title: Town Hall
short_description: The town is half empty, but the town hall still opens at nine. You are the clerk. Whatever your stamp approves becomes true — permits, licenses, names, deaths. Everyone who reaches your desk brings a reason, and most bring money. In the basement, a file explains why the town emptied.

title: Toxic Dating Simulator
short_description: Atakan'ın Binder'da eşleştiği, yaşam tarzları birbirinden farklı olan 3 kadınla randevulardan sağ çıkmaya çalış. Yapacağın seçimlerle Atakan'ın karakterini şekillendir. Kılıbık ol, alfa ol, yalancı ol, dürüst ol, manipülatif ol. Seçimini yap ve sonucuna katlan.

title: Toy Box
short_description: Collect toys, avoid mischievous enemies, and escape colorful mazes in this fast-paced retro-style arcade game inspired by classic maze games!

title: ToyOps
short_description: Tiny agents. Giant world. A rookie squad’s first mission goes wrong. In this action-puzzle adventure, dodge traps and enemies, leap across oversized environments, and combine unique abilities—including teleportation—to solve platforming puzzles and infiltrate enemy territory.

title: Trade or Threat
short_description: Trade or Threat is a first-person shopkeeping and dungeon-crawling simulation where you sell goods by day and search for valuable loot after dark. Earn enough gold to repay your debt to the boss while balancing profit, danger, and the rules imposed on your shop.

title: Traffic Monster
short_description: Traffic Monster is a fast-paced endless runner! Dodge heavy traffic, collect power-ups, and customize your dream car. Challenge real players in online multiplayer, place bets, and survive the chaos!

title: Trash Inc.
short_description: Turn a bankrupt recycling yard into a smooth-running operation in this relaxing incremental management game. Open bags and sort waste by hand, hire a crew, install processing machines, and automate the journey from truck delivery to valuable recycled goods.

title: Traymon World: Taskbar Monster RPG
short_description: The world’s smallest idle monster-collecting RPG. Hatch special monsters from eggs and trade with players around the world. Battles play out automatically, so don’t stop until you’ve built the strongest squad!

title: Treasure Simulator
short_description: Search the world for hidden treasures with untapped potential. Haggle, restore, or even forge items to turn a profit. Upgrade your skills, expand your shop, hire employees, and rise to become a master treasure hunter. Survive amid the escalating conflict between the government and rebel forces.

title: Trials Of The Void
short_description: Trials of the Void is a co-op survival crafting and base defense game for up to four players. Explore, gather, craft, and upgrade your castle by day. When night falls, the Void awakens. Defend what you've built, survive the relentless siege, and prepare to face another day.

title: Trimson
short_description: TRIMSON is a system-driven zombie survival game where you play as a rescue operative sent into infected zones to save survivors. Every injury, infection, resource, and survivor lost has lasting consequences.

title: Trolley Dilemma
short_description: Face impossible dilemmas, meet strange characters, and discover how every switch changes the story. As the trolley keeps moving, your choices will decide who you trust, who you betray, and whether you become someone you never meant to be.

title: Tropic Industry
short_description: Build your tropical industry. Grow, process, and export resources — from simple plantations to complex production chains. Optimize logistics, increase efficiency, and grow your business into a global export network.

title: Tropical Romance
short_description: At an elite academy for fruit-family heirs, Geum Gyuri, a kumquat farmer’s daughter, is drawn to a pair of polar-opposite twins—only to uncover the “rotten” truth beneath the school’s “fresh” facade.

title: Tropico 7
short_description: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

title: Trouble in Potion High
short_description: Something went terribly wrong at Potion High. The school fell into the "Non-Dimension" and was placed under quarantine. If you don't break this lockdown, you'll be stuck here forever. Your wits are your weapon. Solve twisted environmental puzzles and get out of this place.

title: Trucker Joe 2
short_description: Transport various goods to companies with your truck! Expand your fleet with trucks and trailers to keep the industry running. In this mix of simulation and strategy, you decide where companies are built—plan wisely, shorten your routes, and dominate the logistics market!

title: Tsukumo SNAP!
short_description: Every forgotten thing grows a soul. Photograph them with your grandma's ancient flip phone, befriend 161 spirits, and spin them into battle. A comedy monster-collecting RPG in a Japanese town that changes with the real calendar.

title: TsundereSQL
short_description: Type real SQL to answer each question in this anime visual novel. Every query you submit is checked against hidden data, across 224 problems in 14 modules, from your first SELECT to window functions, cohorts and messy production data. Romance can be switched off. English only.

title: Tuanbot
short_description: Create desktop companions, discover little stories in Tuan House, and enjoy playful moments with Feihuahua. Link supported Agent tools to view quotas and manage accounts. This free TuanBot demo supports up to 3 companions and does not include AI chat.

title: Tubular Tides
short_description: Grab your trusty innertube and explore a colorful world in Tubular Tides. Meet quirky locals, take on quests, fish, hunt for hidden treasure and follow your curiosity to uncover the forgotten past.

title: Tumble Tavern
short_description: Farkle with enchanted runes. Throw six dice, bank your points or push your luck, and cast the runestone that turns a losing throw around. Take on 12 tavern regulars, run the roguelite gauntlet, or pass the dice to a friend on the same screen.

title: TunaSweeper
short_description: A top-down PvE looter shooter that alternates between peaceful life at the base and dangerous expeditions. Explore for supplies, fight enemies, and decide what to take and when to return.

title: Tunnel Heist
short_description: Rent a dying laundromat next to First City Bank. Every night, dig. Haul the dirt out unseen, shore up the ceiling before it caves in, and keep quiet when the patrol car rolls by. One city block, one tunnel, one shot at the vault.

title: Turnabout Tactics
short_description: A chess puzzle game where you play both sides, no opponent, no checkmate. Each level sets its own objectives. Some pieces explode when captured, others freeze or shield the squares around them, and some move right through other pieces. Rewind freely until every objective is met at once.

title: Tutsak
short_description: Tutsak is a 1–4 player co-op horror game where you complete objectives and escape before the creature catches you. Caught? You're locked in a cell until your friends break you out. Sometimes, you can sell out a teammate instead.

title: Twelve Knots
short_description: Twelve Knots is a 2D Korean folk horror adventure. Ring a brass bell to reveal hidden traces, solve ritual puzzles, and uncover a family’s buried past in a school that leads to a village of the dead.

title: Twilight Tides : Mirage Journey
short_description: At this encounter, journey's begun. Tarot. Two worlds: apocalypse & WWII Nanyang. Love, loss, stolen fate. Choice forges destiny.

title: Twin-stick Japanese
short_description: Choose a deck, blast words, and turn correct answers into power. Shooting a word presents four choices. Pick the right one to earn a power-up and strengthen your build. Survive increasingly intense waves while mastering your Japanese, with study progress saved between runs.

title: Two Years Later
short_description: More than a visual novel: explore campus, plan each day, use an interactive phone, discover dynamic events, earn achievements, and unlock character outfits through a cosmetic gacha system that never affects the story, choices, or in-game economy. What will tomorrow be? Chose on you.

title: Type the World
short_description: Learn to type on a keyboard with all ten fingers by typing the world map. Learn geography. That’s it, that’s the game. For kids and grownups.

title: UKNON Jones - Fighters
short_description: A spin-off of the series: "UKNON Jones & Guynelk" and developed by one person. A colorful, dynamic 2.D fighting game playable locally or online with characters possessing unique and varied abilities.

title: UMBRATIO - THE ODDS ARE FIXED
short_description: Read the odds of an illegal fight circuit and bet on the matches everyone else has misjudged. Buy unreliable tips, study injuries, traits, and fight patterns, and interfere before the bell when needed. Repay your debt, buy shares, reach bigger fights, and decide whether the loser lives or dies.

title: UNDERDEEP
short_description: UNDERDEEP is an idle RPG set in a gritty, immersive fantasy world, where you can dive deep into dungeon exploration and mapping. Blending the charm of classic RPGs with modern idle mechanics, it offers a rich and thoughtful gameplay experience.

title: UNDERSKIN
short_description: Dario works in a warehouse. Tonight his mind gives in. A psychological horror roguelike in pixel art: go down into his head, pay in pills, fuse 19 weapons into 171 hybrids, with a voice that is not on your side.

title: UNDERSTAR: Dig Below, Rise Above
short_description: Dig, fly, and fight your way through a persistent 2D mining world. Find lost stars and ancient Titans, turn discoveries into new abilities, and decide how deep one more expedition should go.

title: UNSEAM
short_description: An action platformer set in a world stitched shut. Ride the cracks your attacks leave for high-speed movement, carve terrain that falls the way you cut it, and journey to recover the memories of a girl who woke from her coffin.

title: Ultimate Girlfriend Experience
short_description: Your anime girlfriend moves onto your desktop. She watches your cursor, blushes at your touch... dress her, spoil her, and see how far she lets you go.

title: Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator
short_description: Build and manage your own pet shop in a first-person simulation experience. Sell pets, place stands, decorate your store, satisfy customers, grow your business, and create the ultimate pet shop.

title: Ultracapitalism
short_description: Ultracapitalism is a company-building roguelike autobattler where cash is your health and debt is your weapon. Assemble a 10-slot board of corporate assets, customize synergies with buzzwords, and auto-battle rival founders in deterministic asynchronous boardroom combat.

title: UnPerfect World
short_description: What starts as a battle against a minor evil may ultimately lead to saving the whole world

title: Unburied
short_description: Unburied is a dark-fantasy tower-defense roguelite for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. Raise palisades and towers by day, then hold your keep by night as the dead pour in. Turn the fight with your captain's Space counter, shape your build, and survive until dawn turns them to ash.

title: Under the dead sun
short_description: The Sun is dead. Humanity survives in eternal darkness. Awaken among the corpses as Nameless, guided by a living heart. Explore a dying world, master forbidden magic, and decide what future humanity deserves.

title: Undermoon
short_description: UnderMoon is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelike RPG. Step through portals, plan your moves on a square grid, choose a race, and combine weapons and skills. Use fire, ice and lightning to shape battles, explore themed areas, face bosses and find a way out of this moonlit world.

title: Undying Soul
short_description: Undying Soul is a 2D action roguelite focused on fluid combat, character swapping, and broken build crafting. Choose your allies, combine their abilities, discover powerful synergies and adapt your playstyle to overcome deadly foes and reclaim your shattered soul.

title: Unedited Footage: The Abandoned Factory
short_description: YouTuber Junho enters an abandoned factory at night to film his next video. The footage from that night is never uploaded. Explore the dark, three-story factory, complete the shoot, and uncover its secrets in this first-person psychological horror game.

title: Unhistorical Warfare
short_description: Command 30+ historical armies across 3,000 years of warfare, from Persian spearmen to Abrams tanks, in real-time pixel-art battles where every soldier fights and flees on his own. Then deploy the anomalies: trolls, zombies, wizards, flying saucers and more!

title: Unorthodox Rules
short_description: A mystery-comedy deduction adventure inspired by Ace Attorney and Liar Game. Investigate clues, expose contradictions, and survive deadly rule-based games by turning unfair rules against your opponents.

title: Unregistered Scene
short_description: Unregistered Scene is a Minesweeper-style anomaly deduction game. As Agent 03, an insurance company agent, investigate scenes where records no longer match reality. Work with a mysterious assistant to identify anomalies and uncover hidden rules.

title: Unreported Shift
short_description: Psychological indie-horror, simulation. In the 1990s, a small Balkan border town hides dangerous secrets. When Agent Bogomir is assigned to the checkpoint, he becomes an unwilling witness to the town’s darkest mysteries - and must uncover the monster behind the evil living within it.

title: Until I Reclaim It
short_description: Set during the Japanese colonial period, this first-person visual novel follows a story where personal choices to protect a loved one conflict with the turbulent tides of the independence movement. Experience a deeply immersive historical narrative driven by consequential choices.

title: Until somewhere
short_description: WARNING! This game is harder than it looks – you’ll need to be a real go-getter. The aim is to build your shuttle and upgrade it so you can venture into the unknown depths of interstellar space. With only Lina, your faithful companion, by your side, will you have enough patience?

title: Used Car Dealer Simulator
short_description: Buy and sell used cars Find cars at the right price, add them to your dealership, and sell them for profit. Run your own car dealership Manage your car lot, organize your vehicles, and grow your business step by step.

title: Usurper
short_description: Your enemies are your weapons. Usurper puts a fresh spin on incremental space shooters. Take control of enemy ships and their firepower, grow stronger through combat and research, master new forms, and use your enemies' power against them. Ultimately, seize the Sovereign's power.

title: VECTORHYTHM
short_description: Turn rhythm into firepower in a neon bullet heaven. Time your attacks to charge Power and strengthen your weapons, build devastating synergies in Survivors mode, or chase high scores in quick Arcade runs as every song drives the fight.

title: VEKARRA
short_description: A dark-fantasy party roguelite with turn-based tactical combat on a shared timeline. Lead four heroes into the Abyss, watch most enemy attacks charge, and interrupt the killing blow. Draft skills instead of grinding levels. Lose all four and the run ends. Free demo: solo or two-player local co-op.

title: VERAKORIA
short_description: Choose your race and class, create a unique build, and battle relentless hordes in VERAKORIA. Collect experience, unlock powerful upgrades, defeat deadly bosses, and survive the escalating onslaught in this pixel-art action roguelite.

title: VIGNETTE
short_description: A first-person point-and-click psychological horror game. Only the areas illuminated by your flashlight change in appearance. The game progresses through quiet unease and puzzle-solving, without relying on jump scares. A demo is now available (approx. 20 minutes).

title: VIRSTEX ENDSTRAIN
short_description: A fast-paced 2D side-scrolling run-and-gun set in a research facility devastated by an unknown outbreak. Use eight-direction shooting, dashes, shields, smart bombs, and heavy melee attacks to survive infected trainees, mutated creatures, and powerful bosses.

title: VIRTUAL ENCORE
short_description: VTuber業界を舞台にしたビジュアルノベル。事務所マネージャー・若葉として、担当タレント・月宮エリカの初ソロライブまでの6日間を支えよう。選択肢によって物語は分岐する。その6日間の先に待つものを、あなたはまだ知らない。

title: VLCNP Story
short_description: A 2D metroidvania where you switch between Akim, a short-faced tiger, and his very long-faced friends. Punch through walls, slow foes with poison, float and fire will-o'-wisps. Recover memories to raise HP and grab rainbow seeds to power up, but hits power you down. Goofy looks, solid action!

title: VOID ARMOR: FORM DRIVE
short_description: A top-down mecha action shooter where you instantly switch between an Energy Blade, rifle, launcher, and defense system to destroy enemy machines. Close the distance to slash, attack from range, or defend against incoming fire. Clear missions, improve your performance, and aim for higher ranks.

title: VOIDHOLD: Squad Survival Roguelite
short_description: Command three troopers, a combat dog and an eagle-drone against hordes that never stop growing. Give orders, land your own shots and stack synergies until your squad shreds whole waves. A third-person roguelite across 10 biomes: hold the line at the edge of the void.

title: VPet Sort Together: Cozy Tidy Up
short_description: A cozy organizing sim for 1–4 players: sort 9,600+ virtual pet toys — egg keychains, boxed pets, watches, rings and more — onto the shelves of a pastel VPet shop. Toss, stack and tidy up the chaos together, unlock skills and perks, no timer.

title: VTC - Voice To Chat
short_description: VTC turns your voice into in-game chat messages. Hold your Push-To-Talk button, speak naturally, and VTC automatically sends your message to the game chat, helping you stay focused on the game instead of the keyboard.

title: Valley of Stability
short_description: Crash-land on a dying alien world and bring it back to life. Build automated factories, master real chemistry and nuclear physics, and terraform the atmosphere one gas at a time — while sandworms hunt the power signature of everything you build.

title: Vampolitics: Vassals of the Void
short_description: Vampolitics is a resource management RPG set in the dark and silly universe of the Space Vampires. As a Space Vampire Sovereign, you rule your failing coven from the throne room, struggling to balance your budget against the increasingly chaotic needs of your kingdom.

title: Vangrid
short_description: Vangrid is a top-down tactical shooter you can play solo or team up with friends online. Storm strongholds, hold points, escort convoys, or retake lost outposts using firepower, drivable vehicles, and active backpack skills against smart AI squads and towering bosses across ever-changing maps.

title: Vanguard's Descent
short_description: Build a three-hero party in a 3D action roguelite where you dodge attacks in real time, command your characters using powerful abilities, and combine character-specific archetypes into powerful synergies. Recruit new Vanguard and eradicate the Plagued!

title: Vault of Eras
short_description: A bullet hell shooter, dungeon crawler about robbing a pyramid that rearranges itself after every run.

title: Vauren's BeastBorn
short_description: PvP deck builder where the effects you accumulate transform. Build your deck, stack combos, and decide the exact moment your cards evolve to defeat your opponent.

title: Vehicle Game
short_description: It is a game where you gather resources, secure food, and build structures to survive to the very end.

title: Veil of Time
short_description: Raine's brother is missing, and his uncle has handed him the family sword. Fight in real time on the field, where a perfect parry drops the world to pencil, or let foes close in for turn-based battles with timed strikes. A JRPG with hand-painted maps, a 32-track score and optional voices.

title: Verdant Requiem
short_description: “SRPG in Search of Balance" On a continent where three nations’ ideals clash, what will you choose, and what will you protect? Verdant Requiem is a SRPG about a war for balance beyond good and evil, featuring detailed 2D maps, branching storylines, resource management, and elemental balance.

title: Verdreamia
short_description: A cozy gardening sim where you create the gardens of your dreams. Plant dreams in twelve places: a meadow, a conservatory, a window of stars. Tend them at your own pace, in your favorite world style, and frame the views you love into your gallery.

title: Very Very RARE
short_description: Forge turrets at the anvil and pray for Eternal. An incremental idle tower defense where every strike rolls one of 11 rarities, from Common to impossibly rare. Socket glyphs, collect relics, grow your castle and break through five regions of monsters and bosses.

title: Vestibule
short_description: Every band dreams of a tour. Yours goes through Hell. Vestibule is a doom metal roguelite deckbuilder: recruit outcasts and burnouts, chain riffs, sign cursed pacts, stack damage, and play loud enough to kill the dead.

title: Veyrasol
short_description: Veyrasol is a real-time MMO strategy game set in the Veyra Spiral galaxy. Build colonies, command fleets, forge alliances, and battle for dominance across ~120-day seasons in this free-to-play browser-born strategy experience.

title: Virtus Arenae
short_description: Choose your tribe and step into the arena. Angels, demons, specters or sylvan folk: your creatures come to life on a 5×5 board. Move them, wield your magic to reshape the battlefield and break through enemy lines to crush your opponent.

title: Vizier
short_description: The king holds the power — but the words are yours. Advise a young ruler through intrigue, war, and betrayal in a turn-based court drama, where the right counsel shapes a realm and the wrong one ends you.

title: Void Descent
short_description: Void Descent is a fast-paced bullet heaven where aggression is mandatory. Weave through swarms and maximize DPS to raise your Combat Rank or release the controls to slow time and plan your next move. Explore over 80 billion loadout combinations with weapons, elemental mods, and unlockable augments!

title: Void Forge
short_description: Void Forge is a pixel-art auto-chess game. Recruit champions, equip them with Relics, deploy your lineup. The Crimson Tyrant, Elemental Conclave, Void Cult, and more collide in your battlefield. After the World Heart shattered, you must gather heroes and uncover the truth.

title: Void Inc
short_description: Survive corporate horror in this surreal startup simulator. A dark comedy, where you drink coffee, plan, get through the day, grow the startup, manage staff and explore the company and it's dark secrets.

title: Void Strike
short_description: Shred endless waves of hostile spaceships in a 1-bit arcade survival roguelite. Build absurd weapon combos, unlock pilots, upgrade your fighter, and survive escalating dogfights against swarms, elite enemies, and colossal bosses.

title: Void Walkers X64
short_description: Your aura fights their aura. A 70-hour classic JRPG where every boss is fought twice — once for their health, once for their soul. Real-time charge-gauge combat, 183 maps, 40 hubs, and deep hybrid class trees. Sovereign C++ engine (IIRIS) iGPU compatible, 128MB VRAM floor.

title: VoltHaven
short_description: Build electric grid in small settlement. Advance from outdated generators to modern powerplants, use fossils and renewables. Accomodate growing customer base and weather changes. Farms or mines provide extra income. Map-free layout with drag-and-drop simplicity. Simulation based on european data.

title: Voltswarm
short_description: A lone robot faces an ever-growing machine swarm in this 3D bullet heaven. Weapons fire automatically. Choose your weapons, upgrades, cores, and mods wisely, then survive escalating waves of industrial chaos.

title: VoxMancer
short_description: VoxMancer is a voice-driven 3D magic PvP game where players shout their own incantations in battle. Magic is imagination made real: invoke elemental and arcane forces, shape magic with your words, and unleash dramatic, ridiculous, or panicked ideas as powerful spells or spectacular misfires.

title: Voxel Gambit
short_description: Classic chess reborn as a 3D tactical RPG. Command unique pieces based on RPG classes across procedurally generated battlefields. Manage your action points, test your units' 'effort' and survive an adaptive AI on dynamic maps. The board has evolved.

title: WARONOMY
short_description: Waronomy is a turn-based fantasy strategy conquest wargame set in a medieval magic world, where strategy is everything: raise armies, empower heroes, forge elite stacks, and annihilate rival warlords until every castle on the map is yours.

title: WBS26 Wrestling Booker Simulator
short_description: Run a wrestling promotion and book every match. Build your roster, choose champions and watch your shows in 3D. Manage contracts, rivalries, finances and backstage relationships as you shape the next generation of stars.

title: WHEN ARMIES WAVER
short_description: Break enemy morale and push the line. Command your whole army in a real-time medieval battle roguelite. Advance, defend, or retreat; choose one of three rewards to build your army; and weigh losses against risky routes to the final battle.

title: WHO THE HELL OPENED THE PORTAL?!
short_description: A funny pixel art roguelite strategy. You manage a fantasy island kingdom connected by magical portals. By day — build, gather resources, hire heroes, and dive through portals to expand into new lands. By night — defend! The same portals unleash hordes of demons straight from Hell.

title: WORJONG
short_description: Build four three-letter English words from letter tiles, one draw and one discard at a time. Just don't throw away the letter a rival needs to finish their words.

title: WORKS: Motorsport Factory
short_description: A tycoon game about building a racing factory from your garage. Scavenge, buy or design your own parts, fix cars, and climb every tier of motorsport. Balancing tight finances and decaying parts forces hard calls: repairs, upgrades, or paying the debts to keep the team alive.

title: Waderverse
short_description: Following a large-scale societal collapse, explore a crazy, disturbed world of confrontational sickos and clashing ideologies.

title: Wager of Banners
short_description: Your village is one of several on a small island, and none of the others intend to stay small. Build it out of what it already makes, sharpen a deck that reshuffles every night, and pick your fights carefully. Beaten villagers here are not killed. They are taken, and they do not come back.

title: Wall Street Tycoon
short_description: You start as an intern clicking SIGN on paperwork nobody reads. An hour later the SEC is at your door and you are deciding whether to bribe them. An incremental tycoon about how fast a small amount of money turns into a problem.

title: Wall of Symbols
short_description: A roguelite siege defense played on an alchemist's table. Spin, place, and let symbols ripen into forms your deck never held. Every neighbour feeds the next, and one transmute turns the whole board into damage.

title: Wanted Drift
short_description: Survivors on wheels: drift through police swarms, build an arsenal of automatic weapons and collect coins for new cars and permanent powerups. WANTED DRIFT is a top-down roguelite set in an endless neon city.

title: Wanxiang Corridor: Elements
short_description: Wanxiang Corridor: Elements is a 2D roguelike action shooter. Wield a bow through procedurally generated corridors, switching between Water and Ice to trigger Freeze and stun your foes. Clear rooms, pick randomized buffs, forge your build across five stages. Pixel art, a fresh run every time.

title: War in Asia
short_description: Take command of any faction in the East Asian theater of World War II (1937–1945). Govern your nation’s military, economy, and transportation through realistic simulation systems, and direct your forces via a structured chain of command across a 7 km-scale map to conduct operations.

title: Warchaic
short_description: Command your army, build your economy, and advance through the ages in Warchaic, a fast-paced online 1v1 strategy game. Deploy units, construct buildings and defenses, choose powerful cards, and outsmart your opponent to destroy their base.

title: Wardspire
short_description: Arrows won't stop a draugr. Fire won't stop a giant. Every wave in Wardspire demands a different answer - and the tower you love most is the one that gets you killed. Norse tower defense with hard counters, permanent progression and an endless mode.

title: Warehouseman
short_description: Start with a small warehouse in a rural 1990s region. Partner with brands, stock products, prepare customer orders, and deliver goods to remote areas with your own vehicle. Organize your warehouse, expand your land, and become a trusted business across the region.

title: Warix
short_description: Warix is a fast-paced 1v1 territory capture fighting game set in a dark, microscopic world. Control a glowing cybernetic nanobot, draw trails to claim turf, and destroy your rival in high-speed combat. Parry bullets, steal boost, and outsmart players online or battle a relentless solo AI.

title: Warlore
short_description: A 15-minute 11×11 board strategy duel about territory, timing, and commander powers. Place stones to control space like Go; use cards only as tactical support when the board is ready. 16 historical commanders, 30 strategy cards, 500 challenges.

title: WarmSpot
short_description: A cozy logic puzzle where every animal needs its own row, column, and hot-spring pool—and no two may touch. Solve 50 curated stages, meet adorable guests, and unwind across five scenic onsen towns.

title: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
short_description: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!

title: Warpack
short_description: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

title: Warring Kingdoms: Chronicles of War
short_description: A RPG where you build and rule a fantasy kingdom, manage resources, command large-scale battles, and use your character's abilities to change the course of war.

title: Warrior Quest
short_description: What would you say to a goblin if you could speak to it in your own words? Bribe it, lie to it, threaten it... or just chop its head off. Warrior Quest is an old-school dark-fantasy dungeon crawler where you can fight, sneak, bluff, or bargain your way through. Whatever you do, roll well!

title: Warstead
short_description: Warstead combines settlement building, resource management and tactical real-time combat. Build, trade and lead your troops. The game is still in development and is not yet finished. Multiplayer: joining is available; hosting requires special access.

title: Was Silence
short_description: Was Silence is an atmospheric 2D exploration visual novel about Ian, a guitarist as sound slips away. He meets others who have each lost a single sense, walking a world of silence together — holding on to what still remains.

title: Watch My Step!
short_description: Invisible traps, different perspectives, and only one way out! In this 2–4 player online co-op platformer, every player sees different traps. Warn each other, overcome the course together, and climb to the top of the leaderboards with your best time!

title: Watch Party: Watch the Web Together
short_description: Watch Party is a 1–16 player online social hangout where you can watch videos and browse the web with friends or strangers. Join public rooms or create a private space. Stay synchronized or watch at your own pace. Play classic board games while you hang out together.

title: Water is Heavy
short_description: Become an ordinary fish descending endlessly into the pitch-black abyss. In this 3D marine roguelite, master bubble attacks and combine diverse skills and powerful items to survive the crushing pressure of swarming enemies. At the end of the harsh abyss, what belief will you ultimately forge?

title: Waveguard
short_description: A roguelike tower defense where every run reshapes your strategy. Build your team of towers, combine more than 80 artifacts, and explore a pixel-art world while taking on ever tougher challenges and bosses.

title: Way Too Many Eggs
short_description: Way Too Many Eggs is an incremental game about turning a tiny chicken farm into egg-filled chaos. Collect eggs, grow your flock, hire helpers, crack giant eggs and unlock permanent upgrades in the skill tree!

title: Way Too Many Fish!
short_description: Way Too Many Fish! is a cozy sorting game aboard your own fishing boat. Haul the net, dump the catch on deck, and throw all 82 species of fish into the right crates.

title: Waywardens
short_description: Lead three heroes with one shared deck in a dark fantasy tactical roguelite. Play each card as an action or a chess-inspired move. Read enemy attacks, break their formation and turn a desperate hand into a winning plan. Build your company. Brave the road.

title: We Become Legion
short_description: A strategic incremental auto-battler where you grow an army, collect equipment to create powerful builds, and command battles with active abilities. Recruit diverse units, unlock permanent upgrades, and push through increasingly dangerous waves.

title: We Don't Exist
short_description: A single-player, first-person psychological horror game. You wake up in a facility where every room wants you dead and a voice records everything. The worst trap is the other subjects: trust them, betray them, sacrifice yourself? Training modes playable by two, online or in split screen.

title: We're Gonna Need More Fireballs
short_description: You're gonna need a bigger tower. Then thirty of them. A million bugs are coming down tunnels the size of a city, and the only correct answer is more fire. Burn them, rot them, feed them to hungry trees - whatever you do, don't stop casting.

title: We, situated in a parallel world ~ Parallel Hearts ~
short_description: A school-life visual novel about childhood friends, companionship, and youth. Follow Hibiki Hinata, energetic Nanase, and a colorful group of friends through 26 chapters of laughter, chaos, travel, exams, and first love. If we had never met in another world, what would this closeness become?

title: Wealth of Nations: Economic Strategy
short_description: Lead a nation through decades of political and economic challenges. Manage budgets, taxes, industry, migration, crises, and public opinion in a deep grand-strategy simulation where every decision shapes your country's future.

title: Welcome to Hell Resort!
short_description: "Hell's traffic flow is a mess." Team up with a young Enma as a former resort developer to rebuild a collapsing underworld! Extend enemy routes with corridor tiles and combine turrets, traps, and blocker units in this spatial-puzzle deckbuilding tower defense.

title: WerkstattManager – Uncle Karl's Legacy
short_description: Take over Uncle Karl's run-down backstreet garage. Investigate symptoms, spend precious time on tests—or trust your hunch—then prepare a quote, repair the car, and rebuild your reputation in this warm, nostalgic management game.

title: Westward Dash
short_description: Relive the childhood board game of Journey to the West. An ink-wash race for 1-8 players. Roll your dice to avoid peril on every space! One staff to sweep demons aside, one dash die to turn the race on its head. Solo or with friends: nothing is settled until the very last space!

title: Whale Life Simulator
short_description: Experience the life of a whale. Hit the streets, earn cash, and pour massive amounts of money into an online game. Use your maxed-out account to crush other players!

title: Whale Simulator
short_description: A livestream management sim. Lead your streamers all the way up — numbers climbing — until they stand on the national-champion stage. You're more than the operator behind the curtain. When the mood hits, you can jump in yourself, throw gifts, and fight the whole room for that number-one spot.

title: What Killed Rachel
short_description: A story-driven psychological horror that chases the truth behind Rachel's death. As you follow scattered memories, you slowly come face to face with the reality of the tragedy. Blaming someone is easy. But answering what truly killed her is not.

title: What Was Lost
short_description: A two-player online co-op puzzle game. One of you plays Ben in the family house as it was, the other plays Lily in the same house years later. You can only see your own timeline, so you solve it by talking. Chapters 1 to 4 in Early Access, with Chapters 5 to 7 coming in free updates.

title: What Was That?!
short_description: A cozy-spooky roguelite deckbuilder where you play as a household pet exploring a home full of mysterious encounters after dark.

title: What a Shift!
short_description: What a Shift! is a chaotic top-down restaurant management roguelite. Serve burgers, fries and drinks, survive growing queues and disasters, choose upgrades each run, then spend your earnings on permanent improvements before jumping back into another shift.

title: Wheat Awn: Line Zero
short_description: Wheat Awn: Line Zero is a single-player military strategy game about raising an army for the next impossible battle. Earn Star Coins in the Live-Fire Trial, recruit officers, buy supplies, expand your formation, master tactical cards at the Academy, then take Line Zero into 15 boss warzones.

title: Wheel Street
short_description: Wheel Street is a roguelike deckbuilder on a circular board. Move and merge assets, combine strategy cards, and build a money-making machine. Grow on down days, cash in on up days, and unleash combos to beat rising weekly targets.

title: When the Day Comes
short_description: When the Day Comes is a brutal top-down online survival game where daylight is your greatest enemy. Build, craft, scavenge, fight zombies and hostile players, expand your settlement, and survive in an endless procedurally generated world where every day could be your last

title: When the Embers Wake
short_description: When the Embers Wake is a third person narrative adventure about Emmie and the relationship with her mother. You play as a red panda as their story unfolds, raising awareness of the urgent and very real threats facing wildlife today.

title: Where is my sword
short_description: A mismatched duo—a wicked demon god and a kind-hearted fox girl—is gathering followers!? Travel across many lands and survive hectic yet strategic real-time battles by rummaging through your bag for just the right item! Fight your foes or turn them into followers... What awaits at journey's end?

title: Whispering Eclipsia
short_description: A first-person psychological horror detective thriller. Play as Inspector Keshav, investigate a mysterious murder, interrogate suspects, uncover disturbing evidence, and confront the terrifying secrets hidden within Woods Lane. But beware—some truths are better left buried.

title: White Christmas
short_description: Multiplayer for up to 16 players: roll ever-growing snowballs, build snowmen and start snowball fights. Explore a snowy village with a Christmas market, go sledding, ice skating or ice fishing. A cozy winter sandbox you can also play solo.

title: White Whisper
short_description: An unknown signal. A silent ship. Only traces of the crew and empty corridors remain on the Sentinel. As Elara Wynn, you investigate what happened—and why the last transmission was a desperate distress call from the depths of space...

title: Who Am I
short_description: Lost in amnesia, face a horrific past rising from nightmares. Uncover the truth hidden in a diary. In this psychological horror where reality and hallucination blur, piece together memories before madness consumes you. When the truth is out, ask yourself: Who was I?

title: Who Is Wrong
short_description: Everyone enters the same room but sees different things. You have to find every difference before time runs out! The only thing you can trust is what your friends tell you. 2-4 player horror - anomaly hunting game. So — how much can you really trust your friend?

title: Who Pressed It?!
short_description: A chaotic 2–4 player co-op puzzle game. Work together to solve test rooms, interact with giant buttons, and try not to press the wrong thing. Every mistake sends the facility further into chaos!

title: Widget Idle
short_description: Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness :)

title: Wild Crazy 8s
short_description: The Crazy Eights roguelike. Every 8 is wild: call the suit, keep the chain alive, and cash out monster combos. Build decks that bend the rules, stack House Rules that multiply each other, and break the casino one floor at a time.

title: Wild East: The Straw Man
short_description: 1993, just after Czechoslovakia split in two. Play as reporter Marek and investigate the death of a company director in name only. In Prague, journalist Eva pursues a case of her own. Explore locations, read documents, and uncover where their cases meet in a classic 2D point-and-click mystery.

title: Wild Heroes: Fight Together
short_description: Team up with up to 3 friends in an online co-op action roguelite. Carve a path into the living Wild, battle monster packs in bramble arenas, topple three colossal bosses and come back stronger after every expedition.

title: Wild Spirits Era
short_description: Wild Spirits Era is a multiplayer PvPvE battle royale with roguelite progression. Up to 50 Spirits enter a new world for each 28-minute Era. Gather Vital Energy, build, fight and form alliances. Your actions shape your class. Only Spirits protected by a Relic endure when the world ends.

title: Wildfire Command '98
short_description: The year is 1998 and you're the Air Attack Supervisor. Read the wind, the slope and the fuel, then draw the lines your tankers and helicopters will fly. Eleven authored fires, endless generated incidents, two-player co-op, and a shareable replay of every run.

title: Wildixir
short_description: Wildixir is a fantasy survivor roguelite about dangerous alchemy. Combine automatic spells, dodge growing hordes, and turn cleansed shrines into healing groves or deadly gardens. Unlock alchemists and confront the bosses of three corrupted lands.

title: Wildmane: Blood Bay
short_description: Your horse lives on your wallpaper. She grazes behind your windows, wanders across every monitor, and comes when you call. Usually. Ignore her long enough and she'll let you know how she feels about it. Pet her, play with her, fence her in. She is not productive and she is not sorry.

title: Wildmark
short_description: A cozy idle RPG in an illustrated woodland. Chop, forage, fish, mine, craft and chart through eleven gentle skills, raise a homestead building by building, explore a map of islands above the clouds, and defend the wilds with your companions, even while you're away.

title: Wirehawk
short_description: Wirehawk is a neon vector shmup in the spirit of 80s arcade classics. Play it your way: razor-sharp mouse control, or a dedicated controller mode rebalanced for the stick. Blast asteroids and alien waves, dodge bullet storms, slow time with stasis. Autofire always on.

title: Wisp: Elemental Conflict
short_description: You start as a simple neutral Wisp. Absorb elemental motes, add elemental effects and strengthen your abilities, build your power, and survive a world that's already at war with itself. 12 elements. 11 abilities. 12 bosses. Permanent progression. Every run, a new chance.

title: Witch Hunt 0
short_description: "Witch Hunt 0" is a magic-focused, stage-based boss rush 3D action game. Take on the role of the witch Astera. To reclaim her lost powers, she must craft spells, tame defeated enemies as familiars, and conquer the formidable foes that stand in her way.

title: Witch of Oz
short_description: Turn poker hands into magic in this card-puzzle adventure. Form spell patterns on a 3×3 grid, overlap them for powerful combos, and experiment with items and card enchantments. Explore a pixel-art Oz with Dorothy and use your magic to help her companions.

title: Witch's Last Curse
short_description: A text-based dark fantasy: Your master is dead, her thorns are eating the town, and the town blames you. 100 days, a few actions each day is all you have to fix the issue. Work, gossip, make friends, steal, and learn which ingredients the ritual requires.

title: WizKitty and the Tower of Doom, Gloom, and Other Bad Stuff
short_description: Craft ridiculous loot in a roguelike deckbuilder where your deck doesn’t attack, it builds the weapon that does. Upgrade, reroll, and stack modifiers as you climb the tower and bully RNG into giving you the perfect item.

title: Wizard Jars: Tidy Up Together
short_description: Wizard Jars is a cozy solo and co-op sorting game where you organize 3,240 magical jars in a chaotic apothecary. Put every jar back on its shelf, fulfill magical customer requests, unlock useful upgrades, and restore the apothecary to perfect order

title: Wizard of Maths
short_description: Conquer your maths anxiety and build numerical confidence through fun and challenging quests! Wizard of Maths is a JRPG-inspired, research-backed arithmetic adventure that helps you unlock your inner “human calculator,” whether you’re a child learning the basics or an adult sharpening your skills.

title: Wizard’s Path: Palette of Spells
short_description: A survivors-like action roguelite where you discover your class through the spells you choose. Transform into one of 470+ mages, unlock them for future runs, bend the rules with 30+ runes, raise other players' fallen mages, and climb the Endless leaderboards.

title: Wizzy the Wood
short_description: Wizzy the Wood is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a forest creature on a quest to reclaim the Stone of Eternity from an evil sorcerer and save your tribe.

title: Woks & Works
short_description: Build and automate your restaurant empire. Manage chefs, customers, supplies, and production chains in a living food economy.

title: Wonderland Gacha House: Muster
short_description: A casual bullet-hell roguelite with character collection and a progression system. Collect adorable Figurines, gear up through equipment Gacha, and use everyday items to battle powerful Bosses. No in-app purchases, duplicates, or fragment systems.

title: Word Link
short_description: Guess the 12 hidden words on every board using definitions, rhymes, emojis and facts. Play solo, survive endless escalating waves, or battle friends on the couch, where phones become the controllers. Fully playable in English and Arabic.

title: WordMaxed
short_description: Build words, bend multipliers, and fill every corner in this strategic word game. Play solo, challenge the AI, pass and play, or battle 2-4 friends online across quick 5x5 and classic 10x10 boards, plus Daily Challenges and leaderboards.

title: Words In Place
short_description: A spatial word puzzle: drag shaped letter pieces onto a cluttered grid and uncover hidden category words. Crossword-style intersections mean one placement can complete several words at once. Fit the pieces. Find the words. Feel the click.

title: Wordy Space
short_description: Type to blast space threats, defeat bosses, and upgrade your ship. Chase high scores in Classic, play to the beat in Beat the Beat, or translate words across languages in Polyglot.

title: World Resetter
short_description: World Resetter is a CRPG featuring real-time strategy controls and ARPG loot mechanics. Command a squad of up to 5 unique characters as you explore a vast world and interact with dynamic NPCs. Defeat powerful foes, craft deep attribute builds, and uncover the truth behind the world.

title: World of Slime
short_description: World of Slime is a casual MMORPG where you capture, collect, and grow with all kinds of slimes. Find new slimes through field capture, synthesis, and fishing, then take them with you into battles, exploration, and puzzles.

title: Worldkampf '72
short_description: Worldkampf is a 4X real-time grand strategy game set in a fractured 1970s interstellar empire. As an upstart noble following the Kaiser's assassination, develop tile-based economies, command battle walkers and combined-arms armies, and conquer a handcrafted universe to claim the throne.

title: Wretched Tales:Cinderella
short_description: A familiar Cinderella fairy tale is twisted into a grotesque puzzle adventure. Observe static 2D scenes, interpret the hidden reactions of objects, and complete the cruel procedure that leads to the ball.

title: Wuxing - Elemental Array Poker
short_description: Poker hands aren't just played here — they're placed. Drop each card onto a 3×3 altar where the Five Elements feed and fight their neighbors, cascading multipliers across the board. A roguelike deckbuilder about space, not sequence.

title: XENOFALL
short_description: A single-player anime action roguelite on a ravaged Earth. Slash and shoot through alien horrors across hostile stages, stack game-breaking item synergies, and master 5 fighter classes. Every run is different. Every death makes you stronger.

title: Xenobiome Command
short_description: Build a colony on a fungal alien world and keep it alive. Explore the fog, expand across the map, exploit the land, and exterminate the alien packs before they reach your people. Xenobiome Command goes hard - from planetfall to last stand.

title: Xenogarden
short_description: Xenogarden is a dark sci-fi strategy game where you spread an alien swarm, build synapse nodes, defend your core, and overwhelm human defenders before they destroy your living network and cut the invasion apart.

title: Xenomire
short_description: XENOMIRE is a 2D sci-fi horror extraction shooter. Descend to a contaminated alien planet, complete contracts, gather loot, and extract before the horrors lurking there tear you apart. Upgrade your gear and create unique builds for each high-risk expedition.

title: Xenowave Survivor
short_description: Survive alien hordes across hostile planets. Choose your hero, unlock talent-tree pets, build your deck of stat cards between waves, and deploy tactical gadgets in real time. Master elemental synergy alone or in local & online co-op

title: Xydorth
short_description: In search of your wife, you must descend into the darkness of a vast cave system. But with every step deeper, your descent becomes a journey into your own personal hell. Xydorth is a dark first-person shooter with survival horror elements.

title: YOU IN?
short_description: Break into a hostile system alone or with a friend in a fast top-down bullet-hell roguelite. Read the patterns, swap weapons and gear, shape your build with Traits, and steal a signature attack from every boss.

title: Yathsel
short_description: Yathsel is a Wild West dice roguelite: play crooked Yahtzee-style hands, sneak loaded artifact dice from the smuggler under the table, and cheat your way past gunslinging rivals in a solo campaign, quick duels, and online saloons with ranked 1v1 for up to 8 players.

title: Yokai Idle
short_description: Yokai Idle is a relaxing idle RPG inspired by Japanese folklore. Collect over 50 Yokai, craft equipment with powerful modifiers, and create unique builds as you progress through the historical Ages of Japan and guide the island of Onigashima into a new era 🎎

title: Yorick: Worlds in Bloom
short_description: Play as a little reaper who turns death into life. Harvest energy from a forgotten world, transform barren landscapes into colorful ecosystems, and uncover hidden marvels in a cozy exploration adventure."

title: Yukizuki no Seisou
short_description: High school student Kusaka Sousuke, who has faint precognition, visits Yukizuki during winter break—a town haunted by rumors of ghosts and mysterious disappearances. In the snow-covered town, he meets the mysterious girl he saw in a dream… An adventure-type visual novel from VODALES.

title: ZERO KNOWLEDGE
short_description: A single-player cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder where one card can turn a 4×4 board. Build your deck, set up chains of captures, and follow the evidence through hostile networks to expose the intelligence framing you.

title: ZeroEco
short_description: A psychological horror narrative game in pixel art about routine, memory, and the fear of change. Explore, interpret, and uncover what lies hidden within yourself.

title: Zili Diary escape against witch
short_description: Zili Diary is a psychological horror visual novel. Explore a cursed mall, make life-or-death choices, and fight to survive. Every action costs a piece of your soul.

title: Zombie Car: Kaiju Killer
short_description: Mow down relentless zombie hordes, turn carnage into cash, and upgrade your war rig into an unstoppable death machine! In this action-packed incremental roguelite, every run brings you closer to facing colossal Kaiju bosses. Gear up, smash through, and dominate!

title: Zombie Cropse
short_description: Zombie Cropse is a cozy gothic idle management game where you plant zombie seeds to grow zombies, automate your graveyard, and raid the living. Build your horde, conquer a branching campaign, and ascend to begin again with permanent power.

title: Zombie Day Protocol
short_description: Activate beacons, summon the horde, and shoot your way out! Survive a 25-day train journey in this first-person zombie shooter. Return aboard between battles to gear up and shape your build. Fulfill a mysterious company's contract and reach the survivors' camp alive.

title: Zombie Fish Tank
short_description: Devour smaller fish, grow stronger, and climb the food chain as an immortal zombie fish hungry for revenge. Explore 40 hand-drawn levels, collect temporary powers, battle challenging bosses, and eat your way through more than 80 fish species.

title: Zombie Horde Survivors
short_description: Zombie Horde Survivors is a 2D pixel-art top-down bullet heaven shooter. Survive in a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by a biochemical outbreak. Upgrade your gear, strengthen your body, break through waves of zombies, and fight to the end!

title: Zombie Hospital : Abandoned
short_description: [Zombie Hospital : Abandoned] is a survival horror game that combines exploration, puzzle-solving, and crafting. You set out alone to investigate a disappearance that occurred in an abandoned hospital. Craft tools and medicine from limited resources and fight to survive against zombies.

title: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
short_description: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats challenges you to rescue 100 cats that survived the zombie outbreak and are hiding in abandoned streets! Find them, click carefully, use clues wisely, race against time, and climb to the top of the global leaderboard!

title: Zombie Princess
short_description: Raise a daughter infected with a zombie virus in this dark fantasy raising simulation. Over 5 years, balance your daily care in secret with dangerous expeditions. Will you cure her humanity, or help her rise as an immortal zombie queen? Discover over 60 unique endings!

title: Zombie Warz
short_description: Zombie Warz is a tower defense RTS game with rogue-lite gameplay elements. Play as the king of a kingdom under siege by zombies and survive to discover their origins.

title: Zombie Wrap Simulator: Grill the Dead
short_description: The apocalypse continues, and survivors still need to eat. In Zombie Wrap Simulator you run a kebab shop serving fresh veggies, smooth sauces and… questionable meat. Grill meals, deliver food to shelters and defend your place at night from furious Zomboners.

title: Zone Idle
short_description: An incremental extraction simulator set in a ruthless world inspired by the extraction genre and book Roadside Picnic. Manage your inventory, navigate hazardous events, and upgrade your hideout. Same tension, but with time to think.

title: Zorezdra
short_description: Zorezdra is a sci-fi platformer/metroidvania with a retro graphical aesthetic. Run, jump, fight and glide your way through a vast starport as you search for the truth about your protagonist's complex origins.

title: bet you won't
short_description: You're a livestream unboxer. Your audience wants you to open the next package. The killer wants you dead. Inspect suspicious deliveries, uncover hidden clues, and survive a series of terrifying events—all while keeping your stream alive. Would you open the next box?

title: content moderator.
short_description: Eidopathy is a disease in which hallucinations spread through photographs. To pay for your mother's surgery, you apply for a suspicious part-time job as a Content Moderator, deleting photos containing hallucinations. Make it out of the anomalous office alive.

title: hexGame: Hero Path
short_description: The world needs a hero — choose yours. Any NPC can become the chosen one. Explore a living, procedurally generated hex world, carve your own path, craft unique combinations of weapons, tools, and relics, and fight through relentless hordes in fast-paced combat. Every run is different.

title: memory cafe
short_description: A cosy woodland café where you understand every customer. Brew, garden and decorate — but the real work is noticing what each animal isn't saying. Serve thirty regulars, earn their trust, and fill a storybook with the stories they've never told anyone.

title: pond thing
short_description: PondThing is a micro-horror narrative puzzle game. It follows Shen Qingheng, a narcissistic young man who is drawn into a sacrificial ritual. As his mind grows numb and begins to break down, he is ultimately saved by his family’s “love.”

title: s[TOR-Y]telling: Closed Loop
short_description: Shape a cinematic visual novel through conversations with AI characters. Explore 50 built-in stories and create your own. Run AI on your compatible GPU with no usage fees, or choose optional Cloud AI using credits.

title: the Cellarer
short_description: The Cellarer is a medieval automation city builder. Every good your monastery needs travels by cart, along the paths you lay between its workshops. Grow it plot by plot, from a humble cloister to a cathedral.

title: いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -
short_description: 『いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -』は、探索するほど老いていく、孤島館ホラーADV。若さを奪う館の真相を暴き、偽装工作で敵を欺き、崩れゆく島から脱出せよ。

title: お洒落無限ループ　すごろくドリフター
short_description: Stylish Infinite Loop! Sugoroku Drifter is a roguelike where you build the board itself as your deck and aim for each stage's target score. Customize pieces, collect Relics from bosses, and find powerful combinations to overcome ever-tougher goals!

title: ぺちぺちハクスラ
short_description: A hack-and-slash RPG where you defeat monsters, gather materials, and grow stronger through equipment crafting and skills. The more you upgrade, the faster your material farming becomes! Watching your stats steadily rise is irresistibly addictive!

title: 万剑之残破修仙界
short_description: "The Broken Cultivation World of Ten Thousand Swords" is a portrait‑mode wuxia single‑player game from an indie developer. Featuring gorgeous combat visuals, its idle‑style gameplay focuses on item gathering. Every idle grind prepares for thrilling high‑damage bursts in turn‑based xianxia battles.

title: 三天 Three Days
short_description: A narrative visual novel adapted from real life. Three days before his baby is born, a first-time father learns what it means to become one. Ordinary days, unspoken words, and choices that reshape his bond with his wife and family. About one hour per playthrough.

title: 仙路烟尘
short_description: Path of Immortal Dust is a text-based cultivation sim. Train your techniques, break through realms, and explore a world of sect politics and turn-based combat. Every action costs time. Every choice shapes your fate. Immortality is but a thought away.

title: 侠影痴剑录
short_description: 《侠影痴剑录》是一款武侠剧情冒险游戏，故事讲述南北朝末年至隋朝统一这段动荡乱世中的江湖传奇。 在战乱频仍、王朝更迭的时代，四位年轻人因战争征发、官府苛政、权贵构陷、王朝篡逆的不同境遇，被迫卷入乱世风暴，机缘巧合下聚首并肩，并最终亲历天下归一的历史洪流。

title: 别人家孩子都筑基了！ You Can Do Better!
short_description: Cultivate, study, and work through a modern-day life. Choose techniques and set their order before automatic battles. When a life ends, leave a final wish and pass your legacy to the next generation. How many generations will it take to ascend? A demo is available now.

title: 变废为宝 Trash to Cash
short_description: Trash to Cash – a satisfying, surprising incremental trash-diving game. Rummage for treasure, and maybe you'll become the next Trash King!

title: 呪ショッピング
short_description: You are shopping on a major online store when strange listings gradually begin to appear. The more you look into them, the more clearly the whole picture of a crime comes into view…

title: 喵呜风云
short_description: Hang a battlefield on your desktop and let your soldier fight and grow automatically. Plan talents, buy gear, refine builds, and use APM to boost combat speed. Team up with friends for ranked battles, chase higher KDA and scores, and find out who is best at “strategic slacking” during work.

title: 墨守
short_description: 東洋ハイファンタジーの世界で、防衛成功まで何度も時を巻き戻す高難易度２Ｄタワーディフェンス。 さらにゲーム内のステージ作成機能により、プレイヤーの数だけ終わりないステージが待っている。

title: 多元幸存者 Diverse survivors
short_description: Diverse survivors is a 2D top-down solo ARPG horde survival game. Fight monster swarms, enchant single skills, loot random affix gear and unlock set bonuses with full armor sets. Make unique builds, explore multiverse dungeons alone and grow strong with gear enchantment systems.

title: 天坑追匪
short_description: A scientific expedition team composed of Chinese and foreign researchers fell into a sinkhole due to an accident, and the entire team mysteriously lost contact. As the captain of the emergency search and rescue mission, you will overcome numerous obstacles and confront the unknown fate head-on

title: 孤狼之春
short_description: This is a true-harem galgame set in a Western fantasy world.

title: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn
short_description: A Japanese horror-mystery. Trapped in an inn room, you survive by obeying rules that grow every night. By morning, use the guest register to learn who the earlier guests were and how they died. The rules never lie, but some nights something not in them arrives disguised as something that is.

title: 崇祯模拟器
short_description: 1644—the Ming Dynasty is collapsing. Rebels close on Beijing, Manchu armies at the gates, the treasury empty. As Chongzhen, China's last emperor, you command AI-driven ministers who flatter, scheme, and defy you. Rewrite history—or fall as the records say?

title: 巫师牌《Wizard Cards》
short_description: Explore a world of builds in this dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Combine class cards, tactics, blessings and card growth to stack damage and multipliers. Adapt to random shops and boss modifiers across nine acts and 27 battles, discovering new synergies each run.

title: 幻想进度条 Fantasy Bar
short_description: Fantasy Progress Bar is a medieval fantasy idle mobile game. Enjoy effortless AFK and free class switching, alongside mythical beast nurturing, equipment forging and mount exploration. You don’t need to keep your screen on — progress continues even offline.

title: 幻想郷大激突 : Touhou Impact
short_description: 幻想郷大激突 : Touhou Impact is an unofficial Touhou Project fan game. Youkai have appeared—far too many of them. This is clearly an incident, but don't worry. In Gensokyo, the answer is simple: beat them all up first, then find the culprit later.

title: 弈统三国：三国五子棋
short_description: Three Kingdoms Gomoku combines classic Gomoku with Three Kingdoms themes and general skills. You can freely build decks from various factions, utilize generals' abilities to create brilliant tactical combos, and enjoy the unique fun of skill-based Gomoku.

title: 弾幕の戦乙女 -Barrage of Valhalla-
short_description: A bullet-hell shoot 'em up meets hack-and-slash RPG. Become a valkyrie, weave through neon barrages under a sky of iron, hunt loot, forge gear, and fish, farm, cook between sorties. Can't dodge? Grind through it. Can? Chase top ranks. No stamina, no pay-to-win — buy once, play it all.

title: 我的女友是杀手
short_description: 高中生秦越有一个愿望——安稳过完高中。然而转校生铃木静的出现打乱了这份计划。沉默寡言、身手利落的她，自称是来“保护”他的。还没等他消化这一切——八卦的百事通、骄纵的大小姐、深不可测的学生会长，以及那位笑容迷人却暗藏锋芒的美女老师……一段交织着谜团、守护与心动的恋爱喜剧，就此开幕！

title: 挂机传奇
short_description: idle ARPG. Auto-battle through treacherous dungeons for endless loot! Mix warrior, mage, and taoist skills, craft mythic gear in ancient forges, climb demon towers, and explore mythical mazes. Enjoy full offline gains—your hero never stops fighting!

title: 方块战场 Block Battlefield
short_description: 《方块战场 Block Battlefield》 is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat. By clearing blocks, you can deploy soldiers, choose random upgrades, and break through enemy fortresses. Build your block army and push your limits on an ever-changing battlefield!

title: 无人归家
short_description: Read immersive dialogue sequences, make crucial choices to shift the storyline, and unlock multiple distinct endings in this story-focused visual novel. Your decisions alter character relationships and rewrite the fate of every role.

title: 日本四季百景
short_description: Explore the scenery and culture of Japan's Chugoku region in a single-player puzzle journey. Enjoy spot-the-difference puzzles, jigsaws, and quizzes across five prefectures.

title: 明末：力挽狂澜
short_description: 正在尝试让地图大战略+AI模拟结合，看看能碰撞出怎样的火花，游戏支持传统大战略地图策略模拟的大部分要素，同时让AI替代了核心的摇骰子阶段，让游戏的自由度更上一层楼。科技，国策，人物，势力以及几乎所有的一切，不再局限于开发者的预设条目和节点。

title: 星月大陆：放置帝国
short_description: A retro pixel-art idle RPG with strategic team-building and hero collection. All heroes and resources obtained via exploration and offline gains. Features free draws, gear sets, achievement perks, and Steam-exclusive daily bonuses. Perfect for casual solo idle fans.

title: 最强仙门
short_description: This is a sect management simulation game. It features over 200 manuals for learning skills, more than 600 NPCs to interact with and explore, and 1,200+ divine artifacts for combat—not to mention an endless supply of procedurally generated gear.

title: 東方連珠
short_description: An online battle game where you place girls from Gensokyo like in a game of Go! However, since the goal is to compete based on how well they get along, you can only win when the girls next to each other are friends. Enjoy the strategies created by their abilities and relationships!

title: 汪里个狼 Wolf in Woof
short_description: Wolf in Woof is a single-player Werewolf game where wolves hide among cute dog NPCs. Through speech, suspicion, alliances, voting, and deduction, players must uncover the hidden wolves—enjoying tense mind games without matchmaking or social pressure.

title: 渔乐圈
short_description: 工作学习时，你的鱼塘正自动运转：鱼竿挂机钓鱼，员工打理渔场，顾客岸边垂钓。 慢慢扩建渔场，从钓台到茶座，雇人管理、研究鱼饵引稀鱼。偶尔点开，或许能撞见锦鲤上钩，员工在换水。 经营越用心，渔场越热闹，成你屏幕里的悠闲小天地 —— 随时来 “摸鱼” 呀。

title: 灵劫变
short_description: 《灵劫变》是一款开放世界玄幻修仙角色扮演游戏。你可以使用自己的专属形象在数万格的手工地图中不断探索全新机缘，体验蝴蝶效应般的非线性剧情与红尘情缘。除却驾驭灵兽与法宝进行策略战斗，你还能开辟洞府、经营宗门，甚至与道侣建立家族，亲自培养下一代天骄，开启有温度的修真之路。

title: 疾风群侠传
short_description: 《疾风群侠传》是一款武侠题材的多周目养成Roguelike游戏。在不断推进的江湖岁月中，自由修炼武学，加入风栖谷或凌霄门，踏上截然不同的门派道路。邂逅多位性格各异的红颜，在随机见闻、奇遇抉择与生死战斗中积累实力，探寻身世之谜，决定正邪立场，谱写独属于你的侠客传奇。

title: 神明游戏
short_description: Game of Gods is a cross-genre team-building battle sim. Historical generals, basketball stars, footballers, anime and video game characters clash across themes. Choose your roster, assign positions, combine abilities and bonds, then let the rules-driven simulation decide how they fight and who wins.

title: 程序员的刻板印象
short_description: For years, society has held many stereotypes about the programming profession. In this life simulation game, players can experience a programmer's journey from university to career development. Whether a programmer's life truly matches public perception can be discovered by trying it out.

title: 窗台世界（Sill World）
short_description: A desktop wallpaper engine, a catgirl companion, and a focus tool. Grow flowers, keep fish, decorate, and press flowers, with over 1,000 collectibles. Almost everything is yours to customize. Your wallpaper, your rules!

title: 紀事盆栽 Potted Archive
short_description: Potted Archive is an idle desktop companion blending sci-fi storytelling with plant cultivation. Grow over 20 exotic plants in a transparent, low-energy window. As they evolve, unlock diary entries to uncover an epic tale of interstellar exile right from your screen.

title: 終末生徒 The Last Student：Showa Era Radio Room
short_description: A Showa-era school, a radio room at night. In a building where you are not alone, you repeat broadcasts. Strange responses return. Records change, unknown logs grow. Reality begins to erode, and the story twists through your choices. Ten endings await.

title: 緋修羅 HIJURA SCARLET GEAR
short_description: A chaotic, mad run-and-gun! Flamethrowers, homing, double jumps, invincible dashes—all here! As Hijura with a Scarlet Gear, destroy the "Dokugan" horde! 35-year dev Zorge Ichizo's "AI-Toxic" showdown with AI. Will I dance to the AI's tune, or will my individuality win? See for yourself!

title: 红楼梦华录 Red Chamber Chronicle
short_description: Red Chamber Chronicle is a classical Chinese life simulation and visual novel with multiple endings. You play as Jia Baoyu in the Grand View Garden, where daily life, relationships, and choices shape your branching story and different outcomes.

title: 美偶人 Puppet
short_description: A first-person 3D survival horror game. You wander into this eerie space. Deranged puppets and a tall phantom chase you relentlessly. You have to tread carefully with every step and stay out of their sight. Explore the surroundings, use items and clues from notes, and strive to escape this nightmare

title: 迷失小镇
short_description: Lost Town is a 3D roguelike survival shooter. Play as an armed girl in a corrupted abandoned town. Maps are random. Fight mutant hordes, earn XP, unlock random skills and upgrades, and build unique combat styles. Each run changes; death restarts. Find the escape route and uncover the town's secret.

title: 這遺虚配信
short_description: Photograph and repel the monsters that appear in the abandoned hotel using a mysterious camera! Uncover the mysteries surrounding the abandoned hotel by relying on comments from your viewers! Use the Super Chats you receive to buy items and gain the upper hand in battle!

title: 郑成功传 Clash of Armadas: Koxinga
short_description: Auto Chess +Tower Defense + Naval Battle Choose from the legendary captains of the Age of Sail – Blackbeard, Francis Drake, Horatio Nelson, Zheng Chenggong… and more. Command 10+ ships. Position your fleet. Broadside fire. Enemies come in waves on fixed routes.

title: 释魂日志
short_description: Soul Protocol is a workplace suspense visual novel. You're the only one in the building who can hear the dead. By day you grind; by night you help five ghosts recover their memories. A 14-day countdown has begun—and every choice is a verdict only you can deliver.

title: 重构人生 Project Refactor
short_description: Every choice comes with loss. This is no power fantasy, but a ten-year reckoning with ambition, class, pride, and reality. Plan each week, face relentless comparison and locked paths, and find out what remains when you finally stop trying to become someone else.

title: 银心
short_description: Introverted high school student Moon sets out to find her missing friend Galacora, only to discover that she may be nothing more than a figment of her imagination. As her world unravels, Moon journeys through strange realities in search of the friend she longs to see again...

title: 門 GATE
short_description: A Japanese psychological horror game set in 1980s Japan. Travel to the past after a nuclear war and prepare for the coming battle against AI machines using cursed powers, strange devices, and experimental technology.

title: 阴阳妖怪
short_description: Creature collection + text AVG + adventure! Catch 200+ unique yokai, meet distinct companions in a story of conflicts, feelings and secrets. Kincyo, town of human-yokai harmony, is in crisis. Team up with Miumiu to expose the villain—you hold its fate.

title: 魑魅：离人之歌
short_description: Ghosts: The Song of the Departed will take you into the mysterious ancient village. Here, you will assume a police officer who understands the balance of yin and yang. You can investigate stories such as missing women, exterminated clans, live burials, and the pursuit of immortality.
